lg.l: rnityaṃ yasya vaco na durnayakṛtaiḥ kolāhalairlupyate |
rāgadveṣamukhā dviṣāṃ ca pariṣat kṣiptā kṣaṇādyena sā

doc.p:
iha hi viṣamaduḥṣamārarajanitimiratiraskārabhāskarānukāriṇā
vasudhātalāvatīrṇasudhāsāriṇīdeśyadeśanāvitānaparamārhatīkṛtaśrī--
kumārapālakṣmāpālapravartitābhayadānābhidhānajīvātusaṃjīvitanānā-
jīvapradattāśīrvādamāhātmyakalpāvadhisthāyiviśadayaśaḥśarīreṇa ni-
ravadyacāturvidyanirmāṇaikabrahmaṇā śrīhemacandrasūriṇā jagatprasiddhaśrī-
siddhasenadivākaraviracitadvātriṃśaddvātriṃśikānusāriśrīvardhamānaji-
nastutirūpamayogavyavacchedānyayogavyavacchedābhidhānaṃ dvātriṃśi-
kādvitayaṃ vidvajjanamanastattvāvabodhanibandhanaṃ vidadhe | tatra ca prathama-
dvātriṃśikāyāḥ sukhonneyatvādvyākhyānamupekṣya dvitīyasyāstasyā
niḥśeṣadurvādipariṣadadhikṣepadakṣāyāḥ katipayapadārthavivaraṇakaraṇena
svasmṛtibījaprabodhavidhirvidhīyate | tasyāścedamādikāvyam--
anantavijñānamatītadoṣa--
mabādhyasiddhāntamamartyapūjyam |
śrīvardhamānaṃ jinamāptamukhyaṃ
svayaṃbhuvaṃ stotumahaṃ yatiṣye || 1 ||

śrīvardhamānaṃ jinamahaṃ stotuṃ yatiṣya iti kriyāsaṃbandhaḥ | kiṃ-
viśiṣṭam | anantamapratipāti viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadravyaparyāyaviṣayatve-
notkṛṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ kevalākhyaṃ vijñānaṃ tatonantaṃ vijñānaṃ yasya sonanta-
vijñānastam | tathātītā niḥsattākībhūtatvenātikrāntā doṣā rā-
gādayo yasmātsa tathā tam | tathābādhyaḥ parairbādhitumaśakyaḥ
siddhāntaḥ syādvādaśrutalakṣaṇo yasya sa tathā tam | tathāmartyā
devāsteṣāmapi pūjyamārādhyam ||

atra ca śrīvardhamānasvāmino viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa catvāro mūlāti-
śayāḥ pratipāditāḥ | tatrānantavijñānamityanena bhagavataḥ kevala-
jñānalakṣaṇaviśiṣṭajñānānantyapratipādanājjñānātiśayaḥ | atīta-
doṣamityanenāṣṭādaśadoṣasaṃkṣayābhidhānādapāyāpagamātiśayaḥ | a-
bādhyasiddhāntamityanena kutīrthikopanyastakuhetusamūhāśakyabādha-
syādvādarūpasiddhāntapraṇayanabhaṇanādvacanātiśayaḥ | amartyapūjyami-
tyanenākṛtrimabhaktibharanirbharasurāsuranikāyanāyakanirmitamahāprā-
tihāryasaparyāparijñāṣanātpūjātiśayaḥ ||

atrāha paraḥ | anantavijñānamityetāvadevāstu nātītadoṣamiti |
gatārthaṃtvāt | doṣātyayaṃ vinātyantavijñānatvasyānupapatteḥ || atro-
cyate | kunayamatānusāriparikalpitāptavyavacchedārthamidam | tathā
cāhurājīvikanayānusāriṇaḥ--
jñānino dharmatīrthasya kartāraḥ paramaṃ padam |
gatvāgacchanti bhūyopi bhavaṃ tīrthamikārataḥ ||
iti | tannūnaṃ na tetītadoṣāḥ | kathamanyathā teṣāṃ tīrthanikāra-
darśanepi bhavāvatāraḥ ||

āha | yadyevamatītadoṣamityevāstvanantavijñānamityatiricyate |
doṣātyayevaśyaṃbhāvitvādanantavijñānatvasya || na | kaiściddoṣābhāve-
pi tadanabhyupagamāt | tathā ca tadvacanam--
sarvaṃ paśyatu vā mā vā tattvamiṣṭaṃ tu paśyatu |
kīṭasaṃkhyāparijñānaṃ tasya naḥ kvopayujyate ||
tathā--
tasmādanuṣṭhānagataṃ jñānamasya vicāryatām |
pramāṇaṃ dūradarśī cedete gṛdhrānupāsmahe ||
tanmatavyapohārthamanantavijñānamityaduṣṭameva | vijñānānantyaṃ vinā
ekasyāpyarthasya yathāvatparijñānābhāvāt | tathā cārṣam--
je egaṃ jāṇai se savvaṃ jāṇai |
je savvaṃ jāṇai se egaṃ jāṇai ||
tathā--
eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā yena dṛṣṭaḥ
sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭāḥ |
sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā yena dṛṣṭā
eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭaḥ ||
iti ||

nanu tarhyabādhyasiddhāntamityapārthakam | yathoktaguṇayuktasyā-
vyabhicārivacanatvena taduktasiddhāntasya bādhāyogāt || na | abhi-
prāyāparijñānāt | nirdoṣapuruṣapraṇīta evābādhyasiddhānto
nāpare'pauruṣeyādyā asaṃbhavādidoṣāghrātatvāt iti jñāpanārtham |
ātmamātratārakamūkāntakṛtkevalyādirūpamuṇḍakevalino yathoktasi-
ddhāntapraṇayanāsamarthasya vyavacchedārthaṃ vā viśeṣaṇametat ||

anyastvāha | amartyapūjyamiti na vācyam | yāvatā yathoddiṣṭa-
guṇagariṣṭhasya tribhuvanavibhoramartyapūjyatvaṃ na kathaṃcana vyabhicaratī-
ti || satyam | laukikānāṃ hyamartyā eva pūjyatayā prasiddhāste-
ṣāmapi bhagavāneva pūjya iti viśeṣaṇenānena jñāpayannācāryaḥ
parameśvarasya devādhidevatvamāvedayati ||
evaṃ pūrvārdhe catvārotiśayā uktāḥ ||

anantavijñānatvaṃ ca sāmānyakevalināmapyavaśyaṃ bhāvītyata-
stadvyavacchedāya śrīvardhamānamiti viśeṣyapadamapi viśeṣaṇarūpatayā
vyākhyāyate || śriyā catustriṃśadatiśayasamṛddhyanubhavātmakabhāvārhantya-
rūpayā vardhamānaṃ vardhiṣṇum || nanvatiśayānāṃ parimitatayaiva siddhānte
prasiddhatvātkathaṃ vardhamānatopapattiḥ || iti cenna | yathā niśītha-
cūrṇau bhagavatāṃ śrīmadarhatāmaṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyabāhyalakṣaṇasaṃkhyāyā
upalakṣaṇatvenāntaraṅgalakṣaṇānāṃ sattvādīnāmānantyamuktam | evama-
tiśayānāmadhikṛtaparigaṇanāyogepyaparimitatvamaviruddham | tato
nātiśayaśriyā vardhamānatvaṃ doṣāśraya iti ||

atītadoṣatā copaśāntamohaguṇasthānavartināmapisaṃbhavatītyataḥ
kṣīṇamohākhyāpratipātiguṇasthānaprāptipratipattyarthaṃ jinamiti viśe-
ṣaṇam | rāgādijetṛtvājjinaḥ | samūlakāṣaṃkaṣitarāgādidoṣa
iti | abādhyasiddhāntatā ca śrutakevalyādiṣvapi dṛśyatetastadapo-
hāyāptamukhyamiti viśeṣaṇam | āptirhi rāgadveṣamohānāmaikāntika
ātyantikaśca kṣayaḥ | sā yeṣāmasti te khalvāptāḥ | arśāditvā-
nmatvarthīyo'cpratyayaḥ | teṣu madhye mukhamiva sarvāṅgānāṃ pradhānatvena
mukhyam | śākhāderyaḥ iti tulye yaḥ | amartyapūjyatā ca
tathāvidhagurūpadeśaparicaryāparyāptavidyācaraṇasaṃpannānāṃ sāmānyamunī-
nāmapi na durghaṭā | atastannirākaraṇāya svayaṃbhuvamiti viśe-
ṣaṇam | svayamātmanaiva paropadeśanirapekṣatayāvagatatattvo bhavatīti
svayaṃbhūḥ svayaṃ saṃbuddhaḥ | tamevaṃvidhaṃ caramajinendraṃ stotuṃ stuti-
viṣayīkartumahaṃ yatiṣye yatnaṃ kariṣyāmi || atra cācāryo bhaviṣya-
tkālaprayogeṇa yogināmapyaśakyānuṣṭhānaṃ bhagavadguṇastavanaṃ manyamānaḥ
śraddhāmeva stutikaraṇe'sādhāraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñāpayanyatnakaraṇameva madadhīnaṃ
na punaryathāvasthitabhagavadguṇastavanasiddhiriti sūcitavān | aha-
miti ca gatārthatvepi paropadeśānyānuvṛttyādinirapekṣatayā nija-
śraddhayaiva stutiprārambha iti jñāpanārtham ||

athavā | śrīvardhamānādiviśeṣaṇacatuṣṭayamanantavijñānādipada-
catuṣṭayena saha hetuhetumadbhāvena vyākhyāyate | yata eva śrīvardha-
mānamata evānantavijñānam | śriyā kṛtsnakarmakṣayāvirbhūtānanta-
catuṣkasaṃpadrūpayā vardhamānam | yadyapi śrīvardhamānasya parameśvara-
syānantacatuṣkasaṃpatterutpattyanantaraṃ sarvakālaṃ tulyatvāccayāpacayau
na stastathāpi nirapacayatvena śāśvatikāvasthānayogādvardhamānatva-
mupacaryate | yadyapi ca śrīvardhamānaviśeṣaṇenānantacatuṣkāntarbhā-
vitvenānantavijñānatvamapi siddhaṃ tathāpyanantavijñānasyaiva paro-
pakārasādhakatamatvādbhagavatpravṛtteśca paropakāraikanibandhanatvādana-
ntavijñānatvaṃ śeṣānantatrayātpṛthaṅnirdhāryācāryeṇoktam ||

nanu yathā jagannāthasyānantavijñānaṃ parārthaṃ tathānantadarśanasya
kevalajñānaparaparyāyasya pārārthyamavyāhatameva | kevalajñānakevala-
darśanābhyāmeva hi svāmī kramapravṛttibhyāmupalabdhaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣā-
tmakaṃ padārthasārthaṃ parebhyaḥ prarūpayati | tatkimarthaṃ tannopāttam ||
iti ceducyate | vijñānaśabdena tasyāpi saṃgrahādadoṣaḥ | jñāna-
mātrāyā ubhayatrāpi samānatvāt | ya eva hyabhyantarīkṛta-
samatākhyadharmā viṣamatādharmaviśiṣṭā jñānena gamyanterthāsta eva
hyabhyantarīkṛtaviṣamatādharmāḥ samatādharmaviśiṣṭā darśanena gamyante |
jīvasvābhāvyāt | sāmānyapradhānamupasarjanīkṛtaviśeṣamarthagrahaṇaṃ
darśanamucyate | tathā pradhānaviśeṣamupasarjanīkṛtasāmānyaṃ ca jñānamiti ||

tathā yata eva jinamata evātītadoṣam | rāgādijetṛtvāddhi
jinaḥ | na cājinasyātītadoṣatā || tathā yata evāptamukhyamata
evābādhyasiddhāntam | āpto hi pratyayita ucyate | tata āpteṣu
mukhyaṃ śreṣṭhamāptamukhyam | āptamukhyatvaṃ ca prabhoravisaṃvādivacanatayā
viśvaviśvāsabhūmitvāt | ata evābādhyasiddhāntam | nahi yathā-
vajjñānāvalokitavastuvādī siddhāntaḥ kunayairbādhituṃ śakyate || yata
eva svayaṃbhuvamata evāmartyapūjyam | pūjyate hi devadevo jaga-
ttrayavilakṣaṇalakṣaṇena svayaṃsaṃbuddhatvaguṇena saudharmendrādibhiramartyai-
riti ||

atra ca śrīvardhamānamiti viśeṣaṇatayā yadvyākhyātaṃ tada-
yogavyavacchedābhidhānaprathamadvātriṃśikāprathamakāvyatṛtīyapādavartamānaṃ
śrīvardhamānābhidhamātmarūpam iti viśeṣyamanuvartamānaṃ buddhau saṃpradhārya
vijñeyam | tatra hyātmarūpamiti viśeṣyapadam | āvṛttyā vā
viśeṣaṇamapi viśeṣyatayā vyākhyeyam ||
iti prathamavṛttārthaḥ || 1 ||

asyāṃ ca stutāvanyayogavyavacchedādhikṛtaḥ tasya ca tīrthānta-
rīyaparikalpitatattvābhāsanirāsena teṣāmāptatvavyavacchedaḥ svarūpam |
tacca bhagavato yathāvasthitavastutattvavāditvakhyāpanenaiva prāmāṇyama-
śnute | ataḥ stutikārastrijagadgurorniḥśeṣaguṇastutiśraddhālurapi
sadbhūtavastuvāditvākhyaṃ guṇaviśeṣameva varṇayitumātmanobhiprāyamā-
viṣkurvannāha--
ayaṃ jano nātha tava stavāya
guṇāntarebhyaḥ spṛhayālureva |
vigāhatāṃ kiṃtu yathārthavāda-
mekaṃ parīkṣāvidhidurvidagdhaḥ || 2 ||

he nātha ayaṃ mallakṣaṇo janaḥ tava guṇāntarebhyo yathārthavāda-
vyatiriktebhyonanyasādhāraṇaśārīralakṣaṇādibhyaḥ spṛhayālureva
śraddhālureva | kimartham | stavāya stutikaraṇāya | iyaṃ tādarthye caturthī |
pūrvatra tu--spṛhervyāpyaṃ vā itilakṣaṇā | tava guṇāntarāṇyapi
stotuṃ spṛhāvānevāyaṃ jana iti bhāvaḥ || nanu yadi guṇāntarastutā-
vapi spṛhayālutā tatkimarthaṃ tatropekṣā | ityāśaṅkyottarārdhamāha |
kiṃtvityabhyupagamaviśeṣadyotane nipātaḥ | ekamekameva | yathārthavādaṃ
yathāvasthitavastutattvaprakhyāpanākhyaṃ tvadīyaṃ guṇam | ayaṃ jano
vigāhatāṃ stutikriyayā samantādvyāpnotu | tasminnekasminnapi
hi guṇe varṇite tantrāntarīyadaivatebhyo vaiśiṣṭyakhyāpanadvāreṇa vastutaḥ
sarvaguṇastavanasiddheḥ ||

atha prastutaguṇastutiḥ samyakparīkṣākṣamāṇāṃ divyadṛśāmevau-
citīmañcati nārvāgdṛśāṃ bhavādṛśāmityāśaṅkāṃ viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa
nirākaroti | yatoyaṃ janaḥ parīkṣāvidhidurvidagdhodhikṛtaguṇa-
viśeṣaparīkṣaṇavidhau durvidagdhaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanya iti yāvat | ayamā-
śayaḥ | yadyapi jagadguroryathārthavāditvaguṇaparīkṣaṇaṃ mādṛśāṃ materagocara-
stathāpi bhaktiśraddhātiśayāt tasyāmahamātmānaṃ vidagdhamiva manya
iti viśuddhaśraddhābhaktivyaktimātrarūpatvātstuteḥ ||
iti vṛttārthaḥ || 2 ||

atha ye kutīrthyāḥ kuśāstravāsanāvāsitasvāntatayā tribhuvana
svāminaṃ svāmitvena na pratipannāḥ tānapi tattvavicāraṇāṃ prati
śikṣayannāha--
guṇeṣvasūyāṃ dadhataḥ paremī
mā śiśriyannāma bhavantamīśam |
tathāpi saṃmīlya vilocanāni
vicārayantāṃ nayavartma satyam || 3 ||

amī iti adasastu viprakṛṣṭe iti vacanāttattvātattvavi-
marśabāhyatayā dūrīkaraṇārhatvādviprakṛṣṭāḥ pare kutīrthikāḥ bhavantaṃ
tvām ananyasāmānyasakalaguṇanilayamapi mā īśaṃ śiśriyanmā
svāmitvena pratipadyantām | yato guṇeṣvasūyāṃ dadhataḥ guṇeṣu
baddhamatsarāḥ | guṇeṣu doṣāviṣkaraṇaṃ hyasūyā | yo hi yatra guṇe
matsarībhavati sa tadāśrayaṃ nānurudhyate | yathā mādhuryamatsarī karabhaḥ
puṇḍrekṣukāṇḍam | guṇāśrayaśca bhavān || evaṃ paratīrthikānāṃ bhagava-
dājñāpratipattiṃ pratiṣidhya stutikāro mādhyasthyamivāsthāya tānprati
hitaśikṣāmuttarārdhenopadiśati | tathāpi tvadājñāpratipatterabhāvepi |
locanāni netrāṇi | saṃmīlya militapuṭīkṛtya | satyaṃ yukti-
yuktam | nayavartma nyāyamārgam | vicārayantāṃ vimarśaviṣayīkurvantu ||

atra ca vicārayantāmityātmanepadena phalavatkartṛviṣayeṇaivaṃ
jñāpayatyācāryo yadavitathanayapathavicāraṇayā teṣāmevaphalaṃ vayaṃ
kevalamupadeṣṭāraḥ | kiṃ tatphalam iti cetprekṣāvatteti brūmaḥ |
saṃmīlya vilocanānīti ca vadataḥ prāyastattvavicāraṇamekāgratā-
hetunayananimīlanapūrvakaṃ loke prasiddhamityabhiprāyaḥ || athavā aya-
mupadeśastebhyo'rocamāna evācāryeṇa vitīryate | tato'svadamāno-
pyayaṃ kaṭukauṣadhapānanyāyenāyatisukhatvādbhavadbhirnetre nimīlya peya
evetyākūtam ||

nanu ca yadi pārameśvare vacasi teṣāmavivekātirekādarocakatā
tatkimarthaṃ tān pratyupadeśakleśa iti || naivam | paropakārasāra-
pravṛttīnāṃ mahātmanāṃ pratipādyagatāṃ rucimaruciṃ vānapekṣya hitopa-
deśapravṛttidarśanāt | teṣāṃ hi parārthasyaiva svārthatvenābhimatatvāt |
na ca hitopadeśādaparaḥ pāramārthikaḥ parārthaḥ | tathā cārṣam |
rusau vā paro mā vā visaṃ vā pariyattau |
bhāsiyavvā hiyā bhāsā sapakkhaguṇakāriyā ||
iti | uvāca ca vācakamukhyaḥ--
na bhavati dharmaḥ śrotuḥ sarvasyaikāntato hitaśravaṇāt |
bruvatonugrahabuddhyā vaktustvekāntato bhavati || 1 ||
iti vṛttārthaḥ || 3 ||

atha yathāvannayavartmavicārameva prapañcayituṃ parābhipretatattvānāṃ
prāmāṇyaṃ nirākurvannāditastāvatkāvyaṣaṭkenaulūkyamatābhimata-
tattvāni dūṣayitukāmastadantaḥpātinau prathamataraṃ sāmānyaviśeṣau
dūṣayannāha--
svatonuvṛttivyativṛttibhājo
bhāvā na bhāvāntaraneyarūpāḥ |
parātmatattvādatathātmatattvād-
dvayaṃ vadanto'kuśalāḥ skhalanti || 4 ||

abhavan bhavanti bhaviṣyanti ceti bhāvāḥ padārthā ātma-
pudgalādayaste | svata iti sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ sāvadhāraṇamāmananti
iti | svata eva ātmīyasvarūpādeva | anuvṛttivyativṛttibhājaḥ |
ekākārā pratītirekaśabdavācyatā cānuvṛttiḥ | vyattivṛttiḥ
vyāvṛttiḥ | sajātīyavijātīyebhyaḥ sarvathā vyavacchedaḥ | te ubhe
api saṃvalite bhajanta āśrayantīti anuvṛttivyativṛttibhājaḥ |
sāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakā ityarthaḥ ||

asyaivārthasya vyatirekamāha | na bhāvāntaraneyarūpā iti | neti
niṣedhe | bhāvāntarābhyāṃ parābhimatābhyāṃ dravyaguṇakarmasamavāyebhyaḥ
padārthāntarābhyāṃ bhāvavyatiriktasāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ neyaṃ pratīti-
viṣayaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ rūpaṃ yathāsaṃkhyamanuvṛttivyativṛttilakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ
yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | svabhāva eva hyayaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ yadanuvṛtti-
vyāvṛttipratyayau svata eva janayanti | tathāhi | ghaṭa eva tāvatpṛthu-
budhnodarādyākāravānpratītiviṣayībhavansannanyānapi tadākṛtibhṛtaḥ
padārthānghaṭarūpatayā ghaṭaikaśabdavācyatayā ca pratyāyayansāmā-
nyākhyāṃ labhate | sa eva cetarebhyaḥ sajātīyavijātīyebhyo
dravyakṣetrakālabhāvairātmānaṃ vyāvartayanviśeṣavyapadeśamaśnute | iti
na sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ pṛthakpadārthāntaratvakalpanaṃ nyāyyam | padārtha-
dharmatvenaiva tayoḥ pratīyamānatvāt | na ca dharmā dharmiṇaḥ sakāśā-
datyantaṃ vyatiriktāḥ | ekāntabhede viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānupapatteḥ |
karabharāsabhayoriva dharmadharmivyapadeśābhāvaprasaṅgācca | dharmāṇāmapi
ca pṛthakpadārthāntaratvakalpana ekasminneva vastuni padārthānantya-
prasaṅgaḥ | anantadharmakatvādvastunaḥ ||

tadevaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ svatattvaṃ yathāvadanavabudhyamānā aku-
śalāḥ atattvābhiniviṣṭadṛṣṭayaḥ tīrthāntarīyāḥ skhalanti
nyāyamārgādbhraśyanti niruttarībhavantītyarthaḥ | skhalanena cātra
prāmāṇikajanopahasanīyatā dhvanyate | kiṃ kurvāṇāḥ dvayamanu-
vṛttivyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ pratyayadvayaṃ vadantaḥ | kasmādetatpratyayadvayaṃ
vadantaḥ ityāha | parātmatattvāt | parau padārthebhyo vyatiriktatvā-
danyau parasparanirapekṣau ca yau sāmānyaviśeṣau tayoryadātmatattvaṃ
svarūpamanuvṛttivyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ tasmāt tadāśrityetyarthaḥ gamya-
yapaḥ karmādhāre ityanena pañcamī | kathaṃbhūtāt parātmatattvāt |
ityāha | atathātmatattvāt | mā bhūtparābhimatasya parātmatattvasya
satyarūpateti viśeṣaṇamidam | yathā yenaikāntabhedalakṣaṇena prakāreṇa
paraiḥ prakalpitaṃ na tathā tena prakāreṇātmatattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tattathā |
tasmāt | yataḥ padārtheṣvaviṣvagbhāvena sāmānyaviśeṣau varttete
taiśca tau tebhyaḥ paratvena kalpitau | paratvaṃ cānyatvam | taccaikānta-
bhedāvinābhāvi ||

kiṃca padārthebhyaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayorekāntabhinnatve svīkriya-
māṇa ekavastuviṣayamanuvṛttivyāvṛttirūpaṃ pratyayadvayaṃ nopapadyeta |
ekāntābhede cānyatarasyāsattvaprasaṅgaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavyavahārābhā-
vaśca syāt | sāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakatvenaiva vastunaḥ pramāṇena
pratīteḥ | parasparanirapekṣapakṣastu purastānnirloṭhayiṣyate | ata
eva teṣāṃ vādināṃ skhalanakriyayopahasanīyatvamabhivyajyate | yo
hyanyathāsthitaṃ vastusvarūpamanyathaiva pratipadyamānaḥ parebhyaśca
tathaiva prajñāpayansvayaṃ naṣṭaḥ parānnāśayati na khalu tasmādanya
upahāsapātram ||
iti vṛttārthaḥ || 4 ||

atha tadabhimatāvekāntanityānityapakṣau dūṣayannāha--
ādīpamāvyoma samasvabhāvaṃ
syādvādamudrānatibhedi vastu |
tannityamevaikamanityamanya-
diti tvadājñādviṣatāṃ pralāpāḥ || 5 ||

ādīpaṃ dīpādārabhya | āvyoma vyoma maryādīkṛtya | sarvam |
vastu padārthasvarūpam | samasvabhāvaṃ samaḥ tulyaḥ svabhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ
yasya tattathā | kiṃca vastunaḥ svarūpaṃ dravyaparyāyātmakatvamiti
brūmaḥ | tathā ca vācakamukhyaḥ--utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat
iti | samasvabhāvatvaṃ kutaḥ | iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetumāha-syā-
dvādamudrānatibhedi | syādityavyayamanekāntadyotakam | tataḥ syā-
dvādo'nekāntavādaḥ | nityānityādyanekadharmaśabalaikavastvabhyupagama
iti yāvat | tasya mudrā maryādā tāṃ nātibhinatti nātikrāmatīti
syādvādamudrānatibhedi | yathā hi nyāyaikaniṣṭhe rājani rājyaśriyaṃ
śāsati sati sarvāḥ prajāstanmudrāṃ nātivartitumīśate tadatikrame
tāsāṃ sarvārthahānibhāvāt evaṃ vijayini niṣkaṇṭake syādvāda-
mahānarendratadīyamudrāṃ sarvepi padārthā nātikrāmanti tadullaṅghane teṣāṃ
svarūpavyavasthāhāniprasakteḥ ||

sarvavastūnāṃ samasvabhāvatvakathanaṃ ca parābhīṣṭasyaikaṃ vastu vyo-
mādi nityamevānyacca pradīpādyanityameveti vādasya pratikṣepabījam |
sarve hi bhāvā dravyārthikanayāpekṣayā nityāḥ paryāyārthikanayā-
deśātpunaranityāḥ | tatraikāntānityatayā parairaṅgīkṛtasya pradīpasya
tāvannityānityatvavyavasthāpane diṅmātramucyate || tathāhi | pradīpa-
paryāyāpannāstaijasāḥ paramāṇavaḥ svarasatastailakṣayādvātābhighātādvā
jyotiḥparyāyaṃ parityajya tamorūpaṃ paryāyāntaramāsādayantopi
naikāntenānityāḥ | pudgaladravyarūpatayāvasthitatvātteṣām | na hye-
tāvataivānityatvaṃ yāvatā pūrvaparyāyasya vināśa uttaraparyāyasya
cotpādaḥ | na khalu mṛddravyaṃ sthāsakakośakuśūlaśivakaghaṭādyavasthā-
ntarāṇyāpadyamānamapyekāntato vinaṣṭam | teṣu mṛddravyānugamasyā-
bālagopālaṃ pratītatvāt | na ca tamasaḥ paudgalikatvamasiddham |
cākṣuṣatvānyathānupapatteḥ | pradīpālokavat | atha yaccākṣuṣaṃ tatsarvaṃ
svapratibhāse ālokamapekṣate | na caivaṃ tamaḥ | tatkathaṃ cākṣuṣam ||
naivam | ulūkādīnāmālokamantareṇāpi tatpratibhāsāt | yaistva-
smadādibhiranyaccākṣuṣaṃ ghaṭādikamālokaṃ vinā nopalabhyate tairapi
timiramālokayiṣyate | vicitratvādbhāvānām | kathamanyathā
pītaśvetādayopi svarṇamuktāphalādyā ālokāpekṣadarśanāḥ | pra-
dīpacandrādayastu prakāśāntaranirapekṣāḥ | iti siddhaṃ tamaścākṣuṣam ||
rūpavattvācca sparśavattvamapi pratīyate | śītasparśapratyayajanaka-
tvāt | yāni tvanibiḍāvayavatvamapratighātitvamanudbhūtasparśa-
viśeṣatvamapratīyamānakhaṇḍāvayavidravyapravibhāgatvamityādīni tamasa
paudgalikatvaniṣethāya paraiḥ sādhanānyupanyastāni tāni pradīpa-
prabhādṛṣṭāntenaiva pratiṣedhyāni | tulyayogakṣematvāt | na ca vācyaṃ
taijasāḥ paramāṇavaḥ kathaṃ tamastvena pariṇamanta iti | pudgalānāṃ
tattatsāmagrīsahakṛtānāṃ visadṛśakāryotpādakatvasyāpi darśanāt |
dṛṣṭo hyārdrendhanasaṃyogavaśādbhāsvararūpasyāpi vahnerabhāsvararūpadhūmarūpa-
kāryotpādaḥ | iti siddho nityānityaḥ pradīpaḥ | yadāpi nirvāṇā-
darvāgdedīpyamāno dīpastadāpi navanavaparyāyotpādavināśabhāktvā-
tpradīpatvānvayācca nityānitya eva ||

evaṃ vyomāpyutpādavyayadhrauvyātmakatvānnityānityameva | tathā-
hyavagāhakānāṃ jīvapudgalānāmavagāhadānopagraha eva tallakṣaṇam |
avakāśadamākāśam iti vacanāt | yadā cāvagāhakā jīva-
pudgalāḥ prayogato visrasāto vaikasmānnabhaḥpradeśātpradeśāntaramupa-
sarpanti tadā tasya vyomnastairavagāhakaiḥ samamekasminpradeśe vibhāga
uttarasmiṃśca pradeśe saṃyogaḥ | saṃyogavibhāgau ca parasparaṃ viruddhau
dharmau | tadbhede cāvaśyaṃ dharmiṇo bhedaḥ | tathā cāhuḥ--ayameva hi
bhedo bhedaheturvā yadviruddhadharmādhyāsaḥ kāraṇabhedaśceti | tataśca
tadākāśaṃ pūrvasaṃyogavināśalakṣaṇapariṇāmāpattyā vinaṣṭamuttara-
saṃyogotpādākhyapariṇāmānubhavāccotpannam | ubhayatrākāśadravyasyā-
nugatatvāccotpādavyayayorekādhikaraṇam | tathā ca yat--apra-
cyutānutpannasthiraikarūpaṃ nityam iti nityalakṣaṇamācakṣate tada-
pāstam | evaṃvidhasya kasyacidvastuno'bhāvāt | tadbhāvāvyayaṃ
nityam iti tu satyaṃ nityalakṣaṇam | utpādavināśayoḥ sadbhā-
vepi tadbhāvāt anvayirūpādyanna vyeti tannityamiti tadarthasya
ghaṭamānatvāt | yadi hyapracyutādilakṣaṇaṃ nityamiṣyate tadotpāda-
vyayayornirādhāratvaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca tayoryoge nityatvahāniḥ ||
dravyaṃ paryāyaviyutaṃ paryāyā dravyavarjitāḥ |
kva kadā kena kiṃrūpā dṛṣṭā mānena kena vā ||
iti vacanāt | na cākāśaṃ na dravyam | laukikānāmapi ghaṭā-
kāśaṃ paṭākāśamiti vyavahāraprasiddherākāśasya nityānityatvam |
ghaṭākāśamapi hi yadā ghaṭāpagame paṭenākrāntaṃ tadā paṭākā-
śamiti vyavahāraḥ | na cāyamaupacārikatvādapramāṇameva | upacā-
rasyāpi kiṃcitsādharmyadvāreṇa mukhyārthasparśitvāt | nabhaso hi
yatkila sarvavyāpakatvaṃ mukhyaṃ parimāṇaṃ tadādheyaghaṭapaṭādisaṃbandhi-
niyataparimāṇavaśātkalpitabhedaṃ satpratiniyatadeśavyāpitayā vya-
vahviyamāṇaṃ ghaṭākāśapaṭākāśādi tattadvyapadeśanibandhanaṃ bhavati |
tattaddhaṭādisaṃbandhe ca vyāpakatvenāvasthitasya vyomnovasthānta-
rāpattiḥ | tataścāvasthābhedevasthāvatopi bhedaḥ | tāsāṃ tato'-
viṣvagbhāvāt | iti siddhaṃ nityānityatvaṃ vyomnaḥ ||

syāyaṃbhuvā api hi nityānityameva vastu prapannāḥ | tathā
cāhuste--trividhaḥ khalvayaṃ dharmiṇaḥ pariṇāmo dharmalakṣaṇāvasthā-
rūpaḥ | suvarṇaṃ dharmi | tasya dharmapariṇāmo vardhamānarucakādiḥ |
dharmasya tu lakṣaṇapariṇāmo'nāgatatvādiḥ | yadā khalvayaṃ hemakāro
vardhamānakaṃ bhaṅktvā rucakamāracayati tadā vardhamānako vartamānatā-
lakṣaṇaṃ hitvātītatālakṣaṇamāpadyate | rucakastu anāgatatālakṣaṇaṃ
hitvā vartamānatālakṣaṇamāpadyate | vartamānatāpanna eva tu rucako
navapurāṇabhāvamāpadyamānovasthāpariṇāmavānbhavati | soyaṃ trividhaḥ
pariṇāmo dharmiṇaḥ | dharmalakṣaṇāvasthāśca dharmiṇo bhinnāścābhinnāśca |
tathā ca te dharmyabhedāttannityatvena nityāḥ | bhedāccotpattivi-
nāśaviṣayatvam | ityubhayamupapannamiti ||

athottarārdhaṃ vivriyate || evaṃ cautpādavyayadhrauvyātmakatve sarva-
bhāvānāṃ siddhepi tadvastvevamākāśātmādikaṃ nityameva anyacca
pradīpaghaṭādikamanityameva ityevakārotrāpi saṃbadhyate | itthaṃ hi
durnayavādāpattiḥ | anantadharmātmake vastuni svābhipretanityatvādi
dharmasamarthanapravaṇāḥ śeṣadharmatiraskāreṇa pravarttamānā durnayā iti
tallakṣaṇāt | ityanenollekhena tvadājñādviṣatāṃ bhavatpraṇītaśāsana-
virodhināṃ pralāpāḥ pralapantyasaṃbaddhavākyanīti yāvat ||

atra ca prathamamādīpamiti paraprasiddhyā anityapakṣollekhepi
yaduttaratra yathāsaṃkhyaparihāreṇa pūrvataraṃ nityamevaikamityuktaṃ tadevaṃ
jñāpayati--yadanityaṃ tadapi nityameva kathaṃcit yacca nityaṃ tadapya-
nityameva kathaṃcit | prakrāntavādibhirapyekasyāmeva pṛthivyāṃ
nityānityatvābhyupagamāt | tathā ca praśastakaraḥ--sā tu dvividhā
nityānityā ca | paramāṇulakṣaṇā nityā kāryalakṣaṇā tvanityā iti |
na cātra paramāṇukāryadravyalakṣaṇaviṣayadvayabhedānnaikādhikaraṇaṃ nityā-
nityatvamiti vācyam | pṛthvītvasyobhayatrāpyavyabhicārāt |
evamabādiṣvapīti | ākāśepi saṃyogavibhāgāṅgīkārāttaira-
nityatvaṃ yuktyā pratipannameva | tathā ca sa evāha--śadbakāraṇatva-
vacanātsaṃyogavibhāgau iti nityānityapakṣayoḥ saṃvalitatvam |
etacca leśato bhāvitameveti ||

pralāpaprāyatvaṃ ca paravacanānāmitthaṃ samarthanīyam || vastuna-
stāvadarthakriyākāritvaṃ lakṣaṇam | taccaikāntanityānityapakṣayorna
ghaṭate || apracyutānutpannasthiraikarūpo hi nityaḥ | sa ca krameṇārtha-
kriyāṃ kurvīta akrameṇa vā | anyonyavyavacchedarūpāṇāṃ
prakārāntarāsaṃbhavāt || tatra na tāvatkrameṇa | sa hi kālāntara-
bhāvinīḥ kriyāḥ prathamakriyākāla eva prasahya kuryāt |
samarthasya kālakṣepāyogāt | kālakṣepiṇo vā asāmarthyaprāpteḥ |
samarthopi tattatsahakārisamavadhāne taṃ tamarthaṃ karotīti cet na tarhi
tasya sāmarthyam | aparasahakārisāpekṣavṛttitvāt | sāpekṣamasamartha-
miti nyāyāt | na tena sahakāriṇo'pekṣyante apitu kāryameva saha-
kāriṣvasatsvabhavattānapekṣata iti cet tatkiṃ sa bhāvo'samarthaḥ
samartho vā | samarthaścet kiṃ sahakārimukhaprekṣaṇadīnāni tānyapekṣate
na punarjhaṭiti ghaṭayati | nanu samarthamapi bījamilā-
jalānilādisahakārisahitamevāṅkuraṃ karoti nānyathā | tatkiṃ
tasya sahakāribhiḥ kiṃcidupakriyeta na vā | yadi
nopakriyeta tadā sahakārisaṃnidhānātprāgiva kiṃ na tadāpya-
rthakriyāyāmudāste | upakriyeta cetsa tarhi tairupakāro'bhinno
bhinno vā kriyata iti vācyam | abhede sa eva kriyate |
iti lābhamicchato mūlakṣatirāyātā | kṛtakatvena tasyānitya-
tvāpatteḥ | bhede tu sa kathaṃ tasyopakāraḥ | kiṃ na
sahyavindhyādrerapi | tatsaṃbandhāttasyāyamiti cet upakāryopakārayoḥ
kaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | na tāvatsaṃyogaḥ | dravyayoreva tasya bhāvāt |
atra tūpakāryaṃ dravyamupakāraśca kriyeti na saṃyogaḥ | nāpi
samavāyaḥ | tasyaikatvādvyāpakatvācca pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvena sarvatra
tulyatvānna niyataiḥ saṃbandhibhiḥ saṃbandho yuktaḥ | niyata-
saṃbandhisaṃbandhe cāṅgīkriyamāṇe tatkṛta upakāro'sya samavā-
yasyābhyupagantavyaḥ | tathā ca satyupakārasya bhedābhedakalpanā
tadavasthaiva | upakārasya samavāyādabhede samavāya eva kṛtaḥ
syāt | bhede punarapi samavāyasya na niyatasaṃbandhisaṃbandhatvam |
tannaikāntanityo bhāvaḥ krameṇārthakriyāṃ kurute || nāpyakrameṇa |
na hyeko bhāvaḥ sakalakālakalākalāpabhāvinīryugapatsarvāḥ kriyāḥ
karotīti prātītikam | kurutāṃ vā | tathāpi dvitīyakṣaṇe kiṃ
kuryāt | karaṇe vā kramapakṣabhāvī doṣaḥ | akaraṇe tvarthakriyā-
kāritvābhāvādavastutvaprasaṅgaḥ | ityekāntanityāt kramākramābhyāṃ
vyāptārthakriyā vyāpakānupalabdhibalādvyāpakanivṛttau nivartamānā
svavyāpyamarthakriyākāritvaṃ nivartayati | arthakriyākāritvaṃ ca
nivartamānaṃ svavyāpyaṃ sattvaṃ nivartayati | iti naikāntanityapakṣo
yuktikṣamaḥ ||

ekāntānityapakṣopi na kakṣīkaraṇārhaḥ || anityo hi
pratikṣaṇavināśī | sa ca na krameṇārthakriyāsamarthaḥ | deśakṛtasya
kālakṛtasya ca kramasyaivābhāvāt | kramo hi paurvāparyam | tacca
kṣaṇikasyāsaṃbhavi | avasthitasyaiva hi nānādeśakālavyāptirdeśa-
kramaḥ kālakramaścābhidhīyate | na caikāntavināśini sāsti |
yadāhuḥ--
yo yatraiva sa tatraiva yo yadaiva tadaiva saḥ |
na deśakālayorvyāptirbhāvānāmiha vidyate ||
na ca saṃtānāpekṣayā pūrvottarakṣaṇānāṃ kramaḥ saṃbhavati | saṃtā-
nasyāvastutvāt | vastutvepi tasya yadi kṣaṇikatvaṃ na tarhi kṣaṇebhyaḥ
kaścidviśeṣaḥ | athākṣaṇikatvaṃ tarhi samāptaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgavādaḥ ||

nāpyakrameṇārthakriyā kṣaṇike saṃbhavati | sa hyeko bījapūrādi-
rūpādikṣaṇo yugapadanekān rasādikṣaṇāñjanayannekena svabhāvena
janayennānāsvabhāvairvā | yadyekena tadā teṣāṃ rasādikṣaṇānāmekatvaṃ
syādekasvabhāvajanyatvāt | atha nānāsvabhāvairjanayati kiṃcidrū-
pādikamupādānabhāvena kiṃcidrasādikaṃ sahakāritveneti cet
svabhāvāstasyātmabhūtā anātmabhūtā vā | anātmabhūtāścet svabhā-
vatvahāniḥ | yadyātmabhūtāstarhi tasyānekatvamanekasvabhāvatvāt |
svabhāvānāṃ vaikatvaṃ prasajyeta | tadavyatiriktatvātteṣāṃ tasya
caikatvāt | atha ya eva ekatropādānabhāvaḥ sa evānyatra sahakāri-
bhāva iti na svabhāvabheda iṣyate | tarhi nityasyaikarūpasyāpi
krameṇa nānākāryakāriṇaḥ svabhāvabhedaḥ kāryasāṃkaryaṃ ca kathamiṣyate
kṣaṇikavādinā | atha nityamekarūpatvādakramam | akramācca kramiṇāṃ
nānākāryāṇāṃ kathamutpattiriti cet aho svapakṣapātī devānāṃpriyo
yaḥ khalu svayamekasmānniraṃśādrūpādikṣaṇātkāraṇādyugapadanekakāraṇa-
sādhyānyanekakāryāṇyaṅgīkurvāṇopi parapakṣe nityepi vastuni krameṇa
nānākāryakaraṇepi virodhamudbhāvayati | tasmātkṣaṇikasyāpi
bhāvasyākrameṇārthakriyā durghaṭā || ityanityaikāntādapi kramākramayo-
rvyāpakayornivṛttyaiva vyāpyārthakriyāpi vyāvartate | tadvyāvṛttau ca
sattvamapi vyāpakānupalabdhibalenaiva nivartate | ityekāntānitya-
vādopi na ramaṇīyaḥ ||

syādvāde tu pūrvottarākāraparihārasvīkārasthitilakṣaṇapariṇāmena
bhāvānāmarthakriyopapattiraviruddhā | na caikatra vastuni parasparaviruddha-
dharmādhyāsāyogādasansyādvāda iti vācyam | nityānityapakṣa-
vilakṣaṇasya pakṣāntarasyāṅgīkriyamāṇatvāt | tathaiva ca sarvairanubhavāt |
tathā ca paṭhanti--
bhāge siṃho naro bhāge yo'rtho bhāgadvayātmakaḥ |
tamabhāgaṃ vibhāgena narasiṃhaṃ pracakṣate || iti ||
vaiśeṣikairapi citrarūpasyaikasyāvayavinobhyupagamādekasyaiva paṭādeścalā-
calaraktāraktāvṛtānāvṛtatvādiviruddhadharmāṇāmupalabdheḥ | saugatairapye-
katra citrapaṭījñāne nīlānīlayorvirodhānaṅgīkārāt ||

atra ca yadyapyadhikṛtavādinaḥ pradīpādikaṃ kālāntarāvasthāyi-
tvātkṣaṇikaṃ na manyante tanmate pūrvāparāntāvacchinnāyāḥ
sattāyā evānityatālakṣaṇāt tathāpi buddhisukhādikaṃ tepi
kṣaṇikatayaiva pratipannāḥ iti tadadhikārepi kṣaṇikavādacarcā
nānupapannā | yadāpi ca kālāntarāvasthāyi vastu tadāpi nityā-
nityameva | kṣaṇopi na khalu sosti yatra vastūtpādavyaya-
dhrauvyātmakaṃ nāsti || iti kāvyārthaḥ || 5 ||

atha tadabhimatamīśvarasya jagatkartṛtvābhyupagamaṃ mithyābhini-
veśarūpaṃ nirūpayannāha |
kartāsti kaścijjagataḥ sa caikaḥ
sa sarvagaḥ sa svavaśaḥ sa nityaḥ |
imāḥ kuhevākaviḍambanāḥ syu-
steṣāṃ na yeṣāmanuśāsakastvam || 6 ||

jagataḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇopalakṣyamāṇacarācararūpasya viśva-
trayasya kaścid anirvacanīyasvarūpaḥ puruṣaviśeṣaḥ kartā sraṣṭā asti
vidyate || te hītthaṃ pramāṇayanti | urvīparvatatarvādikaṃ sarvaṃ buddhi-
matkartṛkam | kāryatvāt | yadyatkāryaṃ tattatsarvaṃ buddhimatkartṛkam yathā
ghaṭaḥ | tathā cedam | tasmāttathā | vyatireke vyomādi | yaśca buddhi-
māṃstatkartā sa bhagavānīśvara eveti ||

na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ | yato bhūbhūdharādeḥ svasvakāraṇakalāpa-
janyatayāvayavitayā vā kāryatvaṃ sarvavādināṃ pratītameva | nāpyanaikā-
ntiko viruddho vā | vipakṣādatyantavyāvṛttatvāt | nāpi kālātyayā-
padiṣṭaḥ | pratyakṣānumānāgamābādhitadharmadharmyanantarapratipāditatvāt ||
nāpi prakaraṇasamaḥ | tatpratipanthidharmopapādanasamarthapratyanumānābhā-
vāt | na ca vācyamīśvaraḥ pṛthvīpṛthvīdharādervidhātā na bhavati
aśarīratvāt nirvṛtātmavaditi pratyanumānaṃ tadbādhakamiti | yatotre-
śvararūpo dharmī pratīto'pratīto vā prarūpitaḥ | na tāvadapratītaḥ | heto-
rāśrayāsiddhiprasaṅgāt | pratītaścet yena pramāṇena sa pratītastenaiva
kiṃ svayamutpāditasvatanurna pratīyate | ityataḥ kathamaśarīratvam |
tasmānniravadya evāyaṃ heturiti ||

sa caika iti | ca punararthe | sa punaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa ekaḥ advitīyaḥ |
bahūnāṃ hi viśvavidhātṛtvasvīkāre parasparavimatisaṃbhāvanāyā ani-
vāryatvādekaikasya vastuno'nyānyarūpatayā nirmāṇe sarvamasamañjasamā-
padyeteti ||

tathā sa sarvaga iti | sarvatra gacchatīti sarvagaḥ | sarvavyāpī |
tasya hi pratiniyatadeśavartitve niyatadeśavṛttīnāṃ viśvatrayāntarva-
rtipadārthasārthānāṃ yathāvannirmāṇānupapattiḥ | kumbhakārādiṣu tathā
darśanāt || athavā sarvaṃ gacchati jānātīti sarvagaḥ sarvajñaḥ | sarve
gatyarthāḥ jñānārthāḥ iti vacanāt | sarvajñatvābhāve hi yathocito-
pādānakāraṇādyanabhijñatvādanurūpakāryotpattirna syāt ||

tathā sa svavaśaḥ svatantraḥ | sakalaprāṇināṃ svecchayā sukha-
duḥkhayoranubhāvanasamarthatvāt | tathā coktam--
īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ vā śvabhrameva vā |
anyo janturanīśo'yamātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ||
pāratantrye tu tasya paramukhaprekṣitayā mukhyakartṛtvavyāghātādanī-
śvaratvāpattiḥ ||

tathā sa nitya iti | apracyutānutpannasthiraikarūpaḥ | tasya
hyanityatve parotpādyatayā kṛtakatvaprāptiḥ | apekṣitaparavyāpāro
hi bhāvaḥ svabhāvaniṣpattau kṛtaka ityucyate | yaścāparastatkartā
kalpyate sa nityo'nityo vā syāt | nityaścedadhikṛteśvareṇa
kimaparāddham | anityaścettasyāpyutpādakāntareṇa bhāvyam |
tasyāpi nityānityatvakalpanāyāmanavasthādausthyamiti ||

tadevamekatvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo bhagavānīśastrijagatkarteti
parābhyupagamamupadarśyottarārdhena tasya duṣṭatvamācaṣṭe || imā etā
anantaroktāḥ | kuhevākaviḍambanāḥ kutsitā hevākā āgrahaviśeṣāḥ
kuhevākāḥ kadāgrahā ityarthaḥ ta eva viḍambanāḥ vicāracāturī-
bāhyatvena tiraskārarūpatvādvigopakaprakārāḥ | syuḥ bhaveyuḥ | teṣāṃ prāmā-
ṇikāpasadānām | yeṣāṃ he svāmin tvaṃ nānuśāsakaḥ na śikṣādātā ||
tadabhiniveśānāṃ viḍambanārūpatvajñāpanārthameva parābhipretapuruṣavi-
śeṣaṇeṣu pratyekaṃ tacchabdaprayogamasūyāgarbhamāvirbhāvayāṃcakāra stuti-
kāraḥ | tathā caivameva nindanīyaṃ prati vaktāro vadanti | sa mūrkhaḥ sa
pāpīyān sa daridra ityādi | tvamityekavacanasaṃyuktayuṣmacchabda-
prayogeṇa parameśituḥ paramakāruṇikatayānapekṣitasvaparapakṣavibhāgama-
dvitīyaṃ hitopadeśakatvaṃ dhvanyate | atotrāyamāśayaḥ | yadyapi
bhagavānaviśeṣeṇa sakalajagajjantujātahitāvahāṃ sarvebhya eva deśa-
nāvācamācaṣṭe tathāpi saiva keṣāṃcinnicitanikācitapāpakarmakalu-
ṣitātmanāṃ rucirūpatayā na pariṇamate | apunarbandhakādivyatiri-
ktatvenāyogyatvāt | tathā ca kādambaryāṃ bāṇopi babhāṇa--apaga-
tamale hi manasi sphaṭikamaṇāviva rajanikaragabhastayo viśanti
sukhamupadeśaguṇāḥ | guruvacanamamalamapi salilamiva mahadupajanayati
śravaṇasthitaṃ śūlamabhavyasya iti | ato vastuvṛttyā na teṣāṃ bhagavā-
nanuśāsaka iti || na caitāvatā jagadgurorasāmarthyasaṃbhāvanā | na hi
kāladaṣṭamanujjīvayan samujjīvitetaradaṣṭako viṣabhiṣagupālambha-
nīyaḥ | atiprasaṅgāt | sa hi teṣāmeva doṣaḥ | na khalu nikhi-
labhuvanābhogamavabhāsayantopi bhānavīyā bhānavaḥ kauśikaloka-
syālokahetutāmabhajamānā upālambhasaṃbhāvanāspadam | tathā ca
śrīsiddhasenaḥ--
saddharmabījavapanānaghakauśalasya
yallokabāndhava tavāpi khilānyabhūvan |
tannādbhutaṃ khagakuleṣviha tāmaseṣu
sūryāṃśavo madhukarīcaraṇāvadātāḥ ||

atha kathamiva tatkuhevākānāṃ viḍambanārūpatvamiti | brūmaḥ |
yattāvaduktaṃ paraiḥ kṣityādayo buddhimatkartṛkāḥ kāryatvāddhaṭavaditi |
tadayuktam | vyāpteragrahaṇāt | sādhanaṃ hi sarvatra vyāptau pramāṇena
siddhāyāṃ sādhyaṃ gamayediti sarvavādisaṃvādaḥ || sa cāyaṃ jaganti
sṛjan saśarīro'śarīro vā syāt || saśarīropi kimasmadādiva-
ddṛśyaśarīraviśiṣṭa uta piśācādivadadṛśyaśarīraviśiṣṭaḥ | prathamapakṣe
pratyakṣabādhaḥ | tamantareṇāpi ca jāyamāne tṛṇatarupuraṃdaradhanurabhrādau
kāryatvasya darśanāt prameyatvādivatsādhāraṇānaikāntiko hetuḥ |
dvitīyavikalpe punaradṛśyaśarīratve tasya māhātmyaviśeṣaḥ kāraṇam
āhosvidasmadādyadṛṣṭavaiguṇyam | prathamaprakāraḥ kośapānapratyāyanīyaḥ |
tatsiddhau pramāṇābhāvāt | itaretarāśrayadoṣāpatteśca | siddhe hi
māhātmayaviśeṣe tasyādṛśyaśarīratvaṃ pratyetavyam | tatsiddhau ca
māhātmyaviśeṣasiddhiriti | dvaitīyikastu prakāro na saṃcaratyeva
vicāragocare | saṃśayānivṛtteḥ | kiṃ tasyāsattvādadṛśyaśarīratvaṃ
vāndhyeyādivat kiṃ vāsmadādyadṛṣṭavaiguṇyātpiśācādivaditiniścayā-
bhāvāt || aśarīraścettadā dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyam | ghaṭādayo
hi kāryarūpāḥ saśarīrakartṛkā dṛṣṭāḥ | aśarīrasya ca satastasya
kāryapravṛttau kutaḥ sāmarthyam ākāśādivat | tasmātsaśarīrāśarīra-
lakṣaṇe pakṣadvayepi kāryatvahetorvyāptyasiddhiḥ || kiṃ ca tvanmatena
kālātyayāpadiṣṭopyayaṃ hetuḥ | dharmyekadeśasya taruvidyudabhrāderidā-
nīmapyutpadyamānasya vidhāturanupalabhyamānatvena pratyakṣabādhita-
dharmyanantaraṃ hetubhaṇanāt | tadevaṃ na kaścijjagataḥ kartā ||

ekatvādīni tu jagatkartṛtvavyavasthāpanāyānīyamānāni tadvi-
śeṣaṇāni ṣaṇḍhaṃ prati kāminyā rūpasaṃpannirūpaṇaprāyāṇyeva |
tathāpi teṣāṃ vicārāsahatvakhyāpanārthaṃ kiṃciducyate || tatraikatvacarca-
stāvat | bahūnāmekakāryakaraṇe vaimatyasaṃbhāvaneti nāyamekāntaḥ |
anekakīṭikāśataniṣpādyatvepi śakramūrdhnonekaśilpikalpitatvepi
prāsādādīnāṃ naikasaraghānirvartitatvepi madhucchatrādīnāṃ caika-
rūpatāyā avigānenopalambhāt | athaiteṣvapyeka eveśvaraḥ karteti
brūṣe | evaṃ cedbhavato bhavānīpatiṃ prati niṣpratimā vāsanā
tarhi kuvindakumbhakārāditiraskāreṇa paṭaghaṭādīnāmapi kartā sa eva
kiṃ na kalpyate | atha teṣāṃ pratyakṣasiddhaṃ kartṛtvaṃ kathamapahnotuṃ
śakyam | tarhi kīṭikādibhiḥ kiṃ teṣāṃ virāddhaṃ yatteṣāmasadṛśa-
tādṛśaprayāsasādhyaṃ kartṛtvamekahelayaivāpalapyate | tasmādvaimatyabhayā-
nmaheśiturekatvakalpanā bhojanādivyayabhayātkṛpaṇasyātyantavallabha-
putrakalatrādiparityajanena śūnyāraṇyānīsevanamiva ||

tathā sarvagatatvamapi tasya nopapannam | taddhi śarīrātmanā jñānā-
tmanā vā syāt | prathamapakṣe tadīyenaiva dehena jagattrayasya vyāptatvādi-
taranirmeyapadārthānāmāśrayānavakāśaḥ | dvitīyapakṣe tu siddhasādhyatā |
asmābhirapi niratiśayajñānātmanā paramapuruṣasya jagattrayakroḍī-
karaṇābhyupagamāt | yadi paramevaṃ bhavatpramāṇīkṛtena vedena
virodhaḥ | tatra hi śarīrātmanā sarvagatatvamuktam | viśvataścakṣu-
ruta viśvatomukho viśvataḥpāṇiruta viśvataḥpāt ityādiśruteḥ ||
yaccoktaṃ tasya pratiniyatadeśavartitve tribhuvanagatapadārthānāmani-
yatadeśavṛttīnāṃ yathāvannirmāṇānupapattiriti | tatredaṃ pṛcchyate | sa
jagattrayaṃ nirmimāṇastakṣādivatsākṣāddehavyāpāreṇa nirmimīte yadi
vā saṃkalpamātreṇa | ādye pakṣa ekasyaiva bhūbhūdharādervidhāne'kṣodī-
yasaḥ kālakṣepasya saṃbhavādbaṃhīyasāpyanehasā na parisamāptiḥ |
dvitīyapakṣe tu saṃkalpamātreṇaiva kāryakalpanāyāṃ niyatadeśasthāyi-
tvepi na kiṃciddūṣaṇamutpaśyāmaḥ | niyatadeśasthāyināṃ sāmānyade-
vānāmapi saṃkalpamātreṇaiva tattatkāryasaṃpādanapratipatteḥ || kiṃ ca
tasya sarvagatatvenāṅgīkriyamāṇe śuciṣu nirantarasantamaseṣu
narakādisthaleṣvapi tasya vṛttiḥ prasajyate | tathā cāniṣṭāpattiḥ |
atha yuṣmatpakṣepi yadā jñānātmanā sarvajagattrayaṃ vyāpnotītyucyate
tadā śucirasasvādādīnāmapyupalambhasaṃbhāvanānnarakādiduḥkhasvarūpa-
saṃvedanātmakatayā duḥkhānubhavaprasaṅgāccāniṣṭāpattistulyaiveti cet
tadetadupapattibhiḥ pratikartumaśaktasya dhūlibhirivāvakaraṇam | yato-
jñānamaprāpyakāri svasthalasthameva viṣayaṃ paricchinatti na punastatra
gatvā | tatkuto bhavadupālambhaḥ samīcīnaḥ | tarhi bhavatopyaśuci-
jñānamātreṇa tadrasāsvādānubhūtiḥ | tadbhāve hi srakcandanāṅganā-
rasavatyādicintanamātreṇaiva tṛptisiddhau tatprāptiprayatnavaiphalyaprasakti-
riti || yattu jñānātmanā sarvagatatve siddhasādhanaṃ prāguktaṃ tacchakti-
mātramapekṣya mantavyam | tathā ca vaktāro bhavanti | asya matiḥ
sarvaśāstreṣu prasaratīti | na ca jñānaṃ prāpyakāri | tasyātmadharmatvena
bahirnirgamābhāvāt | bahirnirgame cātmano'caitanyāpattyā'jīvatvapra-
saṅgaḥ | na hi dharmo dharmiṇamatiricya kvacana kevalo vilokitaḥ |
yacca pare dṛṣṭāntayanti yathā sūryasya kiraṇā guṇarūpā api
sūryānniṣkramya bhuvanaṃ bhāsayantyevaṃ jñānamapyātmanaḥ sakāśādbahi-
rnirgatya prameyaṃ paricchinattīti tatredamuttaram | kiraṇānāṃ guṇatvama-
siddham | teṣāṃ taijasapudgalamayatvena dravyatvāt | yaśca teṣāṃ prakāśātmā
guṇaḥ sa tebhyo na jātu pṛthagbhavatīti | tathā ca dharmasaṃgrahiṇyāṃ
śrīharibhadrācāryapādāḥ--
kiraṇā guṇā na davvaṃ tesiṃ payāso guṇo na vā davvaṃ ||
jaṃ nāṇaṃ āyaguṇo kahamadavvo sa annattha || 1 ||
gantūṇa na parichiṃdai nāṇaṃ ṇeyaṃ tayammi desammi |
āyatthaṃ ciya navaraṃ acintasattī u viṇṇeyaṃ || 2 ||
lohovalassa sattī āyatthā ceva bhinnadesaṃpi |
lohaṃ āgarisaṃtī dīsai iha kajja paccakhkhā || 3 ||
evamiha nāṇasattī āyatthā ceva haṃdi logaṃtaṃ |
jai parichiṃdai sammaṃ ko ṇu viroho bhave tattha || 4 ||
ityādi ||

atha sarvagaḥ sarvajña iti vyākhyānaṃ tatrāpi pratividhīyate |
nanu tasya sārvajñyaṃ kena pramāṇena gṛhītam | pratyakṣeṇa parokṣeṇa
vā | na tāvatpratyakṣeṇa | tasyendriyārthasaṃnikarṣotpannatayātī-
ndriyagrahaṇāsāmarthyāt | nāpi parokṣeṇa | taddhyanumānaṃ śādbaṃ vā
syāt | na tāvadanumānam | tasya liṅgagrahaṇena liṅgiliṅgasaṃbandha-
smaraṇapūrvakatvāt | na ca tasya sarvajñatvenumeye kiṃcidavyabhicāri
liṅgaṃ paśyāmaḥ | tasyātyantaviprakṛṣṭatvena tatpratibaddhaliṅgasaṃbandhagrahaṇā-
bhāvāt | atha tasya sarvajñatvaṃ vinā jagadvaicitryamanupapadyamānaṃ sarvajñatva-
marthādāpādayatīti cenna | avinābhāvābhāvāt | na hi jagadvaicitrī
tatsārvajñyaṃ vinānyathā nopapannā | dvividhaṃ hi jagat | sthāvarajaṅgama-
bhedāt | tatra jaṅgamānāṃ vaicitryaṃ svopāttaśubhāśubhakarmaparipāka-
vaśenaiva | sthāvarāṇāṃ tu sacetanānāmiyameva gatiracetanānāṃ tu
tadupabhogayogyatāsādhanatvenānādikālasiddhameva vaicitryamiti ||
nāpyāgamastatsādhakaḥ | sa hi tatkṛtonyakṛto vā syāt |
tatkṛta eva cettasya sarvajñatāṃ sādhayati tadā tasya mahattvakṣatiḥ |
svayameva svaguṇotkīrtanasya mahatāmanadhikṛtatvāt | anyacca tasya
śāstrakartṛtvameva na yujyate | śāstraṃ hi varṇātmakam | te ca tālvā-
divyāpārajanyāḥ | sa ca śarīra eva saṃbhavī | śarīrābhyupagame ca
tasya pūrvoktā eva doṣāḥ | anyakṛtaścetsonyaḥ sarvajño'sarvajño vā |
sarvajñatve tasya dvaitāpattyā prāguktatadekatvābhyupagamabādhastatsādhakapra-
māṇacarcāyāmanavasthāpātaśca | asarvajñaścetkastasya vacasi viśvāsaḥ |
aparaṃ ca bhavadabhīṣṭa āgamaḥ pratyuta tatpraṇeturasarvajñatvameva sādhayati |
pūrvāparaviruddhārthavacanopetatvāt | tathāhi na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtānīti
prathamamuktvā paścāttatraiva paṭhitam |
ṣaṭśatāni niyujyante paśūnāṃ madhyame'hani |
aśvamedhasya vacanānnyūnāni paśubhistribhiḥ ||
tathā agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta saptadaśa prājāpatyānpaśūnāla-
bheta ityādivacanāni kathamiva na pūrvāparavirodhamanurudhyante ||
tathā nānṛtaṃ brūyāt ityādinā anṛtabhāṣaṇaṃ prathamaṃ niṣidhya paścād
brāhmaṇārthamanṛtaṃ brūyāt ityādi | tathā--
na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti
na strīṣu rājanna vivāhakāle |
prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre
pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni ||
tathā adattādānamekadhā nirasya paścāduktam--yadyapi brāhmaṇo
haṭhena parakīyamādatte chalena vā tathāpi tasya nādattādānam | yataḥ
sarvamidaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dattaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu daurbalyādvṛṣalāḥ paribhuñjate |
tasmādapaharan brāhmaṇaḥ svamādatte svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste
svaṃ dadāti iti || tathā | aputrasya gatirnāsti iti lapitvā
anekāni sahasrāṇi kumārabrahmacāriṇām |
divaṃ gatāni viprāṇāmakṛtvā kulasantatim ||
ityādi || kiyanto vā dadhimāṣabhojanātkṛpaṇā vivecyante |
tadevamāgamopi na tasya sarvajñatāṃ vakti | kiṃ ca sarvajñaḥ sannasau
carācaraṃ cedviracayati tadā jagadupaplavakaraṇasvairiṇaḥ paścādapi
kartavyanigrahānsuravairiṇa etadadhikṣepakāriṇaścāsmādādīnkimarthaṃ
sṛjatīti | tannāyaṃ sarvajñaḥ ||

tathā svavaśatvaṃ svātantryam | tadapi tasya na kṣodakṣamam || sa hi
yadi nāma svādhīnaḥ san viśvaṃ vidhatte paramakāruṇikaśca tvayā
varṇyate tatkathaṃ sukhitādyavasthābhedavṛndasthapuṭitaṃ ghaṭayati bhuvana-
mekāntaśarmasaṃpatkāntameva tu kiṃ na nirmimīte | atha janmā-
ntaropārjitatattattadīyaśubhāśubhakarmapreritaḥ saṃstathā karotīti |
dattastarhi svavaśatvāya jalāñjaliḥ | karmajanye ca tribhuvanavaicitrye
śipiviṣṭahetukaviṣṭapasṛṣṭikalpanāyāḥ kaṣṭaikaphalatvādasmanmatamevā-
ṅgīkṛtaṃ prekṣāvatā | tathācāyāto'yaṃ ghaṭakuṭyāṃ prabhātamitinyāyaḥ |
kiṃ ca prāṇināṃ dharmādharmāvapekṣamāṇaścedayaṃ sṛjati prāptaṃ tarhi
yadayamapekṣate tanna karotīti | na hi kulālo daṇḍādi karoti |
evaṃ karmāpekṣaścedīśvaro jagatkāraṇaṃ syāttarhi karmaṇīśvaratvamīśvaronī-
śvaraḥ syaditi ||

tathā nityatvamapi tasya svagṛha eva praṇigadyamānaṃ hṛdyam || sa
khalu nityatvenaikarūpaḥ san tribhuvanasargasvabhāvo'tatsvabhāvo vā |
prathamavidhāyāṃ jagannirmāṇātkadācidapi noparameta | taduparame
tatsvabhāvatvahāniḥ | evaṃ ca sargakriyāyā aparyavasānādekasyāpi
kāryasya na sṛṣṭiḥ | ghaṭo hi svārambhakṣaṇādārabhya parisamāpte-
rupāntyakṣaṇaṃ yāvanniścayanayābhiprāyeṇa na ghaṭavyapadeśamāsādayati |
jalāharaṇādyarthakriyāyāmasādhakatamatvāt | atatsvabhāvapakṣe tu na
jātu jaganti sṛjetsvabhāvāyogādgaganavat | api ca tasyaikānta-
nityasvarūpatve sṛṣṭivatsaṃhāropi na ghaṭate | nānārūpakāryakaraṇe-
'nityatvāpatteḥ | sa hi yenaiva svabhāvena jaganti sṛjettenaiva tāni
saṃharet svabhāvāntareṇa vā | tenaiva cet sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoryaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ |
svabhāvābhedāt | ekasvabhāvātkāraṇādanekasvabhāvakāryotpatti
virodhāt | svabhāvāntareṇa cet nityatvahāniḥ | svabhāvabheda eva
hi lakṣaṇamanityatāyāḥ | yathā pārthivaśarīrasyāhāraparamāṇusaha-
kṛtasya pratyahamapūrvāpūrvotpādena svabhāvabhedādanityatvam | iṣṭaśca bhavatāṃ
sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoḥ śambhau svabhāvabhedaḥ | rajoguṇātmakatayā sṛṣṭau
tamoguṇātmakatayā saṃharaṇe sāttvikatayā ca sthitau tasya vyāpāra-
svīkārāt | evaṃ cāvasthābhedastadbhede cāvasthāvatopi bhedānnitya-
tvakṣatiḥ || athāstu nityastathāpi kathaṃ satatameva sṛṣṭau na ceṣṭate |
icchāvaśāccennanu tā apīcchāḥ svasattāmātranibandhanātmalābhāḥ
sadaiva kiṃ na pravartayantīti sa evopālambhaḥ | tathā śambhoraṣṭaguṇā-
dhikaraṇatve kāryabhedānumeyānāṃ tadicchānāmapi viṣamarūpatvahāniḥ
kena vāryate | kiṃ ca prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiḥ svārthakaruṇābhyāṃ vyāptā | tata-
ścāyaṃ jagatsarge vyāpriyate svārthātkāruṇyādvā | na tāvat svārthāt ta-
sya kṛtakṛtyatvāt | na ca kāruṇyāt | paraduḥkhaprahāṇecchā hi kāruṇyam |
tataḥ prāksargājjīvānāmindriyaśarīraviṣayānutpattau duḥkhābhāvena
kasya prahāṇecchā kāruṇyam | sargottarakāle tu duḥkhinovalokya
kāruṇyābhyupagame duruttaramitaretarāśrayaṃ kāruṇyena sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭyā ca
kāruṇyam | iti nāsya jagatkartṛtvaṃ kathamapi siddhyati | tadevamevaṃ-
vidhadoṣakaluṣite puruṣaviśeṣe yasteṣāṃ sevāhevākaḥ sa khalu kevalaṃ
balavanmohaviḍambanāparipāka iti | atra ca yadyapi madhyavartino
nakārasya ghaṇṭālālānyāyena yojanādarthāntaramapi sphurati
yathā imāḥ kuhevākaviḍambanāsteṣāṃ na syuryeṣāṃ tvamanuśāsaka iti
tathāpi so'rthaḥ sahṛdayairna hṛdayadhāraṇīyo'nyayogavyavacchedasyā-
dhikṛtatvāditi kāvyārthaḥ ||

atha caitanyādayo rūpādayaśca dharmā ātmāderghaṭādeśca dharmiṇo'-
tyantaṃ vyatiriktā api samavāyasaṃbandhena saṃbaddhāḥ santo dharma-
dharmivyapadeśamaśnuvate tanmataṃ dūṣayannāha |
na dharmadharmitvamatīvabhede
vṛttyāsti cenna tritayaṃ cakāsti |
ihedamityasti matiśca vṛttau
na gauṇabhedo'pi ca lokabādhaḥ || 7 ||

dharmadharmiṇoratīvabhede [atīvetyatrevaśabdo vākyālaṅkāre taṃ
ca prāyo'tiśabdātkiṃvṛtteśca prayuñjate śābdikāḥ yathā--āva-
rjjitā kiñcidiva stanābhyām udvṛttaḥ ka iva sukhāvahaḥ
pareṣāmityādi] tataśca ekāntabhinnatve'ṅgīkriyamāṇe dharmadharmitvaṃ
na syād asya dharmiṇa ime dharmā eṣāṃ ca dharmāṇāmayamāśrayabhūto
dharmītyevaṃ sarvaprasiddho dharmadharmivyapadeśo na prāpnoti | tayoratyanta-
bhinnatvepi tatkalpanāyāṃ padārthāntaradharmāṇāmapi vivakṣitadharma-
dharmitvāpatteḥ || evamukte sati paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate | vṛttyāstīti |
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāmihapratyayahetuḥ saṃbandhaḥ sama-
vāyaḥ | sa ca samavayanātsamavāya iti dravyaguṇakarmasāmānya-
viśeṣeṣu pañcasu padārtheṣu vartanādvṛttiriti cākhyāyate | tayā
vṛttyā samavāyasaṃbandhena tayordharmadharmiṇoritaretaravinirluṇṭhitatvepi
dharmadharmivyapadeśa iṣyate | iti nānantarokto doṣa iti || atrācāryaḥ
samādhatte | cediti | yadyevaṃ tava matiḥ sā pratyakṣapratikṣiptā | yato na
tritayaṃ cakāsti | ayaṃ dharmī ime cāsya dharmā ayaṃ caitatsaṃba-
ndhanibandhanaṃ samavāya ityetattritayaṃ vastutrayaṃ na cakāsti jñāna-
viṣayatayā na pratibhāsate | yathā kila śilāśakalayugalasya mitho'
nusandhāyakaṃ rālādidravyaṃ tasmātpṛthak tṛtīyatayā pratibhāsate
naivamatra samavāyasyāpi pratibhānaṃ kiṃ tu dvayoreva dharmadharmiṇoriti
śapathapratyāyanīyoyaṃ samavāya iti bhāvārthaḥ || kiṃ cāyaṃ tena vādinā
eko nityaḥ sarvavyāpako 'mūrtaśca parikalpyate | tato yathā ghaṭāśritāḥ
pākajarūpādayo dharmāḥ samavāyasaṃbandhena samavetāstathā kiṃ na
paṭepi | tasyaikatvanityatvavyāpakatvaiḥ sarvatra tulyatvāt | yathākāśa
eko nityo vyāpako'mūrtaśca san sarvaiḥ saṃbandhibhiryugapadavi-
śaṣeṇa saṃbadhyate tathā kiṃ nāyamapīti | vinaśyadekavastusamavāyābhāve
ca samastavastusamavāyābhāvaḥ prasajyate | tattadavacchedakabhedānnāyaṃ-
doṣa iti cedevamanityatvāpattiḥ | prativastusvabhāvabhedāditi | atha
kathaṃ samavāyasya na jñāne pratibhāsanaṃ yatastasyehetipratyayaḥ sāva-
dhānaṃ sādhanam | ihapratyayaścānubhavasiddha eva | iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ihātmani
jñānam | iha ghaṭe rūpādaya iti pratīterupalambhāt | asya ca pratya-
yasya kevaladharmadharmyanālambanatvādasti samavāyākhyaṃ padārthāntaraṃ
taddheturiti parāśaṅkāmabhisandhāya punarāha | ihedamityasti matiśca
vṛttāviti | ihedamiti ihedamiti āśrayāśrayibhāvahetuka ihapratyayo
vṛttāvapyasti samavāyasaṃbandhepi vidyate | caśabdo'piśabdārthaḥ | tasya
ca vyavahitasaṃbandhastathaiva ca vyākhyātam | idamatra hṛdayam | yathā
tvanmate pṛthivītvābhisaṃbandhātpṛthivī tatra pṛthivītvaṃ pṛthivyā eva
svarūpamastitvākhyaṃ nāparaṃ vastvantaraṃ tena svarūpeṇaiva samaṃ yo-
sāvabhisaṃbandhaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sa eva samavāya ityucyate | prāptā-
nāmeva prāptiḥ samavāyaḥ iti vacanāt | evaṃ samavāyatvābhisaṃbandhā-
tsamavāya ityapi kiṃ na kalpyate | yatastasyāpi yatsamavāyatvaṃ
svasvarūpaṃ tena sārdhaṃ saṃbandhostyeva | anyathā niḥsvabhāvatvā-
cchaśaviṣāṇavadavastutvameva bhavet | tataśca iha samavāye samavāyatva-
mityullekhena ihapratyayaḥ samavāyepi yuktyā ghaṭata eva | tato yathā
pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivītvaṃ samavāyena samavetaṃ samavāyepi samavāyatvamevaṃ
samavāyāntareṇa saṃbandhanīyaṃ tadapyapareṇetyevaṃ dustarānavasthā
mahānadī || evaṃ samavāyasyāpi samavāyatvābhisaṃbandhe yuktyā upa-
pādite sāhasikyamālambya punaḥ pūrvapakṣavādī vadati | nanu pṛthivyā-
dīnāṃ pṛthivītvābhisaṃbandhanibandhanaṃ samavāyo mukhyaḥ | tatra tvatalā-
dipratyayābhivyaṅgyasya saṃgṛhītasakalāvāntarajātilakṣaṇavyakti-
bhedasya sāmānyasyodbhavāt | iha tu samavāyasyaikatvena vyaktibhe-
dābhāve jāteranudbhūtatvādgauṇoyaṃ yuṣmatparikalpita ihetipratyaya-
sādhyaḥ samavāyatvābhisaṃbandhastatsādhyaśca samavāya iti | tadeta-
nna cetaścamatkārakāraṇam | yatotrāpi jātirudbhavantī kena niru-
dhyeta | vyakterabhedeneti cenna | tattadavacchedakavaśāttadbhedopapattau
vyaktibhedakalpanāyā durnivāratvāt | anyo hi ghaṭasamavāyonyaśca
paṭasamavāya iti vyakta eva samavāyasyāpi vyaktibheda iti ta-
tsiddhau siddha eva jātyudbhavaḥ | tasmādanyatrāpi mukhya eva samavāyaḥ |
ihapratyayasyobhayatrāpyavyabhicārāt ||

tadetatsakalaṃ sapūrvapakṣaṃ samādhānaṃ manasi nidhāya
siddhāntavādī prāha | na gauṇabheda iti | gauṇa iti yoyaṃ bhedaḥ
sa nāsti | gauṇalakṣaṇābhāvāt | tallakṣaṇaṃ cetthamācakṣate--
avyabhicārī mukhyo'vikalo'sādhāraṇo'ntaraṅgaśca |
viparīto gauṇorthaḥ sati mukhye dhīḥ kathaṃ gauṇe ||

tasmāddharmadharmiṇoḥ saṃbandhane mukhyaḥ samavāyaḥ samavāye
ca samavāyatvābhisaṃbandhe gauṇa ityayaṃ bhedo nānātvaṃ nāstīti
bhāvārthaḥ | kiṃ ca yoyamiha tantuṣu paṭa ityādipratyayātsamavāyasādhana-
manorathaḥ sa khalvanuharate napuṃsakādapatyaprasavamanoratham | iha tantuṣu
paṭa ityādervyavahārasyālaukikatvāt | pāṃśulapādānāmapīha paṭe
tanturityevaṃ pratītidarśanāt | iha bhūtale ghaṭābhāva ityatrāpi sama-
vāyaprasaṅgāt | ata evāha api ca lokabādha iti | apiceti dūṣaṇā-
bhyuccaye | lokaḥ prāmāṇikalokaḥ sāmānyalokaśca | tena bādho
virodho lokabādhaḥ | tadapratītavyavahārasādhanāt | bādhaśabdasya
īhādyāḥ pratyayabhede iti puṃstrīliṅgatā | tasmāddharmadharmiṇo-
raviṣvagbhāvalakṣaṇa eva saṃbandhaḥ pratipattavyo nānyaḥ samavāyādi-
riti kāvyārthaḥ || 7 ||

atha sattābhidhānaṃ padārthāntaramātmanaśca vyatiriktaṃ jñānākhyaṃ
guṇamātmaviśeṣaguṇocchedasvarūpāṃ ca muktimajñānādaṅgīkṛtavataḥ
parānupahasannāha |
satāmapi syātkvacideva sattā
caitanyamaupādhikamātmanonyat |
na saṃvidānandamayī ca muktiḥ
susūtramāsūtritamatvadīyaiḥ || 8 ||

vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyākhyāḥ ṣaṭ-
padārthāstattvatayābhipretāḥ || tatra pṛthivyāpastejovāyurākāśaḥ
kālo dig ātmā mana iti nava dravyāṇi || guṇāścaturviṃśatiḥ |
tadyathā--rūparasagandhasparśasaṃkhyāparimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavi-
bhāgau paratvāparatve buddhiḥ sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnaśceti
sūtroktāḥ saptadaśa | caśabdasamuccitāśca sapta--dravatvaṃ gurutvaṃ saṃskāraḥ
sneho dharmādharmau śabdaśca | ityevaṃ caturviṃśatirguṇāḥ | saṃskārasya vega-
bhāvanāsthitisthāpakabhedātttraividhnyepi saṃskāratvajātyapekṣayā
ekatvācchauryaudāryādīnāṃ cātraivāntarbhāvānnādhikyam || karmāṇi
pañca | tadyathā--utkṣepaṇamavakṣepaṇamākuñcanaṃ prasāraṇaṃ gamanamiti |
gamanagrahaṇād bhramaṇarecanasyandanādyavirodhaḥ || atyantavyāvṛttānāṃ
piṇḍānāṃ yataḥ kāraṇādanyonyasvarūpānugamaḥ pratīyate tadanuvṛtti-
pratyayahetuḥ sāmānyam | tacca dvividhaṃ paramaparaṃ ca | tatra paraṃ sattā
bhāvo mahāsāmānyamiti cocyate | dravyatvādyavāntarasāmānyāpekṣayā
mahāviṣayatvāt | aparasāmānyaṃ ca dravyatvādi | etacca sāmānya-
viśeṣa ityapi vyapadiśyate | tathāhi dravyatvaṃ navasu dravyeṣu vartamāna-
tvātsāmānyaṃ guṇakarmabhyo vyāvṛttatvādviśeṣaḥ | tataḥ karmadhāraye
sāmānyaviśeṣa iti | evaṃ dravyatvāpekṣayā pṛthivītvādikamaparaṃ
tadapekṣayā ghaṭatvādikam | evaṃ caturviṃśatau guṇeṣu vṛtterguṇatvaṃ sā-
mānyaṃ dravyakarmabhyo vyāvṛtteśca viśeṣaḥ | evaṃ guṇatvāpekṣayā rūpatvā-
dikaṃ tadapekṣayā nīlatvādikam | evaṃ pañcasu karmasu vartanātkarmatvaṃ
sāmānyaṃ dravyaguṇebhyo vyāvṛttatvādviśeṣaḥ | evaṃ karmatvāpekṣayā
utkṣepaṇatvādikaṃ jñeyam || tatra sattā dravyaguṇakarmabhyorthāntaraṃ
kayā yuktyeti cet | ucyate | na dravyaṃ sattā dravyādanyetyarthaḥ |
ekadravyavattvāt | ekaikasmin dravye vartamānatvādityarthaḥ | dravyatvavat |
yathā dravyatvaṃ navasu dravyeṣu pratyekaṃ vartamānaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavati kiṃ
tu sāmānyaviśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ dravyatvameva evaṃ sattāpi | vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ
hi adravyaṃ vā dravyam anekadravyaṃ vā dravyam | tatrādravyamākāśaḥ
kālo dig ātmā manaḥ paramāṇavaḥ | anekadravyaṃ tu dvyaṇukādi-
skandhaḥ | ekadravyaṃ tu dravyameva na bhavati | ekadravyavatī ca sattā |
iti dravyalakṣaṇavilakṣaṇatvānna dravyam | evaṃ na guṇaḥ sattā |
guṇeṣu bhāvād | guṇatvavat | yadi hi sattā guṇaḥ syānna tarhi guṇeṣu
varteta | nirguṇatvād guṇānām | vartate ca guṇeṣu sattā | san guṇa
iti pratīteḥ | tathā na sattā karma | karmasu bhāvāt | karmatvavat | yadi ca
sattā karma syānna tarhi karmasu varteta | niṣkarmatvāt karmaṇām | varttate
ca karmasu sattā | sat karmeti pratīteḥ | tasmāt padārthāntaraṃ sattā ||

tathā viśeṣā nityadravyavṛttayontyā atyantavyāvṛttihetavaste
dravyādivailakṣaṇyāt padārthāntaram | tathā ca praśastakaraḥ--anteṣu
bhavā antyāḥ | svāśrayaviśeṣakatvādviśeṣāḥ | vināśārambharahiteṣu
nityadravyeṣvaṇvākāśakāladigātmamanaḥsu pratidravyamekaikaśo varta-
mānā atyantavyāvṛttibuddhihetavaḥ | yathāsmadādīnāṃ gavādiṣvaśvā-
dibhyastulyākṛtiguṇakriyāvayavopacayāvayabaviśeṣasaṃyoganimittā
pratyayavyāvṛttirdṛṣṭā gauḥ śuklaḥ śīghragatiḥ pīnaḥ kakudmān mahāghaṇṭa
iti tathāsmadviśiṣṭānāṃ yogināṃ nityeṣu tulyākṛtiguṇakriyeṣu
paramāṇuṣu muktātmamanaḥsu cānyanimittāsaṃbhavādyebhyo nimittebhyaḥ
pratyādhāraṃ vilakṣaṇoyaṃ vilakṣaṇoyamitipratyayavyāvṛttirdeśakāla-
viprakṛṣṭe ca paramāṇau sa evāyamiti pratyabhijñānaṃ ca bhavati tentyā
viśeṣā iti | amī ca viśeṣarūpā eva na tu dravyatvādivatsāmānya-
viśeṣobhayarūpā | vyāvṛttereva hetutvāt ||

tathā ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāmihapratyayahetuḥ saṃbandhaḥ
samavāya iti | ayutasiddhayoḥ parasparaparihāreṇa pṛthagāśrayānā-
śritayorāśrayāśrayibhāvaḥ iha tantuṣu paṭa ityādeḥ pratyayasyāsā-
dhāraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ samavāyaḥ | yadvaśāt svakāraṇasāmarthyādupajāyamānaṃ
paṭādyādhāryaṃ tantvādyādhāre saṃbadhyate yathā chidikriyā chedyeneti
sopi dravyādilakṣaṇavaidharmyāt padārthāntaram || iti ṣaṭ padārthāḥ ||

sāṃpratamakṣarārtho vyākriyate | satāmapītyādi | satāmapi
sadbuddhivedyatayā sādhāraṇānāmapi ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ madhye kvacideva
keṣucideva padārtheṣu sattā sāmānyayogaḥ syāt bhavet na sarveṣu |
teṣāmeṣā vācoyuktiḥ saditi | yato dravyaguṇakarmasu sā sattā iti
vacanāt yatraiva satpratyayastatraiva sattā | satpratyayaśca dravyaguṇakarmasve-
va atasteṣveva sattāyogaḥ | sāmānyādipadārthatraye tu na | tadabhāvāt |
idamuktaṃ bhavati | yadyapi vastusvarūpamastitvaṃ sāmānyāditrayepi
vidyate tathāpi tadanuvṛttipratyayaheturna bhavati | ya eva cānuvṛtti-
pratyayaḥ sa eva saditipratyaya iti tadabhāvānna sattāyogaḥ tatra |
dravyādīnāṃ punastrayāṇāṃ ṣaṭpadārthasādhāraṇaṃ vastusvarūpamastitvamapi
vidyate | anuvṛttipratyayahetuḥ sattāsaṃbandhopyasti | niḥsvarūpe
śaśaviṣāṇādau sattāyāḥ samavāyābhāvāt | sāmānyāditrike kathaṃ
nānuvṛttipratyaya iti cet bādhakasadbhāvāditi brūmaḥ | tathā hi sattā-
yāmapi sattāyogāṅgīkārenavasthā | viśeṣeṣu punastadabhyupagame
vyāvṛttihetutvalakṣaṇatatsvarūpahāniḥ | samavāye tatkalpanāyāṃ
saṃbandhābhāvaḥ | kena hi saṃbandhena tatra sattā saṃbadhyate |
samavāyāntarābhāvāt | tathā ca prāmāṇikaprakāṇḍamudayanaḥ--
vyakterabhedastulyatvaṃ saṃkarothānavasthitiḥ |
rūpahānirasaṃbandho jātibādhakasaṃgrahaḥ ||
iti | tataḥ sthitametatsatāmapi syātkvacideva satteti ||

tathā caitanyamityādi | caitanyaṃ jñānam | ātmanaḥ kṣetrajñāt |
anyat atyantavyatiriktam | asamāsakaraṇādatyantamiti labhyate |
atyantabhede sati kathamātmanaḥ saṃbandhi jñānamiti vyapadeśa iti
parāśaṅkāparihārārtham aupādhikamitiviśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetva-
bhidhānam | upādherāgatam aupādhikam | samavāyasaṃbandhalakṣaṇe-
nopādhinā ātmani samavetam | ātmanaḥ svayaṃ jaḍarūpatvāt |
samavāyasaṃbandhopaḍhaukitamiti yāvad | yadyātmano jñānādavyati-
riktatvamiṣyate tadā duḥkhajanmapravṛttidoṣamithyājñānānāmuttaro-
ttarāpāye tadanantarābhāvād buddhyādīnāṃ navānāmātmaviśeṣaguṇā-
nāmucchedāvasara ātmanopyucchedaḥ syāt | tadavyatiriktatvāt |
ato bhinnamevātmano jñānaṃ yauktikamiti || tathā na saṃvidityādi |
muktirmokṣaḥ | na saṃvidānandamayī na jñānasukharūpā | saṃvid jñānam |
ānandaḥ saukhyam | tato dvandvaḥ | saṃvidānandau prakṛtau yasyāṃ sā
saṃvidānandamayī | tādṛśī na bhavati | buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣa-
prayatnadharmādharmasaṃskārarūpāṇāṃ navānāmātmano vaiśeṣikaguṇānā-
matyantocchedo mokṣa iti vacanāt | caśabdaḥ pūrvoktābhyupa-
gamadvayasamuccaye | jñānaṃ hi kṣaṇikatvādanityaṃ sukhaṃ ca saprakṣayatayā
sātiśayatayā ca na viśiṣyate saṃsārāvasthātaḥ | iti taducchede
ātmasvarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ mokṣa iti | prayogaścātra--navānāmā-
tmaviśeṣaguṇānāṃ saṃtānotyantamucchidyate | saṃtānatvāt | yo yaḥ
saṃtānaḥ sa sotyantamucchidyate yathā pradīpasaṃtānaḥ | tathā cāyaṃ |
tasmādatyantamucchidyate iti | taduccheda eva mahodayo na kṛtsnakarma-
kṣayalakṣaṇa iti | na hi vai saśarīrasya priyāpriyayorapahatirasti |
aśarīraṃ vā vasantaṃ priyāpriye na spṛśataḥ ityādayopi
vedāntāstādṛśīmeva muktimādiśanti | atra hi priyā-
priye sukhaduḥkhe te cāśarīraṃ muktaṃ na spṛśataḥ | api ca
yāvadātmaguṇāḥ sarve nocchinnā vāsanādayaḥ |
tāvadātyantikī duḥkhavyāvṛttirna vikalpyate || 1 ||
dharmādharmanimitto hi saṃbhavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ |
mūlabhūtau ca tāveva stambhau saṃsārasadmanaḥ || 2 ||
taducchede ca tatkāryaśarīrādyanupaplavāt |
nātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhe sta ityasau mukta ucyate || 3 ||
icchādveṣaprayatnādi bhogāyatanabandhanam |
ucchinnabhogāyatano nātmā tairapi yujyate || 4 ||
tadevaṃ dhiṣaṇādīnāṃ navānāmapi mūlataḥ |
guṇānāmātmano dhvaṃsaḥ sopavargaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 5 ||
nanu tasyāmavasthāyāṃ kīdṛgātmāvaśiṣyate |
svarūpaikapratiṣṭhānaḥ parityaktokhilairguṇaiḥ || 6 ||
ūrmiṣaṭkātigaṃ rūpaṃ tadasyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
saṃsārabandhanādhīnaduḥkhakleśādyadūṣitam || 7 ||

kāmakrodhalobhagarvadambhaharṣāḥ ūrmiṣaṭkamiti | tadetadabhyupagamatraya-
mitthaṃ samarthayadbhiḥ atvadīyaistvadājñābahirbhūtaiḥ kaṇādamatānugāmibhiḥ
susūtramāsūtritam samyagāgamaḥ prapañcitaḥ | atha vā susūtramitikri-
yāviśeṣaṇam | śobhanaṃ sūtraṃ vastuvyavasthāghaṭanāvijñānaṃ yatraivamāsūtritaṃ
tattacchāstrārthopanibandhaḥ kṛta iti hṛdayam | sūtraṃ tu sūcanākāri
granthe tantuvyavasthayoḥ ityanekārthavacanāt | atra susūtramiti
viparītalakṣaṇayopahāsagarbhaṃ praśaṃsāvacanam | yathā--upakṛtaṃ bahu tatra
kimucyate sujanatā prathitā bhavatā ciram ityādi | upahasanīyatāca
yuktiriktatvāt tadaṅgīkaraṇam | tathā hi aviśeṣeṇa sadbuddhivedyeṣvapi
sarvapadārtheṣu dravyādiṣveva triṣu sattāsaṃbandhaḥ svīkriyate na sāmānyā-
ditraye iti mahatīyaṃ paśyatoharatā | yataḥ paribhāvyatāṃ sattāśabdasya
śabdārthaḥ | astīti san | sato bhāvaḥ sattā astitvam | tadvastusvarūpaṃ
nirviśeṣamaśeṣeṣvapi padārtheṣu tvayāpyuktam | tatkimidamardhajaratīyaṃ
yaddravyāditraya eva sattāyogo netaratra traye iti | anuvṛttipratyayā-
bhāvānna sāmānyāditraye sattāyoga iti cet na | tatrāpyanuvṛtti-
pratyayasyānivāryatvāt | pṛthivītvagotvaghaṭatvādisāmānyeṣu
sāmānyaṃ sāmānyamiti viśeṣeṣvapi bahutvādayamapi viśeṣoyamapi
viśeṣa iti samavāye ca prāguktayuktyā tattadavacchedakabhedāt
ekākārapratīteranubhavāt | svarūpatvasādharmyeṇa sattādhyāropāt |
sāmānyādiṣvapi satsadityanugama iti cet tarhi mithyāpratyayo-
yamāpadyate | atha bhinnasvabhāveṣvekānugamo mithyaiveti cet
dravyādiṣvapi sattādhyāropakṛta evāstu pratyayānugamaḥ | asati
mukhyedhyāropasyāsaṃbhavāt | dravyādiṣu mukhyoyamanugataḥ pratyayaḥ sā-
mānyādiṣu tu gauṇa iti cet na | viparyayasyāpi śakyakalpanatvāt |
sāmānyādiṣu bādhakasaṃbhavānna mukhyonugataḥ pratyayaḥ dravyādiṣu
tu tadabhāvānmukhya iti cet nanu kimidaṃ bādhakam | atha sāmānyepi
sattābhyupagamenavasthā viśeṣeṣu punaḥ sāmānyasadbhāve svarūpahāniḥ
samavāyepi sattākalpane tadvṛttyarthaṃ saṃbandhāntarābhāva iti bādhakā-
nīti cet na | sāmānyepi sattākalpane yadyanavasthā tarhi kathaṃ na sā
dravyādiṣu | teṣāmapi svarūpasattāyāḥ prāgeva vidyamānatvāt | viśeṣeṣu
punaḥ sattābhyupagamepi na rūpahāniḥ | svarūpasya pratyutottejanāt |
niḥsāmānyasya viśeṣasya kvacidapyanupalambhāt | samavāyepi sama-
vāyatvalakṣaṇāyāḥ svarūpasattāyāḥ svīkāre upapadyata evāviṣva-
gbhāvātmakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | anyathā tasya svarūpābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | iti
bādhakābhāvāt teṣvapi dravyavanmukhya eva sattāsaṃbandha iti vyarthaṃ
dravyaguṇakarmasveva sattākalpanam || kiṃ ca tairvādibhiryo dravyāditraye
mukhyaḥ sattāsaṃbandhaḥ kakṣīkṛtaḥ so'pi vicāryamāṇo viśīryeta |
tathā hi--yadi dravyādibhyo'tyantavilakṣaṇā sattā tadā dravyā-
dīnyasadrūpāṇyeva syuḥ | sattāyogātsattvamastyeveti cet asatāṃ
sattāyogepi kutaḥ sattvam | satāṃ tu niṣphalaḥ sattāyogaḥ |
svarūpasattvaṃ bhāvānāmastyeveti cet tarhi kiṃ śikhaṇḍitā sattāyogena |
sattāyogātprāg bhāvo na san nāpyasan sattāyogātta sanniti cet
vāṅmātrametat | sadasadvilakṣaṇasya prakārāntarasyāsaṃbhavāt | tasmāt
satāmapi syātkvacideva satteti teṣāṃ vacanaṃ viduṣāṃ pariṣadi
kathamiva nopahāsāya jāyate || jñānamapi yadyekāntenātmanaḥ sakā-
śādbhinnamiṣyate tadā tena caitrajñānena maitrasyeva naiva viṣayapariccheda
syādātmanaḥ | atha yatraivātmani samavāyasaṃbandhena samavetaṃ jñānaṃ
tatraiva bhāvāvabhāsaṃ karotīti cenna | samavāyasyaikattvānnityatvā-
dvyāpakattvācca | sarvatra vṛtteraviśeṣātsamavāyavadātmanāmapi vyāpa-
katvādekajñānena sarveṣāṃ viṣayāvabodhaprasaṅgaḥ | yathā ca ghaṭe
rūpādayaḥ samavāyasaṃbandhena samavetāstadvināśe ca tadāśrayasya
ghaṭasyāpi vināśa evaṃ jñānamapyātmani samavetam tacca kṣaṇikam
tatastadvināśe ātmanopi vināśāpatteranityatvāpattiḥ | athāstu
samavāyena jñānātmanoḥ saṃbandhaḥ | kiṃ tu sa eva samavāyaḥ
kena tayoḥ saṃbadhyate | samavāyāntareṇa cet anavasthā | svenaiva
cet kiṃ na jñānātmanorapi tathā | atha yathā pradīpasvābhā-
vyādātmānaṃ paraṃ ca prakāśayati tathā samavāyasyedṛgeva svabhāvo
yadātmānaṃ jñānātmanau ca saṃbandhayatīti cet jñānātmano-
rapi kiṃ na tathāsvabhāvatā yena svayamevaitau saṃbadhyete | kiṃ ca
pradīpadṛṣṭāntopi bhavatpakṣe na jāghaṭīti | yataḥ pradīpastāvaddravyaṃ
prakāśaśca tasya dharmo dharmadharmiṇośca tvayātyantaṃ bhedobhyupagamyate
tatkathaṃ pradīpasya prakāśātmakatā | tadabhāve ca svaparaprakāśakasvabhāva-
tābhaṇitirnirmūlaiva | yadi ca pradīpātprakāśasyātyantabhedepi
pradīpasya svaparaprakāśakatvamiṣyate tadā ghaṭādīnāmapi tadanuṣajyate |
bhedāviśeṣāt | api ca tau svaparasaṃbandhasvabhāvau samavāyādbhinnau
syātāmabhinnau vā | yadi bhinnau tatastasyaitau svabhāvāviti kathaṃ
saṃbandhaḥ | saṃbandhanibandhanasya samavāyāntarasyānavasthābhayādana-
bhyupagamāt | athābhinnau tataḥ samavāyamātrameva | na tau | tadavyatiri-
ktatvāttatsvarūpavaditi | kiṃ ca yathā iha samavāyiṣu samavāya iti
mitiḥ samavāyaṃ vināpyupapannā tathā ihātmani jñānamityayamapi
pratyayastaṃ vinaiva ceducyate tadā ko doṣaḥ | athātmā kartā jñānaṃ karaṇaṃ
kartṛkaraṇayośca varddhakivāsīvadbheda eva pratītastatkathaṃ jñānātmanorabheda
iti | tanna | dṛṣṭāntasya vaiṣamyāt | vāsī hi bāhyaṃ karaṇaṃ jñānaṃ
cābhyantaraṃ tatkathamanayoḥ sādharmyam | na caivaṃ karaṇasya dvaividhyama-
prasiddham | yadāhurlākṣaṇikāḥ |
karaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ buddhaiḥ |
yathā lunāti dātreṇa meruṃ gacchati cetasā ||

yadi hi kiṃcitkaraṇamāntaramekāntena bhinnamupadarśyate tataḥ
syāt dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sādharmyam | na ca tathāvidhamasti | na ca
bāhyakaraṇagato dharmaḥ sarvopyāntare yojayituṃ śakyate | anyathā
dīpena cakṣuṣā devadattaḥ paśyatītyatrāpi dīpādiccakṣuṣopyekāntena
devadattasya bhedaḥ syāt | tathā ca sati lokapratītivirodha iti |
apica sādhyavikalopi vāsīvarddhakidṛṣṭāntaḥ | tathā hi nāyaṃ varddhakiḥ
kāṣṭhamidamanayā vāsyā ghaṭayiṣya ityevaṃ vāsīgrahaṇapariṇāmenā-
pariṇataḥ san tāmagṛhītvā ghaṭayati kiṃ tu tathā pariṇatastāṃ gṛhītvā |
tathā pariṇāmena vāsirapi tasya kāṣṭhasya ghaṭane vyāpriyate puruṣopi |
ityevaṃ lakṣaṇaikārthasādhakatvādvāsīvarddhakyorabhedopyupapadyate | tatka-
thamanayorbheda evetyucyate | evamātmāpi vivakṣitamarthamanena jñānena
jñāsyāmīti jñānagrahaṇapariṇāmavān jñānaṃ gṛhītvārthaṃ vyavasyāti | tataśca
jñānātmanorubhayorapi saṃvittilakṣaṇaikakāryasādhakatvādabheda eva | evaṃ
kartṛkaraṇayorabhede siddhe saṃvittilakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kimātmani vyavasthitaṃ
āhosvidviṣaya iti vācyam | ātmani cet siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam |
viṣaye cet kathamātmanonubhavaḥ pratīyate | atha viṣayasthitasaṃvitteḥ
sakāśāṃdātmanonubhavaḥtarhi kiṃ na puruṣāntarasyāpi | tadbhedāvi-
śeṣāt | atha jñānātmanorabhedapakṣe kathaṃ kartṛkaraṇabhāva iti cet nanu
yathā sarpa ātmānamātmanā veṣṭayatītyatra abhede yathā kartṛkaraṇa-
bhāvastathātrāpi | atha parikalpito'yaṃ kartṛkaraṇabhāva iti cet
veṣṭanāvasthāyāṃ prāgavasthāvilakṣaṇagatinirodhalakṣaṇārthakriyādarśa-
nāt kathaṃ parikalpitatvam | na hi parikalpanāśatairapi śailastambha
ātmānamātmanā veṣṭayatīti vaktuṃ śakyam | tasmādabhedepi
kartṛkaraṇabhāvaḥ siddha eva || kiṃ ca caitanyamitiśabdasya cintyatā-
manvarthaḥ | cetanasya bhāvaścaitanyam | cetanaścātmā tvayāpi
kīrtyate | tasya bhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ caitanyam | yacca yasya svarūpaṃ na
tattato bhinnaṃ bhavitumarhati | yathā vṛkṣādvṛkṣasvarūpam | athāsti
cetana ātmā | paraṃ cetanāsamavāyasaṃbandhāt na svataḥ tathāpratīteriti
cet tadayuktam | yataḥ pratītiścetpramāṇīkriyate tarhi nirbādhamupayo-
gātmaka evātmā prasiddhyati | na hi jātucitsvayamacetanohaṃ ceta-
nāyogāccetanaḥ acetane vā mayi cetanāyāḥ samavāya iti pratī-
tirasti | jñātāhamiti samānādhikaraṇatayā pratīteḥ | bhede tathā-
pratītiriti cet na | kathaṃcittādātmyābhāve sāmānādhikaraṇya-
pratīteradarśanāt | yaṣṭiḥ puruṣa ityādipratītistu bhede satyupacā-
rāt dṛṣṭā na punastāttvikī | upacārasya tu bījaṃ puruṣasya yaṣṭi-
gatastabdhatvādiguṇairabhedaḥ | upacārasya mukhyārthasparśitvāt | tathā
cātmani jñātāhamiti pratītiḥ kathaṃciccetanātmatāṃ gamayati |
tāmantareṇa jñātāhamitipratīteranupapadyamānatvāt | ghaṭādivat | na hi
ghaṭādiracetanātmako jñātāhamiti pratyeti | caitanyayogābhāvādasau
na tathā pratyetīti cet na | acetanasyāpi caitanyayogāccetanohami-
ti pratipatteranantarameva nirastatvāt | ityacetanatvaṃ siddhamātmano
jaḍasyārthaparicchedaṃ parākaroti | taṃ punaricchatā caitanyasvarūpatāsya
svīkaraṇīyā || nanu jñānavānahamitipratyayādātmajñānayorbhedaḥ anya-
thā dhanavānitipratyayādapi dhanadhanavatorbhedābhāvānuṣaṅgāt | tadasat |
yato jñānavānahamiti nātmā bhavanmate pratyeti jaḍatvaikāntarūpatvāt |
ghaṭavat | sarvathā jaḍaśca syādātmā jñānavānahamitipratyayaśca syāda-
sya virodhābhāvāt iti mā nirṇaiṣīḥ | tasya tathotpattyasaṃbhavāt | jñā-
navānahamiti hi pratyayo nāgṛhītajñānākhye viśeṣaṇe viśeṣye cā-
tmani jātūtpadyate | svamatavirodhāt | nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye
buddhiḥ iti vacanāt | gṛhītayostayorutpadyata iti cetkutastadgṛhītiḥ |
na tāvatsvataḥ | svayaṃvedanānabhyupagamāt | svayaṃvidite hyātmani
jñāne ca svataḥ sā yujyate nānyathā | saṃtānāntaravat | parataścet-
tadapi jñānāntaraṃ viśeṣyaṃ nāgṛhīte jñānatvaviśeṣaṇe grahītuṃ śakyam |
gṛhīte hi ghaṭatve ghaṭagrahaṇamiti jñānāntarāttadgrahaṇena bhāvyamitya-
navasthānāt kutaḥ prakṛtapratyayaḥ | tadevaṃ nātmano jaḍasvarūpatā
saṃgacchate | tadasaṃgatau ca caitanyamāpādhikamātmano'nyat iti vā-
ṅmātram ||

tathā yadapi na saṃvidānandamayī ca muktiriti vyavasthā-
panāyānumānamavādi saṃtānatvāditi tatrābhidhīyate | nanu ki-
midaṃ saṃtānatvaṃ svatantramaparāparapadārthotpattimātraṃ vā ekāśrayāpa-
rāparotpattirvā | tatrādyaḥ pakṣaḥ savyabhicāraḥ | aparāpareṣāmutpā-
dukānāṃ ghaṭapaṭakaṭādīnāṃ saṃtānatvepyatyantamanucchidyamānatvāt | atha
dvitīyapakṣaḥ tarhi tādṛśaṃ saṃtānatvaṃ pradīpe nāstīti sādhanavikalo
dṛṣṭāntaḥ | paramāṇupākajarūpādibhiśca vyabhicārī hetuḥ | tathāvidhasaṃtā-
natvasya tatra sadbhāvepyatyantocchedābhāvāt | api ca saṃtānatvamapi bhavi-
ṣyati atyantānucchedaśca bhaviṣyati | viparyayabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt |
iti saṃdigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvādapyanaikāntikoyam | kiṃ ca
syādvādavādināṃ nāsti kvacidatyantamucchedo dravyarūpatayā sthā-
snūnāmeva satāṃ bhāvānāmutpādavyayayuktatvāt iti viruddhaśca | iti
nādhikṛtānumānādbudhyādiguṇocchedarūpā siddhiḥ sidhyati || nāpi
na hi vai saśarīrasya ityāderāgamāt | sa hi śubhāśubhādṛṣṭaparipāka-
janye sāṃsārikapriyāpriye parasparānuṣakte apekṣya vyavasthitaḥ |
muktidaśāyāṃ tu sakalādṛṣṭakṣayahetukamaikāntikamātyantikaṃ ca kevalaṃ
priyameva tatkathaṃ pratiṣidhyate | āgamasya cāyamarthaḥ saśarīrasya
gaticatuṣṭayānyatamasthānavartinaḥ ātmanaḥ priyāpriyayoḥ parasparā-
nuṣaktayoḥ sukhaduḥkhayorapahatirabhāvo nāstīti | avaśyaṃ hi tatra
sukhaduḥkhābhyāṃ bhāvyam | parasparānuṣaktatvaṃ ca samāsakaraṇādabhyūhyate |
aśarīraṃ muktātmānam | vāśabdasyevakārārthatvādaśarīrameva santaṃ
siddhikṣetramadhyāsīnaṃ priyāpriye parasparānuṣakte sukhaduḥkhe na spṛ-
śataḥ | idamatra hṛdayam | yathā kila saṃsāriṇaḥ sukhaduḥkhe paraspa-
rānuṣakte syātāṃ na tathā muktātmanaḥ kiṃ tu kevalaṃ sukhameva |
duḥkhamūlasya śarīrasyaivābhāvāt | sukhaṃ tvātmasvarūpatvādavasthitameva |
svasvarūpāvasthānaṃ hi mokṣaḥ | ata evāśarīramityuktam | āga-
mārthaścāyamitthameva samarthanīyaḥ | yata etadarthānupātinyeva smṛti-
rapi dṛśyate |
sukhamātyantikaṃ yatra buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam |
taṃ vai mokṣaṃ vijānīyādduṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ ||

na cāyaṃ sukhaśabdo duḥkhābhāvamātre vartate | mukhyasukha-
vācyatāyāṃ bādhakābhāvāt | ayaṃ rogādvipramuktaḥ sukhī
jāta ityādivākyeṣu ca sukhītiprayogasya paunaruktyaprasaṅgācca |
duḥkhābhāvamātrasya rogādviprayukta itīyataiva gatatvāt | na ca bhava-
dudīrito mokṣaḥ puṃsāmupādeyatayā saṃmataḥ | ko hi nāma śilā-
kalpamapagatasakalasukhasaṃvedanamātmānamupapādayituṃ yateta | duḥkhasaṃ-
vedanarūpatvādasya sukhaduḥkhayorekasyābhāve'parasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt |
ata eva tvadupahāsaḥ śrūyate |
varaṃ vṛndāvane ramye kroṣṭṛtvamabhivāñchitam |
na tu vaiśeṣikīṃ muktiṃ gautamo gantumicchati ||

sopādhikasāvadhikaparimitānandaniṣyandāt svargādapyadhikaṃ
tadviparītānandamamlānajñānaṃ ca mokṣamācakṣate vicakṣaṇāḥ | yadi
tu jaḍaḥ pāṣāṇanirviśeṣa eva tasyāmavasthāyāmātmā bhavet tada-
lamapavargeṇa | saṃsāra eva varamastu | yatra tāvadantarāntarāpi duḥkha-
kaluṣitamapi kiyadapi sukhamanubhujyate cintyatāṃ tāvatkimalpa-
sukhānubhavo bhavya uta sarvasukhoccheda eva | athāsti tathābhūte
mokṣe lābhātirekaḥ prekṣādakṣāṇām | te hyevaṃ vivecayanti | saṃsāre
tāvat duḥkhāspṛṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ na saṃbhavati duḥkhaṃ cāvaśyaṃ heyaṃ viveka-
hānaṃ cānayorekabhājanapatitaviṣamadhunoriva duḥśakyamata eva dve
api tyajyete | ataśca saṃsārānmokṣaḥ śreyān | yatotra duḥkhaṃ
sarvathā na syāt | varamiyatī kādācitkasukhamātrāpi tyaktā
na tu tasyāḥ kṛte duḥkhabhāra iyān vyūḍha iti | tadetatsatyam | sāṃsā-
rikasukhasya madhudigdhadhārākarālamaṇḍalāgragrāsavadduḥkharūpatvādeva
yuktaiva mumukṣūṇāṃ tajjihāsā | kiṃtvātyantikasukhaviśeṣalipsūnā-
meva | ihāpi viṣayanivṛttijaṃ sukhamanubhavasiddhaṃ tadyadi mokṣe viśiṣṭaṃ
nāsti tato mokṣo duḥkharūpa evāpadyata ityarthaḥ | ye api viṣa-
madhunī ekatra saṃpṛkte tyajyete te api sukhaviśeṣalipsayaiva |
kiñca yathā prāṇināṃ saṃsārāvasthāyāṃ sukhamiṣṭaṃ duḥkhaṃ cāniṣṭaṃ tathā
mokṣāvasthāyāṃ duḥkhanivṛttiriṣṭā sukhanivṛttistvaniṣṭaiva | tato yadi
tvadabhimato mokṣaḥ syāttadā na prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt | bhavati
ceyam | tataḥ siddho mokṣaḥ sukhasaṃvedanasvabhāvaḥ | prekṣāvatpravṛtte-
ranyathānupapatteḥ | atha yadi sukhasaṃvedenaikasvabhāvo mokṣaḥ syāttadā
tadrāgeṇa pravartamāno mumukṣurna mokṣamadhigacchet | nahi rāgiṇāṃ
mokṣosti | rāgasya bandhanātmakatvāt | naivam | sāṃsārikasukhameva rāgo
bandhanātmako viṣayādipravṛttihetutvāt | mokṣasukhe tu rāgo na bandhanā-
tmakaḥ | parāṃ koṭimārūḍhasya ca spṛhāmātrarūpopyasau nivartate | mokṣe
bhave ca sarvatra niḥspṛho munisattamaḥ iti vacanāt | anyathā bhavatpa-
kṣepi duḥkhanivṛttyātmakamokṣāṅgīkṛtau duḥkhaviṣayakaṣāyakāluṣyaṃ
kena niṣidhyeta | iti siddhaṃ kṛsnakarmakṣayātparamasukhasaṃvedanātmako
mokṣo na buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇocchedarūpa iti || api ca bhoḥ tapa-
svin kathaṃ ciducchedosmākamapyabhimata evaiṣāmiti mā virūpaṃ
manaḥ kṛthāḥ | tathā hi buddhiśabdena jñānamucyate | tacca matiśrutāva-
dhimanaḥparyāyakevalabhedātpañcadhā | tatrādyaṃ jñānacatuṣṭayaṃ kṣāyopaśa-
mikatvāt kevalajñānāvirbhāvakāla eva pralīnam | “naṭhṭhaṃmi u chāu-
matthie nāṇe” ityāgamāt | kevalaṃ tu sarvadravyaparyāgataṃ kṣāyika-
tvena niṣkalaṅkātmasvarūpatvādastyeva mokṣāvasthāyāṃ sukhaṃ tu vaiṣayikaṃ
tatra nāsti | taddhetorvedanīyakarmaṇo'bhāvāt | yattu niratiśayamakṣaya-
manapekṣamanantaṃ ca sukhaṃ tadbāḍhaṃ vidyate | duḥkhasya cādharmamūlatvā-
ttaducchedāducchedaḥ | nanvevaṃ sukhasyāpi dharmamūlatvāddharmasya cocche-
dāttadapi na yujyate | puṇyapāpakṣayo mokṣaḥ ityāgamavacanāt |
naivam | vaiṣayikasukhasyaiva dharmamūlatvādbhavatu taducchedo na punarana-
pekṣasyāpi sukhasyocchedaḥ | icchādveṣayoḥ punarmoharbhedatvāt tasya
ca samūlakāṣaṃkaṣitatvādabhāvaḥ | prayatnaśca kriyāvyāpāragocaro
nāstyeva | kṛtakṛtyatvāt | vīryāntarāya kṣayopanatastvastyeva prayatno
dānādhilabdhivat | na ca kvacidupayujyate kṛtārthatvāt | dharmādharma-
yostu puṇyapāpāparaparyāyayorucchedo'styeva | tadabhāve mokṣasyaivā-
yogāt | saṃskāraśca matijñānaviśeṣa eva | tasya ca mohakṣayānantarameva
kṣīṇatvādabhāva iti | tadevaṃ na saṃvidānandamayī ca muktiriti
yuktirikteyamuktiriti kāvyārthaḥ || 8 ||

atha te vādinaḥ kāyapramāṇatvamātmanaḥ svayaṃsaṃvedyamānamapyapa-
lapya tādṛśakuśāstraśastrasaṃparkavinaṣṭadṛṣṭayastasya vibhutvaṃ manyante | ata-
statropālambhamāha |
yatraiva yo dṛṣṭaguṇaḥ sa tatra
kumbhādivanniṣpratipakṣametat |
tathāpi dehādvahirātmatattva-
matattvavādopahatāḥ paṭhanti || 9 ||

yatraiva deśe yaḥ padārtho dṛṣṭaguṇo dṛṣṭāḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇatonu-
bhūtā guṇā dharmā yasya sa tathā sa padārthastatraiva vivakṣitadeśa evo-
papadyate | kriyādhyāhāro gamyaḥ | pūrvasyaivakārasyāvadhāraṇārthasyātrā-
pyabhisaṃbandhāt tatraiva nānyatretyanyayogavyavacchedaḥ | amumevārthaṃ
dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | kumbhādivaditi | ghaṭādivat | yathā kumbhāde-
ryatraiva deśe rūpādayo guṇā upalabhyante tatraiva teṣāmastitvaṃ pratīyate
nānyatra evamātmanopi guṇāścaitanyādayo deha eva dṛśyante na
bahiḥ tasmāt tatpramāṇa evāyamiti | yadyapi puṣpādīnāmavasthāna-
deśādanyatrāpi gandhādiguṇa upalabhyate tathāpi tena na vyabhi-
cāraḥ | tadāśrayā hi gandhādipudgalāsteṣāṃ ca vaisrasikyā
prāyogikyā vā gatyā gatimattvena tadupalambhakaghrāṇādideśaṃ yāva-
dāgamanopapatteriti | ata evāha | niṣpratipakṣametaditi | etanni-
ṣpratipakṣaṃ bādhakarahitam | na hi dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāmeti nyāyāt |
nanu mantrādīnāṃ bhinnadeśasthānāmapyākarṣaṇoccāṭanādiko guṇo
yojanaśatādeḥ paratopi dṛśyate ityasti bādhakamiti cet maivaṃ
vocaḥ | sa hi na khalu mantrādīnāṃ guṇaḥ kiṃ tu tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatānām |
tāsāṃ cākarṣaṇīyoccāṭanīyādideśagamane kautaskuto'yamupālambhaḥ |
na jātu guṇā guṇinamatiricya vartanta iti ||

athottarārdhaṃ vyākhyāyate | tathāpītyādi | tathāpyevaṃ niḥsapatnaṃ
vyavasthitepi tattve | atattvavādopahatāḥ | anācāra ityatreva nañaḥ
kutsārthatvāt | kutsitatattvavādena tadabhimatāptābhāsapuruṣaviśeṣapraṇītena
tattvābhāsaprarūpaṇenopahatā vyāmohitāḥ | dehādbahiḥ śarīravyati-
riktepideśe | ātmatattvamātmarūpam | paṭhanti śāstrarūpatayā praṇayante ||
ityakṣarārthaḥ ||

bhāvārthastvayam | ātmā sarvagato na bhavati | sarvatra tad-
guṇānupalabdheḥ | yo yaḥ sarvatrānupalabhyamānaguṇaḥ sa sarvagato
na bhavati yathā ghaṭaḥ | tathā cāyam | tasmāt tathā | vyatireke vyomā-
diḥ || na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ | kāyavyatiriktadeśe tadguṇānāṃ buddhyā-
dīnāṃ vādinā prativādinā vānabhyupagamāt | tathā ca bhaṭṭaḥ
śrīdharaḥ | sarvagatatvepyātmano dehapradeśe jñātṛtvaṃ nānyatra śarī-
rasyopabhogāyatanatvāt anyathā tasya vaiyarthyāt iti | athāstya-
dṛṣṭamātmano viśeṣaguṇaḥ | tacca sarvotpattimatāṃ nimittaṃ sarvavyāpakaṃ
ca | kathamitarathā dvīpāntarādiṣvapi pratiniyatadeśavarttipuruṣopabho-
gyāni kanakaratnacandanāṅganādīni tenotpādyante | guṇaśca guṇinaṃ
vihāya na vartate | atonumīyate sarvagata ātmeti | naivam | adṛ-
ṣṭasya sarvagatatvasādhane pramāṇābhāvāt | athāstyeva pramāṇaṃ vahne-
rūrddhvajvalanaṃ vāyostiryaggamanaṃ cādṛṣṭakāritamiti cenna | tayo-
statsvabhāvatvādeva tatsiddherdahanasya dahanaśaktivat | sāpyadṛṣṭakā-
ritā cet tarhi jagattrayavaicittrīsūtraṇepi tadeva sūtradhārāyatāṃ
kimīśvarakalpanayā | tannāyamasiddho hetuḥ || nacānaikāntikaḥ |
sādhyasādhanayorvyāptigrahaṇena vyabhicārābhāvāt || nāpi viruddhaḥ |
atyantaṃ vipakṣavyāvṛttatvāt | ātmaguṇāśca buddhyādayaḥ śarīra
evopalabhyante tato guṇināpi tatraiva bhāvyam || iti siddhaḥ kāya-
pramāṇa ātmā || anyacca | tvayā ātmanāṃ bahutvamiṣyate | nānātmāno
vyavasthāta iti vacanāt | te ca vyāpakāḥ | tatasteṣāṃ pradīpaprabhā-
maṇḍalānāmiva parasparānuvedhe tadāśritaśubhāśubhakarmaṇāmapi para-
sparaṃ saṃkaraḥ syāt | tathācaikasya śubhakarmaṇā anyaḥ sukhī bhave-
ditarasyāśubhakarmaṇā anyo duḥkhītyasamañjasamāpadyeta | anyacca
ekasyaivātmanaḥ svopāttaśubhakarmavipākena sukhitvaṃ paropārjitā-
śubhakarmavipākasaṃbandhena ca duḥkhitvamiti yugapatsukhaduḥkhasaṃvedana-
prasaṅgaḥ | atha svāvaṣṭabdhabhogāyatanamāśrityaiva śubhāśubhayorbhogaḥ tarhi
svopārjitamapyadṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ bhogāyatanādbahirniṣkramya vahnerūrddhvajvala-
nādikaṃ karotīti cintyametat || ātmanāṃ ca sarvagatatve ekaikasya
sṛṣṭikartṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ | sarvagatatveneśvarāntarānupraveśasya saṃbhāvanīya-
tvāt | īśvarasya vā tadantaranupraveśe tasyāpyakartṛtvāpattiḥ | na hi
kṣīranīrayoranyonyasaṃbandhe ekatarasya pānādikriyā anyatarasya na
bhavatīti yuktaṃ vaktum || kiṃca ātmanaḥ sarvagatatve naranārakādi-
paryāyāṇāṃ yugapadanubhavānuṣaṅgaḥ | atha bhogāyatanābhyupagamānnāyaṃ
doṣa iti cet nanu sa bhogāyatanaṃ sarvātmanāvaṣṭabhnīyādekadeśena
vā | sarvātmanā cedasmadabhimatāṅgīkāraḥ | ekadeśena cet sāvaya-
vatvaprasaṅgaḥ | paripūrṇabhogābhāvaśca || athātmano vyāpakatvābhāve
digdeśāntaravartiparamāṇubhiryugapatsaṃyogābhāvādādyakarmābhāvaḥ tada-
bhāvādantyasaṃyogasya tannirmitaśarīrasya tena tatsaṃbandhasya cābhā-
vādanupāyasiddhaḥ sarvadā sarveṣāṃ mokṣaḥ syāt | naivam | yadyena
saṃyuktaṃ tadeva taṃ pratyupasarpatīti niyamāsaṃbhavāt | ayaskāntaṃ pratya-
yasastenāsaṃyuktasyāpyākarṣaṇopalabdheḥ | athāsaṃyuktasyāpyākarṣaṇe
taccharīrārambhaṃ pratyekamukhībhūtānāṃ tribhuvanodaravivaravartiparamāṇū-
nāmupasarpaṇaprasaṅgānna jāne taccharīraṃ kiyatpramāṇaṃ syāditi cet
saṃyuktasyāpyākarṣaṇe kathaṃ sa eva doṣo na bhavet | ātmano vyāpaka-
tvena sakalaparamāṇūnāṃ tena saṃyogāt | atha tadbhāvāviśeṣepyadṛṣṭavaśā-
dvivakṣitaśarīrotpādanānuguṇā niyatā eva paramāṇava upasarpanti |
taditaratrāpi tulyam || athāstu yathākathaṃciccharīrotpattiḥ tathāpi
sāvayavaṃ śarīraṃ pratyavayavamanupraviśannātmā sāvayavaḥ syāt | tathā
cāsya paṭādivat kāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ | kāryatve cāsau vijātīyaiḥ sa-
jātīyairvā kāraṇairārabhyeta | na tāvadvijātīyaiḥ | teṣāmanārambhakatvāt |
na hi tantavo ghaṭamārabhante | na ca sajātīyaiḥ | yata ātmatvābhisaṃba-
ndhādevaiteṣāṃ kāraṇānāṃ sajātīyatvam | pārthivādiparamāṇūnāṃ vijātī-
yatvāt | tathā cātmabhirātmā ārabhyata ityāyātam | taccāyuktam | ekatra
śarīre'nekātmanāmātmārambhakāṇāmasaṃbhavāt | saṃbhave vā pratisandhā-
nānupapattiḥ | nahyanyena dṛṣṭamanyaḥ pratisandhātumarhati | atiprasaṅgāt |
tadārabhyatve cāsya ghaṭavadavayavakriyāto vibhāgātsaṃyogavināśā-
dvināśaḥ syāt | tasmādvyāpaka evātmā yujyate | kāyapramāṇatā-
yāmuktadoṣasadbhāvāt | iti cenna | sāvayavatvakāryyatvayoḥ kathaṃcidā-
tmanyabhyupagamāt | tatra sāvayavatvaṃ tāvadasaṃkhyeyapradeśātmakatvam |
tathā ca dravyālaṅkārakārau | ākāśopi sadeśaḥ sakṛtsarvamūrtā-
bhisaṃbandhārhatvāt iti | yadyapyavayavapradeśayorgandhahastyādiṣu
bhedosti tathāpi nātra sūkṣmekṣikā cintyā | pradeśeṣvapyavayavavyava-
hārāt | kāryatvaṃ tu vakṣyāmaḥ || nanvātmanāṃ kāryatve ghaṭādivat
prākprasiddhasamānajātīyāvayavārabhyatvaprasaktiḥ | avayavā hyavaya-
vinamārabhante yathā tantavaḥ paṭamiti cenna vācyam | na khalu
ghaṭādāvapi kārye prākprasiddhasamānajātīyakapālasaṃyogātmatvaṃ dṛṣṭam |
kumbhakārādivyāpārānvitānmṛtpiṇḍātprathamameva pṛthubudhnodarādyā-
kārasyāsyotpattipratīteḥ | dravyasya hi pūrvākāraparityāgena uttarā-
kārapariṇāmaḥ kāryatvam | tacca bahirivāntarapyanubhūyata eva | tataścā-
tmāpi syātkāryaḥ | na ca paṭādau svāvayavasaṃyogapūrvakakāryatvo-
palambhāt sarvatra tathābhāvo yuktaḥ | kāṣṭhe lohalekhyatvopalambhād-
vajrepitathābhāvraprasaṅgāt | pramāṇabādhanamubhayatratulyam | na coktala-
kṣaṇakāryatvābhyupagamepyātmano'nityatvānuṣaṅgātpratisandhānābhāvo'
nuṣajyate | kathaṃcidanityatve satyevāsyopapadyamānatvāt | pratisa-
ndhānaṃ hi yamahamadrākṣaṃ tamahaṃ smarāmītyādirūpam | taccaikāntanityatve
kathamupapadyate | avasthābhedāt | anyā hyanubhavāvasthā anyā ca
smaraṇāvasthā | avasthābhede cāvasthāvatopi bhedādekarūpatva-
kṣateḥ kathaṃcidanityatvaṃ yuktyāyātaṃ kena vāryatām || athātmanaḥ
śarīraparimāṇatve mūrtatvānuṣaṅgāt śarīrenupraveśo na syāt | mūrte mūrta-
syānupraveśavirodhāt | tato nirātmakamevākhilaṃ śarīraṃ prāpnotīti
cet kimidaṃ mūrtatvaṃ nāma | asarvagatadravyaparimāṇatvaṃ rūpādimattvaṃ
vā | tatra nādyaḥ pakṣo doṣāya | saṃmatatvāt | dvitīyastvayuktaḥ |
vyāptyabhāvāt | nahi yadasarvagataṃ tanniyamena rūpādimadityavinā-
bhāvosti | manaso'sarvagatatvepi bhavanmate tadasaṃbhavāt | ākā-
śakāladigātmanāṃ sarvagatatvaṃ sarvasaṃyogisamānadeśatvaṃ vetyukta-
tvānmanaso vaidharmyātsarvagatatvapratiṣedhanāt | ato nātmanaḥ śarīre'
nupraveśānupapattiryena nirātmakaṃ tat syāt | asarvagatadravyaparimāṇa-
lakṣaṇamūrtatvasya manovatpraveśāpratibandhakatvāt | rūpādimattvalakṣaṇa-
mūrtatvopetasyāpi jalādervālukādāvanupraveśo na niṣidhyate ātma-
nastu tadrahitasyāpi tatrāsau pratiṣidhyata iti mahaccitram || athā-
tmanaḥ kāyapramāṇatve bālaśarīraparimāṇasya sato yuvaśarīrapari-
māṇasvīkāraḥ kathaṃ syāt | kiṃ tatparimāṇaparityāgāt tadaparityā-
gādvā | parityāgāccet tadā śarīravattasyānityatvaprasaṅgātpara-
lokādyabhāvānuṣaṅgaḥ | athāparityāgāt tanna | pūrvaparimāṇāparityāge
śarīravattasyottaraparimāṇotpattyanupapatteḥ | tadayuktam | yuvaśarīrapari-
māṇāvasthāyāmātmanobālaśarīraparimāṇaparityāge sarvathāvināśā-
saṃbhavāt | viphaṇāvasthotpāde sarpavat | iti kathaṃ paralokābhāvo-
nuṣajyate | paryāyatastasyānityatvepi dravyato nityatvāt || athā-
tmanaḥ kāyapramāṇatve tatkhaṇḍane khaṇḍanaprasaṅga iti cet kaḥ kimāha
śarīrasya khaṇḍane kathaṃcittatkhaṇḍanasyeṣṭatvāt | śarīrasaṃbaddhātmapradeśe-
bhyo hi katipayātmapradeśānāṃ khaṇḍitaśarīrapradeśevasthānādātmanaḥ
khaṇḍanam | taccātra vidyata eva | anyathā śarīrātpṛthagbhūtāvayavasya
kampopalabdhirna syāt | na ca khaṇḍitāvayavānupraviṣṭasyātmaprade-
śasya pṛthagātmatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tatraivānupraveśāt | na caikatra saṃtāne'neke
ātmānaḥ | anekārthapratibhāsijñānānāmekapramātrādhāratayā pratibhā-
sābhāvaprasaṅgāt | śarīrāntaravyavasthitānekajñānāvaseyārthasaṃvitti-
