vat | kathaṃ khaṇḍitāvayavayoḥ saṃghaṭṭanaṃ paścāditi cet ekāntena
chedānabhyupagamāt | padmanālatantuvacchedasyāpi svīkārāt |
tathābhūtādṛṣṭavaśāttatsaṃghaṭṭanamaviruddhameveti tanuparimāṇa evātmāṅgī-
kartavyo na vyāpakaḥ | tathā cātmā vyāpako na bhavati | cetanatvāt |
yattu vyāpakaṃ na taccetanaṃ yathā vyoma | cetanaścātmā | tasmānna vyāpakaḥ |
avyāpakatve cāsya tatraivopalabhyamānaguṇatvena siddhā kāyapramāṇa-
tā | yatpunaraṣṭasamayasādhyakevalisamujjñātadaśāyāmārhatānāmapi
caturdaśarajjvātmakalokavyāpitvenātmanaḥ sarvavyāpakatvaṃ tatkādāci-
tkamiti na tena vyabhicāraḥ | syādvādamantrakavacāvaguṇṭhitānāṃ ca
nedṛśabibhīṣikābhyo bhayamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 9 ||

vaiśeṣikanaiyāyikayoḥ prāyaḥ samānatantratvādaulūkyamate kṣipte
yaugamatamapi kṣiptamevāvaseyam | padārtheṣu ca tayorapi na tulyā
pratipattiriti sāṃpratamakṣapādapratipāditapadārthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ caturtha-
puruṣārthaṃ pratyasādhakatamatve vācyepi tadantaḥpātināṃ chalajāti-
nigrahasthānānāṃ paropanyāsanirāsamātraphalatayā atyantamanupāde-
yatvāt tadupadeśadāturvairāgyamupahasannāha |
svayaṃvivādagrahile vitaṇḍā-
pāṇḍityakaṇḍūlamukhe jane'smin |
māyopadeśātparamarma bhinda-
nnaho virakto muniranyadīyaḥ || 10 ||

anye avijñātatvadājñāsāratayā'nupādeyanāmānaḥ pare | teṣāmayaṃ
śāstṛtvena saṃbandhī anyadīyaḥ | muniḥ akṣapādaṛṣiḥ | aho viraktaḥ
aho vairāgyavān | aho ityupahāsagarbhamāścaryaṃ sūcayati | anya-
dīya ityatra īyakārake iti dontaḥ | kiṃ kurvannityāha paramarma
bhindan | jātāvekavacanaprayogāt paramarmāṇi vyathayan | bahu-
bhirātmapradeśairadhiṣṭhitā dehāvayavā marmāṇīti pāribhāṣikī saṃjñā |
tata upacārātsādhyasvatattvasādhanāvyabhicāritayā prāṇabhūtaḥ sādha-
nopanyāsopi marmeva marma | kasmāttadbhindan | māyopadeśāddhetoḥ |
māyāparavañcanam | tasyā upadeśaśchalajātinigrahasthānalakṣaṇapadārtha-
cayaprarūpaṇadvāreṇa śiṣyebhyaḥ pratipādanaṃ tasmāt | guṇādastriyāṃ na
vā ityanena hetau tṛtīyāprasaṅge pañcamī | kasminviṣaye māyāmaya-
mupadiṣṭavān ityāha | asmin pratyakṣopalakṣyamāṇe jane tattva-
vimarśabahirmukhatayā prākṛtaprāye loke | kathaṃbhūte | svayamātmanā
paropadeśanirapekṣameva | vivādagrahile | viruddhvaḥ parasparakakṣīkṛta-
pakṣādhikṣepadakṣo vādo vacanopanyāso vivādaḥ | tathā ca bhagavān
haribhadrasūriḥ |
labdhikhyātyarthinā tu syād duḥsthitenāmahātmanā |
chalajātipradhāno yaḥ sa vivāda iti smṛtaḥ ||
tena grahila i grahagṛhīta iva vivādagrahilaḥ | tatra yathā grahā-
dyapasmāraparavaśaḥ puruṣo yatkiṃcanapralāpī syādevamayamapi jana
iti bhāvaḥ | tathā vitaṇḍā pratipakṣasthāpanāhinaṃ vākyam | vita-
ṇḍyate āhanyate'nayā pratipakṣasādhanamiti vyutpatteḥ | abhyupetya
pakṣaṃ yo na sthāpayati sa vaitaṇḍika ityucyate iti nyāyavārtti-
kam | vastutastu aparāmṛṣṭatattvātattvavicāraṃ maukharyaṃ vitaṇḍā |
tatra yatpāṇḍityamavikalaṃ kauśalaṃ tena kaṇḍūlamiva kaṇḍūlaṃ mukhaṃ
lapanaṃ yasya sa tathā tasmin | kaṇḍūḥ kharjjūḥ | kaṇḍūrasyāstīti
kaṇḍūlaḥ | sidhmāditvānmatvarthīyo lapratyayaḥ | yathā kilāntarutpanna-
kṛmikulajanitāṃ kaṇḍūtiṃ niroddhumapārayanpuruṣo vyākulatāṃ
kalayati evaṃ tanmukhamapi vitaṇḍāpāṇḍityenāsaṃbaddhapralāpacā-
palamākalayatkaṇḍūlamityupacaryate | evaṃ ca svarasata eva svasvā-
bhimatavyavasthāpanāvisaṃṣṭhulo vaitaṇḍikalokaḥ | tatra ca tatparamāptabhūta-
puruṣaviśeṣaparikalpitaparavañcanapracuravacanopadeśaścetsahāyaḥ sama-
jani tadā svata eva jvālākalāpajaṭile prajvalati hutāśana iva
kṛto ghṛtāhutiprakṣepa iti | taiśca bhavābhinandibhirvādibhiretādṛśo-
padeśadānamapi tasya muneḥ kāruṇikatvakoṭāvāropitam | tathā
cāhuḥ |
duḥśikṣitakutarkāṃśaleśavācālitānanāḥ |
śakyāḥ kimanyathā jetuṃ vitaṇḍāṭopamaṇḍitāḥ ||
gatānugatiko lokaḥ kumārgaṃ tatpratāritaḥ |
mā gāditi chalādīni prāha kāruṇiko muniḥ ||
kāruṇikatvaṃ ca vairāgyānna bhidyate | tato yuktamuktam aho
virakta iti stutikāreṇopahāsavacanam || atha māyopadeśādi-
tisūcanāsūtraṃ vitanyate | akṣapādamate kila ṣoḍaśa padārthāḥ |
pramāṇaprameyasaṃśayaprayojanadṛṣṭāntasiddhāntāvayavatarkanirṇayavādajalpa-
vitaṇḍāhetvābhāsachalajātinigrahasthānānāṃ tattvajñānānniḥśreya-
sādhigama iti vacanāt | na caiteṣāṃ vyastānāṃ samastānāṃ vā
adhigamo niḥśreyasāvāptihetuḥ | na hyekenaiva kriyāvirahitena jñāna-
mātreṇa muktiryuktimatī | asamagrasāmagrīkatvāt | vighaṭitaikacakra-
rathena manīṣitanagaraprāptivat | na ca vācyaṃ na khalu vayaṃ kriyāṃ
pratikṣipāmaḥ kiṃtu tattvajñānapūrvikāyā eva tasyā muktihetutva-
miti jñāpanārthaṃ tattvajñānānniḥśreyasādhigama iti brūma iti | na
hyamīṣāṃ saṃhate api jñānakriye muktiprāptihetubhūte | vitathatvā-
ttajjñānakriyayoḥ | na ca vitathatvamasiddham | vicāryamāṇānāṃ ṣoḍa-
śānāmapi tattvābhāsatvāt | tathā hi | taiḥ pramāṇasya tāvallakṣa-
ṇamitthaṃ sūtritam arthopalabdhihetuḥ pramāṇamiti | etacca na vicāra-
saham | yato'rthopalabdhau hetutvaṃ yadi nimittatvamātraṃ tatsarva-
kārakasādhāraṇamiti kartṛkarmāderapi pramāṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ | atha kartṛ-
karmādivilakṣaṇaṃ hetuśabdena karaṇameva vivakṣitaṃ tarhi tajjñānameva
yuktaṃ na cendriyasannikarṣādi | yasmin hi satyartha upalabdho bhavati
sa tatkaraṇam | na cendriyasannikarṣasāmagryādau satyapi jñānābhāve'-
rthopalambhaḥ | sādhakatamaṃ hi karaṇam | avyavahitaphalaṃ tadiṣyate | vyava-
hitaphalasyāpi karaṇatve dugdhabhojanāderapi tathāprasaṅgaḥ | tanna
jñānādanyatra pramāṇatvam | anyatropacārāt | yadapi nyāyabhūṣaṇasūtra-
kāreṇoktaṃ samyaganubhavasādhanaṃ pramāṇamiti tatrāpi sādhanagrahaṇā-
tkartṛkarmanirāsena karaṇasyaivaṃ pramāṇatvaṃ sidhyati | tathāpyavyava-
hitaphalatvena sādhakatamatvaṃ jñānasyaiveti na tatsamyagalakṣaṇam |
svaparavyavasāyi jñānaṃ pramāṇam iti tu tāttvikaṃ lakṣaṇam ||

prameyamapi tairātmaśarīrendriyārthabuddhimanaḥpravṛttidoṣapretyabhāvaphala-
duḥkhāpavargabhedād dvādaśavidhamuktam | tacca na samyak || yataḥ śarīre-
ndriyabuddhimanaḥpravṛttidoṣaphaladuḥkhānāmātmanyevāntarbhāvo yuktaḥ |
saṃsāriṇa ātmanaḥ kathaṃcittadaviṣvagbhūtatvāt | ātmā ca
prameya eva na bhavati | tasya pramātṛtvāt || indriyabuddhimanasāṃ tu kara-
ṇatvātprameyatvābhāvaḥ || doṣāstu rāgadveṣamohāste ca pravṛtterna pṛthagbha-
vitumarhanti | vāṅmanaḥkāyavyāpārasya śubhāśubhaphalasya viṃśati-
vidhasya tanmate pravṛttiśabdavācyatvāt | rāgādidoṣāṇāṃ ca mano-
vyāpārātmakatvāt || duḥkhasya śabdādīnāmindriyārthānāṃ ca phala
evāntarbhāvaḥ | pravṛttidoṣajanitaṃ sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ mukhyaṃ phalaṃ tatsā-
dhanaṃ tu gauṇam iti jayantavacanāt || pretyabhāvāpavargayoḥ punarātmana
eva pariṇāmāntarāpattirūpatvānna pārthakyamātmanaḥ sakāśāducitam ||
tadevaṃ dvādaśavidhaṃ prameyamiti vāgvistaramātram | dravyaparyāyātmakaṃ
vastu prameyam iti tu samīcīnaṃ lakṣaṇam | sarvasaṃgrāhakatvāt ||

evaṃ saṃśayādīnāmapi tattvābhāsatvaṃ prekṣāvadbhiranuprekṣaṇīyam | atra
tu pratītatvād granthagauravabhayācca na prapañcitam | nyakṣeṇa hyatra
nyāyaśāstramavatāraṇīyaṃ taccāvatāryamāṇaṃ granthāntaratāmavagāhata
ityāstām ||

tadevaṃ pramāṇādiṣoḍaśapadārthānāmaviśiṣṭepi tattvābhāsatve
prakaṭakapaṭanāṭakasūtradhārāṇāṃ trayāṇāmeva chalajātinigrahasthānānāṃ
māyopadeśāditipadenopakṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ || tatra parasya vadato'rthavikalpo-
papādanena vacanavighātaśchalam | tattridhā | vākchalaṃ sāmānya-
cchalamupacāracchalaṃ ceti | tatra sādhāraṇe śabde prayukte vakturabhipre-
tādarthādarthāntarakalpanayā tanniṣedho vākchalam | yathā navakamba-
lo'yaṃ māṇavaka iti nūtanavivakṣayā kathite paraḥ saṃkhyāmāropya
niṣedhati kutosya nava kambalā iti | saṃbhāvanayātiprasaṅginopi
sāmānyasyopanyāse hetutvāropaṇena tanniṣedhaḥ sāmānyacchalam |
yathā aho tu khalvasau brāhmaṇo vidyācaraṇasaṃpanna iti brāhmaṇa-
stutiprasaṅge kaścidvadati saṃbhavati brāhmaṇe vidyācaraṇasaṃpaditi
tacchalavādī brāhmaṇatvasya hetutāmāropya nirākurvannabhiyuṅkte yadi
brāhmaṇe vidyācaraṇasaṃpad bhavati vrātyepi sā bhavedvrātyopi brāhmaṇa
eveti | aupacārike prayoge mukhyapratiṣedhena pratyavasthānamupacāra-
cchalam | yathā mañcāḥ krośantītyukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate kathamace-
tanāḥ mañcāḥ krośanti mañcasthāḥ puruṣāḥ krośantīti || tathā
samyaghetau hetvābhāse vā vādinā prayukte jhaṭiti taddoṣatattvā-
pratibhāse hetupratibimbanaprāyaṃ kimapi pratyavasthānaṃ jātirdūṣaṇā-
bhāsa ityarthaḥ | sā ca caturviṃśatibhedā | sādharmyādipratyavasthāna-
bhedena | yathā sādharmyavaidharmyotkarṣāpakarṣavarṇyāvarṇyavikalpasādhya-
prāptyaprāptiprasaṅgapratidṛṣṭāntānutpattisaṃśayaprakaraṇāhetvarthāpattyaviśe-
ṣopapattyupalabdhyanupalabdhinityānityakāryasamāḥ | tatra sādharmyeṇa
pratyavasthānaṃ sādharmyasamā jātirbhavati | anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka-
tvād ghaṭavaditi prayoge kṛte sādharmyaprayogeṇaiva pratyavasthānaṃ nityaḥ
śabdo niravayavatvādākāśavat | na cāsti viśeṣaheturghaṭasādharmyā-
tkṛtakatvādanityaḥ śabdo na punarākāśasādharmyānniravayavatvā-
nnitya iti | vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ vaidharmyasamā jātirbhavati |
anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvād ghaṭavadityatraiva prayoge sa eva
pratiheturvaidharmyeṇa prayujyate nityaḥ śabdo niravayavatvāt
anityaṃ hi sāvayavaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭādīti | na cāsti viśe-
ṣaheturghaṭasādharmyāt kṛtakatvādanityaḥ śabdo na punasta-
dvaidharmyānniravayavatvānnitya iti | utkarṣāpakarṣābhyāṃ pratyava-
sthānamutkarṣāpakarṣasame jātī bhavataḥ | tatraiva prayoge dṛṣṭāntadharmaṃ
kaṃcitsādhyadharmiṇyāpādayannutkarṣasamāṃ jātiṃ prayuṅkte | yadi ghaṭa-
vat kṛtakatvādanityaḥ śabdo ghaṭavadeva mūrto bhavatu na cenmūrto
ghaṭavadanityopi mābhūditi śabde dharmāntarotkarṣamāpādayati |
apakarṣastu ghaṭaḥ kṛtakaḥ sannaśrāvaṇo dṛṣṭaḥ evaṃ śabdopyastu no
ced ghaṭavadanityopi mābhūditi śabde śrāvaṇatvadharmamapakarṣatīti |
ityetāścatasro diṅmātradarśanārthaṃ jātaya uktāḥ | evaṃ śeṣā api
viṃśatirakṣapādaśāstrādavajñeyāḥ | atra tu anupayogitvānna likhi-
tāḥ || tathā vipratipattirapratipattiśca nigrahasthānam | tatra vipratipattiḥ
sādhanābhāse sādhanabuddhirdūṣaṇābhāse ca dūṣaṇabuddhiriti | aprati-
pattiḥ sādhanasyādūṣaṇaṃ dūṣaṇasya cānuddharaṇam | tacca nigrahasthānaṃ
dvāviṃśatividham | tadyathā | pratijñāhāniḥ pratijñāntaraṃ pratijñā-
virodhaḥ pratijñāsaṃnyāsaḥ hetvantaram arthāntaram nirarthakam avijñā-
tārtham apārthakam aprāptakālam nyūnam adhikam punaruktam ananu-
bhāṣaṇam ajñānam apratibhā vikṣepaḥ matānujñā paryanuyojyopekṣaṇaṃ
niranuyojyānuyogaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ hetvābhāsāśca | tatra hetāvanaikā-
ntikīkṛte pratidṛṣṭāntadharmaṃ svadṛṣṭāntebhyupagacchataḥ pratijñāhāni-
rnāma nigrahasthānam | yathā anityaḥ śabda aindriyakatvād ghaṭavaditi
pratijñāsādhanāya vādī vadan pareṇa sāmānyamaindriyakamapi nityaṃ
dṛṣṭamiti hetāvanaikāntikīkṛte yadyevaṃ brūyāt sāmānyavaddhaṭopi
nityo bhavatviti sa evaṃ bruvāṇaḥ śabdānityatvapratijñāṃ jahyāt |
pratijñātārthapratiṣedhe pareṇa kṛte tatraiva dharmiṇi dharmāntaraṃ sādhanī-
yamabhidadhataḥ pratijñāntaraṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati | anityaḥ
śabda aindriyakatvādityukte tathaiva sāmānyena vyabhicāre codite
yadi brūyāt yuktaṃ sāmānyamaindriyakaṃ nityaṃ taddhi sarvagatam asarva-
gatastu śabdaḥ iti tadidaṃ śabde'nityatvalakṣaṇapūrvapratijñātaḥ prati-
jñāntaramasarvagataḥ śabda iti nigrahasthānam | anayā diśā śeṣā-
ṇyapi viṃśatirjñeyāni | iha tu na likhitāni | pūrvahetoreva || ityevaṃ
māyāśabdenātra chalāditrayaṃ sūcitam | tadevaṃ paravañcanātmakānyapi
chalajātinigrahasthānāni tattvarūpatayopadiśato'kṣapādarṣervairāgya-
vyāvarṇanaṃ tamasaḥ prakāśātmakatvaprakhyāpanamiva kathamiva nopa-
hasanīyamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 10 ||

adhunā mīmāṃsakabhedābhimataṃ vedavihitahiṃsāyā dharmahetutvamupa-
pattipurasaraṃ nirasyannāha |
na dharmaheturvihitāpi hiṃsā
notsṛṣṭamanyārthamapodyate ca |
svaputraghātānnṛpatitvalipsā-
sabrahmacāri sphuritaṃ pareṣām || 11 ||

iha khalvarcirmārgapratipakṣadhūmamārgāśritā jaiminīyā itthamā-
cakṣate | yā hiṃsā gārhyād vyasanitayā vā kriyate saivādharmānu-
bandhahetuḥ pramādasaṃpāditatvāt śaunikalubdhakādīnāmiva | veda-
vihitā tu hiṃsā pratyuta dharmahetuḥ devatātithipitṛṛṇāṃ prītisaṃpāda-
katvāt tathāvidhapūjopacāravat | na ca tatprītisaṃpādakatva-
masiddham | kārīrīprabhṛtiyajñānāṃ svasādhye vṛṣṭyādiphale yaḥ
khalvavyabhicāraḥ sa tatprīṇitadevatāviśeṣānugrahahetukaḥ | evaṃ
tripurārṇavavarṇitacchagalajāṅgalahomātpararāṣṭravaśīkṛtirapi tadanukū-
litadaivataprasādasaṃpādyā | atithiprītistu madhuparkasaṃskārādi-
samāsvādajā pratyakṣopalakṣyaiva | pitṛṛṇāmapi tattadupayācitaśrāddhā-
dividhānena prīṇitānāṃ svasaṃtānavṛddhividhānaṃ sākṣādeva vīkṣyate |
āgamaścātra pramāṇam | sa ca devaprītyarthamaśvamedhagomedhanaramedhā-
dividhānābhidhāyakaḥ pratīta eva | atithiviṣayastu mahokṣaṃ vā
mahājaṃ vā śrotriyāya prakalpayet ityādiḥ | pitṛprītyarthastu--
dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīnmāsān hāriṇena tu |
aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākuneneha pañca tu ||
ityādiḥ | evaṃ parābhiprāyaṃ hṛdi saṃpradhāryācāryaḥ pratividhatte na
dharmetyādi || vihitāpi vedapratipāditāpi | āstāṃ tāvadavihitā
hiṃsā prāṇiprāṇavyaparopaṇarūpā | na dharmahetuḥ na dharmānubandhanibandha-
nam | yato'tra prakaṭa eva svavacanavirodhaḥ | tathāhi | hiṃsā ceddharmahetuḥ
katham dharmahetuśceddhiṃsā katham | śrūyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ śrutvā caivā-
vadhāryatāmityādiḥ | na hi bhavati mātā ca vandhyā ceti | hiṃsā
kāraṇaṃ dharmastu tatkāryamiti parābhiprāyaḥ | nacāyaṃ nirapāyaḥ |
yato yadyasyānvayavyatirekāvanuvidhatte tattasya kāryam | yathā
mṛtpiṇḍāderghaṭādiḥ | na ca dharmo hiṃsāta eva bhavatīti prātīti-
kam | tapovidhānadānadhyānādīnāṃ tadakāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt | atha
na vayaṃ sāmānyena hiṃsāṃ dharmahetuṃ brūmaḥ kiṃ tu viśiṣṭāmeva
viśiṣṭā ca saiva yā vedavihiteti cet nanu tasyā dharmahetutvaṃ kiṃ
vadhyajīvānāṃ maraṇābhāvena maraṇepi teṣāmārttadhyānābhāvātsugati-
lābhena vā | nādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | prāṇatyāgasya teṣāṃ sākṣādavekṣyamā-
ṇatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | paracetovṛttīnāṃ durlakṣatayārttadhyānābhāvasya
vāṅmātratvāt | pratyuta hā kaṣṭam asti na kopi kāruṇikaḥ
śaraṇamiti svabhāṣayā virasamārasatsu teṣu vadanadainyanayanataralatā-
dīnāṃ liṅgānāṃ darśanāt | durdhyānasya spaṣṭameva niṣṭaṅkyamānatvāt ||
athetthamācakṣīthāḥ yathā ayaḥpiṇḍo gurutayā majjanātmakopi
tanutarapatrādikaraṇena saṃskṛtaḥ san jalopari plavate yathā ca
māraṇātmakamapi viṣaṃ mantrādisaṃskāraviśiṣṭaṃ sad guṇāya jāyate
yathā vā dahanasvabhāvopyagniḥ satyādiprabhāvapratihataśaktiḥ
sanna hi pradahati evaṃ mantrādividhisaṃskārānna khalu
vedavihitā hiṃsā doṣapoṣāya | na ca tasyāḥ kutsi-
tatvaṃ śaṅkanīyaṃ tatkāriṇāṃ yājñikānāṃ loke pūjyatvadarśanāditi |
tadetanna dakṣāṇāṃ kṣamate kṣodam | vaiṣamyeṇa dṛṣṭāntānāmasādhakatamatvā-
t | ayaḥpiṇḍādayo hi patrādibhāvāntarāpannāḥ santaḥ salilataraṇā-
dikriyāsamarthāḥ | naca vaidikamantrasaṃskāravidhināpi viśasyamānānāṃ
paśūnāṃ kācidvedanānutpādādirūpā bhāvāntarāpattiḥ pratīyate | atha
teṣāṃ vadhānantaraṃ devatāpattirbhāvāntaramastyeveti cetkimatra pramāṇam |
na tāvatpratyakṣam | tasya saṃbaddhavartamānārthagrāhakatvāt | saṃbaddhaṃ
vartamānaṃ ca gṛhyate cakṣurādinā iti vacanāt | nāpyanumānam |
tatpratibaddhaliṅgānupalabdheḥ | nāpyāgamaḥ | tasyādyāpi vivādāspada-
tvāt | arthāpattyupamānayostvanumānāntargatatayā taddūṣaṇenaiva gatā-
rthatvam | atha bhavatāmapi jināyatanādividhāne pariṇāmaviśeṣā-
tpṛthivyādijantujātaghātanamapi yathā puṇyāya kalpata iti kalpanā
tathāsmākamapi kiṃ neṣyate | vedoktavidhividhānarūpasya pari-
ṇāmaviśeṣasya nirvikalpaṃ tatrāpi bhāvāt | naivam | pariṇāmaviśe-
ṣopi sa eva śubhaphalo yatrānanyopāyatvena yatanayāpakṛṣṭapratanu-
caitanyānāṃ pṛthivyādijīvānāṃ vadhepi svalpapuṇyavyayenāparimita-
sukṛtasaṃprāptiḥ na punaritaraḥ | bhavatpakṣe tu satsvapi tattacchrutismṛti-
purāṇetihāsapratipāditeṣu yamaniyamādiṣu svargāvāptyupāyeṣu tāṃstā-
ndevānuddiśya pratipratīkaṃ kartanakadarthanayā kāndiśīkānkṛpaṇa-
pañcendriyān śaunikādhikaṃ mārayatāṃ kṛtsnasukṛtavyayena durgati-
mevānukūlayatāṃ durlabhaḥ śubhapariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ | evaṃ ca yaṃ kaṃcana
padārthaṃ kiṃcitsādharmyadvāreṇaiva dṛṣṭāntīkurvatāṃ bhavatāmatiprasaṅgaḥ
saṃgacchate | na ca jināyatanavidhāpanādau pṛthivyādijīvavadhepi na
guṇaḥ | tathāhi taddarśanādguṇānurāgitayā bhavyānāṃ bodhilābhaḥ pūjā-
tiśayavilokanādinā ca manaḥprasādaḥ tataḥ samādhiḥtataśca krameṇa
niśreyasaprāptiriti | tathā ca bhagavānpañcaliṅgīkāraḥ |
puḍhavāiyāṇa jaivi hu hoi viṇāso jiṇālayāhiṃto |
tavvisayā vi sudiṭhṭhissa ṇiyamao atthi aṇukaṃpā || 1 ||
eyāhiṃto buddhā virayā rakkhaṃti jeṇa puḍhavāī |
itto nivvāṇagayā abāhiyā ābhavamimāṇaṃ || 2 ||
rogisirāveho iva suvijjakiriyā va suppauttāo |
pariṇāmasuṃdaracciya ciṭṭhā se bāhajoge vi || 3 ||
iti | vaidikavadhavidhāne tu na kaṃcitpuṇyārjanānuguṇaṃ guṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
atha viprebhyaḥ puroḍāśādipradānena puṇyānubandhī guṇostyeveti
cet na | pavitrasuvarṇādipradānamātreṇaiva puṇyopārjanasaṃbhavāt |
kṛpaṇapaśugaṇavyaparopaṇasamutthamāṃsadānaṃ kevalaṃ nirghṛṇatvameva
vyanakti | atha na pradānamātraṃ paśuvadhakriyāyāḥ phalaṃ
kiṃ tu bhūtyādikam | yadāha śrutiḥ śvetaṃ vāyavyamaja-
mālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ ityādi | etadapi vyabhicārapiśācagrastatvā-
dapramāṇameva | bhūteścaupayikāntarairapi sādhyatvāt | atha tatra satre
hanyamānānāṃ chāgādīnāṃ pretyasaṅgatiprāptirūpostyevopakāra iti
cet vāṅmātrametat | pramāṇābhāvāt | na hi te nihatāḥ paśavaḥ
saṃgatilābhamuditamanasaḥ kasmaicidāgatya tathābhūtamātmānaṃ katha-
yanti | athāstyāgamākhyaṃ pramāṇam | yathā
auṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣāstiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā |
yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvantyucchritaṃ punaḥ ||
ityādi | naivam | tasya pauruṣeyāpauruṣeyavikalpābhyāṃ nirā-
kariṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca śrautena vidhinā paśuviśasanavidhāyinā
svargāvāptirupakāra iti vācyam | yadi hi hiṃsayāpi svargaprāptiḥ
syāttarhi bāḍhaṃ pihitā narakapurapratolyaḥ | śaunikādīnāmapi
svargaprāptiprasaṅgāt | tathā ca paṭhanti pāramarṣāḥ |
yūpaṃ chitvā paśūn hatvā kṛtvā rudhirakardamam |
yadyevaṃ gamyate svarge narake kena gamyate ||
kiṃca aparicitāspaṣṭacaitanyānupakāripaśuhiṃsanenāpi tridiva-
padavīprāptistadā paricitaspaṣṭacaitanyaparamopakārimātāpitrādivyā-
pādanena yajñakāriṇāmadhikatarapadaprāptiḥ prasajyate | atha acintyo
hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ iti vacanādvaidikamantrāṇāmacintya-
prabhāvatvāt tatsaṃskṛtapaśuvadhe saṃbhavatyeva svargaprāptiriti cet na |
iha loke vivāhagarbhādhānajātakarmādiṣu tanmantrāṇāṃ vyabhicāro-
palambhādadṛṣṭe svargādāvapi tadvyabhicāronumīyate | dṛśyante hi
vedoktamantrasaṃskāraviśiṣṭebhyopi vivāhādibhyonantaraṃ vaidhavyā-
lpāyuṣkatādāridryādyupadravavidhurāḥ paraḥśatāḥ | apare ca mantrasaṃskāraṃ
vinā kṛtebhyopi tebhyonantaraṃ tadviparītāḥ | atha tatra kriyāvaiguṇyaṃ
visaṃvādaheturiti cet na | saṃśayānivṛtteḥ | kiṃ tatra kriyāvaigu-
ṇyā phale visaṃvādaḥ kiṃ vā mantrāṇāmasāmarthyāditi na niścayaḥ |
teṣāṃ phalenāvinābhāvāsiddheḥ | atha yathā yuṣmanmate āroggabohi-
lābhaṃ samāhivaramuttamaṃ diṃtu ityādīnāṃ vākyānāṃ lokāntara
eva phalamiṣyate evamasmadabhimatavedavākyānāmapi neha janmani
phalamiti kiṃ na pratipadyate | tataśca vivāhādau nopalambhāvakāśa
iti cet aho vacanavaicitrī | yathā vartamānajanmani vivāhādiṣu
prayuktairmantrasaṃskārairāgāmini janmani tatphalamevaṃ dvitīyādijanmā-
ntareṣvapi vivāhādīnāmeva pravṛttidharmāṇāṃ puṇyahetutvāṅgīkārenanta
bhavānusandhānaṃ prasajyate | evaṃ ca na kadācana saṃsārasya parisamāptiḥ |
tathā ca na kasyacidapavargaprāptiḥ | iti prāptaṃ bhavadabhimatavedasyāparyava-
sitasaṃsāravallarīmūlakandatvam | ārogyādiprārthanā tu asatyāmṛṣā-
bhāṣāpariṇāmaviśuddhikāraṇatvānna doṣāya | tatra hi bhāvārogyā-
dikameva vivakṣitam | tacca cāturgatikasaṃsāralakṣaṇabhāvarogaparikṣaya-
svarūpatvāduttamaphalam | tadviṣayā ca prārthanā kathamiva vivekinā-
manādaraṇīyā | na ca tajjanyapariṇāmaviśuddhestatphalaṃ na prāpyate |
sarvavādināṃ bhāvaśuddherapavargaphalasaṃpādane'vipratipatteriti | na ca
vedaniveditā hiṃsā na kutsitā | samyagdarśanajñānasaṃpannairarci-
rmārgaprapannairvedāntavādibhiśca garhitatvāt | tathā ca tattvadarśinaḥ
paṭhanti |
devopahāravyājena yajñavyājena yethavā |
ghnanti jantūn gataghṛṇā ghoraṃ te yānti durgatim ||
vedāntikā apyāhuḥ |
andhe tamasi majjāmaḥ paśubhirye yajāmahe |
hisā nāma bhaveddharmo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||
tathā agnirmāmetasmāddhiṃsākṛtādenaso muñcatu | chāndasatvānmo-
cayatu ityarthaḥ | iti | vyāsenāpyuktam |
jñānapāliparikṣipte brahmacaryadayāmbhasi |
snātvātivimale tīrthe pāpapaṅkāpahāriṇi || 1 ||
dhyānāgnau jīvakuṇḍasthe damamārutadīpite |
asatkarmasamitkṣepairagnihotraṃ kurūttamam || 2 ||
kaṣāyapaśubhirduṣṭairdharmakāmārthanāśakaiḥ |
śamamantrahatairyajñaṃ vidhehi vihitaṃ budhaiḥ || 3 ||
prāṇighātāttu yo dharmamīhate mūḍhamānasaḥ |
sa vāñchati sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ kṛṣṇāhimukhakoṭarāt || 4 ||
ityādi || yacca yājñikānāṃ lokapūjyatvopalambhādityuktaṃ tada-
pyasāram | abudhā eva hi pūjayanti tān na tu viviktabuddhayaḥ |
abudhapūjyatā tu na pramāṇam | tasyāḥ sārameyādiṣvapyupalambhāt ||
yadapyabhihitaṃ devatātithipitṛprītisaṃpādakatvādvedavihitā hiṃsā
na doṣāyeti tadapi vitatham | yato devānāṃ saṃkalpamātropanatā-
bhimatāhārapudgalarasāsvādasuhitānāṃ vaikriyaśarīratvād yuṣmadā-
varjitajugupsitapaśumāṃsādyāhṛtigṛhītāvicchaiva duḥsaṃbhavā | audā-
rikaśarīriṇāmeva tadupādānayogyatvāt | prakṣepāhārasvīkāre ca
devānāṃ mantramayadehatvābhyupagamabādhaḥ | na ca teṣāṃ mantramayadehatvaṃ
bhavatpakṣe na siddham | caturthyantapadameva devatā iti jaiminivacana-
prāmāṇyāt | tathā ca mṛgendraḥ |
śabdetaratve yugapadbhinnadeśeṣu yaṣṭvaṣu |
na sā prayāti sāṃnidhyaṃ mūrtatvādasmadādivat ||
iti | seti devatā | hūyamānasya ca vastuno bhasmībhāvamātropala-
mbhāttadupayogajanitā devānāṃ prītiḥ pralāpamātram | api ca
yoyaṃ tretāgniḥ sa trayastriṃśatkoṭidevatānāṃ mukham | agnimukhā
vai devā iti śruteḥ | tataścottamamadhyamādhamadevānāmekenaiva mukhena
bhuñjānānāmanyocchiṣṭabhuktiprasaṅgaḥ | tathā caita turuṣkebhyopya-
tiricyante | tepi tāvadekatraivāmatre bhuñjate na punarekenaiva
vadanena | kiṃ ca | ekasmin vapuṣi vadanabāhulyaṃ kvacana śrūyate
yatpunaranekaśarīreṣvekaṃ mukhamiti mahadāścaryam | sarveṣāṃ ca devā-
nāmekasminneva mukheṅgīkṛte yadā kenacideko devaḥ pūjādinā-
rāddhonyaśca nindādinā virāddhastataścaikenaiva mukhena yugapadanugraha-
nigrahavākyoccāraṇasaṃkaraḥ prasajyeta | anyacca | mukhaṃ dehasya
navamo bhāgastadapi yeṣāṃ dāhātmakaṃ teṣāmekaikaśaḥ sakaladehadāhā-
tmakatvaṃ tribhuvanabhasmīkaraṇaparyavasitameva saṃbhāvyata ityalamati-
carcayā || yaśca kārīrīyajñādau vṛṣṭyādiphale'vyabhicārastatprī-
ṇitadevatānugrahahetuka uktaḥ sopyanaikāntikaḥ | kvacid vyabhi-
cārasyāpi darśanāt | yatrāpi na vyabhicārastatrāpi na tvadā-
hitāhutibhojanajanmā tadanugrahaḥ | kiṃ tu sa devatāviśeṣotiśaya-
jñānī svoddeśanirvartitaṃ pūjopacāraṃ yadā svasthānāvasthitaḥ san
jānīte tadā tatkartāraṃ prati prasannacetovṛttistatkāryāṇīcchāva-
śātsādhayati | anupayogādinā punarajānāno jānānopi vā
pūjākarturabhāgyasahakṛtaḥ sanna sādhayati | dravyakṣetrakālabhāvādi-
sahakārisācivyāpekṣasyaiva kāryotpādasyopalambhāt | sa ca pūjo-
pacāraḥ paśuviśasanavyatiriktaiḥ prakārāntarairapi sukarastatkimanayā
pāpaikaphalayā śaunikavṛttyā | yacca chagalajāṅgalahomātpararāṣṭra-
vaśīkṛtisiddhyā devyāḥ paritoṣānumānaṃ tatra kaḥ kimāha | kāsāṃ-
citkṣudradevatānāṃ tathaiva pratyaṅgīkārāt | kevalaṃ tatrāpi tadvastu-
darśanajñānādinaiva paritoṣo na punastadbhuktyā | ni??bapatrakaṭuka-
tailadhūmāṃśādīnāṃ hūyamānadravyādīnāmapi tadbhojyatvaprasaṅgāt |
paramārthatastu tattatsahakārisamavadhānasacivārādhakānāṃ bhaktireva
tattatphalaṃ janayati acetane cintāmaṇyādau tathādarśanāt | ati-
thīnāṃ tu prītiḥ saṃskārasaṃpannapakvānnādināpi sādhyā | tadarthaṃ
mahokṣamahājādiprakalpanaṃ nirvivekatāmeva khyāpayati | pitṛṛṇāṃ
punaḥ prītiranaikāntikī śrāddhādividhānenāpi bhūyasāṃ saṃtānavṛddhe-
ranupalabdheḥ | tadavidhānepi ca keṣāṃcidgardabhaśūkarājādīnāmiva
sutarāṃ taddarśanāt | tataśca śrāddhādividhānaṃ mugdhajanavipratāraṇa-
mātraphalameva | ye hi lokāntaraṃ prāptāste tāvatsvakṛtakarmānusāreṇa
suranārakādigatiṣu sukhamasukhaṃ vā bhuñjānā evāsate te kathamiva
tanayādibhirāvarjitaṃ piṇḍamupabhoktuṃ spṛhayālavopi syuḥ | tathā
ca yuṣmadyūthinaḥ paṭhanti |
mṛtānāmapi jantūnāṃ śrāddhaṃ cettṛptikāraṇam |
tannirvāṇapradīpasya snehaḥ saṃvarddhayecchikhām ||
iti kathaṃ śrāddhavidhānādyarjitaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ samīpamupaitu | tadanya-
kṛtatvāt tasya jaḍatvāt niścaraṇatvācca | atha teṣāmuddeśena śrāddhā-
dividhānepi puṇyaṃ dātureva tanayādeḥ syāditi cenna | tena tajjanya-
puṇyasya svādhyavasāyāduttāritatvāt | evaṃ ca tatpuṇyaṃ naivetara-
syāpi iti vicāla eva vilīnaṃ triśaṅkujñātena | kiṃ tu pāpānu-
bandhipuṇyatvāt tattvataḥ pāpameva | atha vipropabhuktaṃ tebhya upatiṣṭhata
iti cet ka ivaitatpratyetu | viprāṇāmeva medurodaratādarśanāt | tadvapuṣi
ca teṣāṃ saṃkramaḥ śraddhātumapi na śakyate | bhojanāvasare tatsaṃkrama
liṅgasya kasyāpyanavalokanāt | viprāṇāmeva ca tṛpteḥ sākṣātkara-
ṇāt | yadi paraṃ ta eva sthūlakavalairākulataramatigārddhyādbhakṣayantaḥ
pretaprāyā iti mudhaiva śrāddhādividhānam | yadapi gayāśrāddhādiyācana-
mupalabhyate tadapi tādṛśavipralambhakavibhaṅgajñānivyantarādikṛtameva
niśceyam || yadapyuditam āgamaścātra pramāṇamiti tadapyapramāṇam |
sa hi pauruṣeyo vā syādapauruṣeyo vā | pauruṣeyaścet sarvajñakṛtaḥ tadi-
tarakṛto vā | ādyapakṣe yuṣmanmatavyāhatiḥ | tathā ca bhavatsiddhāntaḥ |
atīndriyāṇāmarthānāṃ sākṣāddraṣṭā na vidyate |
nityebhyo vedavākyebhyo yathārthatvaviniścayaḥ ||
dvitīyapakṣe tu tatra doṣavatkartṛkatvenānāśvāsaprasaṅgaḥ | apauruṣeya-
ścenna | saṃbhavatyeva svarūpanirākaraṇāt turaṅgaśṛṅgavat | tathā-
hyuktirvacanamucyata iti ceti puruṣakriyānugataṃ rūpamasya etatkriyā-
bhāve kathaṃ bhavitumarhati | nacaitatkevalaṃ kvacidadhvanadupalabhyate |
upalabdhāvapyadṛśyavaktrāśaṅkāsaṃbhavāt | tasmādyadvacanaṃ tatpauruṣeya-
meva varṇātmakatvāt kumārasaṃbhavādivacanavat | vacanātmakaśca vedaḥ |
tathā cāhuḥ |
tālvādijanmā nanu vaṇavargo
varṇātmako veda iti sphuṭaṃ ca |
puṃsaśca tālvādi tataḥ kathaṃ syā-
dapauruṣeyoyamiti pratītiḥ ||
iti śruterapauruṣeyatvamurarīkṛtyāpi tāvadbhavadbhirapi tadarthavyākhyānaṃ
pauruṣeyamevāṅgīkriyate | anyathāgnihotraṃ juhuyātsvargakāma ityatra
śvamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayediti kiṃ nārthaḥ | niyāmakābhāvāt | tato varaṃ
sūtramapi pauruṣeyamabhyupagatam | astu vā apauruṣeyaḥ tathāpi
tasya na prāmāṇyam | āptapuruṣādhīnā hi vācāṃ pramāṇateti |
evaṃ ca tasyāprāmāṇye taduktastadanupātismṛtipratipāditaśca hiṃsā-
tmako yāgaśrāddhādividhiḥ prāmāṇyavidhura eveti || atha yoyaṃ
na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni ityādinā hiṃsāniṣedhaḥ sa autsargiko
mārgaḥ | sāmānyato vidhirityarthaḥ | tataścāpavādenotsargasya bādhita-
tvānna śrauto hiṃsāvidhirdoṣāya | utsargāpavādayorapavādo vidhirba-
līyāniti nyāyāt | bhavatāmapi hi na khalvekāntena hiṃsāni-
ṣedhaḥ | tattatkāraṇajāte pṛthivyādipratisevanānāmanujñānāt | glānā-
dyasaṃstare ādhākarmādigrahaṇabhaṇanācca | apavādapadaṃ ca yājñikī
hiṃsā devatādiprīteḥ puṣṭālambanatvāditi paramāśaṅkya stutikāra
āha | notsṛṣṭamityādi | anyārthamiti madhyavarti padaṃ ḍamaruka-
maṇinyāyenobhayatrāpi saṃbandhanīyam | anyārthamutsṛṣṭam anyasmai
kāryāya prayuktam | utsargavākyamanyārthaprayuktena vākyena nāpodyate
nāpavādagocarīkriyate | yamevārthamāśritya śāstre utsargaḥ pravartate
tamevāśrityāpavādopi pravartate | tayornimnonnatādivyavahāravatpara-
sparasāpekṣatvenaikārthasādhanaviṣayatvāt | yathā jainānāṃ saṃyamapari-
pālanārthaṃ navakoṭiviśuddhāhāragrahaṇamutsargaḥ tathāvidhadravyakṣetrakāla-
bhāvāpatsu ca nipatitasya gatyantarābhāve pañcakādiyatanayā'neṣa-
ṇīyādigrahaṇamapavādaḥ sopi ca saṃyamaparipālanārthameva | na ca
maraṇaikaśaraṇasya gatyantarābhāvo'siddha iti vācyam |
savvatthasajaṃmaṃ saṃjamāo appāṇameva rakkhijjā |
muccai aivāyāo puṇo visohī nayā'viraī ||
ityāgamāt | tathā āyurvedepi yamevaikaṃ rogamadhikṛtya kasyāṃcida-
vasthāyāṃ kiṃcidvastvapathyaṃ tadevāvasthāntare tatraiva roge pathyam |
utpadyate hi sāvasthā deśakālāmayānprati |
yasyāmakāryaṃ kāryaṃ syātkarma kāryaṃ tu varjayet ||
iti vacanāt | yathā balavadāderjvariṇo laṅghanaṃ kṣīṇadhātostu
tadviparyayaḥ | evaṃ deśādyapekṣayā jvariṇopi dadhipānādi yojyam |
tathā ca vaidyāḥ |
kālāvirodhi nirdiṣṭaṃ jvarādau laṅghanaṃ hitam |
ṛte'nilaśramakrodhaśokakāmakṛtajvarān ||
evaṃ ca yaḥ pūrvamadhyaparihāro yatra tatraivāvasthāntare tasyaiva paribhogaḥ |
sa khalūbhayorapi tasyaiva rogasya śamanārthaḥ | iti siddhamekaviṣaya-
tvamutsargāpavādayoriti || bhavatāṃ cotsargonyārtho'pavādaścānyārthaḥ |
na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni ityutsargo hi durgatiniṣedhārthaḥ apavādastu
vaidikahiṃsāvidhirdevatātithipitṛprītisaṃpādanārthaḥ | ataśca paraspara-
nirapekṣatve kathamutsargopavādena bādhyate | tulyabalayorvirodha iti
nyāyāt | bhinnārthatvepi tena tadvādhanetiprasaṅgāt | na ca vācyaṃ
vaidikahiṃsāvidhirapi svargahetutayā durgatiniṣedhārtha eveti tasyo-
ktayuktyā svargahetutvanirloṭhanāt | tamantareṇāpi ca prakārāntarairapi
tatsiddhibhāvādgatyantarābhāve hyapavādapakṣakakṣīkāraḥ || na ca vayameva
yāgavidheḥ sugatihetutvaṃ nāṅgīkurmahe kiṃ tu bhavādāptā api | yadāha
vyāsamaharṣiḥ |
pūjayā vipulaṃ rājyamagnikāryeṇa saṃpadaḥ |
tapaḥ pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca muktidam ||
atrāgnikāryaśabdavācyasya yāgādividherupāyāntarairapi labhyānāṃ
saṃpadāmeva hetutvaṃ vadannācāryastasya sugatihetutvamarthātkadarthita-
vāneva | tathā ca sa eva bhāvāgnihotraṃ jñānapālītyādiślokaiḥ
sthāpitavān | tadevaṃ sthite teṣāṃ vādināṃ ceṣṭāmupamayā dūṣayati
svaputretyādi | pareṣāṃ bhavatpraṇītavacanaparāṅmukhānām | sphuritaṃ
ceṣṭitam | svaputraghātānnṛpatitvalipsāsabrahmacāri nijasutanipātanena
rājyaprāptimanorathasadṛśam | yathā kila kaścidavipaścitpuruṣaḥ paruṣā-
śayatayā nijamaṅgajaṃ vyāpādya rājyaśriyaṃ prāptumīhate na ca tasya
tatprāptāvapi putraghātapātakakalaṅkapaṅkaḥ kvacidapayāti evaṃ vedavi-
hitahiṃsayā devatādiprītisiddhāvapi hiṃsāsamutthaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ na khalu
parāhanyate | atra ca lipsāśabdaṃ prayuñjānaḥstutikāro jñāpayati yathā
tasya durāśayasyāsadṛśatādṛkkarmaṇā nirmūlitasatkarmaṇo rājyaprāptau
kevalaṃ samīhāmātrameva na punastatsiddhiḥ evaṃ teṣāṃ durvādināṃ
vedavihitahiṃsāmanutiṣṭhatāmapi devatādiparitoṣaṇe manorājyameva |
na punasteṣāmuttamajanapūjyatvamindrādidivaukasāṃ ca tṛptiḥ |
prāguktayuktyā nirākṛtatvāt || iti kāvyārthaḥ || 11 ||

sāṃprataṃ nityaparokṣajñānavādināṃ mīmāṃsakabhedabhaṭṭānāmekātma-
samavāyijñānāntaravedyajñānavādināṃ ca yaugānāṃ mataṃ vikuṭṭayannāha |
svārthāvabodhakṣama eva bodhaḥ
prakāśate nārthakathānyathā tu ||
pare parebhyo bhayatastathāpi
prapedire jñānamanātmaniṣṭham || 12 ||

bodho jñānam | sa ca svārthāvabodhakṣama eva prakāśate |
svasyātmasvarūpasyārthasya ca padārthasya yovabodhaḥ paricchedaḥ tatra kṣama
eva samartha eva pratibhāsata ityayogavyavacchedaḥ | prakāśata iti
kriyayāvabodhasya prakāśarūpatvasiddheḥ sarvaprakāśānāṃ svārtha-
prakāśakatvena bodhasyāpi tatsiddhiḥ | viparyaye dūṣaṇamāha | nārtha-
kathānyathā tu iti | anyatheti arthaprakāśane'vivādāt jñānasya
svasaṃviditatvānabhyupagamerthakathaiva na syāt | arthakathā padārtha-
saṃbandhinī vārtā | sadasadrūpātmakaṃ svarūpamiti yāvat | tuśadbo-
vadhāraṇe | bhinnakramaśca | sa cārthakathayā saha yojita eva |
yadi hi jñānaṃ svasaṃviditaṃ neṣyate tadā tenātmajñānāya jñānānta-
ramapekṣaṇīyaṃ tenāpyaparamityādyanavasthā | tato jñānaṃ tāvatsvāvabodha-
vyagratāmagnam | arthastu jaḍatayā svarūpajñāpanāsamartha iti ko
nāmārthasya kathāmapi kathayet | tathāpi evaṃ jñānasya svasaṃviditatve
yuktyā ghaṭamānepi | pare tīrthāntarīyāḥ | jñānaṃ karmatāpannam | anātma-
niṣṭham na vidyate ātmanaḥ svasya niṣṭhā niścayo yasya tadanātma-
niṣṭham | asvasaṃviditamityarthaḥ | prapedire prapannāḥ | kuta ityāha |
parebhyo bhayataḥ | pare pūrvapakṣavādinastebhyaḥ sakāśāt jñānasya svasaṃ-
viditatvaṃ nopapadyate svātmani kriyāvirodhādityupālambhasaṃbhā-
vanāsaṃbhavaṃ yadbhayaṃ tasmāt tadāśrityetyarthaḥ ||

itthamakṣaragamanikāṃ vidhāya bhāvārthaḥ prapañcyate || bhaṭṭāstāvadidaṃ
vadanti | yat jñānaṃ svasaṃviditaṃ na bhavati | svātmani kriyāvirodhāt |
na hi suśikṣitopi naṭabaṭuḥ svaskandhamadhiroḍhuṃ paṭuḥ | na ca sutīkṣṇā-
pyasidhārā svaṃ chettumāhitavyāpārā | tataśca parokṣameva jñāna-
miti || tadetanna samyak | yataḥ kimutpattiḥ svātmani virudhyate
jñaptirvā | yadyutpattiḥ sā virudhyatām | na hi vayamapi jñānamātmāna-
mutpādayatīti manyāmahe | atha jñaptiḥ | neyamātmani viruddhā | tadātma-
naiva jñānasya svahetubhya utpādāt prakāśātmaneva pradīpālokasya |
atha prakāśātmaiva pradīpāloka utpanna iti paraprakāśakostu
ātmānamapyetāvanmātreṇaiva prakāśayatīti ko'yaṃ nyāya iti cet
tatkiṃ tena varākeṇāprakāśitenaiva sthātavyam ālokāntarādvāsya
prakāśena bhavitavyam | prathame pratyakṣabādhaḥ | dvitīyepi saivānava-
sthāpattiśca || atha nāsau svamapekṣya karmatayā cakāstītyasvaprakā-
śakaḥ svīkriyate | ātmānaṃ na prakāśayatītyarthaḥ | prakāśarūpatayo-
tpannatvātsvayaṃ prakāśata eva iti cet ciraṃ jīva | na hi vayamapi jñānaṃ
karmatayaiva pratibhāsamānaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ brūmaḥ | jñānaṃ svayaṃ pratibhāsata
ityādāvakarmakasya tasya cakāsanāt | yathā tu jñānaṃ svaṃ jānā-
mīti karmatayāpi tadbhāti tathā pradīpaḥ svaṃ prakāśayatītyayamapi
karmatayā prathita eva | yastu svātmani kriyāvirodho dāṣa
udbhāvitaḥ so'yuktaḥ | anubhavasiddherthe virodhāsiddheḥ | ghaṭamahaṃ
jānāmītyādau kartṛkarmavajjñapterapyavabhāsamānatvāt | na cāpratya-
kṣopalambhasyārthadṛṣṭiḥ prasidhyati | na ca jñānāntarādupalambhasaṃbhā-
vanā | tasyāpyanupalabdhasya prastutopalambhapratyakṣīkārābhāvāt |
upalambhāntarasaṃbhāvane cānavasthā | arthopalambhāttasyopalambhe
'nyonyāśrayadoṣaḥ || athārthaprākaṭyamanyathā nopapadyate yadi jñānaṃ
na syādityarthāpattyā tadupalambha iti cenna | tasyā api jñāpakatvenā-
jñātāyā jñāpakatvāyogāt | arthāpattyantarāttajjñāne'navasthetaretarāśraya-
doṣāpattestadavasthaḥ paribhavaḥ | tasmādarthonmukhatayeva svonmukhatayāpi
jñānasya pratibhāsātsvasaṃviditatvam || nanvanubhūteranubhāvyatve ghaṭā-
divadananubhūtitvaprasaṅgaḥ | prayogastu jñānamanubhavarūpamapyanubhūtirna
bhavati anubhāvyatvād | ghaṭavat anubhāvyaṃ ca bhavadbhiriṣyate jñānam |
svasaṃvedyatvāt | naivam | jñāturjñātṛtvenevānubhūteranubhūtitvenaivānu-
bhavāt | na cānubhūteranubhāvyatvaṃ doṣaḥ | arthāpekṣayānubhūtitvāt svāpe-
kṣayā cānubhāvyatvāt | svapitṛputrāpekṣayaikasya putratvapitṛtvavadvirodhā-
bhāvāt || anumānācca svasaṃvedanasiddhiḥ | tathāhi | jñānaṃ svayaṃ
prakāśamānamevārthaṃ prakāśayati prakāśakatvāt pradīpavat | saṃvedanasya
prakāśyatvātprakāśakatvamasiddhamiti cenna | ajñānanirāsādidvāreṇa
prakāśakatvopapatteḥ | nanu netrādayaḥ prakāśakā api svaṃ na
prakāśayantīti prakāśakatvahetoranaikāntikateti cet nātra netrādi-
bhiranaikāntikatā | teṣāṃ labdhyupayogalakṣaṇabhāvendriyarūpāṇāmeva
prakāśakatvāt || bhāvendriyāṇāṃ ca svasaṃvedanarūpataiveti na vyabhi-
cāraḥ | tathā saṃvit svaprakāśā | arthapratītitvāt | yaḥ svaprakāśo na
bhavati nāsāvarthapratītiryathā ghaṭaḥ || tadevaṃ siddhepi pratyakṣānu-
mānābhyāṃ jñānasya svasaṃviditatve satsaṃprayoge indriyabuddhijanmalakṣaṇaṃ
jñānaṃ tatorthaprākaṭyaṃ tasmādarthāpattiḥ tayā pravartakajñānasyopalambha
ityevaṃrūpā tripuṭīpratyakṣakalpanā bhaṭṭānāṃ prayāsaphalaiva ||

yaugāstvāhuḥ | jñānaṃ svānyaprakāśyam | īśvarajñānānyatve sati prame-
yatvāt | ghaṭavat | samutpannaṃ hi jñānamekātmasamavetānantarodbhaviṣṇu-
mānasapratyakṣeṇaiva lakṣyate na punaḥ svena | na caivamanavasthā | arthāvasāyi-
vijñānotpādamātreṇaivārthasiddhau pramātuḥ kṛtārthatvāt | arthajñāna-
jijñāsāyāṃ tu tatrāpi jñānamutpadyata eveti || tadayuktam | pakṣasya
pratyanumānabādhitatvena hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt | tathā hi |
vivādāspadaṃ jñānaṃ svasaṃviditaṃ jñānatvāt īśvarajñānavat | na cāyaṃ
vādyapratīto dṛṣṭāntaḥ | puruṣasyeśvaratayā jainairapi svīkṛtatvena tajjñā-
nasya teṣāṃ prasiddheḥ | vyarthaviśeṣyaścātra tava hetuḥ | samarthaviśeṣa-
ṇopādānenaiva sādhyasiddheḥ | agnisiddhau dhūmavattve sati dravyatvāditi-
vat īśvarajñānānyatvādityetāvataiva gatatvāt | na hīśvarajñānādanya-
tsvasaṃviditamaprameyaṃ vā jñānamasti yadvyavacchedāya prameyatvāditi
kriyeta | bhavanmate tadanyajñānasya sarvasya prameyatvāt | aprayojakaścāyaṃ
hetuḥ | sopādhitvāt | sādhanāvyāpakaḥ sādhyena samavyāptiśca
khalūpādhirabhidhīyate | tatputratvādinā śyāmatve sādhye śākādyā-
hārapariṇāmavat | upādhiścātra jaḍatvam | tathā hi īśvarajñānānyatve
prameyatve ca satyapi yadeva jaḍaṃ stambhādi tadeva svasmādanyena prakā-
śyate | svaprakāśe paramukhaprekṣitvaṃ hi jaḍasya lakṣaṇam | na ca jñānaṃ
jaḍasvarūpam | ataḥ sādhanāvyāpakatvaṃ jaḍatvasya | sādhyena samavyā-
ptikatvaṃ cāsya spaṣṭameva | jāḍyaṃ vihāya svaprakāśābhāvasya taṃ ca
tyakttvā jāḍyasya kvacidapyadarśanāditi || yaccoktaṃ samutpannaṃ hi
jñānamekātmasamavetetyādi tadapyasatyam | itthamarthajñānatajjñānayo-
rutpadyamānayoḥ kramānupalakṣaṇāt | āśūtpādātkramānupalakṣaṇa-
mutpalapatraśatavyatibhedavaditi cet tanna | jijñāsāvyavahitasyārthajñāna-
syotpādapratipādanāt | na ca jñānānāṃ jijñāsāsamutpādyatvaṃ ghaṭate |
ajijñāsiteṣvapi yogyadeśeṣu viṣayeṣu tadutpādapratīteḥ | na cārtha-
jñānamayogyadeśam | ātmasamavetasyāsya samutpādāt | iti jijñāsāma-
ntareṇaivārthajñāne jñānotpādaprasaṅgaḥ | athotpadyatāṃ nāmedaṃ ko
doṣa iti cet tanna | nanvevameva tajjñānajñānepyaparajñānotpādaprasaṅgaḥ
tatrāpi caivamevāyamityaparāparajñānotpādaparaṃparāyāmevātmano vyāpā-
rānna viṣayāntarasaṃcāraḥ syāditi || tasmādyajjñānaṃ tadātma-
vodhaṃ pratyanapekṣitajñānāntaravyāpāram | yathā gocarāntaragrāhi-
jñānātprāgbhāvigocarāntaragrāhidhārāvāhijñānaprabandhasyāntyajñānam |
jñānaṃ ca vivādādhyāsitaṃ rūpādijñānamiti na jñānasya jñānāntara-
jñeyatā yuktiṃ sahata iti kāvyārthaḥ || 12 ||

atha ye brahmādvaitavādino'vidyā'paraparyāyamāyāvaśātpratibhāsa-
mānatvena viśvatrayavartivastuprapañcamapāramārthikaṃ samarthayante tanmata-
mupahasannāha |
māyā satī ceddvayatattvasiddhi-
rathāsatī hanta kutaḥ prapañcaḥ |
māyaiva cedarthasahā ca tatkiṃ
mātā ca vandhyā ca bhavatpareṣām || 13 ||

tairvādibhistāttvikātmabrahmavyatiriktā yā māyā avidyā
prapañcahetuḥ parikalpitā sā sadrūpā'sadrūpā vā dvayī gatiḥ | satī
sadrūpā cettadā dvayatattvasiddhiḥ | dvāvayavau yasya taddvayaṃ tathāvidhaṃ
yattatvaṃ paramārthastasya siddhiḥ | ayamarthaḥ | ekaṃ tāvattvadabhimataṃ tā-
ttvikamātmabrahma dvitīyā ca māyā tattvarūpā sadrūpatayāṅgīkriyamā-
ṇatvāt | tathā cādvaitavādasya mūle nihitaḥ kuṭhāraḥ | atheti
pakṣāntaradyotane | yadi asatī gaganāmbhojavadavasturūpā sā māyā
tataḥ | hantetyupadarśane āścarye vā | kutaḥ prapañcaḥ | ayaṃ tribhuvanodara-
vivaravivartipadārthasārtharūpaprapañcaḥ kutaḥ | na kutopi saṃbhavītyarthaḥ |
māyāyā avastutvenābhyupagamāt avastunaśca turaṅgaśṛṅgasyeva sarvopā-
khyāvirahitasya sākṣātkriyamāṇedṛśavivartajanane'samarthatvāt |
kilendrajālādau mṛgatṛṣṇādau vā māyopadarśitārthānāmarthakriyāyā-
masāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭam | atra tu tadupalambhātkathaṃ māyāvyapadeśaḥ śraddhīya-
tām | atha māyāpi bhaviṣyati arthakriyāsamarthapadārthopadarśana-
kṣamā ca bhaviṣyati iti cettarhi svavacanavirodhaḥ | na hi bhavati
mātā ca vandhyā ceti | enamevārthaṃ hṛdi nidhāyottarārdhamāha |
māyaiva cedityādi | atraivakāro'pyarthaḥ | apiśca samuccayārthaḥ | agretana-
cakāraśca tathā | ubhayośca samuccayārthayoryaugapadyadyotakatvaṃ pratītameva |
yathā raghuvaṃśe te ca prāpurudanvantaṃ bubudhe cādipūruṣaḥ iti | tadayaṃ
vākyārtho māyā ca bhaviṣyati arthasahā ca bhaviṣyati | arthasahā
arthakriyāsamarthapadārthopadarśanakṣamā | cecchadbotra yojyate iti cet |
evaṃ paramāśaṅkya tasya svavacanavirodhamudbhāvayati | tatkiṃ bhavatpareṣāṃ
mātā ca vandhyā ca | kimiti saṃbhāvane | saṃbhāvyate etat bhavato
ye pare pratipakṣāsteṣāṃ bhavatpareṣāṃ bhavadvyatiriktānāṃ bhavadājñāpṛtha-
gbhūtatvena teṣāṃ vādināṃ yanmātā ca bhaviṣyati vandhyā ca bhavi-
ṣyatītyupahāsaḥ | mātā hi prasavadharmiṇī vanitocyate | vandhyā ca
tadviparītā | tataśca vandhyā cetkathaṃ mātā mātā cetkathaṃ vandhyā |
tadevaṃ māyāyā avāstavyā apyarthasahatveṅgīkriyamāṇe prastutavākya-
vatspaṣṭa eva svavacanavirodhaḥ | iti samāsārthaḥ ||

vyāsārthastvayam | te vādina idaṃ praṇigadanti | tāttvikamātmabrahmai-
vāsti |
sarvaṃ svalvidaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiṃcana |
ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na tatpaśyati kaścana ||
iti samayāt | ayaṃ tu prapañco mithyārūpaḥ pratīyamānatvāt yadevaṃ
tadevaṃ yathā śuktiśakale kaladhautaṃ tathā cāyaṃ tasmāttathā | tadetadvā-
rtam | tathāhi | mithyārūpatvaṃ taiḥ kīdṛgvivakṣitaṃ kimatyantā-
sattvam utānyasyānyākāratayā pratītatvam āhosvidanirvācyatvam |
prathamapakṣe'satkhyātiprasaṅgaḥ | dvitīye viparītakhyātisvīkṛtiḥ |
tṛtīye tu kimidamanirvācyatvam | niḥsvabhāvatvaṃ cennisaḥ prati-
ṣedhārthatve svabhāvaśadbasyāpi bhāvābhāvayoranyatarārthatve'satkhyātisa-
tkhyātyabhyupagamaprasaṅgaḥ | bhāvapratiṣedhe'satkhyātirabhāvapratiṣedhe
satkhyātiriti | pratītyagocaratvaṃ niḥsvabhāvatvamiti cedatra virodhaḥ |
sa prapañco hi na pratīyate cetkathaṃ dharmitayopāttaḥ kathaṃ ca pratīyamā-
natvaṃ hetutayopāttaṃ tathopādāne vā kathaṃ na pratīyate | yathā pratī-
yate na tatheti cet tarhi viparītakhyātiriyamabhyupagatā syāt | kiṃ
ceyamanirvācyatā prapañcasya pratyakṣabādhitā ghaṭoyamityādyākāraṃ hi
pratyakṣaṃ prapañcasya satyatāmeva vyavasyati | ghaṭādipratiniyatapadārtha-
paricchedātmanastasyotpādāt | itaretaraviviktavastūnāmeva ca prapañca-
śadbavācyatvāt | atha pratyakṣasya vidhāyakatvātkathaṃ pratiṣedhe sāmarthyam |
pratyakṣaṃ hi idamiti vastusvarūpaṃ gṛhṇāti nānyatsvarūpaṃ pratiṣedhati |
āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhṛ vipaścitaḥ |
naikatva āgamastena pratyakṣeṇa prabādhyate ||
iti vacanāt iti cenna | anyarūpaniṣedhamantareṇa tatsvarūpapari-
cchedasyāpyasaṃpatteḥ | pītādivyavacchinnaṃ hi nīlaṃ nīlamiti gṛhītaṃ
bhavati nānyathā | kevalavastusvarūpapratipatterevānyapratiṣedhapratipatti-
rūpatvāt | muṇḍabhūtalagrahaṇe ghaṭābhāvagrahaṇavat | tasmādyathā pratyakṣaṃ
vidhāyakaṃ pratipannaṃ tathā niṣedhakamapi pratipattavyam | api ca
vidhāyakameva pratyakṣamityaṅgīkṛte yathā pratyakṣeṇa vidyā vidhīyate
tathā kiṃ nāvidyāpīti | tathā ca dvaitāpattiḥ | tataśca suvyavasthitaḥ
prapañcaḥ | tadamī vādino'vidyāvivekena sanmātraṃ pratyakṣātpratiyanto-
pi na niṣedhakaṃ taditi bruvāṇāḥ kathaṃ nonmattā iti siddhaṃ pratyakṣa-
bādhitaḥ pakṣa iti || anumānabādhitaśca | prapañco mithyā na
bhavati asadvilakṣaṇatvāt ātmavat | pratīyamānatvaṃ ca heturbrahmātmanā
vyabhicārī | sa hi pratīyate na ca mithyā | apratīyamānatve tvasya
tadviṣayavacasāmapravṛttermūkataiva teṣāṃ śreyasī | sādhyavikalaśca dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
śuktiśakalakaladhautepi prapañcāntargatatvena anirvacanīyatāyāḥ
sādhyamānatvāt | kiṃ cedamanumānaṃ prapañcādbhinnamabhinnaṃ vā | yadi bhinnaṃ
tarhi satyamasatyaṃ vā | yadi satyaṃ tadvadeva prapañcasyāpi satyatvaṃ
syāt | advaitavādaprākāre khaṇḍipātāt | athāsatyaṃ tarhi na kiṃcittena
sādhayituṃ śakyam | avastutvāt | abhinnaṃ cet pañcasvabhāvatayā
tasyāpi mithyārūpatvāpattiḥ | mithyārūpaṃ ca tatkathaṃ svasādhya-
sādhanāyālam || evaṃ ca prapañcasyāpi mithyārūpatvāsiddheḥ
kathaṃ paramabrahmaṇastāttvikatvaṃ syādyato bāhyārthābhāvo bhavediti ||

athavā prakārāntareṇa sanmātralakṣaṇasya paramabrahmaṇaḥ
sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ copanyasyate | nanu paramabrahmaṇa evaikasya paramārthasato
vidhirūpasya vidyamānatvātpramāṇaviṣayatvam | aparasya dvitīyasya
kasyacidapyabhāvāt | tathā hi | pratyakṣaṃ tadāvedakamasti | pratyakṣaṃ dvidhā
bhidyate | nirvikalpakasavikalpakabhedāt | tataśca nirvikalpakapratya-
kṣātsanmātrabiṣayāttasyaikasyaiṣa siddhiḥ | tathācoktam |
asti hyālocanājñānaṃ prathamaṃ nirvikalpakam |
bālamūkādivijñānasadṛśaṃ śuddhavastujam |
na ca vidhivatparasparavyāvṛttirapyadhyakṣata eva pratīyata iti
dvaitasiddhiḥ | tasya niṣedhāviṣayatvāt | āhurbidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhṛ
ityādivacanāt | yacca savikalpakapratyakṣaṃ ghaṭapaṭādibhedasādhakaṃ tada-
pi sattārūpeṇānvitānāmeteṣāṃ prakāśakatvāt sattā'dvaitasyaiva sādhakam |
sattāyāśca paramabrahmarūpatvāt | taduktaṃ yadadvaitaṃ tadbrahmaṇo rūpamiti ||
anumānādapi tatsadbhāvo vibhāvyata eva | tathā hi vidhireva tattvam |
prameyatvāt | yataḥ pramāṇaviṣayabhūto'rthaḥ prameyaḥ | pramāṇānāṃ ca pratya-
kṣānumānāgamopamānārthāpattisaṃjñakānāṃ bhāvaviṣayatvenaiva pravṛtteḥ |
tathā coktam |
pratyakṣādyavatāraḥ syādbhāvāṃśo gṛhyate yadā |
vyāpārastadanutpatterabhāvāṃśe jighṛkṣite ||
yaccābhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ tasya prāmāṇyābhāvānna tatpramāṇam | tadvi-
ṣayasya kasyacidapyabhāvāt | yastu pramāṇapañcakaviṣayaḥ sa tu vidhi-
reva | tenaiva ca prameyatvasya vyāptatvāt | siddhaṃ prameyatvena vidhireva
tattvam | yattu na vidhirūpaṃ tanna prameyam yathā kharaviṣāṇam | prameyaṃ cedaṃ
nikhilaṃ vastutattvam | tasmādvidhirūpameva | ato vā tatsiddhiḥ | grāmā-
rāmādayaḥ padārthāḥ pratibhāsāntaḥpraviṣṭāḥ | pratibhāsamānatvāt | yatpra-
tibhāsate tatpratibhāsāntaḥpraviṣṭaṃ yathā pratibhāsasvarūpam | prati-
bhāsante ca grāmārāmādayaḥ padārthāḥ | tasmātpratibhāsāntaḥpraviṣṭāḥ ||
āgamo'pi paramabrahmaṇa eva pratipādakaḥ samupalabhyate | puruṣa evedaṃ
sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyaṃ utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati | yade-
jati yannaijati | yaddūre yadantike | yadantarasya sarvasya yaduta sarva-
syāsya bāhyataḥ | ityādiḥ | śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ
anumantavya ityādivedavākyairapi tatsiddheḥ | kṛtrimeṇāpyāgamena
tasyaiva pratipādanāt | uktaṃ ca |
sarvaṃ vai khalvidaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiṃcana |
ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na tatpaśyati kaścana ||
iti pramāṇatastasyaiva siddheḥ || paramapuruṣa eka eva tattvam | sakala-
bhedānāṃ tadvivartatvāt | tathā hi sarve bhāvā brahmavivartāḥ | sattvaikarūpe-
ṇānvitatvāt | yadyadrūpeṇānvitaṃ tattadātmakameva yathā ghaṭaghaṭīśarāvo-
dañcanādayo mṛdrūpeṇaikenānvitā mṛdvivartāḥ | sattvaikarūpeṇānvitaṃ ca
sakalaṃ vastu | iti siddhaṃ brahmavivartatvaṃ nikhilabhedānāmiti ||

tadetatsarvaṃ madirārasāsvādagadgadodgaditamivābhāsate | vicārāsaha-
tvāt | sarvaṃ hi vastu pramāṇasiddhaṃ na tu vāṅmātreṇa | advaitamate ca pramāṇa-
meva nāsti | tatsadbhāvedvaitaprasaṅgāt | advaitasādhakasya pramāṇasya dvitī-
yasya sadbhāvāt | atha mataṃ lokapratyāyanāya tadapekṣayā pramāṇamapya-
bhyupagamyate | tadasat | tvanmate lokasyaivāsaṃbhavāt | ekasyaiva nitya-
niraṃśasya parabrahmaṇa eva sattvāt || athāstu yathākathaṃcitpramāṇamapi |
tatkiṃ pratyakṣamanumānamāgamo vā tatsādhakaṃ pramāṇamurarīkriyate |
na tāvatpratyakṣam | tasya samastavastujātagatabhedasyaiva prakāśakatvāt |
ābālagopālaṃ tasyaiva pratibhāsanāt | yacca nirvikalpakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ
tadāvedakamityuktaṃ tadapi na samyak | tasya prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt |
sarvasyāpi pramāṇatattvasya vyavasāyātmakasyaiva visaṃvādakatvena prāmā-
ṇyopapatteḥ | savikalpakena tu pratyakṣeṇa pramāṇabhūtenaikasyaiva vidhirūpa-
sya parabrahmaṇaḥ svapnepyapratibhāsanāt | yadapyuktam āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣa-
mityādi tadapi na peśalam | pratyakṣeṇa hyanuvṛttavyāvṛttākārātmaka-
vastuna eva prakāśanāt | etacca prāgeva kṣuṇṇam | na hyanusyūtamekama-
khaṇḍaṃ sattāmātraṃ viśeṣanirapekṣaṃ sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsate yena yadadvaitaṃ
tadbrahmaṇo rūpamityādyuktaṃ śobheta | viśeṣanirapekṣasya kharaviṣāṇa-
vadapratibhāsanāt | taduktam |
nirviśeṣaṃ hi sāmānyaṃ bhavetkharaviṣāṇavat |
sāmānyarahitatvena viśeṣāstadvadeva hi ||
tataḥ siddhe sāmānyaviśeṣātmanyarthe pramāṇaviṣaye kuta evaikasya
parabrahmaṇaḥ pramāṇaviṣayatvam || yacca prameyatvāditvādityanumānamuktaṃ
tadapyetenaivāpāstaṃ boddhavyam | pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhitatvena hetoḥ kālā-
tyayāpadiṣṭatvāt | yacca tatsiddhau pratibhāsamānatvaṃ sādhanamuktaṃ tadapi
sādhanābhāsatvena na prakṛtasādhyasādhanāyālam | pratibhāsamānatvaṃ
hi nikhilabhāvānāṃ svataḥ parato vā | na tāvatsvataḥ | ghaṭapaṭamuku-
ṭaśakaṭādīnāṃ svataḥ pratibhāsamānatvenāsiddheḥ | parataḥ pratibhāsamā-
natvaṃ ca paraṃ vinā nopapadyata iti | yacca paramabrahmavivartavartitvamakhi-
labhedānāmityuktaṃ tadapyanvetranvīyamānadvayāvinābhāvitvena puruṣā-
dvaitaṃ pratibadhnātyeva | na ca ghaṭādīnāṃ caitanyānvayopyasti | mṛdādya-
nvayasyaiva tatra darśanāt | tato na kiṃcidetadapi | atonumānādapi na
tatsiddhiḥ | kiṃ ca pakṣahetudṛṣṭāntā anumānopāyabhūtāḥ parasparaṃ bhinnā
abhinnā vā | bhede dvaitasiddhiḥ | abhede tvekarūpatāpattiḥ | tatkathame-
tebhyonumānamātmānamāsādayati | yadi ca hetumantareṇāpi sādhya-
siddhiḥ syāttarhi dvaitasyāpi vāṅmātrataḥ kathaṃ na siddhiḥ | taduktam |
hetoradvaitasiddhiśced dvaitaṃ syāddhetusādhyayoḥ |
hetunā cedvinā siddhirdvaitaṃ vāṅmātrato na kim ||
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvamityādeḥ sarvaṃ vai khalvidaṃ brahmetyādeścāgamā-
dapi na tatsiddhiḥ | tasyāpi dvaitāvinābhāvitvena advaitaṃ prati
prāmāṇyāsaṃbhavāt | vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇasya dvaitasyaiva tatrāpi
darśanāt | taduktam |
karmadvaitaṃ phaladvaitaṃ lokadvaitaṃ virudhyate |
vidyā'vidyādvayaṃ na syādbandhamokṣadvayaṃ tathā ||
tataḥ kathamāgamādapi tatsiddhiḥ || tato na puruṣādvaitalakṣaṇamekameva
pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ | iti suvyavasthitaḥ prapañcaḥ | iti
kāvyārthaḥ || 13 ||

atha svābhimatasāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakavācyavācakabhāvasama-
rthanapuraḥsaraṃ tīrthāntarīyaprakalpitatadekāntagocaravācyavācakabhāva-
nirāsadvāreṇa teṣāṃ pratibhāvaibhavābhāvamāha |
anekamekātmakameva vācyaṃ
dvayātmakaṃ vācakamapyavaśyam |
atonyathā vācakavācyaklṛptā--
vatāvakānāṃ pratibhāpramādaḥ || 14 ||

vācyamabhidheyaṃ cetanamacetanaṃ vastu | evakārasyāpyarthatvāt | sā-
mānyarūpatayā ekātmakamapi vyaktibhedenānekam anekarūpam | atha
vā'nekarūpamapyekātmakamanyonyasaṃvalitatvāt itthamapi vyākhyāne
na doṣaḥ | tathā vācakamabhidhāyakaṃ śabdarūpaṃ tadapyavaśyaṃ niścitaṃ
dvayātmakam | sāmānyaviśeṣobhayātmakatvāt | ekānekātmakamityarthaḥ |
ubhayatra vācyaliṅgatvepyavyaktatvānnapuṃsakatvam | avaśyamitipadaṃ
vācyavācakayorubhayorapyekānekātmakatvaṃ niścinvattadekāntaṃ vyava-
cchinatti | ata upadarśitaprakārādanyathā sāmānyaviśeṣaikāntarūpeṇa
prakāreṇa | vācakavācyaklṛptau vācyavācakabhāvakalpanāyām | atā??-
kānām atvadīyānām anyayūthyānām | pratibhāpramādaḥ prajñāskha-
litam | ityakṣarārthaḥ || atra cālpasvaratvena vācyapadasya prāgnipāte
prāptepi yadādau vācakagrahaṇaṃ tatprāyo'rthapratipādanasya śabdādhīnatvena
vācakasyārcyatvajñāpanārtham | tathā ca śābdikāḥ |
na sosti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte |
anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena bhāsate ||
iti ||

bhāvārthastvevam | eke tīrthikāḥ sāmānyarūpameva vācyatayā abhyupaga-
cchanti | te ca dravyāstikanayānupātino mīmāṃsakabhedā advaitavādinaḥ
sāṃkhyāśca | kecicca viśeṣarūpameva vācyaṃ nirvacanti | te ca paryāyāsti-
kanayānusāriṇaḥ saugatāḥ | apare ca parasparanirapekṣapadārthapṛthagbhūta-
sāmānyaviśeṣayuktaṃ vastu vācyatvena niścinvate | te ca naigamanayānugā-
minaḥ kāṇādā ākṣapādāśca | etacca pakṣatrayamapi kiṃciccarcyate || tathā
hi saṃgrahanayāvalambino vādinaḥ pratipādayanti | sāmānyameva tattvam |
tataḥ pṛthagbhūtānāṃ viśeṣāṇāmadarśanāt | tathā sarvamekam | aviśeṣeṇa
saditijñānābhidhānānuvṛttiliṅgānumitasattākatvāt | tathā dravya-
tvameva tattvam | tatorthāntarabhūtānāṃ dharmādharmākāśakālapudgalajīvadra-
vyāṇāmanupalabdheḥ | kiṃ ca yaiḥ sāmānyātpṛthagbhūtā anyānyavyāvṛ-
ttyātmakā viśeṣāḥ kalpyante teṣu viśeṣatvaṃ vidyate na vā | no cenniḥ
svabhāvatāprasaṅgaḥ | svarūpasyaivābhāvāt | asti cettarhi tadeva sāmā-
nyam | yataḥ samānānāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānyam | viśeṣarūpatayā ca sarveṣāṃ
teṣāmaviśeṣeṇa pratītiḥ siddhaiva | api ca viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāvṛttipratyaya-
hetutvaṃ lakṣaṇam | vyāvṛttipratyaya eva vicāryamāṇo na ghaṭate | vyāvṛtti-
rhi vivakṣitapadārthe itarapadārthapratiṣedhaḥ | vivakṣitapadārthaścasvasvarūpa-
vyavasthāpanamātraparyavasāyī kathaṃ padārthāntarapratiṣedhe pragalbhate | na ca
svarūpasattvādanyattatra kimapi yena tanniṣedhaḥ pravarttate | tatra ca vyāvṛ-
ttau kriyamāṇāyāṃ svātmavyatiriktaviśvatrayavartino'tītavartamānā-
nāgatāḥ padārthāstasmādvyāvartanīyāḥ | te ca nājñātasvarūpā vyāva-
rtayituṃ śakyāḥ | tataścaikasyāpi viśeṣasya parijñāne pramātuḥ sarvajñatvaṃ
syāt | na caitatprātītikaṃ yauktikaṃ vā | vyāvṛttiśca niṣedhaḥ | sa
cābhāvarūpatvāttucchaḥ kathaṃ pratītigocaramañcati | khapuṣpavat | tathā
yebhyo vyāvṛttiste asadrūpā sadrūpā vā | asadrūpāścettarhi kharaviṣāṇā-
tkiṃ na vyāvṛttiḥ | sadrūpāścetsāmānyameva | yā ceyaṃ vyāvṛttirviśeṣaiḥ
kriyate sā sarvāsu viśeṣavyaktiṣvekā anekā vā | anekā cettasyā
api viśeṣatvāpāttiḥ | anekarūpatvaikajīvitatvādviśeṣāṇām | tataśca
tasyā api viśeṣatvānyathānupapattervyāvṛttyā bhāvyam | vyāvṛtterapi
ca vyāvṛttau viśeṣāṇāmabhāva eva syāt | tatsvarūpabhūtāyā vyāvṛtteḥ
pratiṣiddhatvāt | anavasthāpātācca | ekā cetsāmānyameva saṃjñānta-
reṇa pratipannaṃ syāt | anuvṛttipratyayalakṣaṇāvyabhicārāt | kiṃ cāmī
viśeṣāḥ sāmānyādbhinnā abhinnā vā | bhinnāścenmaṇḍūkajaṭābhārānu-
kārāḥ | abhinnārthāścettadeva tatsvarūpavat | iti sāmānyaikāntavādaḥ ||
paryāyanayānvayinastu bhāṣante | viviktāḥ kṣaṇakṣayiṇo viśeṣā eva
paramārthaḥ | tato viṣvagbhūtasya sāmānyasyāpratīyamānatvāt | na hi
gavādivyaktyanubhavakāle varṇasaṃsthānātmakavyaktirūpamapahāyānya-
tkiṃcidekamanuyāyi pratibhāsate | tādṛśasyānubhavābhāvāt | tathā ca
paṭhanti |
etāsu pañcasvavabhāsinīṣu pratyakṣabodhe sphuṭamaṅgulīṣu |
sādhāraṇaṃ rūpamavekṣate yaḥ śṛṅgaṃ śirasyātmana īkṣate saḥ ||
ekākāraparāmarśapratyayastu svahetudattaśaktibhya evotpadyata iti na
tena sāmānyasādhanaṃ nyāyyam | kiṃ ca yadidaṃ sāmānyaṃ parikalpyate
tadekamanekaṃ vā | ekamapi sarvagatamasarvagataṃ vā | sarvagataṃ cetkiṃ na
vyaktyantarāleṣūpalabhyate | sarvagataikatvābhyupagame ca tasya yathā
gotvaṃ sāmānyaṃ govyaktīḥ kroḍīkaroti evaṃ kiṃ na ghaṭapaṭādivya-
ktīrapi | aviśeṣāt | asarvagataṃ cedviśeṣarūpāpattira bhyupagamabādhaśca |
athānekam gotvāśvatvaghaṭatvapaṭatvādibhedabhinnatvāt tarhi viśeṣā
eva svīkṛtāḥ | anyonyavyāvṛttihetutvāt | na hi yadgotvaṃ tadaśvatvā-
tmakamiti | arthakriyākāritvaṃ ca vastuno lakṣaṇam | tacca viśeṣeṣveva
sphuṭaṃ pratīyate | na hi sāmānyena kācidarthakriyā kriyate | tasya
niṣkriyatvāt | vāhadohādikāsvarthakriyāsu viśeṣāṇāmevopayogāt |
tathedaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣebhyo bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā | bhinnaṃ cedavastu | viśeṣa-
viśleṣeṇārthakriyākāritvābhāvāt | abhinnaṃ cedviśeṣā eva
tatsvarūpavat | iti viśeṣaikāntavādaḥ || naigamanayānugāminastvāhuḥ |
svatantrau sāmānyaviśeṣau | tathaiva pramāṇena pratītatvāt | tathā hi
sāmānyaviśeṣāvatyantaṃ bhinnau | viruddhadharmādhyāsitatvāt | yāvevaṃ
tāvevaṃ yathā pāthaḥpāvakau | tathā caitau | tasmāttathā | sāmānyaṃ hi
gotvādiṃ sarvagataṃ tadviparītāśca śabalaśābaleyādayo viśeṣāḥ | tataḥ
kathameṣāmaikyaṃ yuktam | na sāmānyātpṛthagviśeṣasyopalambha iti cet
kathaṃ tarhi tasyopalambha iti vācyam | sāmānyavyāptasyeti cet na tarhi
sa viśeṣopalambhaḥ | sāmānyasyāpi tena grahaṇāt | tataśca tena bodhena
viviktaviśeṣagrahaṇābhāvāt tadvācakaṃ dhvaniṃ tatsādhyaṃ ca vyavahāraṃ
na pravartayetpramātā | na caitadasti | viśaṣābhidhānavyavahārayoḥ pravṛtti-
darśanāt | tasmādviśeṣamabhilaṣatā tatra ca vyavahāraṃ pravarttayatā tadgrā-
hako bodho viviktobhyupagantavyaḥ | evaṃ sāmānyasthāne viśeṣaśabdaṃ
viśeṣasthāne ca sāmānyaśabdaṃ prayuñjānena sāmānyepi tadgrāhake
bodho viviktoṅgīkartavyaḥ | tasmātsvasvagrāhiṇi jñāne pṛthakprati-
bhāsamānatvāddvāvapītaretaraviśakalitau | tato na sāmānyaviśeṣā-
tmakatvaṃ vastuto ghaṭate | iti svatantrasāmānyaviśeṣavādaḥ ||

tadetatpakṣatrayamapi na kṣamate kṣodam | pramāṇabādhitatvāt | sāmānya-
viśeṣobhayātmakasyaiva vastuno nirvigānamanubhūyamānatvāt | vastuno
hi lakṣaṇamarthakriyākāritvam | ta ttaccānekāntavāda evāvikalaṃ kalaya-
nti parīkṣakāḥ | tathā hi yathā gaurityukta khurakakutsāsnālāṅgūlavi-
ṣāṇādyavayavasaṃpannaṃ vastusvarūpaṃ sarvavyaktyanuyāyi pratīyate tathā mahi-
ṣyādivyāvṛttirapi pratīyate | yatrāpi ca śabalā gaurityucyate tatrāpi
yathā viśeṣapratibhāsastathā gotvapratibhāsopi sphuṭa eva | śabaleti-
kevalaviśeṣaṇoccāraṇepi arthātprakaraṇādvā gotvamanuvarttate | api ca
śabalatvamapi nānārūpam | tathā darśanāt | tato vaktrā śabaletyuktekro-
ḍīkṛtasakalaśabalasāmānyaṃ vivakṣitagovyaktigatameva śabalatvaṃ vyava-
sthāpyate | tadevamābālagopālaṃ pratītiprasiddhepi vastunaḥ sāmānya-
viśeṣātmakatve tadubhayaikāntavādaḥ pralāpamātram | na hi kvacitkadā-
citkenacitsāmānyaṃ viśeṣavinākṛtamanubhūyate viśeṣā vā tadvinā-
kṛtāḥ | kevalaṃ durnayaprabhāvitamativyāmohavaśādekamapalapyā'nyataradvya-
vasthāpayanti bāliśāḥ | soyamandhagajanyāyaḥ || yepi ca tadekānta-
pakṣopanipātinaḥ prāguktā doṣāstepi anekāntavādapracaṇḍamudgarajarja-
ritatvānnocchvasitumapi kṣamāḥ || svatantrasāmānyaviśeṣavādinastvevaṃ
pratikṣepyāḥ | sāmānyaṃ prativyakti kathaṃcidbhinnam | kathaṃcidabhinnam |
kathaṃcittadātmakatvād | visadṛśapariṇāmavat | yathaiva hi kācidvya-
ktirupalabhyamānādvyaktyantarādviśiṣṭā visadṛśapariṇāmadarśanādava
tiṣṭhate tathā sadṛśapariṇāmātmakasāmānyadarśanātsamāneti | tena samā-
no gaurayam | so'nena samāna iti pratīteḥ | na cāsya vyaktisvarūpāda-
bhinnatvātsāmānyarūpatāvyāghātaḥ | yato rūpādīnāmapi vyaktisvarū-
pādabhinnatvamasti na caiteṣāṃ guṇarūpatāvyāghātaḥ | kathaṃcidvyatirekastu
rūpādīnāmiva sadṛśapariṇāmasyāpyastyeva | pṛthagyapadeśādibhāktvāt |
viśeṣā api naikāntena sāmānyātpṛthagbhavitumarhanti | yato yadi sā-
mānyaṃ sarvagataṃ siddhaṃ bhavet tadā teṣāmasarvagatatvena tato viruddhadharmā-
dhyāsaḥ syāt | na ca tasya tatsiddham | prāguktayuktyā nirākṛtatvāt |
sāmānyasya viśeṣāṇāṃ ca kathaṃcitparasparāvyatirekeṇaikānekarūpa-
tayā vyavasthitatvāt | viśeṣebhyo'vyatiriktatvāddhi sāmānyamapya-
nekamiṣyate sāmānyāttu viśeṣāṇāmavyatirekāttepyekarūpā iti ||
ekatvaṃ ca sāmānyasya saṃgrahanayārpaṇātsarvatra vijñeyam | pramāṇārpaṇā-
ttasya kathaṃcidviruddhadharmādhyāsitatvam | sadṛśapariṇāmarūpasya visadṛ-
śapariṇāmavat kathaṃcitprativyakti bhedāt | evaṃ cāsiddhaṃ sāmānyavi-
śeṣayoḥ sarvathāviruddhadharmādhyāsitatvam | kathaṃcidviruddhadharmādhyāsita-
tvaṃ cedvivakṣitaṃ tadāsmatkakṣāpraveśaḥ | kathaṃcidviruddhadharmādhyāsasya kathaṃ-
cidbhedāvinābhūtatvāt | pāthaḥpāvakadṛṣṭāntopi sādhyasādhanavikalaḥ |
tayorapi kathaṃcideva viruddhadharmādhyāsitatvena bhinnatvena ca svīkara-
ṇāt | payastvapāvakatvādinā hi tayorviruddhadharmādhyāso bhedaśca | dravya-
tvādinā punastadvaiparītyamiti | tathā ca kathaṃ na sāmānyaviśeṣātma-
katvaṃ vastuno ghaṭata iti || tataḥ suṣṭhūktaṃ vācyamekamanekarūpamiti ||

evaṃ vācakamapi śabdākhyaṃ dvayātmakam sāmānyaviśeṣātmakam |
sarvaśabdavyaktiṣvanuyāyi śabdatvamekaṃ śāṅkhaśārṅgatīvramandodāttānu-
dāttasvaritādiviśeṣabhedādanekam | śabdasya hi sāmānyaviśeṣātma-
katvaṃ paudgalikatvādvyaktameva | tathāhi paudgalikaḥ śabdaḥ | indriyārtha-
tvāt | rūpādivat | yaccāsya paudgalikatvaniṣedhāya sparśaśūnyāśrayatvāt
atinibiḍapradeśe praveśanirgamayorapratighātāt pūrvaṃ paścāccāvayavānupa-
labdheḥ sūkṣmamūrtadravyāntarāprerakatvāt gaganaguṇatvācceti pañcahetavo
yaugairupanyastāste hetvābhāsāḥ | tathā hi śabdaparyāyasyāśrayo bhāṣā-
vargaṇā na punarākāśam | tatra ca sparśo nirṇīyata eva | yathā śabdā-
śrayaḥ sparśavān | anuvātaprativātayorviprakṛṣṭanikaṭaśarīriṇopalabhya-
mānānupalabhyamānendriyārthatvāt | tathāvidhagandhādhāradravyaparamāṇu-
vat | ityasiddhaḥ prathamaḥ | dvitīyastu gandhadravyeṇa vyabhicārādanaikā-
ntikaḥ | vartyamānajātyakastūrikādigandhadravyaṃ hi pihitadvārāpavaraka-
syāntarviśati bahiśca niryāti na cāpaudgalikam | atha tatra sūkṣmarandhra-
saṃbhavānnātinibiḍatvamatastatra tatpraveśaniṣkramau | kathamanyathoddhā-
ṭitadvārāvasthāyāmiva na tadekārṇavatvam | savathā nīrandhre tu pradeśe
na tayoḥ saṃbhava iti cet tarhi śabdepyetatsamānamityasiddho hetuḥ |
tṛtīyastu taḍillatolkādibhiranaikāntikaḥ | caturthopi tathaiva | gandha-
dravyaviśeṣasūkṣmarajodhūmādibhirvyābhicārāt | na hi gandhadravyādika-
mapi nāsāyāṃ niviśamānaṃ tadvivaradvāradeśodbhinnaśmaśruprerakaṃ dṛśyate |
pañcamaḥ punarasiddhaḥ | tathāhi na gaganaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ | asmadādipratyakṣa-
tvāt | rūpādivat | iti siddhaḥ paudgalikātvātsāmānyaviśeṣātmakaḥ
śabda iti || na ca vācyam ātmanyapaudgalikepi kathaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣā-
tmakatvaṃ nirvivādamanubhūyata iti | yataḥ saṃsāryātmanaḥ pratipradeśama-
nantānantakarmaparamāṇubhiḥ saha vahnitāpitaghanakuṭṭitanirvibhāga-
piṇḍībhūtasūcīkalāpavat lolībhāvamāpannasya kathaṃcitpaudgalikatvā-
bhyanujñānāditi | yadyapi syādvādavādināṃ paudgalikamapaudgalikaṃ
ca sarvaṃ vastu sāmānyaviśeṣātmakaṃ tathāpyapaudgalikeṣu dharmādharmā-
kāśakāleṣu tadātmakatvamarvāgdṛśāṃ na tathāpratītiviṣayamāyātīti
paudgalikeṣu punastatsādhyamānaṃ teṣāṃ suśraddhānamityaprastutamapi
śabdasya paudgalikatvamatra sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatvasādhanāyopanya-
stamiti | atrāpi nityaśabdavādisaṃmataḥ śabdaikatvaikānto'nitya-
śabdavādyabhimataḥ śabdānaikatvaikāntaśca prāgdarśitadiśā pratikṣepyaḥ |
athavā vācyasya ghaṭāderarthasya sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatve tadvācakasya
dhvanerapi tattvam | śabdārthayoḥ kathaṃcittādātmyābhyupagamāt | yadāhu-
rbhadrabāhusvāmipādāḥ |
abhihāṇaṃ abhiheyāu hoi bhiṇṇaṃ abhiṇṇaṃ ca |
khuraaggimoyaguccāraṇammi jamhā u vayaṇasavaṇāṇaṃ ||
navi cheo navi dāho na pūraṇaṃ teṇa bhinnaṃ tu |
jamhā ya moyaguccāraṇammi tattheva paccao hoi ||
na ya hoi sa annatthe teṇa abhinnaṃ tadatthāo |
etena
vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāḥ śabdayonayaḥ |
kāryakāraṇatā teṣāṃ nārthaṃ śabdāḥ spṛśantyapi ||
iti pratyuktam | arthābhidhānapratyayāstulyanāmadheyā iti vaca-
nāt | śabdasya hyetadeva tattvaṃ yadabhidheyaṃ yāthātmyenāsau prati-
pādayati | sa ca tattathāpratipādayan vācyasvarūpapariṇāmapariṇata
eva vaktuṃ śakto nānyathā | atiprasaṅgāt | ghaṭābhidhānakāle paṭādya-
bhidhānasya prāpteriti ||

athavā bhaṅagyantareṇa sakalaṃ kāvyamidaṃ vyākhyāyate |
vācyaṃ vastu ghaṭādikam | ekātmakameva ekarūpameva sat anekam ane-
kasvarūpam | ayamarthaḥ | pramātā tāvatprameyaṃ lakṣaṇena niścinoti |
tacca sajātīyavijātīyavyavacchedādātmalābhaṃ labhate | yathā ghaṭasya
sajātīyā mṛnmayapadārthā vijātīyāśca paṭādayaḥ | teṣāṃ vyavaccheda-
stallakṣaṇam | pṛthubudhnodarādyākāraḥ kambugrīvo jaladhāraṇādikriyā-
samarthaḥ padārthaviśeṣo ghaṭa ityucyate | teṣāṃ ca sajātīyānāṃ svarūpaṃ
tatra buddhyāropya vyavacchidyate | anyathā pratiniyatatatsvarūpa-
paricchedānupapatteḥ | sarvabhāvānāṃ hi bhāvābhāvātmakaṃ svarūpam |
ekāntabhāvātmakatve vastuno vaisvarūpyaṃ syāt | ekāntābhāvātma-
katve ca niḥsvabhāvatā syāt | tasmātsvarūpeṇa sattvātpararūpeṇa
cāsattvādbhāvābhāvātmakaṃ vastu | yadāha |
sarvamasti svarūpeṇa pararūpeṇa nāsti ca |
anyathā sarvasattvaṃ syātsvarūpasyāpyasaṃbhavaḥ ||
tataścaikasmin ghaṭe sarveṣāṃ ghaṭavyatiriktapadārthānāmabhāvarūpeṇa vṛttera-
nekātmakatvaṃ ghaṭasya sūpapādam | evaṃ caikasminnarthe jñāte sarveṣāma-
rthānāṃ jñānam | sarvapadārthaparicchedamantaraṇa tanniṣedhātmana ekasya
vastuno viviktatayā paricchedāsaṃbhavāt | āgamopyevameva vyavasthitaḥ |

je egaṃ jāṇai se savvaṃ jāṇai | je savvaṃ jāṇai se egaṃ jāṇai |
tathā
eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā yena dṛṣṭaḥ sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭāḥ |
sarve bhāvāḥ sarvathā yena dṛṣṭā eko bhāvaḥ sarvathā tena dṛṣṭaḥ ||
ye tu saugatāḥ parāsattvaṃ nāṅgīkurvate teṣāṃ ghaṭādeḥ sarvātmakatva-
prasaṅgaḥ | tathā hi yathā ghaṭasya svarūpādināpi sattvaṃ tathā yadi pararū-
pādināpi syāt tathā ca sati svarūpādisattvavatpararūpādisattvapra-
sakteḥ kathaṃ na sarvātmakatvaṃ bhavet | parāsattvena tu pratiniyato'sau
sidhyati | atha na nāma nāsti parāsattvaṃ kiṃ tu svasattvameva tadi-
ti cet aho vaidagdhī | na khalu yadeva sattvaṃ tadevāsattvaṃ bhavitumarhati |
vidhipratiṣedharūpatayā viruddhadharmādhyāsenānayoraikyāyogāt | atha
yuṣmatpakṣepyevaṃ virodhastadavastha eveti cet aho vācāṭatā devānāṃ
priyasya | na hi vayaṃ yenaiva prakāreṇa sattvaṃ tenaivāsattvaṃ yenaivāsattvaṃ
tenaiva sattvamabhyupemaḥ kiṃ tu svarūpadravyakṣetrakālabhāvaiḥ sattvaṃ para-
rūpadravyakṣetrakālabhāvaistvasattvam tadā kva virodhāvakāśaḥ || yaugāstu
pragalbhante sarvathāpṛthagbhūtaparasparābhāvābhyupagamamātreṇaiva padārtha-
pratiniyamasiddheḥ kiṃ teṣāmasattvātmakatvakalpanayeti | tadasat | yadā
hi paṭādyabhāvarūpo ghaṭo na bhavati tadā ghaṭo ghaṭādireva syāt yathā
ca ghaṭābhāvādbhinnatvād ghaṭasya ghaṭarūpatā tathā paṭāderapi syād |
ghaṭābhāvādbhinnatvādeva | ityalaṃ vistareṇa || evaṃ vācakamapi śabdarūpaṃ
dvayātmakam | ekātmakamapi sadanekamityarthaḥ | yathoktanyāyena śabda-
syāpi bhāvābhāvātmakatvāt | atha vā ekaviṣayasyāpi vācaka-
syānekaviṣayatvopapatteḥ | yathā kila ghaṭaśabdaḥ saṃketavaśātpṛthu-
budhnodarādyākāravati padārthe pravartate vācakatayā tathā deśakālā-
dyapekṣayā tadvaśādeva padārthāntareṣvapi ca tathā pravartamānaḥ kena
vāryate | bhavanti hi vaktāro yoginaḥ śarīraṃ prati ghaṭa iti | saṃke-
tānāṃ puruṣecchādhīnatayā'niyatatvāt | tathā cauraśabdonyatra taskare
rūḍhopi dākṣiṇātyānāmodane prasiddhaḥ | yathā ca kumāraśabdaḥ pūrva-
deśe āśvinamāse rūḍhaḥ | evaṃ karkaṭaśibdādayopi tattaddeśāpekṣayā
yonyādivācakā jñeyāḥ | kālāpekṣayā punaryathā jainānāṃ prāya-
ścittavidhau dhṛtiśraddhāsaṃhananādimati prācīnakāle ṣaḍguruśabdena
śatamaśītyadhikamupavāsānāmucyate sma sāṃpratakāle tu tadviparīte
tenaiva ṣaḍguruśabdenopavāsatrayameva saṃketyate jītakalpavyavahārā-
nusārāt | śāstrāpekṣayā tu yathā purāṇeṣu dvādaśīśabdenaikādaśī
tripurārṇave cāliśabdena madirābhiṣaktaṃ maithunaśabdena madhusa-
rpiṣorgrahaṇamityādi | na caivaṃ saṅketasyaivārthapratyāyane prādhānyam |
svābhāvikasāmarthyasācivyādeva tasya tatra pravṛtteḥ | sarvaśabdānāṃ
sarvārthapratyāyanaśaktiyuktatvādyatra ca deśakālādau padārthapratipādana-
śaktisahakārī saṅketastatra tamarthaṃ pratipādayati | tathā ca nirjita-
durjayaparapravādāḥ śrīdevasūripādāḥ | svābhāvikasāmarthyasamayā-
bhyāmarthabodhanibandhanaṃ śabdaḥ | atra śaktipadārthasamarthanaṃ granthāntarā-
davaseyam || ato'nyathetyādi uttarārddhaṃ pūrvavat | pratibhāpramādastu teṣāṃ
sadasadekānte vācyasya pratiniyatārthaviṣayatve ca vācakasyokta-
yuktyā doṣasadbhāvād vyavahārānupapatteḥ || tadayaṃ samudāyārthaḥ |
sāmānyaviśeṣātmakasya bhāvābhāvātmakasya ca vastunaḥ sāmānyaviśe-
ṣātmako bhāvābhāvātmakaśca dhvanirvācaka iti | anyathā prakārāntaraiḥ
punarvācyavācakabhāvavyavasthāmātiṣṭhamānānāṃ pratibhaiva pramādyati na
tu tadbhaṇitayo yuktisparśamātramapi sahante | kāni tāni vācya-
vācakabhāvaprakārāntarāṇi paravādināmiti cedete brūmaḥ | apoha
eva śabdārtha ityeke |
apohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ na vastuvidhinocyate ||
iti vacanāt | apare ca sāmānyamātrameva śabdānāṃ gocaraḥ |
tasya kvacitpratipannasyaikarūpatayā sarvatra saṃketaviṣayatopapatteḥ |
na punarviśeṣāḥ | teṣāmānantyataḥ kārtsnyenopalabdhumaśakyatayā tadvi-
ṣayatānupapatteḥ | vidhivādinastu vidhireva vākyārtho'pravṛttapravartana-
svabhāvatvāttasyetyācakṣate | vidhirapi tattadvādivipratipattyā'ne-
kaprakāraḥ | tathāhi vākyarūpaḥ śabda eva pravartakatvādvidhirityeke |
tadvyāpāro bhāvanāparaparyāyo vidhirityanye | niyoga ityapare |
praiṣādaya ityeke | tiraskṛtatadupādhipravartanāmātramityanye | evaṃ phala-
tadabhilāṣakarmādayopi vācyāḥ | eteṣāṃ nirākaraṇaṃ sapūrvottarapakṣaṃ
nyāyakumudacandrādavaseyamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 14 ||

idānīṃ sāṃkhyābhimataprakṛtipuruṣāditattvānāṃ virodhāvaruddhatvaṃ
khyāpayan tadbāliśatāvilasitānāmaparimitatvaṃ darśayati |
cidarthaśūnyā ca jaḍā ca buddhiḥ
śabdāditanmātrajamambarādi |
na bandhamokṣau puruṣasya ceti
kiyajjaḍairna grathitaṃ virodhi || 15 ||

cit caitanyaśaktirātmasvarūpabhūtā arthaśūnyā viṣayapariccheda-
virahitā arthādhyavasāyasya buddhivyāpāratvādityekā kalpanā |
buddhiśca mahattatvākhyā jaḍānavabodharūpā iti dvitīyā | ambarādi
vyomaprabhṛti bhūtapañcakaṃ śabdāditanmātrajam śabdādīni pañcatanmā-
trāṇi sūkṣmasaṃjñāni tebhyo jātamutpannaṃ śabdāditanmātrajam iti
tṛtīyā | atra caśabdo gamyaḥ | puruṣasya ca prakṛtivikṛtyanātmaka-
syātmano na bandhamokṣau kiṃ tu prakṛtereva | tathā ca kāpilāḥ |
tasmānna badhyate nāpi mucyate nāpi saṃsarati kaścit |
saṃsarati badhyate mucyate ca nānāśrayā prakṛtiḥ ||
tatra bandhaḥ prākṛtikādiḥ | mokṣaḥ pañcaviṃśatitattvajñānapūrvako'pavarga
iti caturthī | itiśabdasya prakārārthatvādevaṃprakāramanyadapi |
virodhīti viruddhaṃ pūrvāparavirodhādidoṣāghrātam | jaḍairmūrkhaistattvāva-
bodhavidhuradhībhiḥ kāpilaiḥ kiyanna grathitaṃ kiyanna svaśāstreṣūpani-
baddham | kiyadityasūyāgarbham | tatprarūpitaviruddhārthānāmānantyene-
yattā'navadhāraṇāt | iti saṃkṣepārthaḥ ||

vyāsārthastvayam | sāṃkhyamate kila duḥkhatrayābhihatasya puru-
ṣasya tadapaghātahetutattvajijñāsā utpadyate | ādhyātmikamā-
dhidaivikamādhibhautikaṃ ceti duḥkhatrayam | tatrādhyātmikaṃ dvividhaṃ
śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca | śārīraṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyanimittam |
mānasaṃ kāmakrodhalobhamoherṣyāviṣayādarśananibandhanam | sarvaṃ caita-
dāntaropāyasādhyatvādādhyātmikaṃ duḥkham | bāhyopāyasādhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ
dvedhā ādhibhautikamādhidaivikaṃceti | tatrādhibhautikaṃ mānuṣapaśupakṣi-
mṛgasarīsṛpasthāvaranimittam | ādhidaivikaṃ yakṣarākṣasagrahādyāveśahetu-
kam | anena duḥkhatrayeṇa rajaḥ pariṇāmabhedena buddhivartinā cetanāśakteḥ
pratikūlatayā'bhisaṃbandhaḥ abhighātaḥ | tattvāni ca pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
tadyathā avyaktamekaṃ mahadahaṃkārapañcatanmātraikādaśendriyapañcamahābhūta-
bhedāt trayoviṃśatividhaṃ vyaktaṃ puruṣaścidrūpa iti | tathā ceśvarakṛṣṇaḥ |
mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtirmahadādyāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayaḥ sapta |
ṣoḍaśakastu vikāro na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ ||

prītyaprītiviṣādātmakānāṃ lāghavopaṣṭambhagauravadharmāṇāṃ paraspa-
ropakāriṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ sattvarajastamasā sāmyāvasthā
prakṛtiḥ | pradhānamavyaktamityanarthāntaram | taccānādimadhyāntamanavayavaṃ
sādhāraṇamaśabdamasparśamarūpamarasamagandhamavyayam | pradhānādbuddhirmahadi-
tyaparaparyāyotpadyate | yo'yamadhyavasāyo gavādiṣu pratipattiḥ evametat
nānyathā gaurevāyaṃ nāśvaḥ sthāṇureṣa nāyaṃ puruṣa ityeṣā buddhiḥ | ta-
syāstvaṣṭau rūpāṇi dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryarūpāṇi catvāri sāttvikāni
adharmādīni tu tatpratipakṣabhūtāni catvāri tāmasāni | buddhera-
haṃkāraḥ | sa cābhimānātmakaḥ | ahaṃ śabde'haṃ sparśe'haṃ rūpe'haṃ gandhe'-
haṃ rase'haṃ svāmī ahamīśvaraḥ asau mayā hataḥ sasattvohamamuṃ hani-
ṣyāmi ityādipratyayarūpaḥ | tasmātpañcatanmātrāṇi śabdatanmātrādī-
nyaviśeṣarūpāṇi sūkṣmaparyāyavācyāni | śabdatanmātrāddhi śabda
evopalabhyate na punarudāttānudāttasvaritakampitaṣaḍjādibhedāḥ | ṣa-
ḍjādayaḥ śabdaviśeṣādupalabhyante | evaṃ sparśarūparasagandhatanmātre-
ṣvapi yojanīyamiti | tata eva cāhaṅkārādekādaśendriyāṇi ca | tatra
cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ tvagiti pañcabuddhīndriyāṇi vākpāṇipāda-
pāyūpasthāḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi ekādaśaṃ mana iti | pañcatanmātre-
bhyaśca pañcamahābhūtāni utpadyante | tadyathā śabdatanmātrādākāśaṃ
śabdaguṇaṃ śabdatanmātrasahitātsparśatanmātrādvāyuḥ śabdasparśaguṇaḥ
śabdasparśatanmātrasahitādrūpatanmātrāttejaḥ śabdasparśarūpaguṇaṃ śabda-
sparśarūpatanmātrasahitādrasatanmātrādāpaḥ śabdasparśarūparasaguṇāḥ śabda-
sparśarūparasatanmātrasahitādgandhatanmātrāt śabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇā
pṛthvī jāyata iti | puruṣastu--
amūrtaścetano bhogī nityaḥ sarvagato'kriyaḥ |
akartā nirguṇaḥ sūkṣma ātmā kāpiladarśane ||
iti | andhapaṅguvat prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ saṃyogaḥ | cicchaktiśca
viṣayaparicchedaśūnyā | yata indriyadvāreṇa sukhaduḥkhādayo viṣayā
buddhau pratisaṃkrāmanti buddhiścobhayamukhadarpaṇākārā tatastasyāṃ caita-
nyaśaktiḥ pratibimbate | tataḥ sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyaham ityupacāraḥ | ātmā
hi svaṃ buddheravyatiriktamabhimanyate | āha ca patañjaliḥ | śuddhopi
puruṣaḥ pratyayaṃ bauddhamanupaśyati tamanupaśyannatadātmāpi tadātmaka
iva pratibhāsate iti | mukhyatastu buddhereva viṣayaparicchedaḥ | tathā
ca vācaspatiḥ | sarvo vyavahartā ālocya nanvahamatrādhikṛta itya-
bhimatya krartavyametanmayeti adhyavasyati tataśca pravarttata iti lokataḥ
siddham | tatra kartavyamiti yoyaṃ niścayaścitisannidhānāpanna-
caitanyāyā buddheḥ sodhyavasāyo buddherasādhāraṇo vyāpāra iti |
cicchaktisannidhānāccācetanāpi buddhiścetanāvatīvābhāsate | vāda-
mahārṇavopyāha | buddhidarpaṇasaṃkrāntamarthapratibimbakaṃ dvitīyadarpaṇakalpe
puṃsyadhyārohati tadeva bhoktṛtvamasya natvātmano vikārāpattiḥ
iti | tathā cāsuriḥ |
vivikte dṛkpariṇatau buddhau bhogosya kathyate |
pratibimbodayaḥ svacche yathā candramasombhasi ||
vindhyavāsī tvevaṃ bhogamācaṣṭe |
puruṣo'vikṛtātmaiva svanirbhāsamacetanam |
manaḥ karoti sāṃnidhyādupādhiḥ sphaṭikaṃ yathā ||

na ca vaktavyaṃ puruṣaścedaguṇo'pariṇāmī kathamasya mokṣaḥ | muce-
rbandhanaviśleṣārthatvātsavāsanakleśakarmāśayānāṃ ca bandhanasamāmnā-
tānāṃ puruṣe'pariṇāminyasaṃbhavāt | ata eva nāsya pretyabhāvā-
paranāmā saṃsārosti niṣkriyatvāditi | yataḥ prakṛtireva nānā-
puruṣāśrayā satī badhyate saṃsarati mucyate ca na puruṣa iti bandha-
mokṣasaṃsārāḥ puruṣe upacaryante | yathā jayaparājayau bhṛtyagatāvapi
svāminyupacaryete tatphalasya kośalābhādeḥ svāmini saṃbandhāt
tathā bhogāpavargayoḥ prakṛtigatayorapi vivekāgrahātpuruṣe saṃbandha
iti ||

tadetadakhilamālajālam | cicchaktiśca viṣayaparicchedaśūnyā
ceti parasparaviruddhaṃ vacaḥ | citī saṃjñāne | cetanaṃ cityate vā-
nayeti cit | sā cetsvaparaparicchedātmikā neṣyate tadā ciccha-
ktireva sā na syād | ghaṭavat | na cāmūrtāyāścicchakterbuddhau pratibi-
mbodayo yuktaḥ | tasya mūrtadharmatvāt | na ca tathā pariṇāmamantareṇa
pratisaṃkramopi yuktaḥ | kathaṃcitsakriyākatāvyatirekeṇa prakṛtyu-
padhānepyanyathātvānupapatteḥ | apracyutaprācīnarūpasya ca sukhaduḥkhā-
dibhogavyapadeśānarhatvāt | tatpracyave ca prāktanarūpatyāgenottararūpā-
dhyāsitatayā sakriyatvāpattiḥ | sphaṭikādāvapi tathā pariṇāmenaiva
pratibimbodayasamarthanāt | anyathā kathamandhopalādau na pratibimbaḥ |
tathā pariṇāmābhyupagame ca balādāyātaṃ cicchakteḥ kartṛtvaṃ
sākṣādbhoktṛtvaṃ ca | atha apariṇāminī bhoktṛśaktirapratisaṃkramā ca
pariṇāminyarthe pratisaṃkrāteva tadvṛttimanubhavatīti patañjalivacanā-
daupacārika evāyaṃ pratisaṃkrama iti cet tarhi upacārastattvacintā-
yāmanupayogīti prekṣāvatāmanupādeya evāyam | tathā ca pratiprāṇipra-
tītaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvedanaṃ nirāśrayameva syāt | na cedaṃ buddherupapannam |
tasyā jaḍatvenābhyupagamāt | ata eva jaḍā ca buddhirityapi viruddham |
na hi jaḍasvarūpāyāṃ buddhau viṣayādhyavasāyaḥ sādhyamānaḥ sādhīya-
stāṃ dadhāti | nanūktamacetanāpi buddhiścicchaktisāṃnidhyāccetanāvatī-
vāvabhāsata iti | satyamuktamayuktaṃ tūktam | na hi caitanyavati puruṣādau
pratisaṃkrānte darpaṇasya caitanyāpattiścaitanyācaitanyayoraparāvartisvabhāva-
tvena śakreṇāpyanyathākartumaśakyatvāt | kiṃ cācetanāpi cetanāva-
tīva pratibhāsata iti ivaśabdenāropo dhvanyate | na cāroportha-
kriyāsamarthaḥ | na khalvatikopanatvādinā samāropitāgnitvo māṇa-
vakaḥ kadācidapi mukhyāgnisādhyāṃ dāhapākādyarthakriyāṃ kartumīśvaraḥ |
iti cicchaktereva viṣayādhyavasāyo ghaṭate na jaḍarūpāyā buddheriti ||
ata eva dharmādyaṣṭarūpatādyapi tasyā vāṅmātrameva | dharmādīnāmātmadha-
rmatvāt | ata eva cāhaṃkāropi na buddhijanyo yujyate | tasyābhi-
mānātmakatvenātmadharmasyācetanādutpādāyogāt || ambarādīnāṃ ca
śabdāditanmātrajatvaṃ pratītiparāhatatvenaiva vihitottaram | api ca
sarvavādibhistāvadavigānena gaganasya nityatvamaṅgīkriyate | ayaṃ ca
śabdatanmātrāttasyāvirbhāvamudbhāvayannityaikāntavādināṃ ca dhuri ā-
sanaṃ nyāsayannasaṃgatapralāpīva pratibhāti | na ca pariṇāmikāraṇaṃ sva-
kāryasya guṇo bhavitumarhatīti śabdaguṇamākāśamityādi vāṅmātram ||
vāgādīnāṃ cendriyatvameva na yujyate | itarāsādhyakāryakāritvābhāvā-
t | parapratipādanagrahaṇaviharaṇamalotsargādikāryāṇāmitarāvayavairapi
sādhyatvopalabdheḥ | tathāpi tattvakalpana indriyasaṃkhyā na vyavatiṣṭhate |
anyāṅgopāṅgādīnāmapīndriyatvaprasaṅgāt || yaccoktaṃ nānāśrayāyāḥ
prakṛtereva bandhamokṣau saṃsāraśca na puruṣasyeti tadapyasāram | anā-
dibhavaparaṃparānubaddhayā prakṛtyā saha yaḥ puruṣasya vivekāgrahaṇalakṣa-
ṇo'viṣvagbhāvaḥ sa eva cenna bandhastadā ko nāmānyo bandhaḥ syāt |
prakṛtiḥ sarvotpattimatāṃ nimittamiti ca pratipadyamānenāyuṣmatā
saṃjñāntareṇa karmaiva pratipannam | tasyaivaivaṃsvarūpatvāt acetanatvācca ||
yastu prākṛtikavaikārikadākṣiṇabhedāttrividho bandhaḥ | tadyathā prakṛ-
tāvātmajñānādye prakṛtimupāsate teṣāṃ prākṛtiko bandhaḥ | ye vikārā-
neva bhūtendriyāhaṃkārabuddhīḥ puruṣabuddhyopāsate teṣāṃ vaikārikaḥ | iṣṭā-
pūrtterdākṣiṇaḥ | puruṣatattvānabhijño hīṣṭāpūrtikārī kāmopahatamanā
badhyata iti |
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ manyamānā variṣṭhaṃ nānyacchreyo yebhinandanti mūḍhāḥ |

nākasya pṛṣṭhe te sukṛtena bhūtvā imaṃ lokaṃ hīnataraṃ vā viśanti ||
iti vacanāt | sa trividhopi kalpanāmātram | kathaṃcinmithyādarśa-
nāviratipramādakaṣāyayogebhyo'bhinnasvarūpatvena karmabandhahetuṣvevā-
ntarbhāvāt | bandhasiddhau ca siddhastasyaiva nirbādhaḥ saṃsāraḥ | bandhamo-
kṣayoścaikādhikaraṇatvādya eva baddhaḥ sa eva mucyata iti puruṣa-
syaiva mokṣaḥ | ābālagopālaṃ tathāpratīteḥ | prakṛtipuruṣavivekadarśanā-
tpravṛtteruparatāyāṃ prakṛtau puruṣasya svarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ mokṣa iti cet na |
pravṛttisvabhāvāyāḥ prakṛteraudāsīnyāyogāt | atha puruṣārthanibandhanā
tasyāḥ pravṛttiḥ | vivekakhyātiśca puruṣārthaḥ | tasyāṃ jātāyāṃ niva-
rtate | kṛtakāryatvāt |
raṅgasya darśayitvā nivartate nartakī yathā nṛtyāt |
puruṣasya tathātmānaṃ prakāśya vinivartate prakṛtiḥ ||
iti vacanā | iti cet naivam | tasyā acetanāyā vimṛśyakāri-
tvābhāvāt | yatheyaṃ kṛtepi śabdādyupalambhe punastadarthaṃ pravarttate
tathā vivekakhyātau kṛtāyāmapi punastadarthaṃ pravartiṣyate | pravṛtti-
lakṣaṇasya svabhāvasyānapetatvāt | nartakīdṛṣṭāntastu sveṣṭavighātakārī |
yathā hi nartakī nṛtyaṃ pāriṣadebhyo darśayitvā nivṛttāpi puna-
statkutūhalātpravartate tathā prakṛtirapi puruṣāyātmānaṃ darśayitvā
nivṛttāpi punaḥ kathaṃ na pravartatāmiti | tasmātkṛtsnakarmakṣaye puruṣa-
syaiva mokṣa iti pratipattavyam || evamanyāsāmapi tatkalpanānāṃ
tamomohamahāmohatāmisrāndhatāmisrabhedātpañcadhāvidyāsmitārāgadveṣā-
bhiniveśarūpo viparyayaḥ | brāhmaprājāpatyasaumyaindragāndharvayakṣarākṣa-
sapaiśācabhedādaṣṭavidho daivaḥ sargaḥ | paśumṛgapakṣisarīsṛpasthāvarabhe-
dātpañcavidhastairyagyonaḥ | brāhmaṇatvādyavāntarabhedāvivakṣayā caika-
vidho mānuṣa iti caturdaśadhā bhūtasargaḥ | bādhiryakuṣṭhitāndhatvajaḍa-
tā'jighratāmūkatākauṇyapaṅgutvaklaibyodāvartamattatārūpaikādaśendriyava-
dhatuṣṭinavakaviparyayasiddhyaṣṭakaviparyayalakṣaṇasaptadaśabuddhivadhabhedāda-
ṣṭāviṃśatidhā śaktiḥ | prakṛtyupādānakālabhogākhyāḥ ambhaḥsalilau-
ghavṛṣṭyaparaparyāyavācyāścatasra ādhyātmikyaḥ | śabdādiviṣayopara-
tayaścārjanarakṣaṇakṣayabhogahiṃsādoṣadarśanahetujanmānaḥ pañca bāhyāstu-
ṣṭayaḥ | tāśca pārasupārapārāpārānuttamāmbhauttamāmbhaḥśabdavyapadeśyāḥ |
iti navadhā tuṣṭiḥ | trayo duḥkhavighātā iti mukhyāstisraḥ siddhayaḥ
pramodamuditamodamānākhyāḥ | tathādhyayanaṃ śabda ūhaḥ suhṛtprāpti-
rdānamiti duḥkhavighātopāyatayā gauṇyaḥ pañca tārasutāratāra-
tāraramyakasadāmuditākhyāḥ | ityevamaṣṭadhā siddhiḥ | dhṛtiśraddhāsukha-
vividiṣāvijñaptibhedātpañca karmayonayaḥ | ityādīnāṃ saṃvaraprati-
saṃvarādīnāṃ ca tattvakaumudīgauḍapādabhāṣyādiprasiddhānāṃ viruddhatvamu-
dbhāvanīyamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 15 ||

idānīṃ ye pramāṇādekāntenābhinnaṃ pramāṇaphalamāhuḥ ye ca bāhyārtha-
pratikṣepeṇa jñānādvaitamevāstīti bruvate tanmatasya vicāryamāṇatve
viśarārutāmāha |
na tulyakālaḥ phalahetubhāvo
hetau vilīne na phalasya bhāvaḥ |
na saṃvidadvaitapathe'rthasaṃvi-
dvilūnaśīrṇaṃ sugatendrajālam || 16 ||

bauddhāḥ kila pramāṇāttatphalamekāntenābhinnaṃ manyante | tathā ca
tatsiddhāntaḥ | ubhayatra tadeva jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ phalam | adhigamarūpatvāt |
ubhayatreti pratyakṣe'numāne ca tadeva jñānaṃ pratyakṣānumānalakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ
kāryam | kutaḥ | adhigamarūpatvāt iti paricchedarūpatvāt | tathā
hi paricchedarūpameva jñānamutpadyate | na ca paricchedādṛte'nyajjñānapha-
lam | abhinnādhikaraṇatvāt | iti sarvathā na pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ
bhinnaṃ phalamastīti || etacca na samīcīnaṃ yato yadyasmādekāntenābhinnaṃ
tattena sahaivotpadyate yathā ghaṭena ghaṭatvam | taiśca pramāṇaphalayoḥ kārya-
kāraṇabhāvobhyupagamyate | pramāṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ phalaṃ kāryamiti | sa
caikāntābhede na ghaṭate | na hi yugapadutpadyamānayostayoḥ savyetara-
goviṣāṇayoriva kāryakāraṇabhāvo yuktaḥ | niyataprākkālabhāvitvā-
tkāraṇasya | niyatottarakālabhāvitvātkāryasya | etadevāha na
tulyakālaḥ phalahetubhāva iti | phalaṃ kāryaṃ hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ tayorbhāvaḥ
svarūpaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | sa tulyakālaḥ samānakālo na yujyata
ityarthaḥ | atha kṣaṇāntaritatvāttayoḥ kramabhāvitvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyā-
śaṅkyāha | hetau vilīne na phalasya bhāva iti | hetau kāraṇe
pramāṇalakṣaṇe vilīne kṣaṇikatvādutpattyanantarameva niranvayaṃ vinaṣṭe
phalasya pramāṇakāryasya na bhāvaḥ sattā | nirmūlatvāt | vidyamāne
hi phalahetāvasyedaṃ phalamiti pratīyate nānyathā | atiprasaṅgāt | kiṃ
ca hetuphalabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa ca dviṣṭha eva syāt | na cānayoḥ kṣaṇa-
kṣayaikadīkṣito bhavānsaṃbandhaṃ kṣamate | tataḥ kathamayaṃ hetuḥ idaṃ phalamiti
pratiniyatā pratītiḥ | ekasya grahaṇepyanyasyāgrahaṇe tadasaṃbhavāt |
dviṣṭhasaṃbandhasaṃvittirnaikarūpapravedanāt |
dvayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe sati saṃbandhavedanam ||
iti vacanāt | yadapi dharmottareṇā'rthasārūpyamasya pramāṇaṃ tadvaśā-
darthapratītisiddheriti nyāyabindusūtraṃ vivṛṇvatā bhaṇitaṃ nīla-
nirbhāsaṃ hi vijñānaṃ yatastasmānnīlasya pratītiravasīyate yebhyo
hi cakṣurādibhyo jñānamutpadyate na tadvaśāttajjñānaṃ nīlasya saṃve-
danaṃ śakyate'vasthāpayitum nīlasadṛśaṃ tvanubhūyamānaṃ nīlasya saṃve-
danamavasthāpyate na cātrajanyajanakabhāvanibandhanaḥ sādhyasādhana-
bhāvo yenaikasminvastuni virodhaḥ syāt api tu vyavasthāpya-
vyavasthāpakabhāvena tata ekasya vastunaḥ kiṃcidrūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ kiṃci-
tpramāṇaphalaṃ na virudhyate vyavasthāpanaheturhi sārūpyaṃ tasya jñāna-
sya vyavasthāpyaṃ ca nīlasaṃvedanarūpamityādi tadapyasāram | ekasya
niraṃśasya jñānalakṣaṇasya vyavasthāpyavyavasthāpakatvalakṣaṇasvabhāva-
dvayāyogāt | vyavasthāpyavyavasthāpakabhāvasyāpi ca saṃbandhatvena
dvivṛttittvāt ekasminnasaṃbhavāt | kiṃ cārthasārūpyamarthākāratā tacca
niścayarūpamaniścayarūpaṃ vā | niścayarūpaṃ cettadeva vyavasthāpakamastu |
kimubhayakalpanayā | aniścitaṃ cet svayamavyavasthitaṃ kathaṃ nīlā-
disaṃvedanavyavasthāpane samartham | api ca keyamarthākāratā | kimartha-
grahaṇapariṇāmaḥ āhosvidarthākāradhāritvam | nādyaḥ | siddhasā-
dhanāt | dvitīyastu jñānasya prameyākārānukaraṇājjaḍatvāpattyādi-
doṣāghrātaḥ | tanna pramāṇādekāntena phalasyābhedaḥ sādhīyān |
sarvathātādātmye hi pramāṇaphalayorna vyavasthā | tadbhāvavirodhāt |
na hi sārūpyamasya pramāṇamadhigatiḥ phalamiti sarvathātādātmye
siddhyati | atiprasaṅgāt | nanu pramāṇasyāsārūpyavyāvṛttiḥ
sārūpyam anadhigativyāvṛttiradhigatiriti vyāvṛttibhedādekasyā-
pi pramāṇaphalavyavastheti cet naivam | svabhāvabhedamantareṇānya-
vyāvṛttibhedasyāpyanupapatteḥ | kathaṃ ca pramāṇasya phalasya cāpramā-
ṇāphalavyāvṛttyā pramāṇaphalavyavasthāvatpramāṇāntaraphalāntaravyā-
vṛttyāpyapramāṇatvasyāphalatvasya ca vyavasthā na syāt | vijātī-
