yādiva sajātīyādapi vyāvṛttatvādvastunaḥ | tasmātpramāṇātphalaṃ
kathaṃcidbhinnamevaiṣṭavyam | sādhyasādhanabhāvena pratīyamānatvāt | ye hi
sādhyasādhanabhāvena pratīyete te parasparaṃ bhidyete | yathā kuṭhāracchidi-
kriye iti || evaṃ yaugābhipretaḥ pramāṇātphalasyaikāntabhedopi nirā-
kartavyaḥ | tasyaikapramātṛtādātmyena pramāṇātkathaṃcidabhedavyavasthiteḥ |
pramāṇatayā pariṇatasyaivātmanaḥ phalatayā pariṇatipratīteḥ | yaḥ prami-
mīte sa evopādatte parityajatyupekṣate ceti sarvavyavahāribhiraskha-
litamanubhavāt | itarathā svaparayoḥ pramāṇaphalavyavasthāviplavaḥ prasa-
jyata ityalam ||

athavā pūrvārddhamidamanyathā vyākhyeyam | saugatāḥ kiletthaṃ
pramāṇayanti | sarvaṃ sat kṣaṇikam | yataḥ sarvaṃ tāvat ghaṭādikaṃ vastu
mudgarādisaṃnidhau nāśaṃ gacchaddṛśyate tatra yena svarūpeṇāntyāva-
sthāyāṃ ghaṭādikaṃ vinaśyati taccaitatsvarūpamutpannamātrasya vidyate
tadānīmutpādānantarameva tena naṣṭavyamiti vyaktamasya kṣaṇikatvam |
athedṛśa eva svabhāvastasya hetuto jāto yatkiyantamapi kālaṃ
sthitvā vinaśyati | evaṃ tarhi mudgarādisaṃnidhānepi eṣa eva
tasya svabhāva iti punarapyanena tāvantameva kālaṃ sthātavyam iti
naivaṃ vinaśyediti | soyamaditsorvaṇijaḥ pratidinaṃ patralikhitaśva
stanadinabhaṇananyāyaḥ | tasmātkṣaṇadvayasthāyitvenāpyutpattau prathama-
kṣaṇavat dvitīyepi kṣaṇe kṣaṇadvayasthāyitvātpunaraparakṣaṇadvayamavatiṣṭhe-
ta | evaṃ tṛtīyepi kṣaṇe tatsvabhāvatvānnaiva vinaśyediti | syādetat |
sthāvarameva tatsvahetorjātaṃ paraṃ balena virodhakena mudgarādinā
vināśyata iti | tadasat | kathaṃ punaretaddhaṭiṣyate | na ca tadvinaśya-
ti sthāvaratvāt vināśaśca tasya virodhinā balena kriyata iti |
na hyetatsaṃbhavati | jīvati ca devadatto maraṇaṃ cāsya bhava-
tīti | atha vinaśyati tarhi kathamavinaśvaraṃ tadvastu
svahetorjātamiti | na hi mriyate cāmaraṇadharmā ceti yujyate vaktum |
tasmādavinaśvaratve kadācidapi nāśāyogāt dṛṣṭatvācca nāśasya
naśvarameva tadvastu svahetorupajātamevāṅgīkartavyam | tasmādutpannamātra-
meva vinaśyati | tathā ca kṣaṇakṣayitvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | prayogastvevam |
yadvinaśvararūpaṃ tadutpatteranantarānavasthāyi yathāntyakṣaṇavartighaṭasya
svarūpam vinaśvarasvarūpaṃ ca rūpādikamudayakāle iti svabhāvahetuḥ |
yadi kṣaṇakṣayiṇo bhāvāḥ kathaṃ tarhi sa evāyamiti pratyabhijñā syāt |
ucyate | nirantarasadṛśāparāparotpādādavidyānubandhācca pūrvakṣaṇa-
vināśakāla eva tatsadṛśaṃ kṣaṇāntaramudayate tenākāravilakṣaṇatvā-
bhāvādavyavadhānāccātyantocchedepi sa evāyamityabhedādhyavasāyī
pratyayaḥ prasūyate | atyantabhinneṣvapi lūnapunarutpannakuśakāśakeśādiṣu
dṛṣṭa evārya sa evāyamiti pratyayastathehāpi kiṃ na saṃbhāvyate |
tasmātsarvaṃ sat kṣaṇikamiti siddham || atra ca pūrvakṣaṇaupādānakāraṇaṃ
uttarakṣaṇa upādeyamiti parābhiprāyamaṅgīkṛtyāha na tulyakāla
ityādi | te viśakalitamuktāvalīkalpā niranvayavināśinaḥ pūrva-
kṣaṇā uttarakṣaṇān janayantaḥ kiṃ svotpattikāla eva janayanti
uta kṣaṇāntare | na tāvadādyaḥ | samakālabhāvinoryuvatikucayorivo-
pādānopādeyabhāvābhāvāt | ataḥ sādhūktam na tulyakālaḥ phala-
hetubhāva iti | na ca dvitīyaḥ | tadānīṃ niranvayavināśena pūrvakṣaṇasya na-
ṣṭatvāduttarakṣaṇajanane kutaḥ saṃbhāvanāpi | na cānupādānasyotpattirdṛṣṭā |
atiprasaṅgāt | iti suṣṭhu vyāhṛtaṃ hetau vilīne na phalasya bhāva iti ||
padārthastvanayoḥ pādayoḥ prāgevoktaḥ | kevalamatra phalamupādeyaṃ hetu-
rupādānaṃ tadbhāva upādānopādeyabhāva ityarthaḥ || yacca kṣaṇikatvasthā-
panāya mokṣākaraguptenānantarameva pralapitaṃ tat syādvādavāde nirava-
kāśameva | niranvayanāśavarjaṃ kathaṃcitsiddhasādhanāt | pratikṣaṇaṃ paryāya-
nāśasyānekāntavādibhirabhyupagamāt | yadapyabhihitaṃ na hyetatsaṃ-
bhavati jīvati ca devadatto maraṇaṃ cāsya bhavatīti tadapi saṃbhavādeva na
syādvādavādināṃ kṣatimāvahati | yato jīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇaṃ maraṇaṃ cā-
yurdalikakṣayastato jīvatopi devadattasya pratisamayamāyurdalikānāmu-
dīrṇānāṃ kṣayādupapannameva maraṇam | na ca vācyamantyāvasthāyāmeva kṛ-
tsnāyurdalikakṣayāt tatraiva maraṇavyapadeśo yukta iti | tasyāmapyava-
sthāyāṃ nyakṣeṇa tatkṣayābhāvāt | tatrāpi hyavaśiṣṭānāmeva teṣāṃ kṣayo
na punastatkṣaṇa eva yugapatsarveṣām | iti siddhaṃ garbhādārabhya pratikṣaṇaṃ
maraṇam | ityalaṃ prasaṅgena ||

athavā'parathā vyākhyā | saugatānāṃ kilārthena jñānaṃ janyate
tacca jñānaṃ tameva svotpādakamarthaṃ gṛhṇātīti | nākāraṇaṃ viṣaya iti
vacanāt | tataścārthaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñānaṃ ca kāryamiti | etacca na cāru |
yato yasmin kṣaṇe'rthasya svarūpasattā tasminnadyāpi jñānaṃ notpadyate |
tasya tadā svotpattimātravyagratvāt | yatra ca kṣaṇe jñānaṃ samutpannaṃ
tatrārtho'tītaḥ | pūrvāparakālabhāvaniyataśca kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | kṣaṇā-
tiriktaṃ cāvasthānaṃ nāsti | tataḥ kathaṃ jñānasyotpattiḥ | kāraṇasya
vilīnatvāt | tadvilaye ca jñānasya nirviṣayatānuṣajyate | kāraṇa-
syaiva yuṣmanmate tadviṣayatvāt | nirviṣayaṃ ca jñānamapramāṇamevā-
kāśakeśajñānavat | jñānasahabhāvinaścārthakṣaṇasya na grāhyatvam |
tasyākāraṇatvāt | ata āha na tulyakāla ityādi | jñānārthayoḥ
phalahetubhāvaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ tulyakālo na ghaṭate | jñānasahabhāvi-
no'rthakṣaṇasya jñānānutpādakatvāt | yugapadbhāvinoḥ kāryakāraṇa-
bhāvāyogāt | atha prāco'rthakṣaṇasya jñānotpādakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | tanna |
yata āha hetau ityādi | hetau artharūpe jñānakāraṇe vilīne kṣaṇika-
tvānniranvayaṃ vinaṣṭe na phalasya jñānalakṣaṇakāryasya bhāva ātma-
lābhaḥ syāt | janakasyārthakṣaṇasyātītatvānnirmūlameba jñānotthānaṃ
syāt | janakasyaiva ca grāhyatve indriyāṇāmapi grāhyatvāpattiḥ | teṣāma-
pi jñānajanakatvāt | na cānvayavyatirekābhyāmarthasya jñānahetutvaṃ
dṛṣṭam | mṛgatṛṣṇādau jalābhāvepi jalajñānotpādāt | anyathā tatpravṛ-
tterasaṃbhavāt | bhrāntaṃ tajjñānamiti cet nanu bhrāntābhrāntavicāraḥ
sthirībhūya kriyatāṃ tvayā | sāṃprataṃ pratipadyasva tāvadanarthajamapi
jñānam | anvayenārthasya jñānahetutvaṃ dṛṣṭameveti cet na | na hi tadbhāve
bhāvalakṣaṇo'nvaya eva hetuphalabhāvaniścayanimittam | api tu tadabhā-
ṣe'bhāvalakṣaṇo vyatirekopi | sa coktayuktyā nāstyeva | yogināṃ
cātītānāgatārthagrahaṇe kimarthasya nimittatvam | tayorasattvāt |
ṇa ṇihāṇagayā bhaggā puṃjo ṇatthi aṇāgae |
ṇivvuyā ṇeva ciṭhṭhanti āragge sarisovamā ||
iti vacanāt | nimittatve cārthakriyākāritvena sattvādatītā-
nāgatatvakṣatiḥ | na ca prakāśyādātmalābha eva prakāśakasya prakāśa-
katvam | pradīpāderghaṭādibhyo'nutpannasyāpi tatprakāśakatvāt | janaka-
syaiva ca grāhyatvābhyupagame smṛtyādeḥ pramāṇasyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ | ta-
syārthājanyatvāt | na ca smṛtirna pramāṇam | anumānaprāṇabhūtatvāt
sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhasmaraṇapūrvakatvāttasya | janakameva cedgrāhyaṃ tadā
svasaṃvedanasya kathaṃ grāhakatvam | tasya hi grāhyaṃ svarūpameva | na ca tena
tajjanyate | svātmani kriyāvirodhāt | tasmātsvasāmagrīprabhavayorghaṭapra-
dīpayorivārthajñānayoḥ prakāśyaprakāśakabhāvasaṃbhavānna jñānanimitta-
tvamarthasya | nanvarthājanyatve jñānasya kathaṃ pratiniyatakarmavyavasthā |
tadutpattitadākāratābhyāṃ hi sopapadyate | tasmādanutpannasyātadākā-
rasya ca jñānasya sarvārthānpratyaviśeṣātsarvagrahaṇaṃ prasajyeta | naivam |
tadutpattimantareṇāpyāvaraṇakṣayopaśamalakṣaṇayā yogyatayaiva pratiniya-
tārthaprakāśakatvopapatteḥ | tadutpattāvapi ca yogyatāvaśyameṣṭavyā |
anyathā'śeṣārthasānidhye tattadarthāsāṃnidhyepi kutaścidevārthāt kasya-
cideva jñānasya janmeti kautaskuto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ | tadākāratā
tvarthakārasaṃkrāntyā tāvadanupapannā | arthasya nirākāratvaprasaṅgāt |
jñānasya sākāratvaprasaṅgācca | arthena ca mūrtenāmūrtasya jñānasya
kīdṛśaṃ sādṛśyamityarthaviśeṣagrahaṇapariṇāma eva sābhyupeyā | tataḥ
arthena ghaṭayatyenāṃ na hi muttkārtharūpatām |
tasmātprameyādhigateḥ pramāṇaṃ meyarūpatā ||
iti yatkiñcidetat | api ca vyaste samaste vaite grahaṇakāraṇaṃ
syātām | yadi vyaste tadā kapālādyakṣaṇo ghaṭāntyakṣaṇasya jala-
candro vā nabhaścandrasya grāhakaḥ prāpnoti | yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tadutpatte-
stadākāratvācca | atha samaste tarhi ghaṭottarakṣaṇaḥ pūrvaghaṭakṣaṇasya
grāhakaḥ prasajati | tayorubhayorapi sadbhāvāt | jñānarūpatve satyete
grahaṇakāraṇamiti cet tarhi samānajātīyajñānasya samanantarajñāna-
grāhakatvaṃ prasajyeta | tayorjanyajanakabhāvasadbhāvāt | tannayogyatā-
mantareṇānyadgrahaṇakāraṇaṃ paśyāma iti ||

athottarārddhaṃ vyākhyātumupakramyate | tatra ca bāhyārthanirapekṣaṃ
jñānādvaitameva ye bauddhaviśeṣā manvate teṣāṃ pratikṣepaḥ | tanmataṃ cedam |
grāhyagrāhakādikalaṅkānaṅkitaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ jñānamātraṃ paramārthasat |
bāhyārthastu vicārameva na kṣamate | tathāhi | ko'yaṃ bāhyārthaḥ |
kiṃ paramāṇurūpaḥ sthūlāvayavirūpo vā | na tāvatparamāṇurūpaḥ |
pramāṇābhāvāt | pramāṇaṃ hi pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vā | na tāvatpratyakṣaṃ
tatsādhanabaddhakakṣam | taddhi yogināṃ syāt asmadādīnāṃ vā |
nādyam | atyantaviprakṛṣṭatayā śraddhāmātragamyatvāt | na dvitīyam |
anubhavabādhitatvāt | na hi vayamayaṃ paramāṇurayaṃ paramāṇuriti
svapnepi pratīmaḥ | stambho'yaṃ kumbho'yamityevameva naḥ sadaiva saṃvedano-
dayāt | nāpyanumānena tatsiddhiḥ | aṇūnāmatīndriyatvena taiḥ
saha avinābhāvasya kvāpi liṅge grahītumaśakyatvāt | kiṃ cāmī
nityā anityā vāsyuḥ | nityāścet krameṇārthakriyākāriṇo yuga-
padvā | nakrameṇa | svabhāvabhedenānityatvāpatteḥ | na yugapad | ekakṣaṇa eva
kṛtsnārthakriyākaraṇāt kṣaṇāntare tadabhāvādasattvāpattiḥ | anityā-
ścet kṣaṇikāḥ kālāntarasthāyino vā | kṣaṇikāścet sahetukā nirhe-
tukā vā | nirhetukāścet nityaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vā syāt | nirapekṣatvāt |
apekṣāto hi kādācitkatvam | sahetukāścet kiṃ teṣāṃ sthūlaṃ kiṃci-
tkāraṇaṃ paramāṇavo vā | na sthūlam | paramāṇurūpasyaiva bāhyārthasyā-
ṅgīkṛtatvāt | na ca paramāṇavaḥ | te hi santo'santaḥ sadasanto vā
svakāryāṇi kuryuḥ | santaścet kimutpattikṣaṇa eva kṣaṇāntare vā |
notpattikṣaṇe | tadānīmutpattimātravyagratvātteṣām | atha
bhūtiryeṣāṃ kriyā saiva kāraṇaṃ saiva cocyate |
iti vacanāt bhavanameva teṣāmaparotpattau kāraṇamiti cet evaṃ
tarhi rūpāṇavo rasāṇūnāṃ te ca teṣāmupādānaṃ syuḥ | ubhayatra bhavanā-
viśeṣāt | na ca kṣaṇāntare | naṣṭatvāt | athāsantaste tadutpādakāḥ |
tarhi ekaṃ svasattākṣaṇamapahāya sadā tadutpattiprasaṅgaḥ | tadasattvasya
sarvadā'viśeṣāt | sadasatpakṣastu
pratyekaṃ yo bhaveddoṣo dvayorbhāve kathaṃ na saḥ |
iti vacanādvirodhāghrāta eva | tannāṇavaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ | nāpi
kālāntarasthāyinaḥ | kṣaṇikapakṣasadṛkṣayogakṣematvāt | kiṃ cāmī
kiyatkālasthāyinopi kimarthakriyāparāṅmukhāstatkāriṇo vā |
ādye khapuṣpavadasattvāpattiḥ | udagvikalpe kimasadrūpaṃ sadrūpamubha-
yarūpaṃ vā te kāryaṃ kuryuḥ | asadrūpaṃ cecchaśaviṣāṇāderapi kiṃ na
karaṇam | sadrūpaṃ cet satopi karaṇe'navasthā | tṛtīyabhedastu prāgva-
dvirodhadurgandhaḥ | tannāṇurūpo'rthaḥ sarvathā ghaṭate ||

nāpi sthūlāvayavirūpaḥ | ekaparamāṇvasiddhau kathamanekatatsiddhiḥ |
tadabhāve ca tatpracayarūpaḥ sthūlāvayavī vāṅmātram | kiṃ cāyamanekā-
vayavādhāra iṣyate | te cāvayavā yadi virodhinaḥ tarhi naikaḥ
sthūlāvayavī | viruddhadharmādhyāsāt | avirodhinaścetpratītibādhaḥ |
ekasminneva sthūlāvayavini calācalaraktāraktāvṛtānāvṛtādiviruddhā-
vayavānāmupalabdheḥ | api cāsau teṣu vartamānaḥ kārtsnyenaikadeśena vā
vartate | kārtsnyena vṛttāvekasminnevāvayave parisamāptatvādanekāvayava-
vṛttitvaṃ na syāt | pratyavayavaṃ kārtsnyena vṛttau cāvayavibahutvāpatteḥ |
ekadeśena vṛttau ca tasya niraṃśatvābhyupagamabādhaḥ | sāṃśatve vā teṃ'śāstato
bhinnā abhinnā vā | bhinnatve punarapyanekāṃśavṛtterekasya kārtsnyaikade-
śavikalpānatikramādanavasthā | abhinnatve na kecidaṃśāḥ syuḥ |
iti nāsti bāhyo'rthaḥ kaścit | kintu jñānamevedaṃ sarvaṃ nīlādyākāreṇa
pratibhāti | bāhyārthasya jaḍatvena pratibhāsāyogāt | yathoktam |
svākārabuddhijanakā dṛśyā nendriyagocarāḥ |
alaṅkārakāreṇāpyuktam |
yadi saṃvedyate nīlaṃ kathaṃ bāhyaṃ taducyate |
na cetsaṃvedyate nīlaṃ kathaṃ bāhyaṃ taducyate ||
yadi bāhyo'rtho nāsti || kiṃviṣayastarhyayaṃ ghaṭapaṭādipratibhāsa iti
cet nanu nirālambana evāyamanādivitathavāsanāpravartitaḥ | ni-
rviṣayatvāt | ākāśakeśajñānavat svapnajñānavadveti | ata evoktam
nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti tasyā nānubhavo'paraḥ |
grāhyagrāhakavaidhuryātsvayaṃ saiva prakāśate ||
bāhyo na vidyate hyartho yathā bālairvikalpyate |
vāsanāluṭhitaṃ cittamarthābhāsaṃ pravartate ||
iti ||

tadetatsarvamavadyam | jñānamiti hi kriyāśabdaḥ | tato jñāyate'ne-
neti jñānaṃ jñaptirvā jñānamiti | asya ca karmaṇā bhāvyam | nirviṣa-
yāyā jñapteraghaṭanāt | na cākāśakeśādau nirviṣayamapi dṛṣṭaṃ jñāna-
miti vācyam | tasyāpyekāntena nirviṣayatvābhāvāt | na hi sarva-
thā'gṛhītasatyakeśajñānasya tatpratītiḥ | svapnajñānamapyanubhūtadṛṣṭā-
dyarthaviṣayatvānna nirālambanam | tathā ca mahābhāṣyakāraḥ |
aṇuhūyadiṭṭhaciṃtiya suyapayaiviyāradevayāṇūvā |
sumiṇassa nimittāiṃ puṇṇaṃ pāvaṃ ca ṇābhāvo ||
yaśca jñānaviṣayaḥ sa bāhyorthaḥ | bhrāntiriyamiti cet ciraṃ jīva |
bhrāntirhi mukhye'rthe kvaciddṛṣṭe sati karaṇāpāṭavādinā anyatra vipa-
ryastagrahaṇe prasiddhā | yathā śuktau rajatabhrāntiḥ | arthakriyāsamarthe-
'pi vastuni yadi bhrāntirucyate tarhi pralīnā bhrāntābhrāntavya-
vasthā | tathā ca satyametadvacaḥ |
āśāmodakatṛptā ye ye cāsvāditamodakāḥ |
rasavīryavipākādi tulyaṃ teṣāṃ prasajyate ||
na cāmūnyarthadūṣaṇāni syādvādināṃ bādhāṃ vidadhate | paramāṇurūpa-
sya sthūlāvayavirūpasya cārthasyāṅgīkṛtatvāt | yacca paramāṇupakṣa-
khaṇḍane'bhihitaṃ pramāṇābhāvāditi tadasat | tatkāryāṇāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ
pratyakṣatve teṣāmapi kathaṃcitpratyakṣatvaṃ yogipratyakṣeṇa ca sākṣātpra-
tyakṣatvamavaseyam | anupalabdhistu saukṣmyāt | anumānādapi tatsi-
ddhiḥ | yathā santi paramāṇavaḥ sthūlāvayaviniṣpattyanyathānupapatteri-
tyantarvyāptiḥ | na cāṇubhyaḥ sthūlotpāda ityekāntaḥ | sthūlādapi
sūtrapaṭalādeḥ sthūlasya paṭādeḥ prādurbhāvavibhāvanāt | ātmākāśā-
derapudgalatvakakṣīkārācca | yatra punaraṇubhyastadutpattistatra tattatkā-
lādisāmagrīsavyapekṣakriyāvaśātprādurbhūtaṃ saṃyogātiśayamapekṣyeyama-
vitathaiva | yadapi kiṃ cāyamanekāvayavādhāra ityādi nyagādi tatrāpi
kathaṃcidvirodhyanekāvayavāviṣvagbhūtavṛttiravayavyabhidhīyate | tatra ca
yadvirodhyanekāvayavādhāratāyāṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsanamabhihitaṃ tatkathaṃ-
cidupeyata eva tāvat | avayavātmakasya tasyāpi kathaṃcidanekarūpatvāt |
yaccopanyastam api cāsau teṣu vartamānaḥ kārtsnyenaikadeśena vā vartete-
tyādi tatrāpi vikalpadvayānabhyupagama evottaram | aviṣvagbhāvenā-
vayavino'vayaveṣu vṛtteḥ svīkārāt | kiṃ ca yadi bāhyo'rtho nāsti
kimidānīṃ niyatākāraṃ pratīyate | nīlametaditi vijñānākāro'ya-
miti cet na | jñānādbahirbhūtasya saṃvedanāt | jñānākāratve tvahaṃ nīla-
miti pratītiḥ syāt na tvidaṃ nīlamiti | jñānānāṃ pratyekamākāra-
bhedāt kasyacidahamiti pratibhāsaḥ kasyacinnīlametaditi cet na |
nīlādyākāravadahamityākārasya vyavasthitatvābhāvāt | tathā ca yade-
kenāhamiti pratīyate tadevāpareṇa tvamiti pratīyate | nīlādyākāra-
stu vyavasthitaḥ sarvairapyekarūpatayā grahaṇāt | bhakṣitahṛtpūrādibhistu
yadyapi nīlādikaṃ pītāditayā gṛhyate tathāpi tena na vyabhicāraḥ |
tasya bhrāntatvāt | svayaṃ svasya saṃvedane'hamiti pratibhāsata
iti cet nanu kiṃ parasyāpi saṃvedanamasti | kathamanyathā svaśabdasya
prayogaḥ | pratiyogiśabdo hyayaṃ paramapekṣamāṇa eva pravartate |
svarūpasyāpi bhrāntyā bhedapratītiriti cet hanta pratyakṣeṇa
pratīto bhedaḥ kathaṃ na vāstavaḥ | bhrāntaṃ pratyakṣamiti cet nanu kuta
etat | anumānena jñānārthayorabhedasiddheriti cet kiṃ tadanumā-
namiti pṛcchāmaḥ | yadyena saha niyamenopalabhyate tattato na bhidya-
te yathā saccandrādasaccandraḥ | niyamenopalabhyate ca jñānena sahārthaḥ
iti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | pratiṣedhyasya jñānārthayorbhedasya vyāpakaḥ
sahopalambhāniyamaḥtasyānupalabdhiḥ | bhinnayornīlapītayoryugapadupala-
mbhaniyamābhāvāt | ityanumānena tayorabhedāsiddhiriti cet na | saṃdi-
gdhānaikāntikatvenāsyānumānābhāsatvāt | jñānaṃ hi svaparasaṃvedanam |
tat parasaṃvedanatāmātreṇaiva nīlaṃ gṛhṇāti svasaṃvedanatāmātreṇaiva ca
nīlabuddhim | tadevamanayoryugapadgrahaṇātsahopalambhaniyamo'sti a-
bhedaśca nāsti iti sahopalambhaniyamarūpasya hetorvipakṣādvyāvṛtteḥ
saṃdigdhatvāt saṃdigdhānaikāntikatvam | asiddhaśca sahopalambhani-
yamaḥ | nīlametaditi bahirmukhatayā'rthenubhūyamāne tadānīmevānta-
rasya nīlānubhavasyānanubhavāt iti kathaṃ pratyakṣasyānumānena jñānā-
rthayorabhedasiddhyā bhrāntatvam | api ca pratyakṣasya bhrāntatvenābā-
dhitaviṣayatvādanumānasyātmalābhaḥ labdhātmake cānumāne pratyakṣasya
bhrāntatvamityanyonyāśrayadoṣo'pi durnivāraḥ | arthābhāve ca niyata-
deśādhikaraṇā pratītiḥ kutaḥ | na hi tatra vivajñitadeśe'yamāropayi-
tavyo nānyatretyasti niyame hetuḥ | vāsanāniyamāttadāropaniyama
iti cet na | tasyā api taddeśaniyamakāraṇābhāvāt | sati hyarthasadbhāve
yaddeśo'rthastaddeśo'nubhavastaddeśā ca tatpūrvikā vāsanā | bāhyārthā-
bhāve tu tasyāḥ kiṃkṛto deśaniyamaḥ | athāsti tāvadāropaniyamaḥ |
na ca kāraṇaviśeṣamantareṇa kāryaviśeṣo ghaṭate bāhyaścārtho nāsti
tena vāsanānāmeva vaicitryaṃ tatra hetuḥ | iti cet tadvāsanāvaicitryaṃ vo-
dhākārādanyadananyadvā | ananyaccet bodhākārasyaikatvātkastāsāṃ para-
sparato viśeṣaḥ | anyaccet arthe kaḥ pradveṣaḥ yena sarvalokapratītirapahnū-
yate | tadevaṃ siddho jñānārthayorbhedaḥ | tathā ca prayogaḥ | vivādādhyā-
sitaṃ nīlādi jñānādyatiriktam | viruddhadharmādhyastatvāt | viruddhadharmā-
dhyāsaśca jñānasya śarīrāntaḥ arthasya ca bahiḥ | jñānasyāparakāle
arthasya ca pūrvakāle vṛttimattvāt | jñānasya ātmanaḥ sakāśādarthasya
svakāraṇebhya utpatteḥ | jñānasya prakāśarūpatvādarthasya ca jaḍarūpa-
tvāditi || ato na jñānādvaite'bhyupagamyamāne bahiranubhūyamānārtha-
pratītiḥ kathamapi saṃgatimaṅgati | na ca dṛṣṭamapahnotuṃ śakyam iti | ata
evāha stutikāraḥ na saṃvidadvaitapathe'rthasaṃvid iti | samyag avai-
parītyena vidyateavagamyate vastusvarūpamanayeti saṃvit | svasaṃvedanapakṣe
tu saṃvedanaṃ saṃvit jñānaṃ tasyā advaitam | dvayorbhāvo dvitā dvitaiva dvaitaṃ
prajñāditvāt svārthike'ṇi | na dvaitamadvaitam | bāhyārthapratikṣepādekatvam |
saṃvidadvaitaṃ jñānamevaikaṃ tāttvikaṃ na bāhyo'rtha ityabhyupagama ityarthaḥ | tasya
panthāḥ mārgaḥ saṃvidadvaitapathaḥ tasmin jñānādvaitavādapakṣa iti yāvat |
kimityāha | nārthasaṃvit | yeyaṃ bahirmukhatayā'rthapratītiḥ sākṣā-
danubhūyate sā na ghaṭate ityupaskāraḥ | etaccānantarameva bhāvitam |
evaṃsthite sati kimityāha | vilūnaśīrṇaṃ sugatendrajālamiti | sugato
māyāputraḥ tasya saṃbandhi tena parikalpitaṃ kṣaṇakṣayādivastujātam |
indrajālamivendrajālam | mativyāmohavidhātṛtvāt | sugatendrajālaṃ
sarvamidaṃ vilūnaśīrṇam | pūrvaṃ vilūnaṃ paścāt śīrṇaṃ vilūnaśīrṇam |
yathā kiṃcittṛṇastambādi vilūnameva śīryate vinaśyati evaṃ tatka-
lpitamindrajālaṃ tṛṇaprāyaṃ dhārālayuktiśastrikayā chinnaṃ sadviśīryata
iti || atha vā yathā nipuṇendrajālikakalpitamindrajālamavāstavata-
ttadvastvadbhutatopadarśanena tathāvidhabuddhidurvidagdhaṃ janaṃ vipratārya paścā-
dindradhanuriva niravayavaṃ vilūnaśīrṇatāṃ kalayati tathā sugataparika-
lpitaṃ tattatpramāṇatattatphalābhedakṣaṇakṣayajñānārthahetukatattvajñānādvaitā-
bhyupagamādi sarvaṃ pramāṇānabhijñaṃ lokaṃ vyāmohayamānamapi yuktyā vi-
cāyamāṇaṃ viśarārutāmeva sevata iti | atra ca sugataśabda upahāsārthaḥ |
saugatā hi śobhanaṃ gataṃ jñānamasyeti sugata ityuśanti | tataścāho
tasya śobhanajñānatā yenetthamayuktiyuktamuktamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 16 ||

atha tattvavyavasthāpakapramāṇādicatuṣṭayavyavahārāpalāpinaḥ
śūnyavādinaḥ saugatajātīyāṃstatkakṣīkṛtapakṣasādhakasya pramāṇasyā-
ṅgīkārānaṅgīkāralakṣaṇapakṣadvayepi tadabhimatārthāsiddhipradarśanapū-
rvakamupahasannāha |
vinā pramāṇaṃ paravanna śūnyaḥ
svapakṣasiddheḥ padamaśnuvīta |
kupyetkṛtāntaḥ spṛśate pramāṇa-
maho sudṛṣṭaṃ tvadasūyidṛṣṭam || 17 ||

śūnyaḥ śūnyavādī pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ vinā antareṇa svapakṣa-
siddheḥ svābhyupagataśūnyavādaniṣpatteḥ padaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ nāśnuvīta na
prāpnuyāt | kiṃvat paravat itaraprāmāṇikavat | vaidharmyeṇāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
yathā itare prāmāṇikāḥ pramāṇena sādhakatamena svapakṣasiddhimaśnu-
vate evaṃ nāyam | asya mate pramāṇaprameyādivyavahārasyāpāramārthi-
katvāt | sarva evāyamanumānānumeyavyavahāro buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmi-
bhāvena na bahiḥsadasattvamapekṣate ityādivacanāt | apramāṇa-
kaśca śūnyavādābhyupagamaḥ kathamiva prekṣāvatāmupādeyo bhaviṣyati |
prekṣāvattvavyāhatiprasaṅgāt | atha cetsvapakṣasaṃsiddhaye kimapi pramā-
ṇamayamaṅgīkurute tatrāyamupālambhaḥ kupyedityādi | pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣā-
dyanyatamatspṛśate āśrayamāṇāya prakaraṇādasmai śūnyavādine kṛtāntaḥ
tatsiddhāntaḥ kupyet kopaṃ kuryāt siddhāntabādhaḥ syādityarthaḥ | yathā
kila sevakasya viruddhavṛttyā kupito nṛpatiḥ sarvasvamapaharati evaṃ
tatsiddhāntopi śūnyavādaviruddhaṃ pramāṇabhāvamaṅgīkurvāṇasya tasya
sarvasvabhūtaṃ samyagvāditvamapaharati | kiṃ ca svāgamopadeśenaiva
tena vādinā śūnyavādaḥ prarūpyate iti svīkṛtamāgamasya prāmāṇya-
miti kutastasya svapakṣasiddhiḥ | pramāṇāṅgīkaraṇāt | kiṃ ca pramāṇaṃ
prameyaṃ vinā na bhavatīti pramāṇānaṅgīkaraṇe prameyamapi viśīrṇam |
tataścāsya mūkataiva yuktā na punaḥ śūnyavādopanyāsāya tuṇḍatāṇḍava-
ḍambaram | śūnyavādasyāpi prameyatvāt | atra ca spṛśidhātuṃ kṛtā-
ntaśabdaṃ ca prayuñjānasya sūrerayamabhiprāyaḥ | yadyasau śūnyavādī dūre
pramāṇasya sarvathāṅgīkāraḥ yāvatpramāṇasparśamātrapi vidhatte tadā tasmai
kṛtānto yamagajaḥ kupyet | tatkopo hi maraṇaphalaḥ | tataśca svasi-
ddhāntaviruddhamasau pramāṇayannigrahasthānāpannatvānmṛta eveti | evaṃ
sati aho ityupahāsapraśaṃsāyām tubhyamasūyanti guṇeṣu doṣānāvi-
ṣkurvantītyevaṃśīlāstvadasūyinaḥ tantrāntarīyāḥ tairdṛṣṭaṃ matyajñānaca-
kṣuṣā nirīkṣitam aho sudṛṣṭaṃ sādhudṛṣṭam | viparītalakṣaṇayopahāsānna
samyagdṛṣṭamityarthaḥ | atrāsūyadhātostācchīlikaṇakprāptāvapi bā-
hulakāṇṇin | asūyā'styeṣāmityasūyinaḥ tvayyasūyinaḥ tvadasū-
yinaḥ iti matvarthīyāntaṃ vā | tvadasūyudṛṣṭamiti pāṭhepi na kiṃci-
dacāru | asūyuśabdasyodantasyodayanādyairnyāyatātparyapariśuddhyādau
matsariṇi prayāgāditi ||

iha śūnyavādināmayamabhisaṃdhiḥ | pramātā prameyaṃ pramāṇaṃ prami-
tiriti tattvacatuṣṭayaṃ paraparikalpitamavastveva | vicārāsahatvāt |
turaṅgaśṛṅgavat | tatra pramātā tāvadātmā tasya ca pramāṇagrāhyatvā-
bhāvādabhāvaḥ | tathā hi na pratyakṣeṇa tatsiddhiḥ | indriyagocarā-
tikrāntatvāt | yattu ahaṃkārapratyayeṇa tasya mānasapratyakṣatvasādhanaṃ
tadapyanaikāntikam | tasyāhaṃ gauraḥ śyāmo vetyādau śarīrāśraya-
tayāpyupapatteḥ | kiṃ ca yadyayamahaṃkārapratyaya ātmagocaraḥ syāttadā na
kādācitkaḥ syāt | ātmanaḥ sadā sannihitatvāt | kādācitkaṃ hi
jñānaṃ kadācitkāraṇapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā saudāmanījñānamiti | nāpya-
numānena | avyabhicāriliṅgāgrahaṇāt | āgamānāṃ ca parasparavi-
ruddhārthavādināṃ nāstyeva prāmāṇyam | tathā hi ekena kathamapi kaści-
dartho vyavasthāpito'bhiyuktatareṇāpareṇa sa evānyathā vyavasthāpyate |
svayamavyavasthitaprāmāṇyānāṃ ca teṣāṃ kathamanyavyavasthāpane sāma-
rthyam | iti nāsti pramātā || prameyaṃ ca bāhyo'rthaḥ sa cānantarameva
bāhyārthapratikṣepakṣaṇe nirloṭhitaḥ || pramāṇaṃ ca svaparāvabhāsijñānam |
tacca prameyābhāve kasya grāhakamastu | nirviṣayatvāt | kiṃ caitadarthasama-
kālaṃ tadbhinnakālaṃ vā tadgrāhakaṃ kalpyeta | ādyapakṣe tribhuvanavarti-
nopi padārthāstatrāvabhāseran | samakālatvāviśeṣāt | dvitīye tu
nirākāraṃ sākāraṃ vā tatsyāt | prathame pratiniyatapadārthaparicchedā-
nupapattiḥ | dvitīye tu kimayamākāro vyatirikto'vyatirikto vā
jñānāt | avyatireke jñānamevāyaṃ tathā ca nirākārapakṣadoṣaḥ | vyati-
reke yadyayaṃ cidrūpaḥ tadānīmākāropi vedakaḥ syāt | tathā cāyama-
pi nirākāraḥ sākāro vā tadvedako bhavet | ityāvartanenānavasthā |
athācidrūpaḥ kimajñāto jñātā vā tajjñāpakaḥ syāt | prācīne vikalpe
caitrasyeva maitrasyāpi tajjñāpako'sau syāt | taduttare tu nirākāreṇa
sākāreṇa vā jñānena tasyāpi jñānaṃ syāt | ityādyāvṛttāvanavasthai-
veti || itthaṃ pramāṇābhāve tatphalarūpā pramitiḥ kutastanī | iti
sarvaśūnyataiva paraṃ tattvamiti | tathā ca paṭhanti |
yathā yathā vicāryante viśīryante tathā tathā |
yadetatsvayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam ||
iti pūrvapakṣaḥ | vistaratastu pramāṇakhaṇḍanaṃ tattvopaplavasiṃhādavalokanī-
yam ||

atra pratividhīyate | nanu yadidaṃ śūnyavādavyavasthāpanāya
devānāṃpriyeṇa vacanamupanyastaṃ tacchūnyamaśūnyaṃ vā | śūnyaṃ cet sarvo-
pākhyāvirahitatvātkhapuṣpeṇeva nāmena kiṃcitsādhyate niṣidhyate
vā | tataśca niṣpratipakṣā pramāṇāditattvacatuṣṭayīvyavasthā | aśūnyaṃ
cet pralīnastapasvī śūnyavādaḥ | bhavadvacanenaiva sarvaśūnyatāyā vyabhi-
cārāt | tatrāpi niṣkaṇṭikaiva sā bhagavatī | tathāpi prāmāṇikasa-
mayaparipālanārthaṃ kiñcittatsādhanaṃ dūṣyate | tatra yattāvaduktaṃ pramātuḥ
pratyakṣeṇa na siddhirindriyagocarātikrāntatvāt iti tatsiddhasādha-
nam | yatpunarahaṃpratyayena tasya mānasapratyakṣatvamanaikāntikamityuktaṃ
tadasiddham | ahaṃ sukhī ahaṃ duḥkhītyantarmukhasya pratyayasya ātmā-
lambanatayaivopapatteḥ | tathā cāhuḥ |
sukhādi cetyamānaṃ hi svatantraṃ nānubhūyate |
matubarthānuvedhāttu siddhaṃ grahaṇamātmanaḥ ||
idaṃ sukhamiti jñānaṃ dṛśyata na ghaṭādivat |
ahaṃ sukhīti tu jñaptirātmanopi prakāśikā ||
yatpunarahaṃ gauraḥ ahaṃ śyāma ityādibahirmukhaḥ pratyayaḥ sa khalvā-
tmopakārakatvena lakṣaṇayā śarīre prayujyate | yathā priyabhṛtye'hamiti
vyapadeśaḥ | yaccāhaṃpratyayasya kādācitkatvaṃ tatreyaṃ vāsanā | ātmā
tāvadupayogalakṣaṇaḥ | sa ca sākārānākāropayogayoranyatarasminni-
yamenopayukta eva bhavati | ahaṃpratyayopi copayogaviśeṣa eva | tasya
ca karmakṣayopaśamavaicitryādindriyānindriyālokaviṣayādinimitta-
savyapekṣatayā pravartamānamasya kādācitkatvamupapannameva | yathā bījaṃ
satyāmapyaṅkuropajananaśaktau pṛthivyudakādisahakārikāraṇakalāpa-
samavahitamevāṅkuraṃ janayati nānyathā | na caitāvatā tasyāṅkuro-
tpādane kādācitkepi tadutpādanaśaktirapi kādācitkī | tasyāḥ
kathaṃcinnityatvāt | evamātmanaḥ sadā sannihitatvepyahaṃpratyayasya
kādācitkatvam | yadapyuktaṃ tasyāvyabhicāri liṅgaṃ kimapi no-
palabhyate iti tadapyasāram | sādhyāvinābhāvino'nekasya liṅgasya
tatropalabdheḥ | tathā hi | rūpādyupalabdhiḥ sakartṛkā | kriyātvāt |
chidikriyāvat | yaścāsyāḥ kartā sa ātmā | na cātra cakṣurādīnāṃ
kartṛtvam | teṣāṃ kuṭhārādivat karaṇatvenāsvatantratvāt | karaṇatvaṃ caiṣāṃ
paudgalikatvenācetanatvāt | parapreryatvāt | prayoktṛvyāpāranirapekṣapravṛ-
ttyabhāvāt | yadīndriyāṇāmeva kartṛtvaṃ syāttadā teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu pūrvā-
nubhūtārthasmṛtermayā dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭam āghrātam āsvāditaṃ śrutamiti
pratyayānāmekakartṛkatvapratipatteśca kutaḥ saṃbhavaḥ | kiṃca indriyāṇāṃ
svasvaviṣayaniyatatvena rūparasayoḥ sāhacaryapratītau na sāmarthyam |
asti ca tathāvidhaphalāde rūpagrahaṇānantaraṃ tatsahacaritarasānusmara-
ṇam | dantodakasaṃplavānyathānupapattaḥ | tasmādubhayorgavākṣayorantargataḥ
prekṣaka iva dvābhyāmindriyābhyāṃ rūparasayordarśī kaścideko'nu-
mīyate | tasmātkaraṇānyetāni | yaścaiṣāṃ vyāpārayitā sa ātmā |
tathā sādhanopādānaparivarjanadvāreṇa hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthā
ceṣṭā prayatnapūrvikā | viśiṣṭakriyātvāt | rathakriyāvat | śarīraṃ ca praya-
tnavadadhiṣṭhitam | viśiṣṭakriyāśrayatvāt rathavat yaścāsyādhiṣṭhātā sa
ātmā | sārathivat | tathātraiva pakṣe icchāpūrvakavikṛtavāyvāśrayatvāt |
bhasrāvat | vāyuśca prāṇāpānādiścāsyādhiṣṭhātā sa ātmā | bha-
srādhmāpayitṛvat | tathā atraiva pakṣe icchādhīnanimeṣonmeṣavadavaya-
vayogitvāt | dāruyantravat | tathā śarīrasya vṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃrohaṇaṃ ca
prayatnavatkṛtam | vṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃrohaṇatvāt | gṛhavṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃro-
haṇavat | vṛkṣādigatena vṛddhyādinā vyabhicāra iti cet na |
teṣāmapi ekendriyajantutvena sātmakatvāt | yaścaiṣāṃ kartā sa
ātmā | gṛhapativat | vṛkṣādīnāṃ ca sātmakatvamācārāṅgāderava-
seyam | kiṃcidvakṣyate ca | tathā preryaṃ manaḥ | abhimataviṣaya-
saṃbandhanimittakriyāśrayatvāt | dārakahastagatagolakavat | yaścāsya
prerakaḥ sa ātmā iti | tathā ātmacetanakṣetrajñajīvapuruṣādayaḥ
paryāyā na nirviṣayāḥ | paryāyatvāt | ghaṭakuṭakalaśādiparyāyavat |
vyatireke ṣaṣṭhabhūtādi | yaścaiṣāṃ viṣayaḥ sa ātmā | tathā astyātmā |
asamastaparyāyavācyatvāt | yo yaḥ sāṅketikaśuddhaparyāyavācyaḥ
sa so'stitvaṃ na vyabhicarati | yathā ghaṭādi | vyatireke kharavi-
ṣāṇanabhombhoruhādayaḥ | tathā sṛkhādīni dravyāśritāni
guṇatvāt rūpavat | yo'sau guṇī sa ātmā | ityādiliṅgāni |
tasmādanumānato'pyātmā siddhaḥ || āgamānāṃ ca yeṣāṃ pūrvāpara-
viruddhārthatvaṃ teṣāmaprāmāṇyameva | yastvāptapraṇīta āgamaḥ sa
pramāṇameva | kaṣacchedatāpalakṣaṇopādhitrayaviśuddhatvāt | kaṣādīnāṃ
ca svarūpaṃ purastādvakṣyāmaḥ | na ca vācyamāptaḥ kṣīṇasarvado-
ṣaḥ tathāvidhaṃ cāptatvaṃ kasyāpi nāstīti | yato rāgādayaḥ
kasyacidatyantamucchidyante | asmadādiṣu taducchedaprakarṣāpakarṣo-
palambhāt | sūryādyāvarakajaladapaṭalavat | tathā cāhuḥ |
deśato nāśino bhāvā dṛṣṭā nikhilanaśvarāḥ |
meghapaṅktyādayo yadvadevaṃ rāgādayo matāḥ ||
iti | yasya ca niravayavatayaite vilīnāḥ sa evāpto bhagavān
sarvajñaḥ | athānāditvādrāgādīnāṃ kathaṃ prakṣaya iti cenna | upāyatasta-
dbhāvāt | anāderapi suvarṇamalasya kṣāramṛtpuṭapākādinā vilayopa-
lambhāt | tadvadevānādīnāmapi rāgādidoṣāṇāṃ pratipakṣabhūtaratnatrayā-
bhyāsena vilayopapatteḥ | kṣīṇadoṣasya ca kevalajñānāvyabhicārā-
tsarvajñatvam | tatsiddhistu jñānatāratamyaṃ kvacidviśrāntaṃ tāramyatvāt
ākāśaparimāṇatāratamyavat | tathā sūkṣmāntaritadūrārthāḥ kasya-
citpratyakṣā anumeyatvāt kṣitidharakandharādhikaraṇadhūmadhvajavat | evaṃ
candrasūryoparāgādisūcakajyotirjñānāvisaṃvādānyathānupapattiprabhṛta--
yopi hetavo vācyāḥ | tadevamāptena sarvavidā praṇīta āgamaḥ
pramāṇameva | tadaprāmāṇyaṃ hi praṇāyakadoṣanibandhanam |
rāgādvā dveṣādvā mohādvā vākyamucyate hyanṛtam |
yasya tu naite doṣāstasyānṛtakāraṇaṃ kiṃ syāt ||
iti vacanāt | praṇetuśca nirdoṣatvamupapāditameveti siddha āga-
mādapyātmā | ege āyā ityādivacanāt || tadevaṃ pratyakṣānu-
mānāgamaiḥ siddhaḥ pramātā ||

prameyaṃ cānantarameva bāhyārthasādhane sādhitam | tatsiddhau ca
pramāṇaṃ jñānaṃ prameyābhāve kasya grāhakamastu nirviṣayatvāditi
pralāpamātram | karaṇamantareṇa kriyāsiddherayogāt | lavanādiṣu
tathādarśanāt | yaccātra samakālamityādyuktaṃ tatra vikalpadvayamapi
svīkriyata eva | asmadādipratyakṣaṃ hi samakālārthākalanakuśalam |
smaraṇamatītārthasya grāhakam | śabdānumāne ca traikālikasyāpyarthasya
paricchedake | nirākāraṃ caitaddvayamapi | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ | svajñānāvaraṇa-
vīryāntarāyakṣayopaśamaviśeṣavaśādevāsya naiyatyena pravṛtteḥ | śeṣavi-
kalpānāmasvīkāra eva tiraskāraḥ ||

pramitistu pramāṇasya phalaṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhaiva | na hyanubhavepyupa-
deśāpekṣā | phalaṃ ca dvidhā | ānantaryapāraṃparyabhedāt | tatrānantaryeṇa
sarvapramāṇānāmajñānanivṛttiḥ phalam | pāraṃparyeṇa kevalajñānasya
tāvat phalamaudāsīnyam | śeṣapramāṇānāṃ tu hānopādānopekṣā-
buddhayaḥ || iti suvyavasthitaṃ pramātrādicatuṣṭayam ||

tataśca
nāsanna sanna sadasanna cāpyanubhayātmakam |
catuṣkoṭivinirmuktaṃ tattvamādhyātmikā viduḥ ||
ityunmattabhāṣitam || kiṃ cedaṃ pramātrādīnāmavāstavatvaṃ śūnyavā-
dinā vastuvṛttyā tāvadeṣṭavyam | taccāsau pramāṇādabhimanyate a-
pramāṇādvā | na tāvadapramāṇāt | tasyākiṃcitkaratvāt | atha pramāṇāt |
tanna | avāstavatvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ sāṃvṛtamasāṃvṛtaṃ vā syāt | yadi
sāṃvṛtaṃ kathaṃ tasmādavāstavādvāstavasya śūnyavādasya siddhiḥ | tathā
tadasiddhau ca vāstava eva samastopi pramātrādivyavahāraḥ prāptaḥ | atha
tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ svayamasāṃvṛtam | tarhi kṣīṇā pramātrādivyavahārā-
vāstavatvapratijñā | tenaiva vyabhicārāt | tadevaṃ pakṣadvayepi ito vyāghra
itastaṭīti nyāyena vyakta eva paramārthataḥ svābhimatasiddhivirodhaḥ ||
iti kāvyārthaḥ || 17 ||

adhunā kṣaṇikavādina aihikāmuṣmikavyavahārānupapannārtha-
samarthanamavimṛśyakāritaṃ darśayannāha |
kṛtapraṇāśākṛtakarmabhoga-
bhavapramokṣasmṛtibhaṅgadoṣān |
upekṣya sākṣāt kṣaṇabhaṅgamiccha-
nnaho mahāsāhasikaḥ paraste || 18 ||

kṛtapraṇāśadoṣamakṛtakarmabhogadoṣaṃ bhavabhaṅgadoṣaṃ pramokṣabhaṅgadoṣaṃ
smṛtibhaṅgadoṣamityetān | sākṣādityanubhavasiddhān | upekṣya anādṛtya |
sākṣātkurvannapi gajanimīlikāmavalambamānaḥ | kṣaṇabhaṅgam udayā-
nantaravināśarūpakṣaṇakṣayitām | icchan pratipadyamānaḥ | te tava | paraḥ
pratipakṣaḥ vaināśikaḥ saugata ityarthaḥ | aho mahāsāhasikaḥ | sahasā
avimarśātmakena balena vartate sāhasikaḥ | bhāvinamanarthamavibhāvya
yaḥ pravartate sa evamucyate | mahāṃścāsau sāhasikaśca mahāsāhasikaḥ
atyantamavimṛśya pravṛttikārī | iti mukulitārthaḥ ||

vivṛtārthastvayam | bauddhā buddhikṣaṇaparaṃparāmātramevātmānamāmananti
na punarmauktikakaṇanikarānusyūtaikasūtravattadanvayinamekam | tanmate yena
jñānakṣaṇena sadanuṣṭhānamasadanuṣṭhānaṃ vā kṛtaṃ tasya niranvayavināśānna
tatphalopabhogaḥ yasya ca phalopabhogastena tatkarma na kṛtamiti prā-
cyajñānakṣaṇasya kṛtapraṇāśaḥ svakṛtakarmaphalānupabhogāt uttarajñānakṣa-
ṇasya cākṛtakarmabhogaḥ svayamakṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalopabhogāditi | atra
karmaśabdaḥ ubhayatrāpi yojyaḥ | tena kṛtapraṇāśa ityasya kṛtakarmapraṇāśa
ityartho dṛśyaḥ | bandhānulomyāccetthamupanyāsaḥ || tathā bhavabhaṅgadoṣaḥ | bhava
ājavībhāvalakṣaṇaḥ saṃsāraḥ tasya bhaṅgo vilopaḥ sa eva doṣaḥ kṣaṇika-
vāde prasajyate | paralokābhāvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | paralokinaḥ kasya-
cidabhāvāt | paraloko hi pūrvajanmakṛtakarmānusāreṇa bhavati | tacca
prācīnajñānakṣaṇānāṃ niranvayaṃ nāśāt kena nāmopabhujyatāṃ janmāntare |
yacca mokṣākaraguptena yaccittaṃ taccittāntaraṃ pratisaṃdhatte yathedānīntanaṃ
cittaṃ cittaṃ ca maraṇakālabhāvi iti bhavaparaṃparāsiddhaye pramāṇamuktaṃ
tadūvyartham | cittakṣaṇānāṃ niravaśeṣanāśināṃ cittāntarapratisaṃdhānā-
yogāt | dvayoravasthitayorhi pratisaṃdhānamubhayānugāminā kena-
citkriyate | yaścānayoḥ pratisaṃdhātā sa tena nābhyupagamyate | sa
hyātmā'nvayī | na ca pratisaṃdhatte ityasya janayatītyarthaḥ | kāryahetu-
prasaṅgāt | tena vādinā'sya hetoḥ svabhāvahetutvenoktatvāt |
svabhāvahetuśca tādātmye sati bhavati | bhinnakālabhāvinośca
cittacittāntarayoḥ kutastādātmyam | yugapadbhāvinośca pratisaṃdheya-
pratisaṃdhāyakatvābhāvāpattiḥ | yugapadbhāvitve'viśiṣṭepi kimatra
niyāmakaṃ yadekaḥ pratisaṃdhāyako'paraśca pratisaṃdheya iti | astu vā
pratisaṃdhānasya jananamarthaḥ | sopyanupapannaḥ | tulyakālatve hetuphala-
bhāvasyābhāvāt | bhinnakālatve ca pūrvacittakṣaṇasya vinaṣṭatvāt
uttaracittakṣaṇaḥ kathamupādānamantareṇotpadyatām | iti yatkiṃcidetat ||
tathā pramokṣabhaṅgadoṣaḥ | prakarṣeṇāpunarbhāvena karmabandhanānmuktiḥ pramo-
kṣaḥ tasyāpi bhaṅgaḥ prāpnoti | tanmate tāvadātmaiva nāsti kaḥ pretya
sukhībhavanārthaṃ yatiṣyate | jñānakṣaṇopi saṃsārī kathamaparajñāna-
kṣaṇasukhībhavanāya ghaṭiṣyate | na hi duḥkhī devadatto yajñadattasukhāya
ceṣṭamāno dṛṣṭaḥ | kṣaṇasya tu duḥkhaṃ svarasanāśitvāttenaiva sārdhaṃ dadhvaṃse |
saṃtānastu na vāstavaḥ kaścit | vāstavatve tu ātmābhyupagama-
prasaṅgaḥ | api ca bauddhā nikhilavāsanocchede vigataviṣayākāropa-
plavaviśuddhajñānotpādo mokṣa ityāhustacca na ghaṭate | kāraṇābhāvādeva
tadanupapatteḥ | bhāvanāpracayo hi tasya kāraṇamiṣyate | sa ca sthiraikā-
śrayābhāvādviśeṣānādhāyakaḥ pratikṣaṇamapūrvavadupajāyamāno niranvaya-
vināśī gaganalaṅghanābhyāsavadanāsāditaprakarṣo na sphuṭābhijñāna-
jananāya prabhavatītyanupapattireva tasya | samalacittakṣaṇānāṃ svābhāvi-
kyāḥ sadṛśārambhaṇaśakterasadṛśārambhaṃ pratyaśakteścākasmādanucche-
dāt | kiṃ ca samalacittakṣaṇāḥ pūrve svarasaparinirvāṇāḥ ayama-
pūrvo jātaḥ saṃtānaścaiko na vidyate bandhamokṣau caikādhikaraṇau
na viṣayabhedena vartete tatkasyeyaṃ muktirya etadarthaṃ prayatate | ayaṃ
hi mokṣaśabdo bandhanavicchedaparyāyaḥ | mokṣaśca tasyaiva ghaṭate
yo baddhaḥ | kṣaṇakṣayavāde tvanyaḥ kṣaṇo baddhaḥ kṣaṇāntarasya
muktiriti mokṣābhāvaḥ prāpnoti || tathā smṛtibhaṅgadoṣaḥ | tathā
hi pūrvabuddhyānubhūte'rthe nottarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtiḥ saṃbhavati | tato'nya-
tvāt | saṃtānāntarabuddhivat | na hyanyadṛṣṭo'rtho'nyena smaryate |
anyathā ekena dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ sarvaiḥ smaryeta | smaraṇābhāve ca kauta-
skutī pratyabhijñāprasūtiḥ | tasyāḥ smaraṇānubhavobhayasaṃbhavatvāt |
padārthaprekṣaṇaprabuddhaprāktanasaṃskārasya hi pramātuḥ sa evāyamityā-
kāreṇeyamutpadyate | atha syādayaṃ doṣo yadyaviśeṣeṇānyadṛṣṭamanyaḥ
smaratītyucyate | kiṃtvanyatvepi kāryakāraṇabhāvādeva ca
smṛtiḥ | bhinnasaṃtānabuddhīnāṃ tu kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāsti tena
saṃtānāntarāṇāṃ smṛtirna bhavati | na caikasāṃtānikīnāmapi
buddhīnāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāsti yena pūrvabuddhyanubhūterthe
taduttarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtirna syāt | tadapyanavadātam | evamapi anya-
tvasya tadavasthatvāt | na hi kāryakāraṇabhāvābhidhānepi
tadapagatam | kṣaṇikatvena sarvāsāṃ bhinnatvāt | na hi kāryakāraṇa-
bhāvātsmṛtirityatrobhayaprasiddhosti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | atha
yasminneva hi saṃtāne āhitā karmavāsanā |
phalaṃ tatraiva saṃdhatte karpāse raktatā yathā ||
iti karpāsaraktatādṛṣṭāntostīti cet tadasādhīyaḥ | sādhana-
dūṣaṇayorasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi anvayādyasaṃbhavānna sādhanam | na hi
kāryakāraṇabhāvo yatra tatra smṛtiḥ karpāse raktatāvadityanvayaḥ
saṃbhavati | nāpi yatra na smṛtistatra na kāryakāraṇabhāva iti vyati-
rekosti | asiddhatvādyanudbhāvanācca na dūṣaṇam | na hi tatonyatvā-
dityasya hetoḥ karpāse raktatāvadityanena kaściddoṣaḥ pratipādyate |
kiṃca yadyanyatvepi kāryakāraṇabhāvena smṛterutpattiriṣyate tadā
śiṣyācāryādibuddhīnāmapi kāryakāraṇabhāvasadbhāvena smṛtyādiḥ
syāt | atha nāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ekasaṃtānatve satītiviśeṣaṇāditi cet
tadapyayuktam | bhedābhedapakṣābhyāṃ tasyopakṣīṇatvāt | kṣaṇaparaṃparātasta-
syābhede hi kṣaṇaparaṃparaiva sā | tathā ca saṃtāna iti na kiṃcida-
tiriktamuktaṃ syāt | bheda tvapāramārthikaḥ pāramārthiko vā'sau syāt |
apāramārthikatve'sya tadeva dūṣaṇam | akiṃcitkaratvāt | pāramārthika-
tve sthiro vā syāt kṣaṇiko vā | kṣaṇikatve saṃtānanirviśeṣa evā-
yamiti kimanena stenabhītasya stenāntaraśaraṇasvīkaraṇānukara-
ṇinā | sthiraścet ātmaiva saṃjñābhedatirohitaḥ pratipannaḥ | iti na smṛti-
rghaṭate kṣaṇakṣayavādinām | tadabhāve cānumānasyānutthānamityuktaṃ
prāgeva | api ca smṛterabhāve nihitapratyunmārgaṇapratyarpaṇādi-
vyavahārā viśīryeran |
ityekanavate kalpe śaktyā me puruṣo hataḥ |
tena karmavipākena pāde viddhosmi bhikṣavaḥ ||
iti vacanasya ca kā gatiḥ | evamutpattirutpādayati sthitiḥ
sthāpayati jarā jarjarayati vināśo nāśayati iti catuḥkṣaṇikaṃ
vastu pratijānānā api pratikṣepyāḥ | kṣaṇacatuṣkānantaramapi
nihitapratyunmārgaṇādiṃvyavahārāṇāṃ darśanāt || tadevamanekadoṣāpātepi
yaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgamabhipraiti tasya mahat sāhasamiti kāvyārthaḥ || 18 ||

atha tāthāgatāḥ kṣaṇakṣayapakṣe sarvavyavahārānupapattiṃ paraiḥ
sadbhāvitāmākarṇyetthaṃ pratipādayiṣyanti | yatsarvapadārthānāṃ kṣaṇika-
tvepi vāsanābalalabdhajanmanā aikyādhyavasāyena aihikāmuṣmika-
vyavahārapravṛtteḥ kṛtapraṇāśādidoṣā niravakāśā eveti | tadākūtaṃ
parihartukāmastatkalpitavāsanāyāḥ kṣaṇaparaṃparāto bhedābhedānubhaya-
lakṣaṇe pakṣatrayepyaghaṭamānatvaṃ darśayan svābhipretabhedābhedasyādvā-
damakāmayamānānapi tānaṅgīkārayitumāha |
sā vāsanā sā kṣaṇasaṃtatiśca
nābhedabhedānubhayairghaṭete |
tatastaṭādarśiśakuntapota-
nyāyāttvaduktāni pare śrayantu || 19 ||

sā śākyaparikalpitā truṭitamuktāvalīkalpānāṃ parasparaviśa-
kalitānāṃ kṣaṇānāmanyonyānusyūtapratyayajanikā ekasūtrasthānīyā
saṃtānāparaparyāyā vāsanā | vāsaneti pūrvajñānajanitāmuttarajñāne
śaktimāhuḥ | sā ca kṣaṇasaṃtatistaddarśanaprasiddhā pradīpakalikāvannava-
navotpadyamānā'parāparasadṛśakṣaṇaparaṃparā | ete dve api abheda-
bhedānubhayairna ghaṭete || na tāvadabhedena tādātmyena te ghaṭete | tayorhi
abhede vāsanā vā syāt kṣaṇaparaṃparā vā | na dvayam | yaddhi yasmāda-
bhinnaṃ na tataḥ pṛthagupalabhyate yathā ghaṭāt ghaṭasvarūpam | kevalāyāṃ
vāsanāyāmanvayisvīkāraḥ | vāsyābhāve ca kiṃ tayā vāsanīyamastu |
iti tasyā api na svarūpamavatiṣṭhate | kṣaṇaparaṃparāmātrāṅgīkaraṇe
ca prāñca eva doṣāḥ || na ca bhedena te yujyete | sā hi bhinnā vāsanā
kṣaṇikā syādakṣaṇikā vā | kṣaṇikā cet tarhi kṣaṇebhyastasyāḥ
pṛthakkalpanaṃ vyartham | akṣaṇikā cedanvayipadārthābhyupagamenāgama-
bādhaḥ | tathā ca padārthāntarāṇāṃ kṣaṇikatvakalpanāprayāso vyasana-
mātram || anubhayapakṣeṇāpi na ghaṭete | sa hi kadācidevaṃ brūyāt
nāhaṃ vāsanāyāḥ kṣaṇaśreṇito'bhedaṃ pratipadye na ca bhedaṃ kiṃ
tvanubhayamiti | tadapyanucitam | bhedābhedayorvidhiniṣedharūpayorekatara-
pratiṣedhe'nyatarasyāvaśyaṃ vidhibhāvādanyatarapakṣābhyupagamaḥ | tatra ca
prāgukta eva doṣaḥ | athavā'nubhayarūpatve'vastutvaprasaṅgaḥ | bhedābheda-
lakṣaṇapakṣadvayavyatiriktasya mārgāntarasyānastitvāt | anārhatānāṃ hi
vastunā bhinnena vā bhāvyamabhinnena vā | tadubhayātītasya vandhyāsta-
nandhayaprāyatvāt | evaṃ vikalpatrayepi kṣaṇaparaṃparāvāsanayoranupapattau
pāriśeṣyādbhedābhedapakṣa eva kakṣīkaraṇīyaḥ | na ca pratyekaṃ
yo bhaveddoṣo dvayorbhāve kathaṃ na saḥ iti vacanādatrāpi
doṣatādavasthyamiti vācyam | kukkuṭasarpanarasiṃhādivajjātyantaratvāda-
nekāntapakṣasya | nanvārhatānāṃ vāsanākṣaṇaparaṃparayoraṅgīkāra eva
nāsti tatkathaṃ tadāśrayabhedābhedacintā caritārthā iti cennaivam |
syādvādavādināmapi hi pratikṣaṇaṃ navanavaparyāyaparaṃparotpattirabhi-
mataiva | tathā ca kṣaṇikatvam | atītānāgatavartamānaparyāyaparaṃparānu-
saṃdhāyakaṃ cānvayi dravyam | tacca vāsanetisaṃjñāntarabhāgapi abhimatameva |
na khalu nāmabhedādvādaḥ kopi kovidānām | sā ca pratikṣaṇotpadi-
ṣṇuparyāyaparaṃparā anvayidravyāt kathaṃcidbhinnā kathaṃcidabhinnā | tathā
tadapi tasyāḥ syādbhinnaṃ syādabhinnam | iti pṛthakpratyayavyapadeśaviṣa-
yatvādbhedaḥ | dravyasyaiva ca tathā tathā pariṇamanādabhedaḥ | etacca saka-
lādeśavikalādeśavyākhyāne purastātprapañcayiṣyāmaḥ ||

api ca bauddhamate vāsanāpi tāvanna ghaṭate iti nirviṣayā tatra
bhedādivikalpacintā | tallakṣaṇaṃ hi pūrvakṣaṇenottarakṣaṇasya vāsyatā |
na cāsthirāṇāṃ bhinnakālatayā'nyonyāsaṃbaddhānāṃ ca teṣāṃ vāsya-
vāsakabhāvo yujyate | sthirasya saṃbaddhasya ca vastrādermṛgamadādinā
vāsyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti | atha pūrvacittasahajāccetanāviśeṣātpūrvaśaktivi-
śiṣṭaṃ cittamutpadyate so'syaśaktiviśiṣṭacittotpādo vāsanā | tathā
hi pūrvacittaṃ rūpādiviṣayaṃ pravṛttivijñānaṃ yat tat ṣaḍvidham | pañca
rūpādivijñānānyavikalpakāni ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca vikalpavijñānam | tena
saha jātaḥ samānakālaścetanāviśeṣo'haṃkārāspadamālayavijñānam |
tasmātpūrvaśaktiviśiṣṭacittotpādo vāsaneti | tadapi na | asthi-
ratvādvāsakenāsaṃbandhācca | yaścāsau cetanāviśeṣaḥ pūrvacittasahabhāvī
sa na vartamāne cetasyupakāraṃ karoti | vartamānasyāśakyāpaneyo-
paneyatvenāvikāryatvāt | taddhi yathābhūtaṃ jāyate tathābhūtaṃ vina-
śyatīti | nāpyanāgata upakāraṃ karoti | tena sahāsaṃbaddhatvāt |
asaṃbaddhaṃ ca na bhāvayatītyuktam | tasmāt saugatamate vāsanāpi
na ghaṭate | atra ca stutikāreṇābhyupetyāpi tāmanvayidravya-
sthāpanāya bhedābhedādicarcā viraciteti bhāvanīyam ||

athottarārdhavyākhyā | tata iti || pakṣatrayepi doṣasadbhāvāt tvadu-
ktāni bhavadvacanāni bhedābhedasyādvādasaṃvādapūtāni pare kutīrthyāḥ
prakaraṇānmāyāsūnavīyāḥ śrayantu ādriyantām | atropamānamāha
taṭādarśītyādi | taṭaṃ na paśyatīti taṭādarśī yaḥ śakuntapotaḥ
pakṣiśāvakaḥ tasya nyāyaḥ udāharaṇaṃ tasmāt | yathā kila
kathamapyapārapārāvārāntaḥpatitaḥ kākādiśakuniśāvako bahi-
rnirjigamiṣayā pravahaṇakūpastambhādestaṭaprāptaye mugdhatayoḍḍīnaḥ
samantājjalaikārṇavamevāvalokayaṃstaṭamadṛṣṭvaiva nirvedādvyāvṛtya tadeva
kūpastambhādisthānamāśrayate gatyantarābhāvādevaṃ tepi kutīrthyāḥ
prāguktapakṣatrayepi vastusiddhimanāsādayantastvaduktameva caturthaṃ bhedā-
bhedapakṣamanicchayāpi kakṣīkurvāṇāstvacchāsanameva pratipadyantām |
na hi svasya balavikalatāmākalayya balīyasaḥ prabhoḥ śaraṇā-
śrayaṇaṃ doṣapoṣāya nītiśālinām | tvaduktānīti bahuvacanaṃ
sarveṣāmapi tantrāntarīyāṇāṃ pade pade'nekāntavādapratipattireva
yathāvasthitapadārthapratipādanaupayikaṃ nānyaditi jñāpanārtham |
anantadharmātmakasya sarvasya vastunaḥ sarvanayātmakena syādvādena
vinā yathāvadgrahītumaśakyatvāt | itarathāndhagajanyāyena pallava-
grāhitāprasaṅgāt || śrayantīti vartamānāntaṃ kecitpaṭhanti tathā-
pyadoṣaḥ || atra ca samudrasthānīyaḥ saṃsāraḥ | potasamānaṃ
tvacchāsanam | kūpastambhasaṃnibhaḥ syādvādaḥ | pakṣipotopamā
vādinaḥ | te ca svābhimatapakṣaprarūpaṇoḍḍayanena muktilakṣaṇataṭaprā-
ptaye kṛtaprayatnā api tasmādiṣṭārthasiddhimapaśyanto vyāvṛtya syā-
dvādarūpakūpastambhālaṅkṛtatāvakīnaśāsanapravahaṇopasarpaṇameva yadi
śaraṇīkurvate tadā teṣāṃ bhavārṇavādvahirniṣkramaṇamanorathaḥ saphalatāṃ
kalayati nāparatheti kāvyārthaḥ || 19 ||

evaṃ kriyāvādināṃ prāvādukānāṃ katipayakugrahanigrahaṃ vidhāya
sāṃpratamakriyāvādināṃ laukāyatikānāṃ mataṃ sarvādhamatvādante
upanyasyan tanmatamūlasya pratyakṣapramāṇasyānumānādipramāṇāntarā-
naṅgīkāre'kiñcitkaratvapradarśanena teṣāṃ prajñāyāḥ pramādamādarśayati |
vinānumānena parābhisaṃdhi-
masaṃvidānasya tu nāstikasya |
na sāṃprataṃ vaktumapi kva ceṣṭā
kva dṛṣṭamātraṃ ca hahā pramādaḥ || 20 ||

pratyakṣamevaikaṃ pramāṇamiti manyate cārvākaḥ | tatra saṃnahyate ||
anu paścād liṅgasaṃbandhagrahaṇasmaraṇānantaraṃ mīyate paricchidyate
deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭorthonena jñānaviśeṣeṇetyanumānam | prastāvāt
svārthānumānam | tenānumānena laiṅgikapramāṇena vinā parābhisaṃdhiṃ
parābhiprāyam asaṃvidānasya samyagajānānasya | tuśabdaḥ pūrvavādibhyo
bhedadyotanārthaḥ | pūrveṣāṃ vādināmāstikatayā vipratipattisthāneṣu kṣodaḥ
kṛtaḥ nāstikasya tu vaktumapi naucitī kuta eva tena saha kṣoda
iti tuśabdārthaḥ | nāsti paralokaḥ puṇyaṃ pāpamiti vā matirasya |
nāstikāstikadaiṣṭikam iti nipātanānnāstikaḥ | tasya nāstikasya
laukāyatikasya | vaktumapi na sāṃpratam vacanamapyuccārayituṃ no-
citam | tatastūṣṇīṃbhāva evāsya śreyān | dūre prāmāṇikapariṣadi
praviśya pramāṇopanyāsagoṣṭhī | vacanaṃ hi parapratyāyanāya pratipādyate |
pareṇa cāpratipitsitamarthaṃ pratipādayannāsau satāmavadheyavacano bhava-
tyunmattavat | nanu kathamiva tūṣṇīkataivāsya śreyasī yāvatā ceṣṭāviśe-
ṣādinā pratipādyasyābhiprāyamanumāya sukaramevānena vacanoccāraṇa-
mityāśaṅkyāha kva ceṣṭā kva dṛṣṭamātraṃ ca iti | kveti bṛhadantare |
ceṣṭā iṅgitam | parābhiprāyarūpasyānumeyasya liṅgam | kva ca dṛṣṭa-
mātram | darśanaṃ dṛṣṭam | bhāve ktaḥ | dṛṣṭameva dṛṣṭamātram pratyakṣamātram | tasya
liṅganirapekṣapravṛttitvāt | ata eva dūramantarametayoḥ | na hi
pratyakṣeṇātīndriyāḥ paracetovṛttayaḥ parijñātuṃ śakyāḥ | tasyaindriya-
katvāt | mukhaprasādādiceṣṭayā tu liṅgabhūtayā parābhiprāyasya
niścaye anumānapramāṇamanicchatopi tasya balādāpatitam | tathā
hi | madvacanaśravaṇābhiprāyavānayaṃ puruṣaḥ | tādṛgmukhaprasādādiceṣṭā-
'nyathānupapatteriti | ataśca hahā pramādaḥ | hahā iti khede |
aho tasya pramādaḥ pramattatā yadanubhūyamānamapyanumānaṃ pratyakṣa-
mātrāṅgīkāreṇāpahnute | atra saṃpūrvasya vetterakarmakatva evātmane-
padam atra tu karmāsti tatkathamatrānaś | atrocyate | atra
saṃvedituṃ śaktaḥ saṃvidāna iti kāryam | vayaḥśaktiśīle iti
śaktau śānavidhānāt | tataścāyamarthaḥ | anumānena vinā parābhi-
saṃhitaṃ samyagveditumaśaktasyeti | evaṃ parabuddhijñānānyathānupapattyā'-
yamanumānaṃ haṭhādaṅgīkāritaḥ | tathā prakārāntareṇāpyayamaṅgīkāra-
yitavyaḥ | tathā hi | cārvākaḥ kāścijjñānavyaktīḥ saṃvāditvenā-
vyabhicāriṇīrupalabhyānyāśca visaṃvāditvena vyabhicāriṇīḥ punaḥ
kālāntare tādṛśītarāṇāṃ jñānavyaktīnāmavaśyaṃ pramāṇatetarate
vyavasthāpayet | na ca saṃnihitārthabalenotpadyamānaṃ pūrvāparaparāmarśa-
śūnyaṃ pratyakṣa pūrvāparakālabhāvinīnāṃ jñānavyaktīnāṃ prāmāṇyā-
prāmāṇyavyavasthāpakaṃ nimittamupalakṣayituṃ kṣamate | na cāyaṃ svapratī-
tigocarāṇāmapi jñānavyaktīnāṃ paraṃ prati prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ vā
vyavasthāpayituṃ prabhavati | tasmādyathādṛṣṭajñānavyaktisādharmyadvāreṇe-
dānīntanajñānavyaktīnāṃ prāmāṇyāprāmāṇyavyavasthāpakaṃ paraprati-
pādakaṃ ca pramāṇāntaramanumānarūpamupāsīta | paralokādiniṣedhaśca
na pratyakṣamātreṇa śakyaḥ kartum | saṃnihitamātraviṣayatvāttasya |
paralokādikaṃ cāpratiṣidhya nāyaṃ sukhamāste pramāṇāntaraṃ ca
necchatīti ḍimbhahevākaḥ || kiṃca pratyakṣasyāpyarthāvyabhicārādeva
prāmāṇyam | kathamitarathā snānapānāvagāhanādyarthakriyā'samarthe
marumarīcikānicayacumbini jalajñāne na prāmāṇyam | tacca artha-
pratibaddhaliṅgaśabdadvārā samunmajjatoranumānāgamayorapyarthāvyabhicā-
rādeva kiṃ neṣyate | vyabhicāriṇorapyanayordarśanādaprāmāṇyamiti
cet | pratyakṣasyāpi timirādidoṣānniśīthinīnāthayugalāvalambi-
no'pramāṇasya darśanātsarvatrāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ | pratyakṣābhāsaṃ taditi
cet itaratrāpi tulyametadanyatra pakṣapātāt | evaṃ ca pratyakṣamātreṇa
vastuvyavasthānupapatteḥ | tanmūlā jīvapuṇyāpuṇyaparalokaniṣedhādi-
vādā apramāṇameva || evaṃ nāstikābhimato bhūtacidvādopi nirā-
kāryaḥ | tathā ca dravyālaṅkārakāra upayogavarṇane | na cāyaṃ
bhūtadharmaḥ | sattvakaṭhinatvādivat madyāṅgeṣu bhrabhyādimadaśaktivadvā
pratyekamanupalambhāt | anabhivyaktāvātmasiddhiḥ | kāyākārapari-
ṇatebhyastebhyaḥ sa utpadyata iti cet kāyapariṇāmopi tanmātrabhāvī
na kādācitkaḥ | anyastvātmaiva syāt | ahetutve na deśādi-
niyamaḥ | mṛtādapi ca syāt | śoṇitādyupādhiḥ suptādāvapyasti |
na ca satastasyotpattiḥ | bhūyobhūyaḥ prasaṅgāt | alabdhātmanaśca
prasiddhamarthakriyākāritvaṃ virudhyeta | asataḥ sakalaśaktivikalasya
kathamutpattau kartṛtvam | anyasyāpi prasaṅgāt | tanna bhūtakārya-
mupayogaḥ | kutastarhi suptotthitasya tadudayaḥ | asaṃvedanena caitanya-
syābhāvāt | na | jāgradavasthānubhūtasya smagṇāt | asavedanaṃ tu
nidropaghātāt | kathaṃ tarhi kāyavikṛtau caitanyavikṛtiḥ | naikāntaḥ |
śvitrādinā kaśmalavapuṣopi buddhiśuddheḥ | avikāre ca bhāvanāviśeṣataḥ
prītyādibhedadarśanāt | śokādinā buddhivikṛtau kāyavikārādarśanācca |
pariṇāminā vinā ca na kāryotpattiḥ | na ca bhūtānyeva tathā
pariṇamanti | vijātīyatvāt | kāṭhinyāderanupalambhāt | aṇava eve-
ndriyagrāhyatvarūpāṃ sthūlatāṃ pratipadyante tajjātyādi copalabhyate |
tanna bhūtānāṃ dharmaḥ phalaṃ vā upayogaḥ | tathā bhavāṃśca yadākṣipati
tadasya lakṣaṇam | sa cātmā svasaṃviditaḥ | bhūtānāṃ tathābhāve
bahirmukhaṃ syāt | gauro'hamityādi tu nāntarmukham | bāhyakaraṇajanya-
tvāt || anabhyupagatānumānaprāmāṇyasya cātmaniṣedhopi durlabhaḥ |
dharmaḥ phalaṃ ca bhūtānāmupayogā bhavedyadi |
pratyekamupalambhaḥ syādutpādo vā vilakṣaṇāt ||
iti kāvyārthaḥ |

evamuktayuktibhirekāntavādapratikṣepamākhyāya sāṃpratamanādyavi-
dyāvāsanāpravāsitasanmatayaḥ pratyakṣopalakṣyamāṇamapyanekāntavādaṃ
yevamanyante teṣāmunmattatāmāvirbhāvayannāha |
pratikṣaṇotpādavināśayogi-
sthiraikamadhyakṣamapīkṣamāṇaḥ |
jina tvadājñāmavamanyate yaḥ
sa vātakī nātha piśācakī vā || 21 ||

pratikṣaṇaṃ pratisamayam | utpādena uttarākārasvīkārarūpaṇa vinā-
śena ca pūrvākāraparihāralakṣaṇena yujyata ityevaṃśīlaṃ pratikṣaṇotpāda-
vināśayogi | kiṃ tat | sthiraikaṃ karmatāpannam | sthiramutpādavināśayo-
ranuyāyitvāttrikālavarti yadekaṃ dravyaṃ sthiraikam | ekaśabdotra sādhā-
raṇavācī | utpāde vināśe ca tatsādhāraṇam | anvayidravyatvāt | yathā
caitramaitrayorekā jananī sādhāraṇetyarthaḥ | itthameva hi tayorekādhikara-
ṇatā | paryāyāṇāṃ kathaṃcidanekatvepi tasya kathaṃcidekatvāt |
evaṃ trayātmakaṃ vastvadhyakṣamapīkṣamāṇaḥ pratyakṣamavalokayannapi | he
jina rāgādijaitra | tvadājñām ā sāmastyenānantadharmaviśiṣṭatayā
jñāyante avabuddhyante jīvājīvādayaḥ padārthā yayā sājñā āgamaḥ
śāsanam tavājñā tvadājñā tāṃ tvadājñāṃ bhavatpraṇītasyādvādamudrām |
yaḥ kaścidavivekyavamanyate avajānāti | jātyapekṣamekavacanam ava-
jñayā vā | sa puruṣapaśuḥ vātakī piśācakī vā | vāto rogaviśeṣo-
'syāstīti vātakī vātakīva vātakī vātūla ityarthaḥ | evaṃ piśā-
cakīva piśācakī bhūtāviṣṭa ityarthaḥ | atra vāśabdaḥ samuccayārtha
upamānārtho vā | sa puruṣāpasado vātakipiśācakibhyāmadhiro-
hati tulāmityarthaḥ | vātātīsārapiśācātkaścāntaḥ ityanena
matvarthīyaḥ kaścāntaḥ | evaṃ piśācakītyapi | yathā kila vātena
piśācena vākrāntavapurvastutattvaṃ sākṣātkurvannapi tadāveśavaśāda-
nyathā pratipadyate evamayamapyekāntavādāpasmāraparavaśa iti ||

atra ca jineti sābhiprāyam | rāgādijetṛtvāddhi jinaḥ | tataśca
yaḥ kila vigalitadoṣakāluṣyatayāvadheyavacanasyāpi tatrabhavataḥ
śāsanamavamanyate tasya kathaṃ nonmattateti bhāvaḥ | nātha he svāmin |
alabdhasya samyagdarśanāderlambhakatayā labdhasya ca tasyaiva nira-
ticāraparipālanopadeśadāyitayā ca yogakṣemakaratvopapatternāthaḥ |
tasyāmantraṇam |

vastutattvaṃ cotpādavyayadhrauvyātmakam | tathā hi | sarvaṃ vastu
dravyātmanā notpadyate vipadyate vā | parisphuṭamanvayadarśanāt | lūna-
punarjātanakhādiṣvanvayadarśanena vyabhicāra iti na vācyam | pramāṇena
bādhyamānasyānvayasyāparisphuṭatvāt | na ca prastutonvayaḥ pramāṇa-
viruddhaḥ | satyapratyabhijñānasiddhatvāt |
sarvavyaktiṣu niyataṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'nyatvamatha ca na viśeṣaḥ |
satyoścityapacityorākṛtijātivyavasthānāt ||
iti vacanāt | tato dravyātmanā sthitireva sarvasya vastunaḥ |
paryāyātmanā tu sarvaṃ vastūtpadyate vipadyate ca | askhalitaparyāyānubha-
vasadbhāvāt | na caivaṃ śukle śaṅkhe pītādiparyāyānubhavena vyabhicāraḥ |
tasya skhaladrūpatvāt | na khalu soskhaladrūpo yena pūrvākāravināśā-
jahaddhṛtottarākārotpādāvinābhāvī bhavet | na ca jīvādau vastuni
harṣāmarṣaudāsīnyādiparyāyaparaṃparānubhavaḥ skhaladrūpaḥ | kasyacid
bādhakasyābhāvāt | nanūtpādādayaḥ parasparaṃ bhidyante na vā | yadi
bhidyante kathamekaṃ vastu tryātmakam | na bhidyante cet tathāpi katha-
mekaṃ trayātmakam | tathā ca |
yadyutpādādayo bhinnāḥ kathamekaṃ trayātmakam |
athotpādādayo'bhinnāḥ kathamekaṃ trayātmakam ||
iti cet | tadayuktam | kathaṃcidbhinnalakṣaṇatvena teṣāṃ kathaṃci-
dbhedābhyupagamāt | tathā hi | utpādavināśadhrauvyāṇi syādbhi-
nnāni bhinnalakṣaṇatvāt rūpādivaditi | na ca bhinnalakṣaṇatvama-
siddham | asata ātmalābhaḥ sataḥ sattāviyogo dravyarūpatayānu-
vartanaṃ ca khalūtpādādīnāṃ parasparamasaṅkīrṇāni lakṣaṇāni sakala-
lokasākṣikāṇyeva || na cāmī bhinnalakṣaṇā api parasparānapekṣāḥ
khapuṣpavadasattvāpatteḥ | tathāhi | utpādaḥ kevalo nāsti | sthiti-
vigamarahitatvāt kūrmaromavat | tathā vināśaḥ kevalo nāsti |
sthityutpattirahitatvāt tadvat | evaṃ sthitiḥ kevalā nāsti |
vināśotpādaśūnyatvāt tadvadeva | ityanyonyāpekṣāṇāmutpādādīnāṃ
vastuni sattvaṃ pratipattavyam | tathā coktam |
ghaṭamaulisuvarṇārthī nāśotpādasthitiṣvayam |
śokapramodamādhyasthyaṃ jano yāti sahetukam ||
payovrato na dadhyatti na payo'tti dadhivrataḥ |
agorasavrato nobhe tasmādvastu trayātmakam ||
iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

athānyayogavyavacchedasya prastutatvādāstāṃ tāvatsākṣādbhavān
bhavadīyapravacanāvayavā api paratīrthikatiraskārabaddhakakṣā ityā-
śayavān stutikāraḥ syādvādavyavasthāpanāya prayogamupanyasyan
stutimāha |
anantadharmātmakameva tattva-
matonyathā sattvamasūpapādam |
iti pramāṇānyapi te kuvādi-
kuraṅgasaṃtrāsanasiṃhanādāḥ || 22 ||

tattvaṃ paramārthabhūtaṃ vastu jīvājīvalakṣaṇamanantadharmātmaka-
meva | anantāstrikālaviṣayatvādaparimitā ye dharmāḥ sahabhā-
vinaḥ kramabhāvinaśca paryāya sta evātmā svarūpaṃ yasya tadananta-
dharmātmakam | evakāraḥ prakārāntaravyavacchedārthaḥ | ata evāha
atonyathā ityādi | atonyathā uktaprakāravaiparītyena | sattvaṃ
vastutattvam | asūpapādam sukhenopapādyate ghaṭanākoṭisaṃṭaṅkamāropyata
iti sūpapādam na tathā asūpapādaṃ durghaṭamityarthaḥ | anena sādhanaṃ
darśitam | tathāhi | tattvamiti dharmi | anantadharmātmakatvaṃ sādhyo
dharmaḥ | sattvānyathānupapatteriti hetuḥ | anyathānupapattyekalakṣaṇatvā-
ddhetoḥ | antarvyāptyaiva sādhyasya siddhatvāddṛṣṭāntādibhirna prayo-
janam | yadanantadharmātmakaṃ na bhavati tatsadapi na bhavati yathā
viyadindīvaramiti kevalavyatirekī hetuḥ | sādharmyadṛṣṭāntānāṃ
pakṣakukṣinikṣiptatvenānvayāyogāt | anantadharmātmakatvaṃ cātmani
tāvatsākārānākāropayogitā kartṛtvaṃ bhoktṛtvaṃ pradeśāṣṭakaniścalatā
amūrtatvamasaṃkhyātapradeśātmakatā jīvatvamityādayaḥ sahabhāvino
dharmāḥ | harṣaviṣādaśokasukhaduḥkhadevanaranārakatiryaktvādayastu krama-
bhāvinaḥ | dharmāstikāyādiṣvapyasaṃkhyeyapradeśātmakatvaṃ gatyādyupa-
grahakāritvaṃ matyādijñānaviṣayatvaṃ tattadavacchedakāvacchedyatvamavasthi-
tatvamarūpitvamekadravyatvaṃ niṣkriyatvamityādayaḥ | ghaṭe punarāmatvaṃ
pākajarūpādimattvaṃ pṛthubughnodaratvaṃ kambugrīvatvaṃ jalādidhāraṇā-
haraṇasāmarthyaṃ matyādijñānajñeyatvaṃ navatvaṃ purāṇatvamityādayaḥ |
evaṃ sarvapadārtheṣvapi nānānayamatābhijñena śābdānārthāṃśca paryāyā-
npratītya vācyam ||

atra cātmaśabdenānanteṣvapi dharmeṣvanuvṛttirūpamanvayidravyaṃ
dhvanitam | tataśca utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat iti vyavasthitam |
evaṃ tāvadartheṣu | śabdeṣvapi udāttānudāttasvaritavivṛtasaṃvṛtaghoṣa--
vadaghoṣatālpaprāṇamahāprāṇatādayastattadarthapratyāyanaśaktyādayaścāva--
seyāḥ | asya hetorasiddhaviruddhānaikāntikatvādikaṇṭakoddhāraḥ
svayamabhyūhyaḥ | ityevamullekhaśekharāṇi te tava pramāṇānyapi
nyāyopapannasādhanavākyānyapi | āstāṃ tāvatsākṣātkṛtadravyaparyāya-
nikāyo bhavān | tāvadetānyapi kuvādikuraṅgasaṃtrāsanasiṃhanādāḥ
kuvādinaḥ kutsitavādinaḥ | ekāṃśagrāhakanayānuyāyinonyatīrthi-
kāḥ ta eva saṃsāravanagahanavasanavyasanitayā kuraṅgā mṛgāsteṣāṃ
samyaktrāsane siṃhanādā iva siṃhanādāḥ | yathā siṃhasya nādamātra-
mapyākarṇya kuraṅgāstrāsamāsūtrayanti tathā bhavatpraṇītaivaṃprakārapramāṇa-
vacanānyapi śrutvā kuvādinastrasnutāmaśnuvate | prativacanapradāna-
kātaratāṃ bibhratīti yāvat | ekaikaṃ tvadupajñaṃ pramāṇamanyayogavyava-
cchedakamityarthaḥ ||

atra pramāṇānīti bahuvacanamevaṃjātīyānāṃ pramāṇānāṃ
bhagavacchāsane ānantyajñāpanārtham | ekaikasya sūtrasya sarvodadhi-
salilasarvasaridvālukānantaguṇārthatvāt | teṣāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi sarva-
vinmūlatayā pramāṇatvāt | athavā ityādibahuvacanāntā gaṇasya
saṃsūcakā bhavantīti nyāyāt itiśabdena pramāṇabāhulyasū-
canāt pūrvārdhe ekasminnapi pramāṇe upanyaste ucitameva bahuva-
canam || iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

anantaramanantadharmātmakatvaṃ vastuni sādhyaṃ mukulitamuktam |
tadeva saptabhaṅgīprarūpaṇadvāreṇa prapañcayan bhagavato niratiśayaṃ
vacanātiśayaṃ ca stuvannāha |
aparyayaṃ vastu samasyamāna-
madravyametacca vivicyamānam |
ādeśabhedoditasaptabhaṅga-
madīdṛśastvaṃ budharūpavedyam || 23 ||

samasyamānaṃ saṃkṣepeṇocyamānaṃ vastu aparyayam avivakṣitaparyāyam |
vasanti guṇaparyāyā asminniti vastu dharmādharmākāśapudgala-
kālajīvalakṣaṇaṃ dravyaṣaṭkam | ayamabhiprāyaḥ | yadaikameva vastvātma-
ghaṭādikaṃ cetanācetanaṃ satāmapi paryāyāṇāmavivakṣayā dravyarūpameva
vaktumiṣyate tadā saṃkṣepeṇābhyantarīkṛtasakalaparyāyanikāyatvalakṣa
ṇenābhidhīyamānatvādaparyayamityupadiśyate | kevaladravyarūpamevetyarthaḥ |
yathātmāyaṃ ghaṭoyamityādi | paryāyāṇāṃ dravyānatirekāt | ata eva
dravyāstikanayāḥ śuddhasaṃgrahādayo dravyamātramevecchanti | paryāyāṇāṃ
tadaviṣvagbhūtatvāt | paryayaḥ paryavaḥ paryāyaḥ ityanarthāntaram |
adravyamityādi | caḥ punararthe | sa ca pūrvasmādviśeṣadyotane bhinnakramaśca |
vivicyamānaṃ ceti vivekena pṛthagrūpatayocyamānam | punaretadvastu
adravyameva | avivakṣitānvayidravyaṃ kevalaparyāyarūpamityarthaḥ ||

yadā hyātmā jñānadarśanādīnparyāyānadhikṛtya pratiparyāyaṃ vicā-
ryate tadā paryāyā eva pratibhāsante na punarātmākhyaṃ kimapi
dravyam | evaṃ ghaṭopi kuṇḍalauṣṭhapṛthubudhnodarapūrvāparādibhāgādya-
vayavāpekṣayā vivicyamānaḥ paryāyā eva na punarghaṭākhyaṃ tadatiriktaṃ
vastu | ata eva paryāyāstikanayānupātinaḥ paṭhanti |
bhāgā eva hi bhāsante saṃniviṣṭāstathā tathā |
tadvānnaiva punaḥ kaścinnirbhāgaḥ saṃpratīyate ||
iti | tataśca dravyaparyāyobhayātmakatvepi vastuno dravyanayārpaṇayā
paryāyanayānarpaṇayā ca dravyarūpatā paryāyanayārpaṇayā dravyanayā-
narpaṇayā ca paryāyarūpatā ubhayanayārpaṇayā ca tadubhayarūpatā | ata
evāha vācakamukhyaḥ arpitānarpitasiddheḥ iti | evaṃvidhaṃ dravyaparyā-
yātmakaṃ vastu tvameva adīdṛśaḥ tvameva darśitavān | nānya iti
kākvāvadhāraṇāvagatiḥ ||

nanvanyābhidhānapratyayayogyaṃ dravyamamanyābhidhānapratyayaviṣayāśca
paryāyāḥ tatkathamekameva vastūbhayātmakamityāśaṅkya viśeṣaṇa-
dvāreṇa pariharati ādeśabhedetyādi | ādeśabhedena sakalādeśa-
vikalādeśalakṣaṇenādeśadvayenoditāḥ pratipāditāḥ saptasaṃkhyā
bhaṅgā vacanaprakārā yasmin vastuni tattathā | nanu yadi bhagavatā tribhu-
vanabandhunā nirviśeṣatayā sarvebhya evaṃvidhaṃ vastutattvamupadarśitaṃ tarhi
kimarthaṃ tīrthāntarīyāḥ tatra vipratipadyanta ityāha budha-
rūpavedyamiti | budhyante yathāvasthitaṃ vastutattvaṃ sāretaraviṣayavi-
bhāgavicāraṇayā iti budhāḥ | prakṛṣṭā budhā budharūpāḥ naisargikā-
dhigamikānyatarasamyagdarśanaviśadīkṛtajñānaśālinaḥ prāṇinaḥ | tairava
vedituṃ śakyaṃ vedyaṃ paricchedyam | na punaḥ svasvaśāstratattvābhyāsa-
paripākaśāṇāniśātabuddhibhirapyanyaiḥ | teṣāmanādimithyādarśana-
vāsanādūṣitamatitayā yathāsthitavastutattvānavabodhena budharūpatvā-
bhāvāt | tathā cāgamaḥ |
sadasadavisesaṇāu bhavaheujahicchiovalaṃbhāu |
ṇāṇaphalābhāvāu micchādiṭhṭhissa aṇṇāṇaṃ || 1 ||
ata eva tatparigṛhītaṃ dvādaśāṅgamapi mithyāśrutamāmananti |
teṣāmupapattinirapekṣaṃ yadṛcchayā vastutattvopalambhasaṃrambhāt | samya-
gdṛṣṭiparigṛhītaṃ tu mithyāśrutamapi samyakśrutatayā pariṇamati
samyagdṛśām | sarvavidupadeśānusāripravṛttitayā mithyāśrutoktasyā-
pyarthasya yathāvasthitavidhiniṣedhaviṣayatayonnayanāt | tathā hi
kila vede ajairyaṣṭavyam ityādivākyeṣu mithyādṛśo'jaśabdaṃ
paśuvācakatayā vyācakṣate samyagdṛśastu janmāprāyogyaṃ trivārṣikaṃ
yavavrīhyādi pañcavārṣikaṃ tilamasūrādi saptavārṣikaṃ kaṅgusarṣapādi
dhānyaparyāyatayā paryavasāyayanti | ata eva ca bhagavatā śrīvardha-
mānasvāminā vijñānaghana evaitebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānu
vinaśyati na pretya saṃjñāsti ityādiṛcaḥ śrīmadindrabhūtyādīnāṃ
dravyagaṇadharadevānāṃ jīvādiniṣedhakatayā pratibhāsamānā api
tadvyavasthāpakatayā vyākhyātāḥ | tathā smārtā api
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune |
pravṛttireṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttistu mahāphalā ||
iti ślokaṃ paṭhanti | asya ca yathāśrutārthavyākhyāne'saṃbaddha-
pralāpa eva | yasmin hyanuṣṭhīyamāne doṣo nāstyeva tasmānnivṛttiḥ
kathamiva mahāphalā bhaviṣyati | ijyādhyayanadānāderapi nivṛtti-
prasaṅgāt | tasmādanyadaidaṃparyamasya ślokasya | tathāhi na māṃsabhakṣaṇe
kṛte adoṣaḥ api tu doṣa eva | evaṃ madyamaithunayorapi | kathaṃ
nādoṣa ityāha yataḥ pravṛttireṣā bhūtānām | pravartanta utpadyante'-
syāmiti pravṛttiḥ utpattisthānam | bhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ tattajjīvasaṃsa-
ktiheturityarthaḥ | prasiddhaṃ ca māṃsamadyamaithunānāṃ jīvasaṃsaktimūlakāra-
ṇatvamāgame |
āmāsu ya pakkāsu ya vipaccamāṇāsu maṃsapesīsu |
āyaṃtiamuvavāo bhaṇio u ṇigoajīvāṇaṃ || 1 ||
majje mahummi maṃsammi ṇavaṇīyammi cautthae |
uppajjaṃti aṇaṃtā tavvaṇṇā tattha jaṃtuṇo || 2 ||
mehuṇasaṇṇārūḍho ṇavalakkha haṇei suhumajīvāṇaṃ |
kevaliṇā paṇṇattā saddahiavvā sayā kālaṃ || 3 ||
tathāhi
itthījoṇīe saṃbhavaṃti beiṃdiyā u je jīvā |
ikko va do tiṇṇi va lakkhapuhuttaṃ ca ukkosaṃ || 4 ||
puriseṇa saha gayāe tesiṃ jīvāṇa hoi uddavaṇaṃ |
veṇugadiṭhṭhaṃtaṇaṃ tattāyasalāgaṇāeṇaṃ || 5 ||
saṃsaktāyāṃ yonau dvīndriyā ete | śukraśoṇitasaṃbhavāstu garbhaja-
pañcendriyā ime |
paṃciṃdiyā maṇussā egaṇarabhuttaṇārigabbhammi |
ukkosaṃ ṇavalakkhā jāyaṃti egavelāe || 6 ||
ṇavalakkhāṇaṃ majjhe jāyai ikkassa duṇha va samattī |
sesā puṇa emeva ya vilayaṃ vaccaṃti tattheva || 7 ||
tadevaṃ jīvopamardahetutvānna māṃsabhakṣaṇādikamaduṣṭamiti prayogaḥ |
athavā bhūtānāṃ piśācaprāyāṇāmeṣā pravṛttiḥ | ta evātra māṃsabhakṣaṇā-
dau pravartante na punarvivekina iti bhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇāde-
rduṣṭatāṃ spaṣṭīkṛtya yadupadeṣṭavyaṃ tadāha | nivṛttistu mahāphalā | tureva-
kārārthaḥ | tuḥ syādbhedevadhāraṇe iti vacanāt | tataścaitebhyo māṃsa-
bhakṣaṇādibhyo nivṛttireva mahāphalā svargāpavargaphalapradā na punaḥ pravṛ-
ttirapītyarthaḥ | ata eva sthānāntare paṭhitam
varṣe varṣeśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |
māṃsāni ca na khādedyastayostulyaṃ bhavetphalam ||
ekarātroṣitasyāpi yā gatirbrahmacāriṇaḥ |
na sā kratusahasreṇa prāptuṃ śakyā yudhiṣṭhira ||

madyapāne tu kṛtaṃ sūtrānuvādaiḥ | tasya sarvavigarhitatvāt | tānevaṃ-
prakārānarthātkathamiva budhābhāsāstīrthikā veditumarhantīti kṛtamati-
prasaṅgena ||

atha ke'mī saptabhaṅgāḥ kaścāyamādeśabheda ityucyate | ekatra
jīvādau vastunyekaikasattvādidharmaviṣayapraśnavaśādavirodhena pratyakṣā-
divādhāparihāreṇa pṛthagbhūtayoḥ samuditayośca vidhiniṣedhayoḥ paryā-
locanayā kṛtvā syācchabdalāñchito vakṣyamāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ prakārairva-
canavinyāsaḥ saptabhaṅgīti gīyate | tadyathā | syādastyeva sarvamiti
vidhikalpanayā prathamo bhaṅgaḥ 1 | syānnāstyeva sarvamiti niṣedha-
kalpanayā dvitīyaḥ 2 | syādastyeva syānnāstyeveti kramato vidhi-
niṣedhakalpanayā tṛtīyaḥ 3 | syādavaktavyaveti yugapadvidhi--
niṣedhakalpanayā caturthaḥ 4 | syādastyeva syādavaktavyameveti vidhika-
lpanayā yugapadvidhiniṣedhakalpanayā ca pañcamaḥ 5 | syānnāstyeva
syādavaktavyameveti niṣedhakalpanayā yugapadvidhiniṣedhakalpanayā ca
ṣaṣṭhaḥ 6 | syādastyeva syānnāstyeva syādavaktavyameveti kramato
vidhiniṣedhakalpanayā yugapadvidhiniṣedhakalpanayā ca saptamaḥ 7 ||

tatra syātkathaṃcit svadravyakṣetrakālabhāvarūpeṇāstyeva sarvaṃ ku-
mbhādi na punaḥ paradravyakṣetrakālabhāvarūpeṇa | tathāhi kumbho dravyataḥ
pārthivatvenāsti nāpyādirūpatvena | kṣetrataḥ pāṭaliputrakatvena na
kānyakubjāditvena | kālataḥ śaiśiratvena na vāsantikāditvena |
bhāvataḥ śyāmatvena na raktāditvena | anyathetararūpāpattyā svarūpa-
hāniprasaṅga iti | avadhāraṇāṃ cātra bhaṅge'nabhimatārthavyāvṛttyartha-
mupāttam | itarathānabhibhihitatulyataivāsya vākyasya prasajyeta |
pratiniyatasvārthānabhidhānāt | yaduktam
vākye'vadhāraṇaṃ tāvadaniṣṭārthanivṛttaye |
kartavyamanyathānuktasamatvāttasya kutracit ||
tathāpyastyeva kumbha ityetāvanmātropādāne kumbhasya stambhādya-
stitvenāpi sarvaprakāreṇāstitvaprāpteḥ pratiniyatasvarūpānupapattiḥ
syāt | tatpratipattaye syāditi śabdaḥ prayujyate | syātkathaṃcitsvadra-
vyādibhirevāyamasti na paradravyādibhirapītyarthaḥ | yatrāpi cāstai
na prayujyate tatrāpi vyavacchedaphalaivakāravad buddhimadbhiḥ pratīyata
eva | yaduktam
so'prayuktopi vā tajjñaiḥ sarvatrārthātpratīyate |
yathaivakāro'yogādivyavacchedaprayojanaḥ || 1 ||
iti prathamo bhaṅgaḥ ||

syātkathañcinnāstyeva kumbhādiḥ svadravyādibhireva paradravyādi-
bhirapi vastuno'sattvāniṣṭau hi pratiniyatasvarūpābhāvādva-
stupratiniyatirna syāt | na cāstitvaikāntavādibhiratra
nāstitvamasiddhamiti vaktavyam | kathaṃcittasya vastuni yuktisiddha-
tvāt sādhanavat | nahi kvacidanityatvādau sādhye sattvādisādha-
nasyāstitvaṃ vipakṣe nāstitvamantareṇopapannam | tasya sādhanatvā-
bhāvaprasaṅgāt | tasmād vastunostitvaṃ nāstitvenāvinābhūtaṃ
nāstitvaṃ ca teneti | vivakṣāvaśāccānayoḥ pradhānopasarjanabhāvaḥ |
evamuttarabhaṅgeṣvapi jñeyam | arpitānarpitasiddheḥ iti vācakavacanāt |
iti dvitīyaḥ ||
tṛtīyaḥ spaṣṭa eva ||

dvābhyāmastitvanāstitvadharmābhyāṃ yugapatpradhānatayā'rpitā-
bhyāmekasya vastuno'bhidhitsāyāṃ tādṛśasya śabdasyāsaṃbhavāda-
vaktavyaṃ jīvādivastu | tathāhi sadasattvaguṇadvayaṃ yugapadekatra
sadityanena vaktumaśakyam | tasyāsattvapratipādanāsamarthatvāt | tathā'-
sadityanenāpi | tasya sattvapratyāyanasāmarthyābhāvāt | na ca puṣpa-
dantādivatsāṅketikamekaṃ padaṃ tadvaktuṃ samartham tasyāpi krameṇārtha-
dvayapratyāyane sāmarthyopapatteḥ | śatṛśānayoḥ saṃketitasacchabdavat |
ata eva dvandvakarmadhārayavṛttyorvākyasya ca na tadvācakatvam | iti
sakalavācakarahitatvādavaktavyaṃ vastu yugapatsattvāsattvābhyāṃ pradhāna-
bhāvārpitābhyāmākrāntaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate | na ca sarvathā'vaktavyam |
avaktavyaśabdenāpyanabhidheyatvaprasaṅgāt | iti caturthaḥ ||
śeṣāstrayaḥ sugamābhiprāyāḥ ||

na ca vācyamekatra vastuni vidhīyamānaniṣidhyamānānanta-
dharmābhyupagamenānantabhaṅgīprasaṅgādasaṃgataiva saptabhaṅgīti | vidhiniṣedha-
prakārāpekṣayā pratiparyāyaṃ vastunyanantānāmapi saptabhaṅgīnāmeva
saṃbhavāt | yathā hi sadasattvābhyāmevaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāmapi
saptabhaṅgyeva syāt | tathāhi | syātsāmānyaṃ syādviśeṣaḥ
syādubhayaṃ syādavaktavyaṃ syātsāmānyāvaktavyaṃ syādviśeṣāvaktavyaṃ
syātsāmānyaviśeṣāvaktavyamiti | na cātra vidhiniṣedhaprakārau na
sta iti vācyam | sāmānyasya vidhirūpatvādviśeṣasya ca vyāvṛtti-
rūpatayā niṣedhātmakatvāt | athavā pratipakṣaśabdatvādyadā sāmā-
nyasya prādhānyaṃ tadā tasya vidhirūpatā viśeṣasya ca niṣedharūpatā
yadā viśeṣasya puraskārastadā tasya vidhirūpatā itarasya ca niṣedha-
rūpatā | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam | ataḥ suṣṭhūktam anantā api saptabhaṅgya
eva bhaveyuḥ iti | pratiparyāyaṃ pratipādyaparyanuyogānāṃ saptānāmeva
saṃbhavāt | teṣāmapi saptatvaṃ saptavidhatajjijñāsāniyamāt | tasyā
api saptavidhatvaṃ saptadhaiva tatsaṃdehasamutpādāt | tasyāpi saptavidhatva-
niyamaḥ svagocaravastudharmāṇāṃ saptavidhatvasyaivopapatteriti | iyaṃ
ca saptabhaṅgī pratibhaṅgaṃ sakalādeśasvabhāvā vikalādeśasvabhāvā
ca | tatra sakalādeśaḥ pramāṇavākyam | tallakṣaṇaṃ cedam | pramāṇa-
pratipannānantadharmātmakavastunaḥ kālādibhirabhedavṛttiprādhānyāda-
bhedopacārādvā yaugapadyena pratipādakaṃ vacaḥ sakalādeśaḥ | asyārthaḥ |
kālādibhiraṣṭabhiḥ kṛtvā yadabhedavṛtterdharmadharmiṇorapṛthagbhāvasya
prādhānyaṃ tasmātkālādibhirbhinnātmanāmapi dharmadharmiṇāmabhedā-
dhyāropādvā samakālamabhidhāyakaṃ vākyaṃ sakalādeśaḥ | tadviparī-
tastu vikalādeśo nayavākyamityarthaḥ | ayamāśayaḥ | yaugapadye-
nāśeṣadharmātmakaṃ vastu kālādibhirabhedaprādhānyavṛttyā'bhedopacāreṇa
vā pratipādayati sakalādeśaḥ | tasya pramāṇādhīnatvāt | vikalā-
deśastu krameṇa bhedopacārādbhedaprādhānyādvā tadabhidhatte | tasya nayā-
tmakatvāt ||

kaḥ punaḥ kramaḥ kiṃ ca yaugapadyam | yadā'stitvādidharmāṇāṃ
kālādibhirbhedavivakṣā tadaikaśabdasyānekārthapratyāyane śaktya-
bhāvāt kramaḥ | yadā tu teṣāmeva dharmāṇāṃ kālādibhirabhedena vṛtta-
mātmarūpamucyate tadaikenāpi śabdenaikadharmapratyāyanamukhena tadā-
tmakatāmāpannasyānekaśeṣadharmarūpasya vastunaḥ pratipādanasaṃbhavādyau-
gapadyam ||

ke punaḥ kālādayaḥ | kālaḥ ātmarūpam arthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ
upakāraḥ guṇideśaḥ saṃsargaḥ śabdaḥ | tatra syājjīvādi-
vastvastyevetyatra yatkālamastitvaṃ tatkālāḥ śeṣānantadharmā vastu-
nyekatreti teṣāṃ kālenābhedavṛttiḥ (1) | yadeva cāstitvasya tadguṇa-
tvamātmarūpaṃ tadevānyānantaguṇānāmapītyātmarūpeṇābhedavṛttiḥ (2) |
ya eva cādhāro'rtho dravyākhyostitvasya sa evānyaparyāyāṇā-
mityarthenābhedavṛttiḥ (3) | ya eva cāviṣvagbhāvaḥ kathaṃcittā-
dātmyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhostitvasya sa eva śeṣaviśeṣāṇāmiti
saṃbandhenābhedavṛttiḥ (4) | ya eva copakāro'stitvena svānurakta-
tvakaraṇaṃ sa eva śeṣairapi guṇairityupakāreṇābhedavṛttiḥ (5) | ya eva
guṇinaḥ saṃbandhī deśaḥ kṣetralakṣaṇostitvasya sa evānyaguṇānā-
miti guṇideśenābhedavṛttiḥ (6) | ya eva caikavastvātmanāstitvasya
saṃsargaḥ sa eva śeṣadharmāṇāmiti saṃsargeṇābhedavṛttiḥ (7) | avi-
ṣvagbhāve'bhedaḥ pradhānaṃ bhedo gauṇaḥ saṃsarge tu bhedaḥ pradhānama-
bhedo gauṇa iti viśeṣaḥ | ya eva cāstīti śabdostitvadharmā-
tmakasya vastuno vācakaḥ sa eva śeṣānantadharmātmakasyāpīti śabde-
nābhedavṛttiḥ (8) paryāyārthikanayaguṇabhāve dravyārthikanayaprādhānyā-
dupapadyate dravyārthikaguṇabhāve paryāyārthikaprādhānye tu na guṇā-
nāmabhedavṛttiḥ saṃbhavati | samakālamekatra nānāguṇānāmasaṃbhavāt |
saṃbhave vā tadāśrayasya tāvaddhā bhedaprasaṅgāt | nānāguṇānāṃ saṃba-
ndhina ātmarūpasya ca bhinnatvāt | ātmarūpā'bhede teṣāṃ bhedasya
virodhāt | svāśrayasyārthasyāpi nānātvāt anyathā nānāguṇā-
śrayatvasya virodhāt | saṃbandhasya ca saṃbandhibhedena bhedadarśanāt
nānāsaṃbandhibhirekatraikasaṃbandhāghaṭanāt | taiḥ kriyamāṇasyopa-
kārasya ca pratiniyatarūpasyānekatvāt anekairupakāribhiḥ kriya-
māṇasyopakārasya virodhāt | guṇideśasya ca pratiguṇaṃ bhedāt tada-
bhede bhinnārthaguṇānāmapi guṇideśābhedaprasaṅgāt | saṃsargasya ca
pratisaṃsargibhedāt tadabhede saṃsargibhedavirodhāt | śabdasya prati-
viṣayaṃ nānātvāt sarvaguṇānāmekaśabdavācyatāyāṃ sarvārthānāmeka-
śabdavācyatāpatteḥ śabdāntaravaikalyāpattiḥ | tattvatostitvādī-
nāmekatra vastunyevamabhedavṛtterasaṃbhave kālādibhirbhinnātmanāma-
bhedopacāraḥ kriyate | tadetābhyāmabhedavṛttyabhedopacārābhyāṃ kṛtvā
pramāṇapratipannānantadharmātmakasya vastunaḥ samasamayaṃ yadabhidhāyakaṃ
vākyaṃ sa sakalādeśaḥ pramāṇavākyāparaparyāyaḥ | nayaviṣayīkṛtasya
vastudharmasya bhedavṛttiprādhānyādbhedopacārādvā krameṇa yadabhidhāyakaṃ
vākyaṃ sa vikalādeśo nayavākyāparaparyāyaḥ | iti sthitam | tataḥ
sādhūktam ādeśabhedoditasaptabhaṅgam || iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

anantaraṃ bhagavaddarśitasyānekāntātmano vastuno budharūpa-
vedyatvamuktam | anekāntātmakatvaṃ ca saptabhaṅgīprarūpaṇena sukho-
nneyaṃ syāditi sāpi nirūpitā | tasyāṃ ca viruddhadharmādhyāsitaṃ
vastu paśyanta ekāntavādino'budharūpā virodhamudbhāvayanti teṣāṃ
pramāṇamārgāccyavanamāha |
upādhibhedopahitaṃ viruddhaṃ
nārtheṣvāsattvaṃ sadavācyate ca |
ityaprabudhyaiva virodhabhītā
jaḍāstadekāntahatāḥ patanti || 24 ||

artheṣu padārtheṣu cetanācetaneṣvasattvaṃ nāstitvaṃ na viruddhaṃ na
virodhāvaruddham | astitvena saha virodhaṃ nānubhavatītyarthaḥ | na
kevalamasattvaṃ na viruddhaṃ kiṃtu sadavācyate ca | saccāvācyaṃ ca
sadavācye tayorbhāvau sadavācyate | astitvāvaktavyatve ityarthaḥ |
te api na viruddhe || tathā hi | astitvaṃ nāstitvena saha na
virudhyate | avaktavyatvamapi vidhiniṣedhātmakamanyonyaṃ na virudhyate |
athavā avaktavyatvaṃ vaktavyatvena sākaṃ na virodhamudvahati | anena ca
nāstitvā'stitvā'vaktavyatvalakṣaṇabhaṅgakatrayeṇa sakalasaptabhaṅgyā
nirvirodhatopalakṣitā | amīṣāmeva trayāṇāṃ mukhyatvāccheṣa-
bhaṅgānāṃ ca saṃyogajatvenāmīṣvevāntarbhāvāditi || nanvete dharmāḥ
parasparaṃ viruddhāstatkathamekatra vastunyeṣāṃ samāveśaḥ saṃbhavatī-
ti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetumāha upādhibhedopahitam iti | upādhayo'-
vacchedakā aṃśaprakārāḥ teṣāṃ bhedo nānātvam tenopahitam arpitam |
sattvasya viśeṣaṇametat | upādhibhedopahitaṃ sadartheṣvasattvaṃ na
viruddham | sadavācyatayośca vacanabhedaṃ kṛtvā yojanīyam |
upādhibhedopahite satī sadavācyate api na viruddhe |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ | parasparaparihāreṇa ye vartete tayoḥ śītoṣṇava-
tsahānavasthānalakṣaṇo virodhaḥ | na cātraivam | sattvāsattvayori-
taretaramaviṣvagbhāvena vartanāt | nahi ghaṭādau sattvamasattvaṃ pari-
hṛtya vartate | pararūpeṇāpi sattvaprasaṅgāt | tathā ca tadvyatiri-
ktārthāntarāṇāṃ nairarthakyam | tenaiva tribhuvanārthasādhyārthakriyāṇāṃ
siddheḥ | na cāsattvaṃ sattvaṃ parihṛtya vartate | svarūpeṇāpyasattvaprāpteḥ |
tathā ca nirupākhyatvātsarvaśūnyateti | tadā hi virodhaḥ syād
yadyekopādhikaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ ca syāt | na caivam | yato na hi yenai-
vāṃśena sattvaṃ tenaivāsattvamapi | kiṃtvanyopādhikaṃ sattvanyo-
pādhikaṃ punarasattvam | svarūpeṇa hi sattvaṃ pararūpeṇa cāsattvam |
dṛṣṭaṃ hyekasminneva citrapaṭāvayavinyanyopādhikaṃ tu nīlatvamanyo-
pādhikāścetare varṇāḥ | nīlatvaṃ hi nīlīrāgādyupādhikaṃ varṇā-
ntarāṇi ca tattadrañjanadravyopādhikāni | evaṃ mecakaratnepi tatta-
dvarṇapudgalopādhikaṃ vaicitryamavaseyam | na caibhirdṛṣṭāntaiḥ sattvā-
sattvayorbhinnadeśatvaprāptiḥ | citrapaṭādyavayavina ekatvāt | tatrāpi
bhinnadeśatvāsiddheḥ | kathaṃcitpakṣastu dṛṣṭānte dārṣṭāntike ca syādvā-
dināṃ na durlabhaḥ ||

evamapyaparitoṣaścedāyuṣmatastarhyekasyaiva puṃsastattadupādhibhedātpi-
tṛtvaputratvamātulatvabhāgineyatvapitṛvyatvabhrātṛvyatvādidharmāṇāṃ para-
sparaviruddhānāmapi prasiddhidarśanātkiṃ vācyam | evamavaktavyatvā-
dayopi vācyā iti | uktaprakāreṇopādhibhedena vāstavaṃ virodhābhā-
vamaprabudhyaivaajñātvaiva | evakāro'vadhāraṇe | sa ca teṣāṃ samyagjñāna-
syābhāva eva na punarleśato'pi bhāva iti vyanakti | tataste virodha-
bhītāḥ sattvāsattvādidharmāṇāṃ bahirmukhaśemuṣyā saṃbhāvito vā
virodhaḥ sahānavasthānādistasmādbhītāḥ trastamānasāḥ | ata eva
jaḍāḥ tāttvikabhayahetorabhāvepi tathāvidhapaśuvadbhīrutvānmūrkhāḥ para-
vādinaḥ | tadekāntahatāḥ teṣāṃ sattvādidharmāṇāṃ ya ekānta itara-
dharmaniṣedhena svābhipretadharmavyavasthāpananiścayastena hatā iva hatāḥ
patanti skhalanti patitāśca santaste nyāyamārgākramaṇe na samarthā
nyāyamārgādhvanīnānāṃ ca sarveṣāmapyākramaṇīyatāṃ yāntāṃti bhāvaḥ |
yadvā patantīti pramāṇamārgataścayavante | loke hi sanmārgacyutaḥ
patita iti paribhāṣyate | athavā yathā vajrādiparihāreṇa hataḥ
patito mūrcchāmatucchāmāsādya niruddhavākprasaro bhavatyevaṃ tepi
vādinaḥ svābhimataikāntavādena yuktisaraṇimananusaratā vajrāśani-
prāyeṇa nihatāḥ santaḥ syādvādināṃ purato'kiṃcitkarā vāṅmātra-
mapi noccārayitumīśata iti ||

atra ca virodhasyopalakṣaṇatvād vaiyadhikaraṇyam anavasthā saṃkaraḥ
vyatikaraḥ saṃśayaḥ apratipattiḥ viṣayavyavasthāhāniḥ ityetepi
parodbhāvitā doṣā abhyūhyāḥ || tathāhi | sāmānyaviśeṣātmakaṃ
vastvityupanyaste pare upālabdhāro bhavanti | yathā sāmānya-
viśeṣayorvidhipratiṣedharūpayorviruddhadharmayorekatrābhinne vastunyasaṃ-
bhavācchītoṣṇavaditi virodhaḥ | na hi yadeva vidheradhikaraṇaṃ
tadeva pratiṣedhasyādhikaraṇaṃ bhavitumarhatyekarūpatāpatteḥ tato vaiya-
dhikaraṇyamapi bhavati || aparaṃ yenātmanā sāmānyasyādhikaraṇaṃ yena
ca viśeṣasya tāvapyātmānau ekenaiva svabhāvenādhikaroti dvābhyāṃ
vā svabhāvābhyām | ekenaiva cet tatra pūrvavadvirodhaḥ | dvābhyāṃ
vā svabhāvābhyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣākhyaṃ svabhāvadvayamadhikaroti
tadānavasthā tāvapi svabhāvāntarābhyāṃ tāvapi svabhāvānta-
rābhyāmiti || yenātmanā sāmānyasyādhikaraṇaṃ tena sāmānyasya
viśeṣasya ca yena ca viśeṣasyādhikaraṇaṃ tena viśeṣasya sāmā-
nyasya cati saṃkaradoṣaḥ || yena svabhāvena sāmānyaṃ tena viśeṣo
yena viśeṣastena sāmānyamiti vyatikaraḥ || tataśca vastuno'sādhā-
raṇākāreṇa niścetumaśakteḥ saṃśayaḥ || tataścāpratipattiḥ || tataśca
pramāṇaviṣayavyavasthāhāniḥ iti || ete ca doṣāḥ syādvādasya
jātyantaratvānniravakāśā eva | ataḥ syādvādamarmavedibhiruddharaṇī-
yāstattadupapattibhiriti | svatantratayā nirapekṣayoreva sāmānya-
viśeṣayorvidhipratiṣedharūpayosteṣāmavakāśāt ||

athavā virodhaśabdotra doṣavācī | yathā viruddhamācaratīti |
duṣṭamityarthaḥ | tataśca virodhebhyo virodhavaiyadhikaraṇyādidoṣebhyo
bhītā iti vyākhyeyam | evaṃ ca sāmānyaśabdena sarvā api doṣa-
vyaktayaḥ saṃgṛhītā bhavanti || iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

athānekāntavādasya sarvadravyasarvaparyāyavyāpitvepi mūlabhedā-
pekṣayā cāturvidhyābhidhānadvāreṇa bhagavatastattvāmṛtarasāsvādasauhi-
tyamupavarṇayannāha |
syānnāśi nityaṃ sadṛśaṃ virūpaṃ
vācyaṃ na vācyaṃ sadasattadeva |
vipaścitāṃ nātha nipītatattva-
sudhodgatodgāraparaṃpareyam || 25 ||

syādityavyayamanekāntadyotakamaṣṭāsvapi padeṣu yojyam | tade-
vādhikṛtamevaikaṃ vastu syātkathaṃcinnāśi vinaśanaśīlamanityami-
tyarthaḥ | syānnityamavināśadharmītyarthaḥ | etāvatā nityānityala-
kṣaṇamekaṃ vidhānam || tathā syātsadṛśam anuvṛttihetusāmānyarūpam ||
syādvirūpam vividharūpaṃ visadṛśapariṇāmātmakaṃ vyāvṛttihetuviśeṣa-
rūpamityarthaḥ | anena sāmānyaviśeṣarūpo dvitīyaḥ prakāraḥ || tathā
syādvācyaṃ vaktavyam || syānna vācyam avaktavyamityarthaḥ | atra
ca samāse avācyamiti yuktaṃ tathāpyavācyapadaṃ yonyādau rūḍha-
mityasabhyatāparihārārthaṃ na vācyamityasamastaṃ cakāra stutikāraḥ |
etenābhilāpyānabhilāpyasvarūpastṛtīyo bhedaḥ || tathā syātsat
vidyamānamastirūpamityarthaḥ | syādasat tadvilakṣaṇamiti | anena
sadasadākhyā caturthī vidhā ||

he vipaścitāṃ nātha saṃkhyāvatāṃ mukhya iyam anantaroktā nipīta-
tattvasudhodgatodgāraparaṃparā | taveti prakaraṇātsāmarthyādvā gamyate | tattvaṃ
yathāvasthitavastusvarūpaparicchedaḥ tadeva jarāmaraṇāpahāritvādvibudho-
pabhogyatvānmithyātvaviṣorminirākariṣṇutvādāntarāhlādakāritvā-
cca sudhā pīyūṣaṃ tattvasudhā | nitarāmananyasāmānyatayā pītā
āsvāditā yā tattvasudhā tasyā udgatā prādurbhūtā tatkāraṇikā
udgāraparaṃparā udgāraśreṇirivetyarthaḥ | yathā hi kaścidākaṇṭhaṃ pīyūṣa-
rasamāpīya tadanuvidhāyinīmudgāraparaṃparāṃ muñcati tathā bhaga-
vānapi jarāmaraṇāpahāri tattvāmṛtaṃ svairamāsvādya tadrasānuvidhā-
yinīṃ prastutānekāntavādabhedacatuṣṭayīlakṣaṇāmudgāraparaṃmparāṃ deśanā-
mukhenodgīrṇavānityāśayaḥ ||

athavā yairekāntavādibhirmithyātvagaralabhojanamātṛpti bhakṣitaṃ
teṣāṃ tattadvacanarūpā udgāraprakārāḥ prāk pradarśitāḥ | yaistu pacelima-
prācīnapuṇyaprāgbhārānugṛhītairjagadguruvadanenduniḥsyandi tattvāmṛtaṃ
manohatya pītaṃ teṣāṃ vipaścitāṃ yathārthavādaviduṣāṃ he nātha iyaṃ
pūrvadaladarśitollekhaśekharodgāraparaṃpareti vyākhyeyam | ete ca catvā-
ropi vādāsteṣu teṣu sthāneṣu prāgeva carcitāḥ | tathā hi | ādī-
pamāvyoma samasvabhāvām iti vṛtte nityānityavādaḥ pradarśitaḥ |
anekamekātmakameva vācyam iti kāvye sāmānyaviśeṣavādaḥ saṃsū-
citaḥ | saptabhaṅgyāmabhilāpyānabhilāpyavādaḥ sadasadvādaśca carciṃtaḥ |
iti na bhūyaḥ prayāsaḥ || iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

idānīṃ nityānityapakṣayoḥ parasparadūṣaṇaprakāśanabaddhalakṣatayā
vairāyamāṇayoritaretarodīritavividhahetuhetisaṃnipātasaṃjātavini-
pātayorayatnasiddhapratipakṣapratikṣepasya bhagavacchāsanasāmrājyasya
sarvotkarṣamāha |
ya eva doṣāḥ kila nityavāde
vināśavādepi samāsta eva |
parasparadhvaṃsiṣu kaṇṭakeṣu
jayatyadhṛṣyaṃ jinaśāsanaṃ te || 26 ||

kileti niścaye | ya eva nityavāde nityaikāntavāde doṣā
anityaikāntavādibhiḥ prasañjitāḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyānu-
papattyādayasta eva vināśavādepi kṣaṇikaikāntavādepi samāḥ tulyāḥ
nityaikāntavādibhiḥ prasajyamānā anyūnādhikāḥ | tathāhi nitya-
vādī pramāṇayati | sarvaṃ nityaṃ sattvāt | kṣaṇike sadasatkālayorarthakri-
yāvirodhāt tallakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ nāvasthāṃ badhnātīti tato nivartamāna-
mananyaśaraṇatayā nityatvevatiṣṭhate | tathāhi kṣaṇikorthaḥ san vā
kāryaṃ kuryāt asanvā | gatyantarābhāvāt | na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | sama-
samayavartini vyāpārāyogāt | sakalabhāvānāṃ parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇa-
bhāvaprāptyātiprasaṅgācca | nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ kṣodaṃ kṣamate | asataḥ
kāryakaraṇaśaktivikalatvāt | anyathā śaśaviṣāṇādayopi
kāryakaraṇāyotsaheran | viśeṣābhāvāt | iti || anityavādī
nityavādinaṃ prati punarevaṃ pramāṇayati | sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ sattvāt |
akṣaṇike kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodhāt arthakriyākāritvasya
ca bhāvalakṣaṇatvāt tatorthakriyā vyāvartamānā svakroḍīkṛtāṃ
sattāṃ vyāvartayediti kṣaṇikasiddhiḥ | nahi nityorthorthakriyāṃ
krameṇa pravartayitumutsahate | pūrvārthakriyākaraṇasvabhāvopamardadvāreṇottara-
kriyāyāṃ krameṇa pravṛtteḥ | anyathā pūrvakriyākaraṇāvirāmaprasaṅgāt |
tatsvabhāvapracyave ca nityatā prayāti | atādavasthyasyānityatālakṣa-
ṇatvāt | atha nityopi kramavartinaṃ sahakārikāraṇamarthamudīkṣamāṇa-
stāvadāsīt paścāttamāsādya krameṇa kāryaṃ kuryāditi cet na | sahakā-
rikāraṇasya nityerthe'kiṃcitkaratvādakiṃcitkarasyāpi pratīkṣaṇe'-
navasthāprasaṅgāt | nāpi yaugapadyena nityorthorthakriyāṃ kurute | a-
dhyakṣavirodhāt | nahyekakālaṃ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ prārabhamāṇaḥ kaścidupa-
labhyate | karotu vā | tathāpyādyakṣaṇa eva sakalakriyāparisamāpte-
rdvitīyādikṣaṇeṣvakurvāṇasyānityatā balādāḍhaukate | karaṇākaraṇa-
yorekasminvirodhāt | iti || tadevamekāntadvayepi ye hetavaste yukti-
sāmyādviruddhaṃ na vyabhicarantītyavicāritaramaṇīyatayā mugdhajanasya
dhyāndhyaṃ cotpādayantīti viruddhā vyabhicāriṇo'naikāntikāḥ |
iti || atra ca nityānityaikāntapakṣapratikṣepa evoktaḥ | upalakṣaṇa-
tvācca sāmānyaviśeṣādyekāntavādā api mithastulyadoṣatayā
viruddhā vyabhicāriṇa eva hetunupaspṛśantīti paribhāvanīyam ||

athottarārdhaṃ vyākhyāyate | parasparetyādi | evaṃ ca kaṇṭakeṣu
