kṣudraśatruṣvekāntavādiṣu parasparadhvaṃsiṣu satsu parasparasmād dhvaṃsante
vināśamupayāntītyevaṃśīlāḥ sundopasundavaditi parasparadhvaṃsinaḥ |
teṣu he jina te tava śāsanaṃ syādvādaprarūpaṇanipuṇaṃ dvādaśāṅgīrūpaṃ
pravacanaṃ parābhibhāvukānāṃ kaṇṭakānāṃ svayamucchinnatvenaivābhāvāda-
dhṛṣyamaparābhavanīyam | śaktārhe kṛtyāśca iti kṛtyavidhānād dharṣi-
tumaśakyaṃ dharṣitumanarhaṃ vā | jayati sarvotkarṣeṇa vartate | yathā
kaścinmahārājaḥ pīvarapuṇyaparīpākaḥ parasparaṃ vigṛhya svayameva
kṣayamupeyivatsu dviṣatsvayatnasiddhaniṣkaṇṭakatvaṃ samṛddhaṃ rājyamupa-
bhuñjānaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭo bhavatyevaṃ tvacchāsanamapi | iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

anantarakāvye nityānityādyekāntavāde doṣasāmānyamabhi-
hitam | idānīṃ katipayatadviśeṣānnāmagrāhaṃ darśayaṃstatprarūpakāṇā-
masadbhūtodbhāvakatayodvṛttatathāvidharipujanajanitopadravamiva paritrātu
rdharitrīpatestrijagatpateḥ purato bhuvanatrayaṃ pratyupakārakāritāmā-
viṣkaroti--
naikāntavāde sukhaduḥkhabhogau
na puṇyapāpe na ca bandhamokṣau |
durnītivādavyasanāsinaivaṃ
parairviluptaṃ jagadapyaśeṣam || 27 ||

ekāntavāde nityānityaikāntapakṣābhyupagame na sukhaduḥkha-
bhogau ghaṭete | na ca puṇyapāpe ghaṭete | na ca bandhamokṣau ghaṭete |
punaḥpunarnañaḥ prayogo'tyantāghaṭamānatādarśanārthaḥ || tathāhi ekā-
ntanitye ātmani tāvat sukhaduḥkhabhogau nopapadyete | nityasya
hi lakṣaṇam apracyutānutpannasthiraikarūpatvam | tato yadā
ātmā sukhamanubhūya svakāraṇakalāpasāmagrīvaśād duḥkhamupabhuṅkte
tadā svabhāvabhedādanityatvāpattyā sthiraikarūpatāhāniprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ duḥkhamanubhūya sukhamupabhuñjānasyāpi vaktavyam | atha
avasthābhedādayaṃ vyavahāraḥ | na cāvasthāsu bhidyamānāsvapi
tadvato bhedaḥ sarpasyeva kuṇḍalārjavādyavasthāsu iti cet na |
tāstato vyatiriktāḥ avyatiriktā vā | vyatireke tāstasyeti
saṃbandhābhāvaḥ | atiprasaṅgāt | avyatireke tu tadvāneveti
tadavasthitaiva sthiraikarūpatāhāniḥ | kathaṃ ca tadekāntaika-
rūpatve'vasthābhedopi bhavet | iti || kiṃca sukhaduḥkhabhogau
puṇyapāpanivartyau tannirvartanaṃ cārthakriyā sā ca kūṭasthanityasya
krameṇa akrameṇa vā nopapadyata ityuktaprāyam | ata evoktaṃ
na puṇyapāpe iti | puṇyaṃ dānādikriyopārjanīyaṃ śubhaṃ karma
pāpaṃ hiṃsādikriyāsādhyamaśubhaṃ karma | te api na ghaṭete |
prāguktanīteḥ || tathā na bandhamokṣau | bandhaḥ karmapudgalaiḥ saha
pratipradeśamātmano vanhyayaḥpiṇḍavad anyonyasaṃśleṣaḥ |
mokṣaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṣayaḥ | tāvapyekāntanitye na syātām |
bandho hi saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ sa ca aprāptānāṃ prāptiḥ itilakṣaṇaḥ |
prākkālabhāvinī aprāptiranyāvasthā uttarakālabhāvinī prāpti-
ścānyā | tadanayorapyavasthābhedadoṣo dustaraḥ | kathaṃ caikarūpatve
sati tasyākasmiko bandhanasaṃyogaḥ | bandhanasaṃyogācca prāk kiṃ
nāyaṃ mukto'bhavat | kiṃca tena bandhanenāsau vikṛtimanubhavati
na vā | anubhavati cet carmādivad anityaḥ | nānubhavati
cet nirvikāratve satā asatā vā tena gaganasyeva na ko'pyasya
viśeṣaḥ iti bandhavaikalyānnityamukta eva syāt | tataśca viśīrṇā
jagati bandhamokṣavyavasthā | tathā ca paṭhanti |
varṣātapābhyāṃ kiṃ vyomnaścarmaṇyasti tayoḥ phalam |
carmopamaścetso'nityaḥ khatulyaścedasatphalaḥ ||
bandhānupapattau mokṣasyāpyanupapattiḥ | bandhanavicchadepayāryatvānmukti-
śabdasya | iti ||

evamanityaikāntavādepi sukhaduḥkhādyanupapattiḥ | anityaṃ hi
atyantocchedadharmakam | tathābhūte cātmani puṇyopādānakriyākā-
riṇo niranvayaṃ vinaṣṭatvāt kasya nāma tatphalabhūtasukhānubhavaḥ |
evaṃ pāpopādānakriyākāriṇopi niravayavanāśe kasya duḥkhasaṃ-
vedanamastu | evaṃ cānyaḥ kriyākārī anyaśca tatphalabhoktā
ityasamañjasamāpadyate | atha
yasminneva hi saṃtāne āhitā karmavāsanā |
phalaṃ tatraiva saṃdhatte karpāse raktatā yathā ||
itivacanānnāsamañjasamityapi vāṅmātram | saṃtānavāsanayo
ravāstavatvena prāgeva nirloṭhitatvāt | tathā puṇyapāpepi na ghaṭete |
tayorhi arthakriyā sukhaduḥkhopabhogaḥ tadanupapattiścānantarame-
voktā | tato'rthakriyākāritvābhāvāt tayorapyaghaṭamānatvam |
kiṃcānityaḥ kṣaṇamātrasthāyī tasmiṃśca kṣaṇe utpattimātravyagra-
tvāt tasya kutaḥ puṇyapāpopādānakriyārjanam | dvitīyādi-
kṣaṇeṣu cāvasthātumeva na labhate | puṇyapāpopādānakriyābhāve ca
puṇyapāpe kutaḥ | nirmūlatvāt | tadasattve ca kutastanaḥ sukhaduḥkha-
bhogaḥ | āstāṃ vā kathaṃcidetat | tathāpi pūrvakṣaṇasadṛśenottara-
kṣaṇena bhavitavyam | upādānānurūpatvād upādeyasya | tataḥ pūrva-
kṣaṇād duḥkhitāduttarakṣaṇaḥ kathaṃ sukhita utpadyate | kathaṃ ca
sukhitāttataḥ sa duḥkhitaḥ syāt | visadṛśabhāgatāpatteḥ | evaṃ
puṇyapāpādāvapi | tasmādyakiṃcidetat || evaṃ bandhamokṣayorapya-
saṃbhavaḥ | lokepi hi ya eva baddhaḥ sa eva mucyate | niranvaya-
nāśābhyupagame caikādhikaraṇatvābhāvāt saṃtānasya cāvāstavatvāt
kutastayoḥ saṃbhāvanāmātramapi | iti pariṇāmini cātmani svīki-
yamāṇaṃ sarvaṃ nirbādhamupapadyate |
pariṇāmo'vasthāntaragamanaṃ na ca sarvathā hyavasthānam |
na ca sarvathā vināśaḥ pariṇāmastadvidāmiṣṭaḥ ||
itivacanāt | pātañjalaṭīkākāro'pyāha | avasthitasya dravyasya
pūrvadharmanivṛttau dharmāntarotpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ iti || evaṃ sāmānya-
viśeṣasadasadabhilāpyānabhilāpyaikāntavādeṣvapi sukhaduḥkhādya-
bhāvaḥ svayamabhiyuktairabhyūhyaḥ ||

athottarārdhavyākhyā | evamanupapadyamānepi sukhaduḥkhabhogādi-
vyavahāre paraiḥ paratīrthikaiḥ atha ca paramārthataḥ śatrubhiḥ | paraśabdo hi
śatruparyāyopyasti | durnītivādavyasanāsinā | nīyate ekadeśa-
viśiṣṭorthaḥ pratītiviṣayamābhiriti nītayo nayāḥ | duṣṭā nītayo
durnītayo durnayāḥ | teṣāṃ vadanaṃ parebhyaḥ pratipādanaṃ durnītivādaḥ |
tatra yad vyasanam atyāsaktiḥ aucityanirapekṣā pravṛttiriti
yāvat durnītivādavyasanam | tadeva sadbodhaśarīrocchedanaśakti-
yuktatvād asiriva asiḥ kṛpāṇaḥ durnītivādavyasanāsiḥ | tena
durnītivādavyasanāsinā karaṇabhūtena durnayaprarūpaṇahevākakhaṅgena |
evam ityanubhavasiddhaṃ prakāramāha | apiśabdasya bhinnakramatvād
aśeṣamapi jagat nikhilamapi trailokyam | tātsthyāt tadvyapadeśa
iti trailokyagatajantujātam | viluptam samyagjñānādibhāvaprāṇavya-
parāpeṇena vyāpāditam | tat trāyasva ityāśayaḥ | samyagjñānā-
dayohi | bhāvaprāṇāḥ prāvacanikairgīyante | ata eva siddheṣvapi
jīvavyapadeśaḥ | anyathā hi jīvadhātuḥ prāṇadhāraṇārthebhidhīyate
teṣāṃ ca daśavidhaprāṇadhāraṇābhāvādajīvatvaprāptiḥ | sā ca
viruddhā | tasmātsaṃsāriṇo daśavidhadravyaprāṇadhāraṇājjīvāḥ |
siddhāśca jñānādibhāvaprāṇadhāraṇāt | iti siddham || durnayasvarūpaṃ
cotrarakāvye vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

sāṃprataṃ durnayanayapramāṇaprarūpaṇadvāreṇa pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ iti
vacanājjīvājīvāditattvādhigamanibandhanānāṃ teṣāṃ pramāṇanayānāṃ
pratipādayituḥ svāminaḥ syādvādavirodhidurnayamārganirākariṣṇu-
mananyasāmānyaṃ vacanātiśayaṃ stuvannāha |
sadeva satsyātsaditi tridhārtho
mīyeta durnītinayapramāṇaiḥ |
yathārthadarśī tu nayapramāṇa-
pathena durnītipathaṃ tvamāsthaḥ || 28 ||

arthyate paricchidyata ityarthaḥ padārthaḥ | tridhā tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ |
mīyeta paricchidyeta | vidhau saptamī | kaistribhiḥ prakārairityāha |
durnītinayapramāṇaiḥ | nīyate paricchidyate ekadeśaviśiṣṭortha
ābhiriti nītayaḥ nayāḥ | duṣṭā nītayo durnītayo durnayā ityarthaḥ |
nayā naigamādyāḥ | pramīyate paricchidyate'rtho'nekāntaviśiṣṭo'ne-
neti pramāṇaṃ syādvādātmakaṃ pratyakṣaparokṣalakṣaṇam | durnītayaśca
nayāśca pramāṇe ca durnītinayapramāṇāni taiḥ | kenollekhena mīyete-
tyāha sadeva satsyātsaditi | saditi avyaktatvānnapuṃsakatvaṃ yathā
kiṃ tasyā garbhe jātamiti | sadeveti durnayaḥ | saditi nayaḥ |
syātsaditi pramāṇam | tathā hi | durnayastāvatsadeveti bravīti |
astyeva ghaṭa iti | ayaṃ vastunyekāntāstitvamevābhyupagacchanni-
taradharmāṇāṃ tiraskāreṇa svābhipretameva dharmaṃ vyavasthāpayati | durna-
yatvaṃ cāsya mithyārūpatvāt | mithyārūpatvaṃ ca tatra dharmāntarāṇāṃ
satāmapi nihmavāt | tathā sadityullekhavānnayaḥ | sa hyasti
ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭe svābhimatamastitvadharmaṃ prasādhayan śaṣadharmeṣu
gajanimīlikāmālambate | na cāsya durnayatvam | dharmāntarā-
tiraskārāt | na ca pramāṇatvam | syācchabdenālāñchitatvāt |
syātsaditi syātkathaṃcitsadvastu iti pramāṇam | pramāṇatvaṃ
cāsya dṛṣṭeṣṭābādhitatvādvipakṣe bādhakasadbhāvācca | sarvaṃ hi vastu
svarūpeṇa sat pararūpeṇa cāsadityasakṛduktam | saditi diṅmātrade-
śanārtham || anayā diśā asattvanityatvānityatvavaktavyatvāvakta-
vyatvasāmānyaviśeṣādyapi boddhavyam ||

itthaṃ vastusvarūpamākhyāya stutimāha yathārthadarśī ityādi | durnī-
tipathaṃ durnayamārgam | tuśabdasyāvadhāraṇārthasya bhinnakramatvāt tvame-
va | āsthaḥ tvameva nirākṛtavān | na tīrthāntaradaivatāni | kena
kṛtvā | nayapramāṇapathena | nayapramāṇe uktasvarūpe | tayormārgeṇa pracā-
reṇa | yatastvaṃ yathārthadarśī | yathārthosti tathaiva paśyatītyevaṃ-
śīlo yathārthadarśī | vimalakevalajyotiṣā yathāvasthitavastudarśī |
tīrthāntaraśāstārastu rāgādidoṣakāluṣyakalaṅgitatvena tathāvidha-
jñānābhāvānna yathārthadarśinaḥ | tataḥ kathaṃ nāma durnayapathamathane
pragalbhante te tapasvinaḥ | nahi svayamanayapravṛttaḥ pareṣāmanayaṃ niṣe-
ddhumuddhuratāṃ dhatte | idamuktaṃ bhavati | yathā kaścitsanmārgavedī paro-
pakāradurlalitaḥ puruṣaścauraśvāpadakaṇṭakādyākīrṇaṃ mārgaṃ parityājya
pathikānāṃ guṇadoṣobhayavikalaṃ doṣāspṛṣṭaṃ guṇayuktaṃ ca mārgamupa-
darśayati evaṃ jagannāthopi durnayatiraskaraṇena bhavyebhyo nayapramā-
ṇamārgaṃ prarūpayatīti | āsthaḥ ityasyateradyatanyāṃ śāstyasūvakti-
khyāteraṅ ityaṅi śvayatyasūvacapataḥ śvāsthavocapaptam iti
asthādeśe svarādestāsu iti vṛddhau rūpam || mukhyavṛttyā ca pramāṇa-
syaiva prāmāṇyam | yaccātra nayānāṃ pramāṇatulyakakṣatākhyāpanaṃ tatte-
ṣāmanuyogadvārabhūtatayā prajñāpanāṅgatvajñāpanārtham | catvāri hi
pravacanānuyogamahānagarasya dvārāṇyupakramo nikṣeponugamo nayaśceti |
eteṣāṃ ca svarūpamāvaśyakabhāṣyādernirūpaṇīyam | iha tu nocyate |
granthagauravabhayāt | atra caikatra kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pathinśabdaḥ |
anyatra cāvyutpannaḥ pathaśabdo'danta iti pathaśabdasya dviḥprayogo
na duṣyati ||

atha durnayanayapramāṇasvarūpaṃ kiṃcinnirūpyate | tatrāpi prathamaṃ naya-
svarūpam | tadanadhigame durnayasvarūpasya duṣparijñānatvāt | atra
cācāryeṇa prathamaṃ durnayanirdeśo yathottaraṃ prādhānyāvabodhanārthaḥ
kṛtaḥ | tatra pramāṇapratipannārthaiṃkadeśaparāmarśo nayaḥ | anantadharmā-
dhyāsitaṃ vastu svābhipretaikadharmaviśiṣṭaṃ nayati prāpayati
saṃvedanakoṭimārohayatīti nayaḥ | pramāṇapravṛtteruttarakālabhāvī
parāmarśa ityarthaḥ | nayāścānantāḥ | anantadharmatvādvastunastadekadharma-
paryavasitānāṃ vakturabhiprāyāṇāṃ ca nayatvāt | tathā cavṛddhāḥ |
jāvaiā vayaṇapahā tāvaiā ceva huṃti nayavāyā |
iti | tathāpi ciraṃtanācāryaiḥ sarvasaṃgrāhisaptābhiprāyaparikalpanā-
dvāreṇa sapta nayāḥ pratipāditāḥ | tadyathā | naigamasaṃgrahavyavahāra-
ṛjusūtraśabdasamabhirūḍhaivaṃbhūtā iti | kathameṣāṃ sarvagrāhakatvamiti
ceducyate | abhiprāyastāvadarthadvāreṇa śabdadvāreṇa vā pravartate | gatya-
ntarābhāvāt | tatra ye kecanārthanirūpaṇapravaṇāḥ pramātrabhiprāyāste
sarvepyādye nayacatuṣṭayentarbhavanti | ye ca śabdavicāracaturāste
śabdādinayatraya iti ||

tatra naigamaḥ sattālakṣaṇaṃ mahāsāmānyam avāntarasāmānyāni
ca dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādīni tathāntyān viśeṣān sakalā-
sādhāraṇarūpalakṣaṇānavāntara viśeṣāṃścāpekṣayā pararūpavyāvartana-
kṣamān sāmānyādatyantavinirluṭhitasvarūpānabhipraiti | idaṃ ca
svatantrasāmānyaviśeṣavāde kṣuṇṇamiti na pṛthakprayatnaḥ | pravacana-
prasiddhanilayanaprasthadṛṣṭāntadvayagamyaścāyam ||

saṃgrahastu aśeṣaviśeṣatirodhānadvāreṇa sāmānyarūpatayā
viśvamupādatte | etacca sāmānyaikāntavāde prāk prapañcitam ||

vyavahārastvevamāha | yathālokagrāhameva vastvastu kimanayā
adṛṣṭāvyavathiyamāṇavastuparikalpanakaṣṭapiṣṭikayā | yadeva ca
lokavyavahārapathamavatarati tasyaivānugrāhakaṃ pramāṇamupalabhyate neta-
rasya | na hi sāmānyamanādinidhanamekaṃ saṃgrahābhimataṃ pramāṇa-
bhūmiḥ | tathānubhavābhāvāt | sarvasya sarvadarśitvaprasaṅgācca | nāpi
viśeṣāḥ paramāṇulakṣaṇāḥ kṣaṇakṣayiṇaḥ pramāṇagocarāḥ | tathā-
pravṛtterabhāvāt | tasmādimeva nikhilalokābādhitaṃ pramāṇaprasiddhaṃ
kiyatkālabhāvisthūlatāmābibhrāṇamudukādyāharaṇādyarthakriyānirvartana
kṣamaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ vasturūpaṃ pāramārthikam | pūrvottarakālabhāvi-
tatparyāyaparyālocanā punarajyāyasī | tatra pramāṇaprasarābhāvāt |
pramāṇamantareṇa ca vicārasya kartumaśakyatvāt | avastutvācca
teṣāṃ kiṃ tadgocaraparyālocanena | tathāhi pūrvottarakālabhā-
vino dravyavivartāḥ kṣaṇakṣayiparamāṇulakṣaṇā vā viśeṣā na
kathaṃcana lokavyavahāramuparacayanti | tanna te vasturūpāḥ |
lokavyavahāropayogināmeva vastutvāt | ata eva panthā
gacchati kuṇḍikā sravati girirdahyate mañcāḥ krośantītyā-
divyavahārāṇāṃ prāmāṇyam | tathā ca vācakamukhyaḥ |
laukikasama upacāraprāyo vistṛtārtho vyavahāraḥ iti ||

ṛjusūtraḥ punaridaṃ manyate | vartamānakṣaṇavivartyeva vasturūpam |
nātītamanāgataṃ ca | atītasya vinaṣṭatvādanāgatasyālabdhātma-
lābhatvātkharaviṣāṇādibhyo'viśiṣyamāṇatayā sakalaśaktiviraha
rūpatvānnārthakriyānirvartanakṣamatvaṃ tadabhāvācca na vastutvam | yade-
vārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasat iti vacanāt | vartamānakṣaṇā-
liṅgitaṃ punarvasturūpaṃ samastārthakriyāsu vyāpriyata iti tadeva pāra-
mārthikam | tadapi ca niraṃśamabhyupagantavyam | aṃśavyāpteryuktirikta-
tvāt | ekasyānekasvabhāvatāmantareṇānekasvāvayavavyāpanāyogāt |
anekasvabhāvatā evāstu iti cet na | virodhavyāghrāghrātatvāt |
tathāhi yadyekaḥ svabhāvaḥ kathamaneko'nekaścetkathamekaḥ | ekānekayoḥ
parasparaparihāreṇāvasthānāt | tasmātsvarūpanimagnāḥ paramāṇava eva
parasparopasarpaṇadvāreṇa kathaṃcinnicayarūpatāmāpannā nikhilakāryeṣu
vyāpārabhāja iti ta eva svalakṣaṇaṃ na sthūlatāṃ dhārayatpāramā-
rthikamiti | evamasyābhiprāyeṇa yadeva svakīyaṃ tadeva vastu na
parakīyam | anupayogitvāt | iti ||

śabdastu rūḍhito yāvanto dhvanayaḥ kasmiṃścidarthe pravartante yathe-
ndraśakrapuraṃdarādayaḥ surapatau teṣāṃ sarveṣāmapyekamarthamabhipraiti kila |
pratītivaśāt | yathā śadbāvyatirekorthasya pratipādyate tathaiva tasyaika-
manekatvaṃ vā pratipādanīyam | na cendraśakrapurandarādayaḥ paryāya-
śabdāvibhinnārthavācitayā kadācana pratīyante | tebhyaḥ sarvadā
ekākāraparāmarśotpatteraskhalitavṛttitayā tathaiva vyavahāradarśanāt |
tasmādeka eva paryāyaśabdānāmartha iti | śabdyate āhūyate'nenābhi-
prāyeṇārtha iti niruktāt ekārthapratipādanābhiprāyeṇaiva paryāyadhvanīnāṃ
prayogāt | yathā cāyaṃ paryāyaśabdānāmekamarthamabhipraiti tathā taṭa-
staṭī taṭamiti viruddhaliṅgalakṣaṇadharmābhisaṃbandhādvastuno bhedaṃ
cābhidhatte | na hi viruddhadharmakṛtaṃ bhedamanubhavato vastuno viruddha-
dharmāyogo yuktaḥ | evaṃ saṃkhyākālakārakapuruṣādibhedādapi
bhedobhyupagantavyaḥ | tatra saṃkhyā ekatvādiḥ kālotītādiḥ
kārakaṃ kartrādi puruṣaḥ prathamapuruṣādiḥ || samabhirūḍhastu
paryāyaśabdānāṃ pravibhaktamevārthamabhimanyate | tadyathā indanādindraḥ |
paramaiśvaryamindraśabdavācyaṃ paramārthatastadvatyarthe | atadadvatyarthe
punarupacārato vartate | na vā kaścittadvān | savaśabdānāṃ paraspara
vibhaktārthapratipāditayā āśrayāśrayibhāvena pravṛttyasiddheḥ | evaṃ
śakanācchakraḥ pūrdāraṇātpurandara ityādibhinnārthatvaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ
darśayati | pramāṇayati ca | paryāyaśabdā api bhinnārthāḥ | pravi-
bhaktavyutpattinimittakatvāt | iha ye ye pravibhaktavyutpattinimitta-
kāste te bhinnārthakā yathendrapaśupuruṣaśabdāḥ | vibhinnavyutpattini-
mittakāśca paryāyaśabdā api | ato bhinnārthā iti ||

evaṃbhūtaḥ punarevaṃ bhāṣate | yasminnarthe śabdo vyutpādyate sa
vyutpattinimittamartho yadaiva pravartate tadaiva taṃ śabdaṃ pravartamānamabhi-
praiti na sāmānyena | yathodakādyāharaṇavelāyāṃ yoṣidādimastakā-
rūḍho viśiṣṭaceṣṭāvāneva ghaṭebhidhīyate na śeṣaḥ | ghaṭaśabdavyutpatti-
nimittaśūnyatvāt paṭādivaditi | atītāṃ bhāvinīṃ vā ceṣṭā-
maṅgīkṛtya sāmānyenaivocyata iti cet na | tayorvinaṣṭānutpannatayā
śaśaviṣāṇakalpatvāt | tathāpi taddvāreṇa śabdapravartane sarvatra prava-
rtayitavyaḥ | viśaṣābhāvāt | kiṃca yadyatītavartsyacceṣṭāpekṣayā
ghaṭaśabdo'ceṣṭāvatyapi prayujyeta tadā kapālamṛtpiṇḍādāvapi tatpra-
vartanaṃ durnivāraṃ syāt | viśeṣābhāvāt | tasmādyatra kṣaṇe vyutpattini-
mittamavikalamasti tasminneva sorthastacchabdavācya iti ||

atra saṃgrahaślokāḥ |
anyadeva hi sāmānyamabhinnajñānakāraṇam |
viśeṣopyanya eveti manyate naigamo nayaḥ || 1 ||
sadrūpatānatikrāntaṃ svasvabhāvamidaṃ jagat |
sattārūpatayā sarvaṃ saṃgṛhṇan saṃgraho mataḥ || 2 ||
vyavahārastu tāmeva prativastu vyavasthitām |
tathaiva dṛśyamānatvādvyāpārayati dehinaḥ || 3 ||
tatrarjusūtranītiḥ syācchuddhaparyāyasaṃśritā |
naśvarasyaiva bhāvasya bhāvātsthitiviyogataḥ || 4 ||
virodhiliṅgasaṃkhyādibhedādbhinnasvabhāvatām |
tasyaivaṃ manyamānoyaṃ śabdaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate || 5 ||
tathāvidhasya tasyāpi vastunaḥ kṣaṇavartinaḥ |
brūte samabhirūḍhastu saṃjñābhedena bhinnatām || 6 ||
ekasyāpi dhvanervācyaṃ sadā tannopapadyate |
kriyābhedena bhinnatvādevaṃbhūto'bhimanyate || 7 ||

eta eva ca parāmarśā abhipretadharmāvadhāraṇātmakatayā śeṣa-
dharmatiraskāreṇa pravartamānā durnayasaṃjñāmaśnuvate | tadbalaprabhāvita-
sattākā hi khalvete parapravādāḥ | tathā hi | naigamanayadarśanānusā-
riṇau naiyāyikavaiśeṣikau | saṃgrahābhiprāyapravṛttāḥ sarvepyadvaitavādāḥ
sāṃkhyadarśanaṃ ca | vyavahāranayānupātiprāyaścārvākadarśanam |
ṛjusūtrākūtapravṛttabuddhayastāthāgatāḥ | śabdādinayāvalambino vaiyā-
karaṇādayaḥ | uktaṃ ca sodāharaṇaṃ nayadurnayasvarūpaṃ śrīdevasūripādaiḥ |
tathā ca tadgranthaḥ | nīyate yena śrutākhyapramāṇaviṣayīkṛtasyārtha-
syāṃśastaditarāṃśaudāsīnyataḥ sa pratipatturabhiprāyaviśeṣo nayaḥ
iti | svābhipretādaṃśāditarāṃśāpalāpī punarnayābhāsaḥ | sa
vyāsasamāsābhyāṃ dviprakāraḥ | vyāsato'nekavikalpaḥ | samāsa-
tastu dvibhedo dravyārthikaḥ paryāyārthikaśca | ādyo naigamasaṃgrahavyavahā-
rabhedāttredhā | dharmayordharmiṇordharmadharmiṇośca | pradhānopasarjanabhāvena
yadvivakṣaṇaṃ sa naikagamo naigamaḥ | saccaitanyamātmanīti dharmayoḥ | vastu-
paryāyavaddravyamiti dharmiṇoḥ | kṣaṇamekaṃ sukhī viṣayāsaktajīva iti
dharmadharmiṇoḥ | dharmadvayādīnāmaikāntikapārthakyābhisaṃdhirnaigamābhā-
saḥ || yathā ātmani sattvacaitanye parasparamatyantaṃ pṛthagbhūte ityādi ||
sāmānyamātragrāhī parāmarśaḥ saṃgrahaḥ | ayamubhayavikalpaḥ paro'-
paraśca | aśeṣaviśeṣeṣvaudāsīnyaṃ bhajamānaḥ śuddhadravyaṃ sanmātramabhima-
nyamānaḥ paraḥ saṃgrahaḥ | viśvamekaṃ sat aviśeṣāditi yathā | sattādvaitaṃ
svīkurvāṇaḥ sakalaviśeṣānnirācakṣāṇastadābhāsaḥ | yathā sattaiva tattvaṃ
tataḥ pṛthagbhūtānāṃ viśeṣāṇāmadarśanāt | dravyatvādīnyavāntarasā-
mānyāni manvānastadbhedeṣu gajanimīlikāmavalambamānaḥ punarapara-
saṃgrahaḥ || dharmādharmākāśakālapudgalajīvadravyāṇāmaikyaṃ dravyatvābhe-
dādityādiryathā | dravyatvādikaṃ pratijānānastadviśeṣānnihnuvāna-
stadābhāsaḥ | yathā dravyatvameva tattvaṃ tatorthāntarabhūtānāṃ dravyāṇāma-
nupalabdherityādi || saṃgraheṇa gocarīkṛtānāmarthānāṃ vidhipūrvakamava-
haraṇaṃ yenābhisaṃdhinā kriyate sa vyavahāraḥ | yathā yatsattaddravyaṃ
paryāyo vetyādiḥ | yaḥ punarapāramārthikadravyaparyāyavibhāgamabhipraiti
sa vyavahārābhāsaḥ | yathā cārvākadarśanam || paryāyārthikaścaturdhā
ṛjusūtraḥ śabdaḥ samabhirūḍha evaṃbhūtaśca || ṛju vartamānakṣaṇasthāyi-
paryāyamātraṃ prādhānyataḥ sūtrayannabhiprāya ṛjusūtraḥ | yathā sukhavivartaḥ
saṃpratyastītyādiḥ | sarvathā dravyāpalāpī tadābhāsaḥ | yathā tathāga-
tamatam || kālādibhedena dhvanerarthabhedaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ śabdaḥ | yathā
babhūva bhavati bhaviṣyati sumerurityādiḥ | tadbhedena tasya tameva
samarthayamānastadābhāsaḥ | yathā babhūva bhavati bhaviṣyati sumerurityā-
dayo bhinnakālāḥ śabdā bhinnamevārthamabhidadhati bhinnakālaśabdatvā-
t tādṛksiddhānyaśabdabadityādiḥ || paryāyaśabdeṣu niruktibhedena
bhinnamarthaṃ samabhirohan samabhirūḍhaḥ | indanādindraḥ śakanācchakraḥ
pūrdāraṇātpurandara ityādiṣu yathā paryāyadhvanīnāmabhidheyanānātvameva
kakṣīkurvāṇastadābhāsaḥ yathendraḥ śakraḥ purandara ityādaya śabdā
bhinnābhidheyā eva bhinnaśabdatvātkarikuraṅgaturaṅgaśabdavadityādiḥ ||
śabdānāṃ svapravṛttinimittabhūtakriyāviṣṭamarthaṃ vācyatvenābhyupaga-
cchannevaṃbhūtaḥ | yathendanamanubhavannindraḥ śakanakriyāpariṇataḥ śakraḥ
pūrdāraṇapravṛttaḥ purandara ityucyate | kriyānāviṣṭaṃ vastu śabdavācyatayā
pratikṣipaṃstu tadābhāsaḥ | yathā viśiṣṭaceṣṭāśūnyaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ vastuna gha-
ṭaśabdavācyaṃ ghaṭaśabdapravṛttinimittabhūtakriyāśūnyatvāt paṭavadityā-
diḥ || eteṣu catvāraḥ prathamerthanirūpaṇapravaṇatvādarthanayāḥ | śeṣāstu
trayaḥ śabdavācyārthagocaratayā śabdanayāḥ || pūrvaḥ pūrvo nayaḥ pracu-
ragocaraḥ paraḥ parastu parimitaviṣayaḥ | sanmātragocarātsaṃgrahānnaigamo
bhāvābhāvabhūmikatvādbhūmaviṣayaḥ | sadviśeṣaprakāśakādvyavahārataḥ saṃgrahaḥ
samastasatsamūhopadarśakatvādbahuviṣayaḥ | vartamānaviṣayādṛjusūtrādvyava-
hārastrikālaviṣayāvalambitvādanalpārthaḥ | kālādibhedena bhinnārtho-
padarśinaḥ śabdādṛjusūtrastadviparītavedakatvānmahārthaḥ pratiparyāyaśabda-
marthabhedamabhīpsataḥ samabhirūḍhācchabdastadviparyayānuyāyitvātprabhūta-
viṣayaḥ | pratikriyaṃ vibhinnamarthaṃ pratijānānādevaṃbhūtātsamabhirū-
ḍhastadanyathārthasthāpakatvānmahāgocaraḥ | nayavākyamapi svaviṣaye prava-
rtamānaṃ vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ saptabhaṅgīmanuvrajati | iti || viśeṣārthinā
nayānāṃ nāmānvarthaviśeṣalakṣaṇākṣepaparihārādicarcastu bhāṣyamaho-
dadhigandhahastiṭīkānyāyāvatārādigranthebhyo nirīkṣaṇīyaḥ ||

pramāṇaṃ tu samyagarthanirṇayalakṣaṇaṃ sarvanayātmakam || syāccha-
bdalāñchitānāṃ nayānāmeva pramāṇavyapadeśabhāktvāt | tathā ca
śrīvimalanāthastave śrīsamantabhadraḥ |
nayāstava syātpadalāñchanā ime rasopaviddhā iva lohadhātavaḥ |
bhavantyabhipretakalā yatastato bhavantamāryāḥ praṇatā hitaiṣiṇaḥ ||
iti | tacca dvividhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ ca | tatra pratyakṣaṃ dvidhā sāṃvyava-
hārikaṃ pāramārthikaṃ ca | sāṃvyavahārikaṃ dvividham indriyānindriya-
nimittabhedāt | tad dvitayamavagrahehā'vāyadhāraṇābhedādekaikaśaścatu-
rvikalpam | avagrahādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ supratītatvānna pratanyate |
pāramārthikaṃ punarutpattāvātmamātrāpekṣam | taddvividhaṃ kṣāyo-
paśamikaṃ kṣāyikaṃ ca | ādyamavadhimanaḥparyāyabhedāddvidhā | kṣāyikaṃ
tu kevalajñānamiti | parokṣaṃ ca smṛtipratyabhijñānohānumānāgama-
bhedātpañcaprakāram | tatra saṃskāraprabodhasaṃbhūtamanubhūtārthaviṣayaṃ
tadityākāraṃ vedanaṃ smṛtiḥ | tattīrthakarabimbamiti yathā | anu-
bhavasmṛtihetukaṃ tiryagūrdhvatāsāmānyādigocaraṃ saṃkalanātmakaṃ jñānaṃ
pratyabhijñānam | yathā tajjātīya evāyaṃ gopiṇḍo gosadṛśo
gavayaḥ sa evāyaṃ jinadatta ityādi | upālambhānupalambhasaṃbha-
vaṃ trikālīkalitasādhyasādhanasaṃbandhādyālambanamidamasminsatyeva
bhavatītyādyākāraṃ saṃvedanamūhā'paranāmā tarkaḥ | yathā yāvān
kaściddhūmaḥ sa sarvo vanhau satyeva bhavatīti tasminnasatyasau
na bhavatyeveti vā | anumānaṃ dvidhā svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca | tatrānyathā
'nupapattyekalakṣaṇahetugrahaṇasaṃbandhasmaraṇakāraṇakaṃ sādhyavijñānaṃ
svārtham | pakṣahetuvacanātmakaṃ parārtham anumānamupacārāt | āptava-
canādāvirbhūtamarthasaṃvedanamāgamaḥ | upacārādāptavacanaṃ ca | iti
smṛtyādīnāṃ ca viśeṣasvarūpaṃ syādvādaratnākarātsākṣepaparihāraṃ jñeya-
miti | pramāṇāntarāṇāṃ punararthāpattyupamānasaṃbhavaprātibhaitihyādīnā-
matraivāntarbhāvaḥ || saṃnikarṣādīnāṃ tu jaḍatvādeva na prāmāṇyam |
iti || tadevaṃvidhena nayapramāṇopanyāsena durnayamārgastvayā khilī-
kṛtaḥ | iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

idānīṃ saptadvīpasamudramātro loka iti vāvadūkānāṃ tanmātraloke
parimitānāmeva sattvānāṃ saṃbhavāt parimitātmavādināṃ doṣa-
darśanamukhena bhagavatpraṇītaṃ jīvānantyavādaṃ nirdoṣatayābhiṣṭuvannāha |
muktopi vābhyetu bhavaṃ bhavo vā
bhavasthaśūnyostu mitātmavāde |
ṣaḍjīvakāyaṃ tvamanantasaṃkhya-
mākhyastathā nātha yathā na doṣaḥ || 29 ||

mitātmavāde saṃkhyātānāmātmanāmabhyupagame dūṣaṇadvayamupatiṣṭhate |
tatkrameṇa darśayati | muktopi vābhyetu bhavamiti | muktaḥ nirvṛti-
māptaḥ | sopi vā | api vismaye | vāśabda uttaradoṣāpekṣayā
samuccayārthaḥ yathā devo vā dānavo veti | bhavamabhyetu saṃsāra-
mabhyāgacchatu | ityeko doṣaprasaṅgaḥ || bhavo vā bhavasthaśūnyostu |
bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ sa vā bhavasthaśūnyaḥ saṃsārijīvairvirahitaḥ astu
bhavatu | iti dvitīyo doṣaprasaṅgaḥ ||

idamatrākūtam | yadi parimitā evātmāno manyante tadā
tattvajñānābhyāsaprakarṣādikrameṇāpavargaṃ gacchatsu teṣu saṃbhāvyate khalu
sa kaścitkālo yatra teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ nirvṛtiḥ | kālasyānādinidha-
natvādātmanāṃ ca parimitatvātsaṃsārasya riktatā bhavantī kena
vāryatām | samunnīyate hi pratiniyatasalilapaṭalaparipūrite
sarasi pavanatapanātapanajanodañcanādinā kālāntare riktatā | na
cāyamarthaḥ prāmāṇikasya kasyacitprasiddhaḥ | saṃsārasya svarūpahā-
niprasaṅgāt | tatsvarūpaṃ hyetadyatra karmavaśavartinaḥ prāṇinaḥ saṃsaranti
samāsārṣuḥ saṃsariṣyanti ceti | sarveṣāṃ ca nirvṛtatve saṃsārasya vā
riktatvaṃ haṭhādabhyupagantavyam | muktairvā punarbhava āgantavyam | na
ca kṣīṇakarmaṇāṃ bhavādhikāraḥ |
dagdhe bīje yathātyantaṃ prādurbhavati nāṅkuraḥ |
karmabīje tathā dagdhe na rohati bhavāṅkuraḥ ||
iti vacanāt | āha ca patañjaliḥ | sati mūle tadvipāko jātyāyu-
rbhogā iti | etaṭṭīkā ca | satsu kleśeṣu karmāśayo vipākārambhī bhavati
nocchinnakleśamūlaḥ | yathā tuṣāvanaddhāḥ śālitaṇḍulā adagdhabīja-
bhāvāḥ prarohaṇasamarthā bhavanti nāpanītatuṣā dagdhabījabhāvā vā
tathā kleśāvanaddhaḥ karmāśayo vipākaprarohī bhavati | nāpanīta-
kleśo na prasaṃkhyānadagdhakleśabījabhāvo veti | sa ca vipākastri-
vidho jātirāyurbhoga iti | akṣapādopyāha | na pravṛttiḥ pratisa-
ndhānāya hīnakleśasya iti ||

evaṃ vibhaṅgajñāniśivarājarṣimatānusāriṇo dūṣayitvā uttarā-
rdhena bhagavadupajñamaparimitātmavādaṃ nirdoṣatayā stauti | ṣaṅjīve-
tyādi | tvaṃ tu he nātha tathā tena prakāreṇa anantasaṃkhyam ana-
ntākhyasaṃkhyāviśeṣayuktam ṣaḍjīvakāyam | ajīvan jīvanti jīvi-
ṣyanti ceti jīvāḥ indriyādijñānādidravyabhāvaprāṇadhāraṇayuktāḥ
teṣāṃ saṃdhevānūrdhve iti cinoterghañi ādeśca katve kāyaḥ
samūho jīvakāyaḥ pṛthivyādiḥ | ṣaṇṇāṃ jīvakāyānāṃ samāhāraḥ
ṣaḍjīvakāyam | pātrādidarśanānnapuṃsakatvam | atha vā ṣaṇṇāṃ
jīvānāṃ kāyaḥ pratyekaṃ saṃghātaḥ ṣaḍjīvakāyaḥ taṃ ṣaḍjīvakāyam |
pṛthivyaptejovāyuvanaspatitrasalakṣaṇaṣaḍjīvanikāyam | tathā tena
prakāreṇa | ākhyaḥ maryādayā prarūpitavān | yathā yena prakāreṇa | na
doṣaḥ dūṣaṇamiti | jātyapekṣamekavacanam | prāguktadoṣadvayajātīyā
anyepi doṣā yathā na prāduḥṣyanti tathā tvaṃ jīvānantyamupa-
diṣṭavānityarthaḥ | ākhya iti āṅpūrvasya khyāteraḍi siddhiḥ |
tvamityekavacanaṃ cedaṃ jñāpayati yajjagadgurorevaikasyedṛk prarūpaṇa-
sāmarthyaṃ na tīrthāntaraśāstṛṛṇāmiti ||

pṛthivyādīnāṃ punarjīvamitthaṃ sādhanīyam | yathā sātmikā
vidrumaśilādirūpā pṛthivī chede samānadhātūtthānāt arśoṅkuravat |
bhaumamambhopi sātmakaṃ kṣatabhūsajātīyasya svabhāvasya saṃbhavāt
śālūravat | āntarikṣamapi sātmakam abhrādivikāre svataḥ saṃbhūya
pātāt matsyādivat | tejopi sātmakam āhāropādānena vṛddhyādi-
vikāropalambhāt puruṣāṅgavat | vāyurapi sātmakaḥ aparapreritatve
tiryaggatimattvāt govat | vanaspatirapi sātmakaḥ chedādibhi-
rmlānyādidarśanāt puruṣāṅgavat | kaṣāṃcitsvāpāṅganopaśleṣādi-
vikārācca | apakarṣataścaitanyādvā sarveṣāṃ sātmakatvasiddhiḥ |
āptavacanācca | traseṣu ca kṛmipipīlikābhramaramanuṣyādiṣu na
keṣāṃcitsātmakatve vigānamiti ||

yathā ca bhagavadupajñe jīvānantye na doṣastathā diṅmātraṃ bhāvyate |
bhagavanmate hi ṣaṇṇāṃ jīvanikāyānāmetadalpabahutvam | sarvasto-
kāstrasakāyikāḥ | tebhyo'saṃkhyātaguṇāstejaskāyikāḥ | tebhyo
viśeṣādhikāḥ pṛthivīkāyikāḥ | tebhyo viśeṣādhikā apkā-
yikāḥ | tebhyopi viśeṣādhikā vāyukāyikāḥ | tebhyonantaguṇā
vanaspatikāyikāḥ | te ca vyāvahārikā avyāvahārikāśca |
golā ya asaṃkhijjā asaṃkhaṇigoa golao bhaṇio |
ikkikkammi ṇigoe aṇantajīvā muṇeavvā ||
sijjhaṃti jattiyā khalu iha saṃvavahārajīvarāsio |
eṃti aṇāivaṇassai rāsio tattiyā tammi ||
iti vacanāt | yāvantaśca yato muktiṃ gacchanti jīvāstāva
nto'nādinigodavanaspatirāśestatrāgacchanti | na ca tāvatā tasya
kācitparihāṇiḥ | nigodajīvānantyasyākṣayatvāt | nigodasvarūpaṃ ca
samayasāgarādavagantavyam | anādyanantepi kāle ye kecinnirvṛtā
nirvānti nirvāsyanti ca te nigodānāmanantabhāgepi na vartante
nāvartiṣata na vartsyanti | tataśca kathaṃ muktānāṃ bhavāgamanaprasaṅgaḥ
kathaṃ ca saṃsārasya riktatāprasaktiriti | abhipretaṃ caitadanyayūthyā-
nāmapi | yathā coktaṃ vārtikakāreṇa |
ata eva viśudhyatsu mucyamāneṣu saṃtatam |
brahmāṇḍalokajīvānāmanantatvādaśūnyatā ||
antyanyūnātiriktatvairyujyate parimāṇavat |
vastunyaparimeye tu nūnaṃ teṣāmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

adhunā paradarśanānāṃ parasparaviruddhārthasamarthakatayā matsaritvaṃ
prakāśayan sarvajñopajñasiddhāntasyānyonyānugatasarvanayamayatayā mā-
tsaryābhāvamāvirbhāvayati |
anyonyapakṣapratipakṣabhāvā-
dyathā pare matsariṇaḥ pravādāḥ |
nayānaśeṣānaviśeṣamicchan
na pakṣapātī samayastathā te || 30 ||

prakarṣeṇodyate pratipādyate svābhyupagatortho yairiti pravādāḥ |
yathā yena prakāreṇa | pare bhavacchāsanādanye | pravādā darśanāni |
matsariṇaḥ atiśāyane matvarthīyavidhānāt sātiśayāsahanatā-
śālinaḥ krodhakaṣāyakaluṣitāntakaraṇāḥ santaḥ pakṣapātina itarapakṣa-
tiraskāreṇa svakakṣīkṛtapakṣavyavasthāpanapravaṇā vartante | kasmād
hetormatsariṇa ityāha | anyonyapakṣapratipakṣabhāvāt | pacyate
vyaktīkriyate sādhyadharmavaiśiṣṭyena hetvādibhiriti pakṣaḥ | kakṣī-
kṛtadharmapratiṣṭhāpanāya sādhanopanyāsaḥ | tasya pratikūlaḥ pakṣaḥ prati-
pakṣaḥ | pakṣasya pratipakṣo virodhī pakṣaḥ pratipakṣaḥ | tasya bhāvaḥ pakṣa-
pratipakṣabhāvaḥ | anyonyaṃ parasparaṃ yaḥ pakṣapratipakṣabhāvaḥ pakṣapratipakṣatva-
manyonyapakṣapratipakṣabhāvaḥ tasmat | tathāhi | ya eva mīmāṃsakānāṃ
nityaḥ śabda iti pakṣaḥ sa eva saugatānāṃ pratipakṣaḥ | tanmate śabda-
syānityatvāt | ya eva saugatānāmanityaḥ śabda iti pakṣaḥ sa
eva mīmāṃsakānāṃ pratipakṣaḥ | evaṃ sarvaprayogeṣu yojyam | tathā
tena prakāreṇa | te tava | samyageti gacchati śabdorthamaneneti punnāmni
ghaḥ samayaḥ saṃketaḥ | yadvā samyag avaiparītyena īyante jñāyante
jīvā jīvādayorthā anena iti samayaḥ siddhāntaḥ | athavā samya-
gayante gacchanti jīvādayaḥ padārthāḥ svasmin rūpe pratiṣṭhāṃ
prāpnuvantyasminniti samaya āgamaḥ | na pakṣapātī naikapakṣānurāgī |
pakṣapātitvasya hi kāraṇaṃ matsaritvaṃ parapravādeṣūktam | tvatsama-
yasya ca matsaritvābhāvānna pakṣapātitvam | pakṣapātitvaṃ hi matsa-
ritvena vyāptaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca nivartamānaṃ vyāpyamapi nivartayatīti
matsaritve nivartamāne pakṣapātitvamapi nivartata iti bhāvaḥ |
tava samaya iti vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇe saṃbandhe ṣaṣṭhīṃ | sūtrāpekṣayā
gaṇadharakartṛkatvepi samayasyārthāpekṣayā bhagavatkartṛkatvādvācya-
vācakabhāvo na virudhyate | atthaṃ bhāsai arahā suttaṃ gaṃthaṃti gaṇaharā
ṇiuṇaṃ iti vacanāt | athavā utpādavyayadhrauvyaprapañcaḥ samayaḥ |
teṣāṃ ca bhagavatā sākṣānmātṛkāpadarūpatayābhidhānāt | tathā
cārṣam | uppanneivā vigameivā dhuveivā ityadāṣaḥ || matsari-
tvābhāvameva viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa samarthayati | nayānaśeṣānaviśaṣa-
micchan iti | aśeṣān samastānnayānnaigamādīnaviśeṣaṃ nirvi-
śeṣaṃ yathā bhavatyevam icchan ākāṅkṣan | sarvanayātmakatvādanekānta-
vādasya | yathā viśakalitānāṃ muktāmaṇīnāmekasūtrānusyūtānāṃ
hāravyapadeśa evaṃ pṛthagabhisandhīnāṃ nayānāṃ syādvādalakṣaṇaikasūtra-
protānāṃ śrutākhyapramāṇavyapadeśa iti | nanu pratyekaṃ nayānāṃ viru-
ddhatve kathaṃ samuditānāṃ nirvirodhitā | ucyate | yathā hi samī-
cīnaṃ madhyasthaṃ nyāyanirṇetāramāsādya parasparaṃ vivadamānā api
vādino vivādādviramanti evaṃ nayā anyonyaṃ vairāyamāṇā api
sarvajñaśāsanamupetya syācchabdaprayogopaśamitavipratipattayaḥ santaḥ
parasparamatyantaṃ suhṛdbhūyāvatiṣṭhante | evaṃ ca sarvanayātmakatve bhaga-
vatsamayasya sarvadarśanamayatvamaviruddhameva | nayarūpatvāddarśanānām |
na ca vācyaṃ tarhi bhagavatsamayasteṣu kathaṃ nopalabhyata iti | samu-
drasya sarvasarinmayatvepi vibhaktāsu tāsvanupalambhāt | tathā ca
vaktṛvacanayoraikyamadhyavasya śrīsiddhasenadivākarapādāḥ |
udadhāviva sarvasindhavaḥ
samudīrṇāstvayi nātha dṛṣṭayaḥ |
na ca tāsu bhavānpradṛśyate
pravibhaktāsu saritsvivodadhiḥ ||

anye tvevaṃ vyācakṣate | yathānyonyapakṣapratipakṣabhāvātpare
pravādā matsariṇastathā tava samayaḥ sarvanayānmadhyasthatayāṅgī-
kurvāṇo na matsarī | yataḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ | pakṣapātī pakṣamekapakṣābhi-
niveśaṃ pātayati tiraskarotīti pakṣapātī | rāgasya jīvanāśaṃ
naṣṭatvāt | atra ca vyākhyāne matsarīti vidheyapadaṃ pūrvasmiṃśca
pakṣapātīti viśeṣaḥ | atra ca kliṣṭākliṣṭavyākhyānaviveko viva-
kibhiḥ svayaṃ kāryaḥ | iti kāvyārthaḥ ||

itthaṃkāraṃ katipayapadārthavivecanadvāreṇa svāmino yathārthavādākhya-
gaṇamabhiṣṭutya samagravacanātiśayavyāvarṇane svasyāsāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭā-
ntapūrvakamupadarśayan auddhatyaparihārāya bhaṅgyantaratirohitaṃ svābhi-
dhānaṃ ca prakāśayan nigamanamāha--
vāgvaibhavaṃ te nikhilaṃ vivektu-
māśasamahe cenmahanīyamukhya |
laṅghema jaṅghālatayā samudraṃ
vahema candradyutipānatṛṣṇām || 31 ||

vibhava eva vaibhavam | prajñāditvātsvārthe'ṇ | vibhorbhāvaḥ
karma ceti vā vaibhavam | vācāṃ vaibhavaṃ vāgvaibhavaṃ vacanasaṃpa-
tprakarṣam | vibhorbhāva iti pakṣe tu sarvanayavyāpakatvam | vibhuśabdasya
vyāpakaparyāyatayā rūḍhatvāt | te tava saṃbandhinaṃ nikhilaṃ kṛtsnaṃ
vivektuṃ vicārayituṃ cet yadi vayamāśāsmahe icchāmaḥ | he mahanīya-
mukhya mahanīyāḥ pūjyāḥ pañca parameṣṭhinasteṣu mukhyaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ
ādyatvāt tasya saṃbodhanam | nanu siddhebhyo hīnaguṇatvādarhatāṃ kathaṃ
vāgatiśayaśālināmapi teṣāṃ mukhyatvam | na ca hīnaguṇatvama-
siddham | pravrajyāvasare siddhebhyasteṣāṃ namaskārakaraṇaśravaṇāt |
kāūṇa namukkāraṃ siddhāṇamabhiggahaṃtu so giṇhe iti śrutakeva-
livacanāt | maivam | arhadupadeśenaiva siddhānāmapi parijñānāt |
tathā cārṣam | arahantuvaeseṇa siddhā ṇajjhaṃti teṇa arihāī
iti | tataḥ siddhaṃ bhagavata eva mukhyatvam | yadi tava vāgvaibhavaṃ
nikhilaṃ vivektumāśāsmahe tataḥ kimityāha | laṅghema ityādi |
tadā ityadhyāhāryam | tadā jaṅghālatayā jāṅghikatayā vegava-
ttayā samudraṃ laṅghema kila samudramiva atikramāmaḥ | tathā vahema
dhārayema | candradyutīnāṃ candramarīcīnāṃ pānaṃ candradyutipānam |
tatra tṛṣṇā tarṣobhilāṣa iti yāvat candradyutipānatṛṣṇā tām |
ubhayatrāpi saṃbhāvane saptamī | yathā kaściccaraṇacaṅkramaṇavega-
vattayā yānapātrādyantareṇāpi samudraṃ laṅghitumīhate yathā ca
kaściccandramarīcīramṛtamayīḥ śrutvā culukādinā pātumicchati na
caitaddvayamapi śakyasādhanam tathā nyakṣeṇa bhavadīyavāgvaibhavavarṇa-
nākāṅkṣāpi aśakyārambhapravṛttitulyā | āstāṃ tāvattāvakīna-
vacanavibhavānāṃ sāmastyena vivecanavidhānaṃ tadviṣayākāṅkṣāpi
mahatsāhasamiti bhāvārthaḥ | athavā laghi śoṣaṇe iti dhātorlaṅghema
śoṣayema samudraṃ jaṅghālatayā atirahaṃsā | atikramaṇārthalaṅghestu
prayoge durlabhaṃ parasmaipadamanityaṃ cātmanepadamiti | atra ca
auddhatyaparihāredhikṛtepi yadāśāsmahe ityātmani bahuvacanamācāryaḥ
prayuktavāṃstaditi sūcayati yadvidyante jagati mādṛśā mandamedhaso
bhūyāṃsaḥ stotāraḥ iti bahuvacanamātreṇa na khalvahaṅkāraḥ stotari
prabhau śaṅkanīyaḥ pratyuta nirabhimānatāprāsādopari patākāropa
evāvadhāraṇīyaḥ | iti kāvyārthaḥ ||
eṣu ekatriṃśativṛtteṣu upajāticchandaḥ ||

evaṃ vipratārakaiḥ paratīrthikairvyāmohamaye tamasi nimajjitasya
jagatobhyuddharaṇe'vyabhicārivacanatāsādhyenānyayogavyavacchedena bha-
gavata eva sāmarthyaṃ darśayan tadupāstivinyastamānasānāṃ puru-
ṣāṇāmaucitīcaturatāṃ pratipādayati |
idaṃ tattvātattvavyatikarakarālendhatamase
jaganmāyākārairiva hataparairhā vinihatam |
taduddhartuṃ śakto niyatamavisaṃvādivacana-
stvamevātastrātastvayi kṛtasaparyāḥ kṛtadhiyaḥ || 32 ||

idaṃ pratyakṣopalabhyamānaṃ jagat viśvam upacārājjagadvartī janaḥ |
hataparaiḥ hatā adhamā ye pare tīrthāntarīyā hatapare taiḥ | māyākāraiḥ
indrajālikairiva śāmbarīyaprayoganipuṇairiveti yāvat | andha-
tamase nibiḍāndhakāre | hā iti khede | vinihataṃ viśeṣeṇa nihitaṃ
sthāpitaṃ pātitamityarthaḥ | andhaṃ karotītyandhayati andhayatī-
tyandhaṃ tacca tattamaścetyandhatamasam samavāndhāttamasaḥ ityatpratyayaḥ
tasminnandhatamase | kathaṃbhūtendhatamase iti dravyāndhakāravyavacche-
dārthamāha | tattvātattvavyatikarakarāle | tattvaṃ cātattvaṃ ca tattvā-
tattve tayorvyatikaro vyatikīrṇatā vyāmiśratā svabhāvavini-
mayastattvātattvavyatikaraḥ tena karāle bhayaṅkare | yatrāndhatamase
tattve atattvābhiniveśoatattve ca tattvābhiniveśa ityevaṃrūpo vyati-
karaḥ saṃjāyata ityarthaḥ | anena ca viśeṣaṇena paramārthato
mithyātvamohanīyamevāndhatamasam | tasyaivedṛśalakṣaṇatvāt | tathā ca
granthāntare prastutastutikārapādāḥ |
adeve devabuddhiryā gurudhīragurau ca yā |
adharme dharmabuddhiśca mithyātvaṃ tadviparyayāt ||
tatoyamarthaḥ | yathā kila aindrajālikāstathāvidhasuśikṣitapara-
vyāmohanakalāprapañcāstathāvidhamauṣadhīmantrahastalāghavādiprāyaṃ kiṃ-
citprayujya pariṣajjanaṃ māyāmaye tamasi majjayanti tathā paratī-
rthikairapi tādṛkprakāraduradhītakutarkayuktīrupadarśya jagadidaṃ vyāmo-
hamahāndhakāre nikṣiptamiti | tajjagaduddhartuṃ mohamahāndhakāropapla-
vāt kraṣṭuṃ niyataṃ niścitaṃ tvameva nānyaḥ śaktaḥ samarthaḥ | kima-
rthamitthamekasyaivaṃ bhagavataḥ sāmarthyamupavarṇyata iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa
kāraṇamāha | avisaṃvādivacanaḥ | kaṣacchedatāpalakṣaṇaparīkṣātraya-
viśuddhatvena phalaprāptau na visaṃvadatītyevaṃśīlamavisaṃvādi | tathā-
bhūtaṃ vacanamupadeśo yasyāsāvavisaṃvādivacanaḥ | avyabhicāri-
vāgityarthaḥ | yathā ca pārameśvarī vāg na visaṃvādamāsādayati tathā
tatra tatra syādvādasādhane darśitam | kaṣādisvarūpaṃ cetthamācakṣate
prāvacanikāḥ ||
pāṇavahāīāṇaṃ pāvadvāṇāṇa jo u paḍiseho |
jhāṇajjhayaṇāīṇaṃ jo ya vihī esa dhammakaso ||
bajjhāṇuṭṭhāṇeṇaṃ jeṇa ṇa bāhijjae tayaṃ ṇiyamā |
saṃbhavai ya parisuddhaṃ so puṇa dhammammi cheutti ||
jīvāibhāvavāo baṃdhāipasāhago ihaṃ tāvo |
eehiṃ parisuddho dhammo dhammattaṇamuvei ||
tīrthāntarīyāptā hi na prakṛtaparīkṣātrayaviśuddhavādina iti te
mahāmohāndhatamasa eva jagatpātayituṃ samarthā na punastaduddhartum |
ataḥ kāraṇāt | kutaḥ kāraṇāt | kumatadhvāntārṇavāntaḥpatitabhu-
vanābhyuddhāraṇāsādhāraṇasāmarthyalakṣaṇāt | he trātaḥ tribhuvanapari-
trāṇapravīṇa | tvayi kākvāvadhāraṇasya gamyamānatvāt tvayyeva
viṣaye na devāntare | kṛtadhiyaḥ | karotiratra parikarmaṇi vartate
yathā hastau kuru pādau kuru iti | kṛtā parikarmitā tattvopadeśa-
peśalatattacchāstrābhyāsaprakarṣeṇa saṃskṛtā dhīrbuddhiryeṣāṃ te kṛtadhiyaḥ
cidrūpāḥ puruṣāḥ | kṛtasaparyāḥ | prādikaṃ vināpyādikarmaṇo
gamyamānatvāt | kṛtā kartumārabdhā saparyā sevāvidhiryaiste kṛta-
saparyāḥ | ārādhyāntaraparityāgena tvayyeva sevāhevākitāṃ pari-
śīlayanti | iti śikhariṇīcchandolaṅkṛtakāvyārthaḥ ||
samāptā ceyamanyayogavyavacchedadvātriṃśikāstavanaṭīkā ||
yeṣāmujjvalahetuhetiruciraḥ prāmāṇikādhvaspṛśāṃ
hemācāryasamudbhavastavanabhūrarthaḥ samarthaḥ sakhā |
teṣāṃ durnayadasyusaṃbhavabhayāspṛṣṭātmanāṃ saṃbhava-
tyāyāsena vinā jināgamapuraprāptiḥ śivaśrīpradā || 1 ||
cāturvaidyamahodadherbhagavataḥ śrīhemasūrergirāṃ
gambhīrārthavilokanaṃ yadabhavaddṛṣṭiḥ prakṛṣṭā mama |
drāghīyaḥ samayādarāgrahaparābhūtaprabhūtāvamaṃ
tannūnaṃ gurupādareṇukaṇikāsiddhāñjanasyorjitam || 2 ||
anyānyaśāstratarusaṃgatacittahāri-
puṣpopameyakaticinnicitaprameyaiḥ |
dṛbdhāṃ mayāntimajinastutivṛttimenāṃ
mālāmivāmalahṛdo hṛdaye vahantu || 3 ||
pramāṇasiddhāntaviruddhamatra
yatkiṃciduktaṃ matimāndyadoṣāt |
mātsaryamutsārya tadāryacittāḥ
prasādamādhāya viśodhayantu || 4 ||
urvyāmeṣa sudhābhujāṃ gururiti trailokyavistāriṇo
yatreyaṃ pratibhābharādanumitirnirdambhamujjṛmbhate |
kiṃ cāmī vibudhāḥ sudheti vacanodgāraṃ yadīyaṃ mudā
śaṃsantaḥ prathayanti tāmatitamāṃ saṃvādamedasvinīm || 5 ||
nāgendragacchagovindavakṣolaṅkārakaustubhāḥ |
te viśvavandyā nandyāsurudayaprabhasūrayaḥ || 6 || yugmam ||
śrīmalliṣeṇasūribhirakāri tatpadagaganadinamaṇibhiḥ |
vṛttiriyaṃ manuravimitaśākābde dīpamahasi śanau || 7 ||
śrījinaprabhasūrīṇāṃ sāhāyyodbhinnasaurabhā |
śrutāvuttaṃsatu satāṃ vṛttiḥ syādvādamañjarī || 8 ||
bibhrāṇe kalinirjaryājjinatulāṃ śrīhemacandraprabhau
taddṛbdhastutivṛttinirmitimiṣādbhaktirmayā vistṛtā |
nirṇetuṃ guṇadūṣaṇe nijagirāṃ tannārthaye sajjanāṃ-
stasyāstattvamakṛtrimaṃ bahumatiḥ sāstyatra samyag yataḥ || 9 ||
iti śrīṭīkākārasya praśastiḥ samāptā ||
